/* === patch.css === */
/* SuperSynthLab - Patch Screen Styles (v15.1.290) */

#screen-patch {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: #0d0d1a;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

#screen-patch.active {
  display: flex;
}

/* Toolbar */
.patch-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: #111122;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #333355;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  overflow: visible;
  max-height: 40px;
  position: relative;
}

.patch-tool-btn {
  padding: 4px 12px;
  font-size: 11px;
  background: #222244;
  color: #cccccc;
  border: 1px solid #444466;
  border-radius: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: monospace;
}

.patch-tool-btn:hover {
  background: #333366;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.patch-toolbar-sep {
  color: #333;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.patch-toolbar-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #9999bb;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-family: monospace;
}

.patch-select {
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  background: #222244;
  color: #cccccc;
  border: 1px solid #444466;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-family: monospace;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Workspace: palette + canvas + param panel */
.patch-main {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 0;
}

/* Node Palette */
.patch-palette {
  width: 260px;
  background: #111122;
  border-right: 1px solid #333355;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  align-content: start;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 4px;
  transition: width 0.2s;
  gap: 2px;
}

.patch-palette.collapsed {
  width: 28px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.palette-cat-title {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  color: #888888;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 8px 4px 2px 4px;
}

.palette-item,
.sp-palette-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: left;
  background: #1a1a2e;
  color: #cccccc;
  border: 1px solid #333355;
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.palette-item:hover,
.sp-palette-item:hover {
  background: #252545;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: #5555aa;
}

.sp-palette-item svg,
.palette-item svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.patch-tool-btn svg {
  vertical-align: middle;
  margin-right: 4px;
}

.patch-toolbar-label svg {
  vertical-align: middle;
  margin-right: 4px;
}

/* Canvas */
.patch-canvas-container {
  flex: 1;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 0;
}

.patch-canvas-container canvas {
  display: block;
  background: #0d0d1a;
  cursor: default;
}

/* Parameter Panel */
.patch-param-panel {
  width: 200px;
  background: #111122;
  border-left: 1px solid #333355;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 8px;
}

.param-panel-title {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin: 0 0 4px 0;
}

.param-panel-type {
  color: #888888;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  margin: 0 0 8px 0;
}

.param-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.param-row label {
  color: #aaaaaa;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.param-row input[type="range"] {
  width: 100%;
  height: 14px;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  background: #222244;
  border: 1px solid #444466;
  border-radius: 2px;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.param-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 6px;
  height: 14px;
  background: #0088FF;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.param-row input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 6px;
  height: 14px;
  background: #0088FF;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.param-row .param-value {
  color: #aaaaaa;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 8px;
  text-align: right;
}

.param-row select {
  background: #222244;
  color: #cccccc;
  border: 1px solid #444466;
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.param-delete-btn {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 6px;
  background: #442222;
  color: #ff6666;
  border: 1px solid #663333;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.param-delete-btn:hover {
  background: #663333;
  color: #ff9999;
}

/* Macro area */
.patch-macro-area {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: #111122;
  border-top: 1px solid #333355;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  min-height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.patch-macro-area .macro-label {
  color: #888888;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.patch-macro-slider {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 2px;
}

.patch-macro-slider label {
  color: #CC44FF;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
}

.patch-macro-slider input[type="range"] {
  width: 120px;
  height: 16px;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  background: #222244;
  border: 1px solid #444466;
  border-radius: 2px;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.patch-macro-slider input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 8px;
  height: 16px;
  background: #CC44FF;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.patch-macro-slider input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 8px;
  height: 16px;
  background: #CC44FF;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.patch-macro-slider .macro-value {
  color: #aaaaaa;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 8px;
  text-align: right;
  width: 120px;
}

/* Recipe Browser — popover overlay, not inline */
.sp-recipe-browser {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: 100%;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  overflow-y: auto;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 120px);
  padding: 8px;
  background: #0a0a14;
  border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px;
  border: 1px solid #333355;
  border-top: none;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}

.sp-recipe-browser.open {
  display: block;
}

.sp-recipe-category {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.sp-recipe-cat-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 0;
  color: #8888cc;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.sp-recipe-cat-icon svg {

  height: 14px;
}

.sp-recipe-cat-grid {

  gap: 6px;
}

.sp-recipe-card {

  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 6px 4px;
  background: #12122a;
  border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
}

.sp-recipe-card:hover {
  border-color: #6a6aff;
  background: #1a1a3a;
}

.sp-recipe-card.active {
  border-color: #6a6aff;
  background: #1e1e44;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(106, 106, 255, 0.3);
}

.sp-recipe-card-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  color: #aaaadd;
}

.sp-recipe-card-icon svg {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}

.sp-recipe-card-name {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  color: #ccccee;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.2;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.sp-recipe-card.active .sp-recipe-card-name {
  color: #ffffff;
}

    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.ssl-feedback-overlay.visible {
    display: flex;
}

.ssl-feedback-modal {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #4cc9f0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px;
    width: 380px;
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 80vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15);
}

.ssl-feedback-title {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-align: center;
}

.ssl-feedback-element-id {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #888;
    background: #2a2a4e;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-family: monospace;
    text-align: center;
}

.ssl-feedback-label {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #aaa;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    display: block;
}

.ssl-feedback-rating {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ssl-feedback-rating-btn {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    border: 1px solid #444;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #2a2a4e;
    color: #ccc;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
}

.ssl-feedback-rating-btn:hover {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
    color: #fff;
}

.ssl-feedback-rating-btn.selected {
    background: #4cc9f0;
    color: #111;
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.ssl-feedback-textarea {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 80px;
    padding: 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    border: 1px solid #444;
    background: #2a2a4e;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
    resize: vertical;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.ssl-feedback-textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
}

.ssl-feedback-submit {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 8px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4cc9f0, #7209b7);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.ssl-feedback-submit:hover {
    opacity: 0.85;
}

.ssl-feedback-submit:disabled {
    opacity: 0.4;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

.ssl-feedback-success {
    text-align: center;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: none;
}

/* ========================================
   About Button
   ======================================== */

.ssl-about-btn {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid #555;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    margin-left: 4px;
}

.ssl-about-btn:hover {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.1);
}

/* ========================================
   Prominent About Button (title bar)
   ======================================== */

.ssl-about-prominent {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid #7c6fff;
    color: #aab;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-left: 8px;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.ssl-about-prominent:hover {
    background: #1a1a30;
    color: #e0e0ff;
}

/* ========================================
   About Modal
   ======================================== */

.ssl-about-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    z-index: 100002;
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.ssl-about-overlay.visible {
    display: flex;
}

.ssl-about-modal {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #4cc9f0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 24px;
    width: 420px;
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 85vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15);
}

.ssl-about-header {
    text-align: center;

}

.ssl-about-header h2 {

.ssl-about-separator {

.ssl-about-section-title {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin: 14px 0 6px 0;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-align: center;
}

.ssl-about-section-sep {
    border: none;
    border-top: 1px solid #444;
    margin: 2px 0;
}

.ssl-about-info {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #ccc;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.ssl-about-features {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0 0 8px 0;
}

.ssl-about-features li {
    font-size: 0.58rem;
    color: #bbb;
    padding: 2px 0 2px 12px;
    position: relative;
}

.ssl-about-features li::before {

    left: 0;

.ssl-about-btn-action {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font-size: 0.58rem;
    border: 1px solid #4cc9f0;

    background: transparent;
    color: #4cc9f0;

    transition: background 0.15s;
    margin: 4px 4px;
}

.ssl-about-btn-action:hover {
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15);
}

.ssl-about-feedback-count {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: #888;
    margin-left: 6px;
}

.ssl-about-contact {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: #888;
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 10px;
}

.ssl-about-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 8px;
    right: 12px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #888;
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.ssl-about-close:hover {
    color: #fff;
}

.ssl-about-modal-inner {
    position: relative;
}

/* ========================================
   Donate Sub-Panel
   ======================================== */

.ssl-donate-panel {
    background: #2a2a4e;
    border: 1px solid #555;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 14px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: none;
}

.ssl-donate-panel.visible {
    display: block;
}

.ssl-donate-panel p {
    font-size: 0.58rem;
    color: #ccc;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.ssl-donate-panel ul {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
}

.ssl-donate-panel ul li {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: #bbb;
    padding: 2px 0 2px 12px;
    position: relative;
}

.ssl-donate-panel ul li::before {
    content: "\2022";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    color: #4cc9f0;
}


/* === sidebar.css === */
/* === Sidebar Navigation === */

/* Main layout: sidebar + screens side by side */
body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* Sidebar container — permanent fixture, 3-column icon grid, NO scrolling */
.ssl-sidebar {
    width: 138px;
    min-width: 138px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    height: 100vh;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-right: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 100;
}

/* Sidebar header / brand */
.sidebar-header {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #7c6fff;
    padding: 6px 4px 2px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Group container */
.sidebar-group {
    padding: 0 3px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Group label (PLAY, CREATE, etc.) — bold separator */
.sidebar-group-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #889;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    padding: 5px 4px 2px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    text-align: center;
    border-top: 1px solid #222244;
}

/* Button grid within each group — 3 columns */
.sidebar-group-buttons {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2px;
}

/* Sidebar button — compact cell with icon + label */
.sidebar-btn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: #99a;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 4px 2px 3px;
    border-left: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: inherit;
    min-height: 34px;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Sub-tab entries: slightly dimmer */
.sidebar-btn[data-tab] {
    opacity: 0.85;
}

.sidebar-btn:hover {
    background: #1a1a33;
    color: #dde;
}

.sidebar-btn.active {
    border-left-color: #7c6fff;
    color: #e8e8ff;
    background: #1a1a35;
}

/* Icon in button — large and clear */
.sidebar-icon {
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 18px;
    line-height: 1;
}

.sidebar-btn.active .sidebar-icon {
    filter: brightness(1.3);
}

/* Label in button — readable, no overflow */
.sidebar-label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: inherit;
    margin-top: 2px;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 48px;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

/* Allow multi-line labels (e.g. Vox Machina) */
.sidebar-btn[data-screen="voxmachina"] .sidebar-label {
    white-space: normal;
    font-size: 9px;
    line-height: 1.15;
}

/* Screens container — fills remaining space next to sidebar */
.ssl-screens {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* Individual screen — scrollable if content exceeds viewport */
.ssl-screen {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

.ssl-screen.active {
    display: block;
}

/* Placeholder for future screens */
.screen-placeholder {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 80vh;
    font-size: 22px;
    color: #556;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* Small screens: sidebar becomes bottom bar */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .ssl-sidebar {
        position: fixed;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        top: auto;
        width: 100% !important;
        min-width: 100% !important;
        height: 54px;
        flex-direction: row;
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: hidden;
        border-right: none;
        border-top: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
    }

    .sidebar-header,
    .sidebar-group-label {
        display: none;
    }

    .sidebar-group {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .sidebar-group-buttons {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
    }

    .sidebar-btn {
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 4px 8px;
        border-left: none;
        border-top: 3px solid transparent;
        min-width: 48px;
        min-height: auto;
    }

    .sidebar-btn.active {
        border-left-color: transparent;
        border-top-color: #7c6fff;
    }

    .sidebar-icon {
        width: auto;
        min-width: auto;
        font-size: 20px;
    }

    .sidebar-label {
        display: block;
        font-size: 9px;
        font-weight: 600;
        opacity: 1;
        margin-left: 0;
        margin-top: 2px;
        max-width: none;
    }

    .ssl-screens {
        margin-bottom: 54px;
    }
}

/* High Contrast Mode (US-20) */
.ssl-high-contrast {
    --hc-text: #ffffff;
    --hc-bg: #000000;
    --hc-accent: #ffff00;
    --hc-border: #ffffff;
}

.ssl-high-contrast .ssl-sidebar {
    background: #000;
    border-right-color: #fff;
}

.ssl-high-contrast .sidebar-btn {
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #666;
}

.ssl-high-contrast .sidebar-btn.active {
    background: #ffff00;
    color: #000;
}

.ssl-high-contrast .ssl-screen {
    background: #000;
    color: #fff;
}

.ssl-high-contrast button,
.ssl-high-contrast select,
.ssl-high-contrast input {
    border-color: #fff !important;
    color: #fff !important;
}

.ssl-high-contrast .learn-tab-btn.active {
    color: #ffff00;
    border-bottom-color: #ffff00;
}


/* === start-screen.css === */
/* ========================================
   Sidebar Fullscreen Mode — start screen
   ======================================== */

/* Branding block — compact in sidebar mode */
.sidebar-branding {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 6px 2px 4px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Hero star — sidebar mode: compact kids button */
.ssl-hero-star .sidebar-icon {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: #ffcc00;
}

.ssl-hero-star .sidebar-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #ffcc00;
}

.sidebar-title {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    color: #7c6fff;
    line-height: 1.1;
}

.sidebar-subtitle {
    display: none;
}

.sidebar-credit {
    display: none;
}

.sidebar-version-badge {
    display: none;
}

/* About button — shows in sidebar mode only */
.sidebar-about-btn {
    display: block;
    margin: 2px auto 4px;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #7c6fff;
    border: 1px solid #7c6fff;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    width: 90%;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.sidebar-about-btn:hover {
    background: #2a2a4e;
}

/* ----------------------------------------
   FULLSCREEN mode — sidebar becomes the
   entire viewport as a welcome/start screen
   ---------------------------------------- */

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    z-index: 10000;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a1a 0%, #14142e 25%, #1a0a2e 50%, #0a1a2e 75%, #0a0a1a 100%);
    background-size: 400% 400%;
    animation: ssl-bg-shift 20s ease infinite;
    border-right: none;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 6px 24px 6px;
}

@keyframes ssl-bg-shift {
    0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
}

/* Hide About button in fullscreen mode */
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-about-btn {
    display: none;
}

/* Branding — tight in fullscreen, no wasted vertical space */
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-branding {
    padding: 0 0 2px;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────
   Hero Kids Star — the ONE big star
   Higher specificity to beat .sidebar-btn
   ────────────────────────────────────── */
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn.ssl-hero-star {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 90px;
    height: 90px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.12) 0%, rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.06) 50%, transparent 75%);
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.25);
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0;
    min-height: 90px;
    backdrop-filter: none;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn.ssl-hero-star .sidebar-icon {
    font-size: 42px;
    color: #ffcc00;
    text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.5), 0 0 50px rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.25), 0 0 80px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.1);
    animation: ssl-star-glow 3s ease-in-out infinite, ssl-star-float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
    line-height: 1;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn.ssl-hero-star .sidebar-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #ffdd44;
    letter-spacing: 5px;
    margin-top: 2px;
    max-width: none;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.3);
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn.ssl-hero-star:hover {
    transform: scale(1.1);
    border-color: rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.6);
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.22) 0%, rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.1) 50%, transparent 75%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.35), 0 0 60px rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.15), 0 0 100px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.05);
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn.ssl-hero-star:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.2);
}

@keyframes ssl-star-glow {
    0%, 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.5), 0 0 50px rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.25); }
    50% { text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.7), 0 0 70px rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.4), 0 0 110px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.15); }
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────
   Title — big, centered, shimmering
   ────────────────────────────────────── */
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-title {
    font-size: 32px;
    letter-spacing: 10px;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4cc9f0, #7209b7, #f72585, #4cc9f0);
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
    animation: ssl-title-shimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.35));
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-subtitle {
    display: block;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 5px;
    text-align: center;
    color: #c8c8ff;
    text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(120, 140, 255, 0.4);
    margin-top: 0;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-credit {
    display: block;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #8888bb;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    margin-top: 2px;
    text-align: center;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-version-badge {
    display: block;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: #6a6aff;
    margin-top: 2px;
    text-align: center;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────
   Groups grid — fit everything on one page
   ────────────────────────────────────── */
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    grid-auto-rows: 1fr;
    gap: 2px 10px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1100px;
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-group {
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-group-label {
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    color: #7777aa;
    border-top: none;
    background: none;
    padding: 2px 2px 1px;
    text-align: center;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-group-buttons {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    grid-auto-rows: 1fr;
    gap: 3px;
    flex: 1;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────
   Buttons — stretch to fill grid cells
   ────────────────────────────────────── */
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn {
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    min-height: 0;
    background: rgba(16, 16, 32, 0.7);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.12);
    border-left: 1px solid rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.12);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 10px 6px 8px;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(30, 30, 60, 0.8);
    border-color: rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.4);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.2), 0 0 40px rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.08);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn:active {
    transform: translateY(1px);
    box-shadow: none;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn.active {
    border-color: rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.35);
    border-left-color: rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.35);
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-icon {
    font-size: 32px;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    max-width: 120px;
    margin-top: 4px;
    color: #9999bb;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn:hover .sidebar-label {
    color: #c8c8ee;

/* ──────────────────────────────────────
   Keyframe animations
   ────────────────────────────────────── */

@keyframes ssl-title-shimmer {
    0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
}

@keyframes ssl-star-float {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
}

@keyframes ssl-fade-in-up {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(16px);
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Staggered entrance animations */
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-btn.ssl-hero-star {
    animation: ssl-fade-in-up 0.6s ease-out forwards;
    opacity: 0;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-branding {
    animation: ssl-fade-in-up 0.5s ease-out 0.1s forwards;
    opacity: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .ssl-waveform-divider {
    display: none;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid {
    animation: ssl-fade-in-up 0.4s ease-out 0.2s forwards;
    opacity: 0;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid .sidebar-group {
    animation: ssl-fade-in-up 0.3s ease-out forwards;
    opacity: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid .sidebar-group:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.25s; }
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid .sidebar-group:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid .sidebar-group:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.35s; }
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid .sidebar-group:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid .sidebar-group:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.45s; }
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid .sidebar-group:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.ssl-sidebar.fullscreen .sidebar-groups-grid .sidebar-group:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 0.55s; }


/* === perform.css === */
/**
 * perform.css - PERFORM screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Keyboard-focused performance view with minimal UI
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-perform {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* ========================================
   Top Bar
   ======================================== */

.perform-top-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    min-height: 32px;
}

.perform-top-bar label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.perform-select {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    max-width: 140px;
}

.perform-select:hover {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
}

.perform-select-sm {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    padding: 2px 4px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.perform-btn {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    background: #3a0ca3;
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.perform-btn:hover {
    background: #4cc9f0;
    color: #000;
}

.perform-note-readout {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-weight: 700;
    min-width: 80px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-left: auto;
}

#performVolume {
    width: 70px;
    height: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* ========================================
   Main Layout
   ======================================== */

.perform-main {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ========================================
   Keyboard Area
   ======================================== */

.perform-keyboard-area {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    min-width: 0;
}

.perform-keyboard {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
}

/* ========================================
   Performance Keys
   ======================================== */

.perf-key {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    transition: background 0.05s, box-shadow 0.05s;
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* White Keys - Large */
.perf-key.perf-white {
    width: 60px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f5f5f0 0%, #ddd8d0 100%);
    border: 1px solid #777;
    border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px;
    color: #333;
    z-index: 1;
    margin: 0 1px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
}

/* Black Keys - Proportional */
.perf-key.perf-black {
    width: 38px;
    height: 55%;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3a3a 0%, #141414 100%);
    border: 1px solid #000;
    border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px;
    color: #999;
    z-index: 2;
    margin: 0 -18px;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
}

/* Playing/Active State */
.perf-key.perf-white.perf-active {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3ddc84 0%, #28a060 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(61, 220, 132, 0.5);
    color: #000;
}

.perf-key.perf-black.perf-active {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2ac070 0%, #1a8048 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(42, 192, 112, 0.4);
    color: #000;
}

/* Key label at bottom */
.perf-key-label {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    opacity: 0.7;
    pointer-events: none;
}

/* Computer key binding label */
.perf-key-binding {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    opacity: 0.5;
    margin-top: 2px;
    pointer-events: none;
    color: #4cc9f0;
}

/* ========================================
   Chromatic Pitch-Class Colors (Piano)
   Each pitch class gets a subtle color tint on white keys
   and a colored strip on black keys
   ======================================== */

/* White key tints — subtle gradient overlay */
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-0  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe0e0 0%, #e0c8c0 100%); } /* C  - red */
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-2  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe8d0 0%, #e0d0c0 100%); } /* D  - orange */
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-4  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff8d0 0%, #e0dcc0 100%); } /* E  - yellow */
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-5  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e8ffd8 0%, #c8e0c0 100%); } /* F  - green */
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-7  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d8f0ff 0%, #c0d8e0 100%); } /* G  - cyan */
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-9  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e0e0ff 0%, #c8c8e0 100%); } /* A  - blue */
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-11 { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0d8ff 0%, #d8c8e0 100%); } /* B  - purple */

/* Black key color accents — colored gradient */
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-1  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5a2020 0%, #2a0a0a 100%); } /* C# - dark red */
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-3  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5a4020 0%, #2a1a0a 100%); } /* D# - dark orange */
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-6  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #205a30 0%, #0a2a10 100%); } /* F# - dark green */
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-8  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #204050 0%, #0a1a2a 100%); } /* G# - dark teal */
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-10 { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a2050 0%, #1a0a2a 100%); } /* A# - dark purple */

/* Active states preserve color identity */
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-0.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff6666 0%, #cc3030 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-2.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffaa44 0%, #cc7720 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-4.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffdd44 0%, #ccaa20 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-5.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #66dd66 0%, #30aa30 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-7.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #44bbff 0%, #2088cc 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-9.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #6666ff 0%, #3030cc 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-white.pc-11.perf-active { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #bb66ff 0%, #8830cc 100%); }

.perf-key.perf-black.pc-1.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #cc4444 0%, #882020 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-3.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #cc8833 0%, #885518 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-6.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #44bb55 0%, #208830 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-8.perf-active  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3399cc 0%, #186688 100%); }
.perf-key.perf-black.pc-10.perf-active { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #9944cc 0%, #662088 100%); }

/* ========================================
   Chromatic Pitch-Class Colors (Iso Grid)
   Each cell gets a distinct background hue
   ======================================== */

.perf-iso-key.pc-0  { background: #3a1a1a; border-color: #884444; } /* C  - red */
.perf-iso-key.pc-1  { background: #3a2218; border-color: #885533; } /* C# */
.perf-iso-key.pc-2  { background: #3a2a14; border-color: #886622; } /* D  - orange */
.perf-iso-key.pc-3  { background: #3a3214; border-color: #887722; } /* D# */
.perf-iso-key.pc-4  { background: #343a14; border-color: #778822; } /* E  - yellow */
.perf-iso-key.pc-5  { background: #1a3a1a; border-color: #448844; } /* F  - green */
.perf-iso-key.pc-6  { background: #143a2a; border-color: #228866; } /* F# */
.perf-iso-key.pc-7  { background: #143a3a; border-color: #228888; } /* G  - cyan */
.perf-iso-key.pc-8  { background: #142a3a; border-color: #226688; } /* G# */
.perf-iso-key.pc-9  { background: #1a1a3a; border-color: #444488; } /* A  - blue */
.perf-iso-key.pc-10 { background: #2a1a3a; border-color: #664488; } /* A# */
.perf-iso-key.pc-11 { background: #3a1a3a; border-color: #884488; } /* B  - purple */

/* Iso hover — brighten */
.perf-iso-key.pc-0:hover  { background: #4a2a2a; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-1:hover  { background: #4a3228; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-2:hover  { background: #4a3a24; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-3:hover  { background: #4a4224; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-4:hover  { background: #444a24; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-5:hover  { background: #2a4a2a; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-6:hover  { background: #244a3a; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-7:hover  { background: #244a4a; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-8:hover  { background: #243a4a; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-9:hover  { background: #2a2a4a; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-10:hover { background: #3a2a4a; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-11:hover { background: #4a2a4a; }

/* Iso playing — bright saturated */
.perf-iso-key.pc-0.playing  { background: #882222; border-color: #ff4444; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-1.playing  { background: #884422; border-color: #ff8844; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-2.playing  { background: #886622; border-color: #ffaa44; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-3.playing  { background: #888822; border-color: #ffdd44; }
.perf-iso-key.pc-4.playing  { background: #668822; border-color: #bbff44; }

/* Iso root override — brighter version of its pitch class */
.perf-iso-key.root { background: #5a2222; border-color: #cc5555; }

/* Drum pad colors — each pad gets a unique accent */

/* ========================================
   Side Panel
   ======================================== */

.perform-side {
    width: 210px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    background: #0e0e1a;
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.perform-analyzer {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #0a0a14;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.perform-arp-toggle {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.perform-arp-toggle label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    cursor: pointer;
}

#performArpToggle:checked + span,
.perform-arp-toggle label:has(input:checked) {
    color: #3ddc84;
}

/* ========================================
   Responsive: Fewer octaves on small screens
   ======================================== */

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
    .perf-key.perf-white {
        width: 48px;
    }
    .perf-key.perf-black {
        width: 30px;
        margin: 0 -14px;
    }
    .perform-side {
        width: 170px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
    .perf-key.perf-white {
        width: 36px;
    }
    .perf-key.perf-black {
        width: 24px;
        margin: 0 -11px;
    }
    .perform-side {
        width: 140px;
    }
    .perform-top-bar {
        gap: 0.3rem;
        padding: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
    }
}

/* ========================================
   Compact Controls (side panel)
   ======================================== */

.perform-compact-section {
    margin: 6px 0;
    padding: 4px 6px;
    background: rgba(20,20,40,0.5);
    border-radius: 4px;
}
.perform-compact-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #9999bb;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.perform-compact-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    margin: 2px 0;
}
.perform-compact-lbl {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #9999bb;
    min-width: 58px;
    text-align: right;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.perform-compact-slider {
    flex: 1;
    height: 10px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: #222;
    border-radius: 3px;
    outline: none;
}
.perform-compact-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 10px;
    height: 14px;
    background: #4cc9f0;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.perform-fx-toggle {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #444;
    color: #9999bb;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 3px 6px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 0 2px;
}
.perform-fx-toggle.active {
    background: #264a26;
    color: #4cff4c;
    border-color: #4c4;
}

/* ========================================
   Isomorphic Grid
   ======================================== */

.perf-iso-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 10px;
    width: 100%;
}
.perf-iso-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
}
.perf-iso-key {
    width: 44px;
    height: 38px;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #aab;
    font-size: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    transition: background 0.05s;
}
.perf-iso-key:hover {
    background: #2a2a4e;
}
.perf-iso-key.root {
    background: #2a1a4e;
    border-color: #7c6fff;
}
.perf-iso-key.root:hover {
    background: #3a2a5e;
}
.perf-iso-key.playing {
    background: #3a5a3a;
    border-color: #6f6;
}
/* Hex tessellation — absolute positioned, proper geometry */
.perf-hex-grid {
    margin: 10px auto;
}

.perf-iso-key.hex {
    clip-path: polygon(25% 0%, 75% 0%, 100% 50%, 75% 100%, 25% 100%, 0% 50%);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 9px;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    transition: background 0.05s;
}

/* ========================================
   Drum Pads
   ======================================== */

.perf-pad-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
    max-width: 400px;
    margin: 20px auto;
}
.perf-drum-pad {
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border: 2px solid #333;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #aab;
    font-size: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    transition: background 0.05s;
}
.perf-drum-pad:hover {
    background: #2a2a4e;
}
.perf-drum-pad.playing {
    background: #5a3a3a;
    border-color: #f66;
}

/* ========================================
   Responsive: Iso/Pads
   ======================================== */

@media (max-width: 800px) {
    .perf-iso-key {
        width: 34px;
        height: 30px;
        font-size: 8px;
    }
    .perf-pad-grid {
        max-width: 300px;
        gap: 6px;
    }
}


/* === design.css === */
/**
 * design.css - DESIGN screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Sound design view with synthesis parameters, filter, ADSR, scope
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-design {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* ========================================
   Top Bar
   ======================================== */

.design-top-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    min-height: 32px;
}

.design-top-bar label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.design-select {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #c0c0dd;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    max-width: 140px;
}

.design-select:hover {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
}

.design-btn {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    background: #3a0ca3;
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.design-btn:hover {
    background: #4cc9f0;
    color: #000;
}

/* Hold bar — sits right above the mini keyboard */
.design-hold-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    background: #0e0e1a;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Hold button — prominent, next to keyboard */
.design-hold-btn {
    padding: 6px 16px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    background: #2a2a4a;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 2px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.design-hold-btn:hover {
    background: #3a3a6a;
    color: #fff;
}

.design-hold-btn.active {
    background: #1a4a1a;
    color: #6f6;
    border-color: #3a8a3a;
    animation: hold-pulse 2s infinite;
}

.design-hold-note {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #556;
    min-width: 40px;
}

.design-hold-btn.active + .design-hold-note {
    color: #6f6;
}

@keyframes hold-pulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(102, 255, 102, 0.3); }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(102, 255, 102, 0.6); }
}

/* ========================================
   Type Button Grid
   ======================================== */

.design-type-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px 8px;
    align-items: flex-start;
}

.design-type-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 3px;
}

.design-type-cat-label {
    font-size: 9px;
    color: #667;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    min-width: 28px;
    text-align: right;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.design-type-btn-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
}

.design-type-btn {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #bbbbdd;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    line-height: 1.3;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.design-type-btn:hover {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
    color: #e0e0ff;
    background: #222244;
}

.design-type-btn.active {
    background: #3a0ca3;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
}

/* ========================================
   3-Column Panel Layout
   ======================================== */

.design-panels {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    gap: 1px;
}

.design-left-col {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1.5;
    min-width: 300px;
    min-height: 0;
}

.design-right-col {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
}

.design-panel {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
    background: #0e0e1a;
}

.design-panel h3 {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    margin: 0 0 0.4rem 0;
    padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.design-panel h4 {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0.3rem 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

/* Engine panel (in left column) */
.design-engine {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
}

.design-left-col {
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

/* Filter + ADSR panel (in right column) */
.design-filter {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 180px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

/* Scope panel (in right column, below filter) */
.design-scope {
    flex: 0.8;
    min-width: 180px;
}

/* ========================================
   Slider Rows
   ======================================== */

.design-slider-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.design-slider-label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    min-width: 70px;
    text-align: right;
}

.design-slider-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    height: 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 100px;
}

.design-slider-val {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #c0c0dd;
    min-width: 44px;
    text-align: left;
    font-family: monospace;
}

.design-slider-row select {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* ========================================
   Oscillator Rows
   ======================================== */

.design-osc-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
    background: #12122a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a3a;
}

.design-osc-num {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-weight: 700;
    min-width: 20px;
}

.design-osc-row select,
.design-osc-row input[type="range"] {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    padding: 3px 6px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

.design-osc-row select {
    width: 100px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.design-osc-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    height: 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 80px;
}

.design-osc-val {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    min-width: 32px;
    font-family: monospace;
}

/* ========================================
   Checkbox Row
   ======================================== */

.design-check-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}

.design-check-row label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
}

/* ========================================
   Scope Canvases
   ======================================== */

.design-scope canvas {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #0a0a14;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

/* Chladni Pattern Display */
.design-chladni-canvas {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #0a0a14;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

/* ========================================
   Test Note Buttons
   ======================================== */

.design-test-notes {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.design-note-btn {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.design-note-btn:hover {
    background: #3a0ca3;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
}

.design-note-btn.playing {
    background: #3ddc84;
    color: #000;
    border-color: #3ddc84;
}

/* ========================================
   Mini Keyboard (1 octave)
   ======================================== */

.design-mini-keyboard {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    height: 60px;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.4rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.design-mini-key {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding-bottom: 4px;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    transition: background 0.05s;
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.design-mini-key.mini-white {
    width: 36px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f5f5f0 0%, #ddd8d0 100%);
    border: 1px solid #777;
    border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px;
    color: #333;
    z-index: 1;
    margin: 0 1px;
}

.design-mini-key.mini-black {
    width: 24px;
    height: 60%;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3a3a 0%, #141414 100%);
    border: 1px solid #000;
    border-radius: 0 0 2px 2px;
    color: #999;
    z-index: 2;
    margin: 0 -11px;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
}

.design-mini-key.mini-active {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3ddc84 0%, #28a060 100%) !important;
    color: #000;
}

/* ========================================
   FM Operator Grid
   ======================================== */

.design-fm-ops {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem;
}

.design-fm-op {
    flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 0.2rem);
    padding: 0.4rem;
    background: #12122a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a3a;
}

.design-fm-op-label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

/* ========================================
   Additive Partial Sliders
   ======================================== */

.design-partials-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.3rem;
}

.design-partial-col {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 24px;
}

.design-partial-col input[type="range"] {
    writing-mode: vertical-lr;
    direction: rtl;
    width: 18px;
    height: 80px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.design-partial-col span {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: #9999bb;
}

/* ========================================
   Responsive
   ======================================== */

/* ========================================
   303 Phrase Sequencer
   ======================================== */

.design-phrase-section {
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.design-phrase-section h4 {
    margin-top: 0;
}

.design-phrase-transport {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.design-phrase-play-btn {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #4cc9f0;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.design-phrase-play-btn:hover {
    background: #222244;
}

.design-phrase-play-btn.playing {
    background: #4cc9f0;
    color: #000;
}

.design-phrase-grid {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.design-phrase-step {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 3px 1px;
    background: #12122a;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a3a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 0;
    transition: border-color 0.1s, background 0.1s;
}

.design-phrase-step.active {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
    background: #1a2a4a;
}

.design-phrase-step .phrase-note {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #c0c0dd;
    font-family: monospace;
    white-space: nowrap;
    user-select: none;
}

.design-phrase-step.rest .phrase-note {
    color: #555;
}

.design-phrase-accent,
.design-phrase-slide {
    width: 18px;
    height: 16px;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: transparent;
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.design-phrase-accent:hover,
.design-phrase-slide:hover {
    border-color: #555;
}

.design-phrase-accent.on {
    background: #cc4400;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #ff6600;
}

.design-phrase-slide.on {
    background: #0066cc;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #0088ff;
}

.design-phrase-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    align-items: center;
}

/* ========================================
   Responsive
   ======================================== */

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
    .design-panels {
        flex-direction: column;
    }
    .design-left-col,
    .design-right-col {
        flex-direction: column;
        min-width: unset;
    }
    .design-left-col {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    }
    .design-engine,
    .design-filter,
    .design-scope {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
        min-width: unset;
    }
    .design-mini-keyboard {
        height: 50px;
    }
    .design-mini-key.mini-white {
        width: 28px;
    }
    .design-mini-key.mini-black {
        width: 18px;
        margin: 0 -8px;
    }
}


/* === sequence-screen.css === */
/**
 * sequence-screen.css - SEQUENCE screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Composition-focused view with note sequencer, transport, page navigation
 */

   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

    flex-direction: column;

    background: #0a0a12;
}

   ======================================== */

    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

}

.seq-screen-top-bar label {

}

.seq-screen-top-bar .seq-scr-btn {

}

.seq-screen-top-bar .seq-scr-btn:hover {

}

.seq-screen-top-bar .seq-scr-btn.active,
.seq-screen-top-bar .seq-scr-btn.playing {

}

.seq-screen-top-bar .seq-scr-select {

    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;

.seq-screen-top-bar .seq-scr-input {

    padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    text-align: center;
}

.seq-screen-transport {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
}

.seq-top-separator {

.seq-top-key-display {

    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;

.seq-screen-bottom-bar .seq-scr-btn {

    background: #2a2a4a;

    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;

.seq-screen-bottom-bar .page-indicator {

.seq-screen-page-nav {

.seq-screen-page-nav .page-indicator {

    color: #aaa;
    min-width: 50px;
    text-align: center;

   Main Content Area (grid + side panel)
   ======================================== */

.seq-screen-body {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ========================================
   Piano Roll Grid
   ======================================== */

.seq-screen-grid-area {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.seq-screen-grid-wrap {
    flex: 1;
