    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding-right: 3px;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.seq-screen-key.black {
    background: #0a0a18;
    color: #8888aa;
}

.seq-screen-key.white {
    background: #111125;
}

.seq-screen-key.c-note {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    color: #aaa;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.seq-screen-grid {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.seq-screen-row {
    display: flex;
    height: 16px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.seq-screen-cell {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 12px;
    border-right: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;
    cursor: crosshair;
}

.seq-screen-cell:hover {
    background: rgba(74, 138, 186, 0.15);
}

.seq-screen-cell.beat-line {
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.seq-screen-cell.bar-line {
    border-left: 1px solid #3a3a6a;
}

.seq-screen-note {
    position: absolute;
    top: 1px;
    bottom: 1px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    opacity: 0.85;
    cursor: grab;
    z-index: 2;
}

.seq-screen-note.inst-0 { background: #f72585; }
.seq-screen-note.inst-1 { background: #7209b7; }
.seq-screen-note.inst-2 { background: #4361ee; }
.seq-screen-note.inst-3 { background: #4cc9f0; }
.seq-screen-note.inst-4 { background: #06d6a0; }

.seq-screen-note:hover {
    opacity: 1;
    filter: brightness(1.2);
}

.seq-screen-row.seq-row-hidden,
.seq-screen-key.seq-row-hidden {
    display: none;
}

.seq-screen-playhead {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 2px;
    background: #f72585;
    z-index: 5;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: left 0.05s linear;
}

/* ========================================
   Side Panel (Mini Arrangement)
   ======================================== */

.seq-screen-side {
    width: 220px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0.3rem;
}

.seq-screen-side-title {
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.seq-screen-page-item {
    padding: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #aaa;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

.seq-screen-page-item:hover {
    background: #2a2a4a;
}

.seq-screen-page-item.active {
    background: #2a2a5a;
    border-color: #4a6aba;
    color: #fff;
}

.seq-screen-page-item .page-num {
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    min-width: 14px;
}

.seq-screen-page-item .page-label {
    flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.seq-screen-page-item .page-label-input {
    flex: 1;
    background: #0a0a18;
    border: 1px solid #4a6aba;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.1rem;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ========================================
   Bottom Bar
   ======================================== */

.seq-screen-bottom {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-height: 28px;
}

.seq-screen-bottom label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    color: #8888aa;
}

.seq-screen-bottom .seq-scr-btn {
    padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    background: #2a2a4a;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.seq-screen-bottom .seq-scr-btn:hover {
    background: #3a3a6a;
}

/* ========================================
   Chord Panel
   ======================================== */

.seq-chord-panel {
    width: 220px;
}

.seq-chord-section {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
}

.seq-chord-section:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.seq-chord-section-title {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Key & Scale */
.seq-chord-key-bar {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

.seq-chord-root-btns {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1px;
}

.seq-chord-root-btn {
    padding: 0.1rem 0.2rem;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #9999bb;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 22px;
    text-align: center;
}

.seq-chord-root-btn:hover {
    background: #2a2a4a;
}

.seq-chord-root-btn.active {
    background: #3a0ca3;
    border-color: #5a2cd3;
    color: #fff;
}

.seq-chord-mode-select {
    width: 100%;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
}

.seq-chord-key-display {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #e0e0ff;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.15rem;
    background: #1a1a30;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Diatonic Chord Palette */
.seq-chord-palette {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
}

.seq-chord-degree-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.1s;
}

.seq-chord-degree-btn:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.3);
}

.seq-chord-degree-btn.armed {
    outline: 2px solid #fff;
    outline-offset: -1px;
}

/* Tonic (I, iii, vi) = blue */
.seq-chord-degree-btn.func-tonic {
    background: #1a2a5a;
    color: #88aaff;
    border-color: #2a3a6a;
}

/* Subdominant (ii, IV) = green */
.seq-chord-degree-btn.func-subdominant {
    background: #1a3a2a;
    color: #88ddaa;
    border-color: #2a4a3a;
}

/* Dominant (V, vii) = red */
.seq-chord-degree-btn.func-dominant {
    background: #3a1a1a;
    color: #ff8888;
    border-color: #4a2a2a;
}

.seq-chord-degree-numeral {
    font-weight: 600;
    min-width: 28px;
}

.seq-chord-degree-name {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: right;
}

/* Extensions row */
.seq-chord-extensions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 2px;
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}

.seq-chord-ext-btn {
    padding: 0.1rem 0.25rem;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #8888aa;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.seq-chord-ext-btn:hover {
    background: #2a2a4a;
}

.seq-chord-ext-btn.active {
    background: #4a3a6a;
    border-color: #6a4a8a;
    color: #ccaaff;
}

/* Placement Controls */
.seq-chord-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

.seq-chord-ctrl-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    color: #8888aa;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

.seq-chord-inv-btns,
.seq-chord-voicing-btns,
.seq-chord-oct-btns {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1px;
}

.seq-chord-toggle-btn {
    padding: 0.1rem 0.2rem;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #9999bb;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 20px;
    text-align: center;
}

.seq-chord-toggle-btn:hover {
    background: #2a2a4a;
}

.seq-chord-toggle-btn.active {
    background: #3a0ca3;
    border-color: #5a2cd3;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Quick Progressions */
.seq-chord-progressions {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

.seq-chord-prog-select {
    width: 100%;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
}

.seq-chord-prog-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

.seq-chord-action-btn {
    flex: 1;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}

/* Page Chord Map */
.seq-chord-map {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1px;
    min-height: 24px;
}

.seq-chord-map-bar {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 22px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.45rem;
    color: #666;
    cursor: pointer;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding: 0 2px;
}

.seq-chord-map-bar.has-chord {
    color: #ccc;
}

.seq-chord-map-bar.func-tonic {
    background: #1a2a5a;
    border-color: #2a3a6a;
}

.seq-chord-map-bar.func-subdominant {
    background: #1a3a2a;
    border-color: #2a4a3a;
}

.seq-chord-map-bar.func-dominant {
    background: #3a1a1a;
    border-color: #4a2a2a;
}

/* Armed state - ghost highlight on piano keys */
.seq-screen-key.chord-ghost {
    background: rgba(90, 44, 211, 0.3);
    color: #ccaaff;
}

/* ========================================
   Octave Jump Bar
   ======================================== */

.seq-octave-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 2px 4px;
    background: #111122;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.seq-octave-label {
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    color: #8888aa;
    margin-right: 2px;
}

.seq-octave-btn {
    padding: 1px 5px;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #9999bb;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 20px;
    text-align: center;
}

.seq-octave-btn:hover {
    background: #3a3a6a;
    color: #fff;
}


/* === rhythm-screen.css === */
/**
 * rhythm-screen.css - RHYTHM screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Drum programming view with pattern grid, pads, and euclidean generator
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-rhythm {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* ========================================
   Top Bar
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-screen-top-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: #111122;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    min-height: 40px;
}

.rhythm-screen-top-bar label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #9999bb;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.rhythm-screen-top-bar .rhy-scr-btn {
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
    background: #2a2a4a;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 32px;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.rhythm-screen-top-bar .rhy-scr-btn:hover {
    background: #3a3a6a;
}

.rhythm-screen-top-bar .rhy-scr-btn.active,
.rhythm-screen-top-bar .rhy-scr-btn.playing {
    background: #3a0ca3;
    border-color: #5a2cd3;
    color: #fff;
}

.rhythm-screen-top-bar .rhy-scr-select {
    padding: 4px 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.rhythm-screen-top-bar .rhy-scr-input {
    width: 56px;
    padding: 4px 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.rhythm-screen-transport {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
}

/* ========================================
   Main Content (grid + side panel)
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-screen-body {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ========================================
   Drum Pattern Grid
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-screen-grid-area {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: auto;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    min-width: 0;
}

.rhythm-grid-table {
    border-collapse: collapse;
    table-layout: fixed;
    width: 100%;
    flex: 1;
}

.rhythm-grid-table th {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #9999bb;
    padding: 6px 2px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: normal;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.rhythm-grid-table thead th:first-child {
    width: 180px;
    min-width: 180px;
}

.rhythm-grid-table th.step-header {
    width: 36px;
}

.rhythm-grid-table th.step-header.beat {
    color: #bbbbdd;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #3a3a5a;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.rhythm-grid-row-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #bbbbdd;
    padding: 4px 6px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-align: right;
    width: 180px;
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.rhythm-grid-cell {
    width: 36px;
    min-height: 42px;
    text-align: center;
    vertical-align: middle;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
    position: relative;
}

.rhythm-grid-cell:hover {
    background: rgba(74, 138, 186, 0.15);
}

.rhythm-grid-cell.beat-line {
    border-left: 2px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #222;
    border: 1px solid #444;
    transition: background 0.1s, transform 0.1s;
}

.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active {
    transform: scale(1.15);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor;
}

.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active.kick { background: #f72585; border-color: #f72585; color: #f72585; }
.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active.snare { background: #7209b7; border-color: #7209b7; color: #7209b7; }
.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active.hihat { background: #4cc9f0; border-color: #4cc9f0; color: #4cc9f0; }
.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active.clap { background: #06d6a0; border-color: #06d6a0; color: #06d6a0; }
.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active.rim { background: #fca311; border-color: #fca311; color: #fca311; }
.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active.tom { background: #e76f51; border-color: #e76f51; color: #e76f51; }
.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active.cymbal { background: #a8dadc; border-color: #a8dadc; color: #a8dadc; }
.rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot.active.perc { background: #d4a5a5; border-color: #d4a5a5; color: #d4a5a5; }

.rhythm-playhead-cell {
    background: rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.18) !important;
}

/* ========================================
   Side Panel (Drum Pads + Euclidean)
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-screen-side {
    width: 260px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    gap: 12px;
}

.rhythm-side-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* ========================================
   Drum Pad Grid (4x4)
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-pad-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 6px;
}

.rhythm-pad {
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #bbbbdd;
    transition: background 0.08s, transform 0.08s;
    user-select: none;
}

.rhythm-pad:hover {
    background: #2a2a4a;
}

.rhythm-pad:active,
.rhythm-pad.hit {
    background: #3a0ca3;
    border-color: #5a2cd3;
    transform: scale(0.93);
    color: #fff;
}

.rhythm-pad .pad-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.rhythm-pad .pad-key {
    font-size: 9px;
    color: #8888aa;
    pointer-events: none;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

/* ========================================
   Euclidean Generator
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-euclidean-panel {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.rhythm-euclidean-panel label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #9999bb;
}

.rhythm-euclidean-panel input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 110px;
    height: 6px;
}

.rhythm-euclidean-panel .euc-value {
    min-width: 20px;
    text-align: right;
    color: #c0c0dd;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.rhythm-euclidean-panel .rhy-scr-btn {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    background: #2a2a4a;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    width: 100%;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.rhythm-euclidean-panel .rhy-scr-btn:hover {
    background: #3a3a6a;
}

.rhythm-euclidean-panel .rhy-scr-select {
    padding: 4px 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: inherit;
}

/* ========================================
   Bottom Bar
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-screen-bottom {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: #111122;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-height: 36px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.rhythm-screen-bottom label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #8888aa;
}

.rhythm-screen-bottom .rhy-scr-btn {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    background: #2a2a4a;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.rhythm-screen-bottom .rhy-scr-btn:hover {
    background: #3a3a6a;
}

/* ========================================
   Per-instrument controls in row label
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-grid-row-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    padding: 2px 4px;
    min-width: 170px;
}

.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-name {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #bbbbdd;
    font-weight: 600;
    min-width: 48px;
    text-align: right;
}

.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-vol {
    width: 54px;
    height: 5px;
    accent-color: #4cc9f0;
    opacity: 0.6;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-vol:hover {
    opacity: 1;
}

.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-mute-btn,
.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-solo-btn {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #8888aa;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-mute-btn:hover,
.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-solo-btn:hover {
    border-color: #5a5a7a;
}

.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-mute-btn.active {
    background: #c83e50;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #c83e50;
}

.rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-solo-btn.active {
    background: #f0c040;
    color: #000;
    border-color: #f0c040;
}

/* ========================================
   Velocity Strip
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-velocity-strip {
    display: table;
    table-layout: fixed;
    width: 100%;
    height: 48px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 10px;
    border-top: 1px solid #1e1e36;
    padding-top: 6px;
}

.rhythm-vel-label-cell {
    display: table-cell;
    width: 180px;
    min-width: 180px;
}

.rhythm-vel-bar-cell {
    display: table-cell;
    width: 36px;
    height: 100%;
    vertical-align: bottom;
    text-align: center;
    cursor: ns-resize;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
}

.rhythm-vel-bar-cell.beat-line {
    border-left: 2px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.rhythm-vel-bar {
    width: 80%;
    background: #f72585;
    border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
    min-height: 2px;
    transition: height 0.05s;
}

/* ========================================
   32-step mode: narrower cells
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-grid-table.steps-32 .rhythm-grid-cell {
    width: 20px;
    height: 28px;
}

.rhythm-grid-table.steps-32 .rhythm-grid-cell .rhy-dot {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
}

.rhythm-velocity-strip.steps-32 .rhythm-vel-bar-cell {
    width: 20px;
}

/* ========================================
   Pattern Chain / Arrangement
   ======================================== */

.rhythm-chain-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    width: 100%;
}

.rhythm-chain-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #9999bb;
    font-weight: 600;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.rhythm-chain-slots {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 28px;
}

.rhythm-chain-empty {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #666688;
    font-style: italic;
}

.rhythm-chain-slot {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 2px 4px;
}

.rhythm-chain-slot.active {
    border-color: #f72585;
    background: rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.15);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.3);
}

.rhythm-chain-select {
    padding: 2px 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    color: #ccccee;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 3px;
    font-family: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.rhythm-chain-remove {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #666688;
    font-size: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0 2px;
    line-height: 1;
}

.rhythm-chain-remove:hover {
    color: #ff6666;
}

.rhythm-chain-add-btn {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: bold;
    padding: 2px 8px !important;
}

.rhythm-chain-clear-btn {
    font-size: 11px !important;
    padding: 2px 8px !important;
}


/* === harmony-screen.css === */
/**
 * harmony-screen.css - HARMONY screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Chord progression building and music theory exploration
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-harmony {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

#screen-harmony *::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

#screen-harmony * {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}

/* ========================================
   Top Bar
   ======================================== */

.harmony-top-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    min-height: 40px;
}

.harmony-top-bar label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #aaaacc;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.harmony-select {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.harmony-select:focus {
    outline: 1px solid #6644aa;
}

.harmony-key-display {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #bb88ff;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #6644aa;
    border-radius: 4px;
    min-width: 70px;
    text-align: center;
}

/* ========================================
   Main Content Area
   ======================================== */

.harmony-main {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
    gap: 0;
}

/* ========================================
   Chord Palette (Left)
   ======================================== */

.harmony-palette {
    width: 180px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.harmony-palette-title {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: #aaaacc;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222;
}

.harmony-chord-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 8px 6px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 36px;
}

.harmony-chord-btn:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    filter: brightness(1.2);
}

.harmony-chord-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
}

.harmony-chord-btn.chord-I   { background: #2a4a8a; color: #8ab4ff; border-color: #4a6aaa; }
.harmony-chord-btn.chord-ii  { background: #3a2a6a; color: #aa88dd; border-color: #5a4a8a; }
.harmony-chord-btn.chord-iii { background: #2a5a3a; color: #88ddaa; border-color: #4a7a5a; }
.harmony-chord-btn.chord-IV  { background: #6a4a2a; color: #ddaa66; border-color: #8a6a4a; }
.harmony-chord-btn.chord-V   { background: #6a2a2a; color: #dd8888; border-color: #8a4a4a; }
.harmony-chord-btn.chord-vi  { background: #2a4a5a; color: #88bbcc; border-color: #4a6a7a; }
.harmony-chord-btn.chord-vii { background: #4a3a3a; color: #aa8888; border-color: #6a5a5a; }

/* ========================================
   Progression Timeline (Center)
   ======================================== */

.harmony-timeline {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.harmony-timeline-title {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: #aaaacc;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.harmony-slots {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    justify-content: flex-start;
}

.harmony-slot {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 70px;
    height: 68px;
    border: 1px dashed #444;
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    background: #0f0f1e;
    position: relative;
}

.harmony-slot:hover {
    border-color: #6644aa;
    background: #151530;
}

.harmony-slot.filled {
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: #555;
}

.harmony-slot.playing {
    border-color: #bb88ff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px #6644aa;
}

.harmony-slot .slot-numeral {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #bb88ff;
}

.harmony-slot .slot-name {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

.harmony-slot .slot-remove {
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 4px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: #8888aa;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
}

.harmony-slot:hover .slot-remove {
    display: block;
}

.harmony-slot .slot-remove:hover {
    color: #ff6666;
}

.harmony-slot .slot-number {
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    left: 4px;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: #8888aa;
}

/* ========================================
   Mini Piano (Right)
   ======================================== */

.harmony-piano-panel {
    width: 160px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.3rem;
}

.harmony-piano-title {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: #aaaacc;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222;
}

.harmony-piano {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
}

.harmony-piano-key {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 18px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding-left: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a2a;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.1s;
}

.harmony-piano-key.white-key {
    background: #222244;
    color: #bbbbdd;
}

.harmony-piano-key.black-key {
    background: #111128;
    color: #aaaacc;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.harmony-piano-key.highlighted {
    background: #4a2a8a;
    color: #ddbbff;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.harmony-piano-key.root-key {
    background: #6a3aaa;
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: bold;
}

/* ========================================
   Bottom Bar
   ======================================== */

.harmony-bottom-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    min-height: 42px;
}

.harmony-play-btn {
    padding: 6px 16px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    background: #3a1a6a;
    color: #ddbbff;
    border: 1px solid #6644aa;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s;
}

.harmony-play-btn:hover {
    background: #4a2a8a;
}

.harmony-play-btn.playing {
    background: #6a3aaa;
    border-color: #bb88ff;
}

.harmony-loop-btn {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #8888aa;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.harmony-loop-btn:hover {
    background: #2a2a4e;
}

.harmony-loop-btn.active {
    background: #1a3a2a;
    color: #44ddaa;
    border-color: #44ddaa;
}

.harmony-clear-btn {
    padding: 6px 12px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    background: #2a1a1a;
    color: #cc8888;
    border: 1px solid #552222;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.harmony-clear-btn:hover {
    background: #3a2a2a;
}

.harmony-bottom-bar label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #aaaacc;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.harmony-bpm-slider {
    width: 100px;
    height: 4px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: #333;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.harmony-bpm-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #bb88ff;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.harmony-bpm-value {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #bb88ff;
    min-width: 32px;
}

/* ========================================
   Progression Controls Bar
   ======================================== */

.harmony-prog-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.harmony-prog-ctrl-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #aaaacc;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.harmony-prog-ctrl-btn {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    background: #2a2a4a;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.harmony-prog-ctrl-btn:hover {
    background: #3a3a6a;
}

.harmony-prog-ctrl-btn.harmony-clear-btn {
    background: #2a1a1a;
    color: #cc8888;
    border-color: #552222;
}

.harmony-prog-ctrl-btn.harmony-clear-btn:hover {
    background: #3a2a2a;
}

/* ========================================
   Preset Grid (Visual Progression List)
   ======================================== */

.harmony-preset-grid-title {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #aaaacc;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    padding: 0.5rem 0 0.3rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222;
    margin-top: 0.4rem;
}

.harmony-preset-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    flex: 1;
    margin-top: 0.3rem;
    padding-right: 0;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}

.harmony-preset-grid::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

.harmony-preset-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 5px 6px;
    background: #0f0f1e;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s;
    min-height: 34px;
}

.harmony-preset-row:hover {
    background: #151530;
    border-color: #3a3a6a;
}

.harmony-preset-load-btn {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    background: #3a1a6a;
    color: #ddbbff;
    border: 1px solid #6644aa;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: background 0.15s;
}

.harmony-preset-load-btn:hover {
    background: #4a2a8a;
}

.harmony-preset-load-btn:active {
    background: #6a3aaa;
}

.harmony-preset-label-col {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 120px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.harmony-preset-name {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #ccccdd;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.harmony-preset-usage {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #8888aa;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.harmony-preset-chords {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    flex: 1;
    justify-content: flex-start;
}

.harmony-preset-chord {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex: 1;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    background: #1a1a3a;
    color: #aaaadd;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    white-space: nowrap;
}


/* === chord-seq.css === */
/**
 * chord-seq.css - Chord Sequencer (NDLR-inspired) styles
 * Generative chord-driven sequencer UI
 * Overhauled layout: larger fonts, 2x2 part grid, color-coded parts
 */

/* ========================================
   Sequencer Container
   ======================================== */

.cseq-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    flex: 1;
}

/* ========================================
   Title
   ======================================== */

.cseq-title {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #ccaaff;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

/* ========================================
   Sub-tab Navigation
   ======================================== */

.harmony-subtabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.harmony-subtab-btn {
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #8888aa;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-bottom: none;
    border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.harmony-subtab-btn:hover {
    background: #252540;
    color: #bbbbdd;
}

.harmony-subtab-btn.active {
    background: #2a2a4a;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #4a4a6a;
}

.harmony-subtab-content {
    display: none;
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.harmony-subtab-content.active {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* ========================================
   Transport Bar (prominent top section)
   ======================================== */

.cseq-transport {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: #111125;
    border-radius: 6px;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cseq-play-btn {
    padding: 6px 18px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    background: #2a5a3a;
    color: #88ff88;
    border: 1px solid #3a7a4a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s;
}

.cseq-play-btn:hover {
    background: #3a7a4a;
}

.cseq-play-btn.playing {
    background: #5a2a2a;
    color: #ff8888;
    border-color: #7a3a3a;
}

.cseq-transport label {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
}

.cseq-preset-select {
    padding: 4px 8px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* ========================================
   Current Chord Display
   ======================================== */

.cseq-chord-display {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #8888ff;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    background: #1a1a35;
    border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a6a;
    text-align: center;
    min-width: 80px;
    margin-left: auto;
}

/* ========================================
   Degree Buttons (I-VII)
   ======================================== */

.cseq-degree-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 2px 0;
}

.cseq-degree-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 8px 4px;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-align: center;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #bbbbdd;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
}

.cseq-degree-btn:hover {
    background: #252540;
    color: #ffffff;
}

.cseq-degree-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
}

.cseq-degree-btn.active {
    background: #3a3a6a;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #6a6aff;
}

/* Degree coloring */
.cseq-deg-1 { border-left: 3px solid #ff6b6b; }
.cseq-deg-2 { border-left: 3px solid #ffa07a; }
.cseq-deg-3 { border-left: 3px solid #ffd700; }
.cseq-deg-4 { border-left: 3px solid #98fb98; }
.cseq-deg-5 { border-left: 3px solid #87ceeb; }
.cseq-deg-6 { border-left: 3px solid #9370db; }
.cseq-deg-7 { border-left: 3px solid #dda0dd; }

/* ========================================
   Chord Timeline
   ======================================== */

.cseq-timeline-section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.cseq-timeline-label {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #88aacc;
}

.cseq-timeline {
    display: flex;
    gap: 5px;
    padding: 8px;
    background: #111122;
    border-radius: 5px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    min-height: 60px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: stretch;
}

.cseq-step {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 58px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    position: relative;
    flex: 1;
}

.cseq-step:hover {
    background: #252540;
    border-color: #4a4a6a;
}

.cseq-step.playing {
    background: #2a3a5a;
    border-color: #4488cc;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(68, 136, 204, 0.4);
}

.cseq-step .step-degree {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #ccccee;
}

.cseq-step .step-type {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

.cseq-step .step-dur {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #7777aa;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

.cseq-step .step-remove {
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 5px;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #664444;
    cursor: pointer;
    line-height: 1;
}

.cseq-step .step-remove:hover {
    color: #ff6666;
}

.cseq-add-btn {
    min-width: 44px;
    padding: 6px;
    background: #151528;
    border: 1px dashed #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #5a5a7a;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.cseq-add-btn:hover {
    background: #1a1a30;
    color: #6a6aff;
    border-color: #5a5aaa;
}

/* Step degree coloring (in timeline) */
.cseq-step.deg-0 { border-left: 3px solid #ff6b6b; }
.cseq-step.deg-1 { border-left: 3px solid #ffa07a; }
.cseq-step.deg-2 { border-left: 3px solid #ffd700; }
.cseq-step.deg-3 { border-left: 3px solid #98fb98; }
.cseq-step.deg-4 { border-left: 3px solid #87ceeb; }
.cseq-step.deg-5 { border-left: 3px solid #9370db; }
.cseq-step.deg-6 { border-left: 3px solid #dda0dd; }

/* ========================================
   Part Controls - 2x2 Grid
   ======================================== */

.cseq-parts {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
}

.cseq-part {
    background: #111122;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-top: 3px solid #2a2a4a;
}

/* Per-part accent colors on the card border-top */
.cseq-part.part-pad    { border-top-color: #5566cc; }
.cseq-part.part-drone  { border-top-color: #cc9933; }
.cseq-part.part-motif1 { border-top-color: #44aa66; }
.cseq-part.part-motif2 { border-top-color: #aa55bb; }

.cseq-part-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    padding-bottom: 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222244;
}

.cseq-part-toggle {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #4a4a6a;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s;
    padding: 0;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cseq-part-toggle.on {
    background: #44cc88;
    border-color: #44cc88;
}

.cseq-part-name {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #bbbbdd;
}

/* Per-part name colors */
.cseq-part-name.pad    { color: #7788ee; }
.cseq-part-name.drone  { color: #ddaa44; }
.cseq-part-name.motif1 { color: #66cc88; }
.cseq-part-name.motif2 { color: #cc77dd; }

.cseq-part-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px 10px;
    align-items: center;
}

.cseq-part-controls label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.cseq-part-controls select,
.cseq-part-controls input[type="number"] {
    padding: 2px 4px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    max-width: 90px;
}

.cseq-part-controls input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
}

/* Cascading voice select dropdowns (Engine / Category / Preset) */
.cseq-voice-cascade {
    display: flex;
    gap: 3px;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cseq-voice-select {
    padding: 2px 3px;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    outline: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.cseq-engine-sel {
    max-width: 80px;
    color: #aabbee;
    border-color: #4455aa;
}

.cseq-cat-sel {
    max-width: 80px;
    color: #bbddaa;
    border-color: #557744;
}

.cseq-preset-sel {
    max-width: 130px;
    color: #ddccaa;
    border-color: #776644;
}

/* Per-part accent tint on engine select */
.part-pad .cseq-engine-sel    { border-color: #5566cc; }
.part-drone .cseq-engine-sel  { border-color: #cc9933; }
.part-motif1 .cseq-engine-sel { border-color: #44aa66; }
.part-motif2 .cseq-engine-sel { border-color: #aa55bb; }

.cseq-voice-select:hover {
    border-color: #6666aa;
}

.cseq-voice-select:focus {
    border-color: #8888cc;
}

.cseq-part-controls input[type="range"] {
    width: 70px;
    height: 6px;
}

/* ========================================
   Perlin Noise Controls (collapsible)
   ======================================== */

.cseq-perlin {
    background: #111122;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-top: 3px solid #885599;
}

.cseq-perlin-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    padding-bottom: 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222244;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.cseq-perlin-header .cseq-collapse-arrow {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #6666aa;
    transition: transform 0.2s;
    display: inline-block;
}

.cseq-perlin-header .cseq-collapse-arrow.collapsed {
    transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.cseq-perlin-title {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #bb99dd;
}

.cseq-perlin-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px 12px;
    align-items: center;
}

.cseq-perlin-controls.collapsed {
    display: none;
}

.cseq-perlin-controls label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.cseq-perlin-controls input[type="range"] {
    width: 60px;
    height: 6px;
}

.cseq-perlin-controls .perlin-val {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #8888bb;
    min-width: 22px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ========================================
   Section Editor
   ======================================== */

.cseq-sections {
    background: #111122;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
}

.cseq-section-title {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #88aacc;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.cseq-section-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #aaaacc;
}

.cseq-section-name {
    font-weight: 700;
    min-width: 20px;
    color: #ccccee;
}

.cseq-section-steps {
    color: #8888aa;
    flex: 1;
}

.cseq-section-repeats {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 3px;
}

.cseq-section-repeats input {
    width: 34px;
    padding: 2px 3px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    text-align: center;
}


/* === generate-screen.css === */
/**
 * generate-screen.css - GENERATE screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Song generation and arrangement
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-generate {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* ========================================
   Top Bar
   ======================================== */

.generate-top-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    min-height: 32px;
}

.generate-top-bar label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    color: #8888aa;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.generate-select {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.generate-select:focus {
    outline: 1px solid #44aa66;
}

/* ========================================
   Main Content Area
   ======================================== */

.generate-main {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
    gap: 0;
}

/* ========================================
   Instrument Assignment (Left)
   ======================================== */

.generate-instruments {
    width: 180px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.generate-inst-title {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #8888aa;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    padding-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222;
}

.generate-inst-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
}

.generate-inst-row label {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.generate-inst-select {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    padding: 3px 6px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* ========================================
   Arrangement Timeline (Center)
   ======================================== */

.generate-timeline {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.generate-timeline-title {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #8888aa;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    padding-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.generate-arrangement {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
}

.generate-section-block {
    min-width: 60px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.generate-section-block:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.2);
    transform: scale(1.05);
}

.generate-section-block.playing {
    border-color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
}

.generate-section-block .section-label {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: inherit;
}

.generate-section-block .section-bars {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    opacity: 0.7;
    margin-top: 1px;
}

/* Section colors */
.generate-section-block.sec-intro      { background: #1a3a5a; color: #88bbdd; }
.generate-section-block.sec-verse      { background: #2a4a2a; color: #88cc88; }
.generate-section-block.sec-chorus     { background: #5a3a1a; color: #ddaa66; }
.generate-section-block.sec-bridge     { background: #4a2a5a; color: #bb88dd; }
.generate-section-block.sec-outro      { background: #3a3a1a; color: #aabb66; }
.generate-section-block.sec-buildup    { background: #4a4a1a; color: #cccc66; }
.generate-section-block.sec-drop       { background: #5a1a1a; color: #dd6666; }
.generate-section-block.sec-breakdown  { background: #1a4a4a; color: #66cccc; }
.generate-section-block.sec-interlude  { background: #3a2a4a; color: #aa88bb; }
.generate-section-block.sec-instrumental { background: #2a3a4a; color: #88aacc; }
.generate-section-block.sec-solo       { background: #5a2a3a; color: #dd88aa; }

/* ========================================
   Generation Controls (Right)
   ======================================== */

.generate-controls {
    width: 180px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.generate-ctrl-title {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #8888aa;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    padding-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #222;
}

.generate-ctrl-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
}

.generate-ctrl-group label {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #9999bb;
}

.generate-slider {
    width: 100%;
    height: 4px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: #333;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.generate-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #66cc88;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.generate-slider-value {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #66cc88;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ========================================
   Bottom Bar
   ======================================== */

.generate-bottom-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    min-height: 40px;
}

.generate-gen-btn {
    padding: 6px 20px;
    font-size: 0.58rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    background: #1a5a2a;
    color: #88ff99;
    border: 2px solid #44aa55;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.generate-gen-btn:hover {
    background: #2a7a3a;
    transform: scale(1.05);
}

.generate-gen-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
}

.generate-gen-btn.generating {
    background: #4a6a2a;
    animation: gen-pulse 1s infinite;
}

@keyframes gen-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0.6; }
}

.generate-play-btn {
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 0.50rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    background: #2a2a5a;
    color: #aaaaff;
    border: 1px solid #4444aa;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.generate-play-btn:hover {
    background: #3a3a6a;
}

.generate-play-btn.playing {
    background: #4a4a8a;
    border-color: #8888ff;
}

.generate-clear-btn {
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 0.58rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    background: #5a1a1a;
    color: #ffaa88;
    border: 1px solid #aa4444;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.generate-clear-btn:hover {
    background: #7a2a2a;
}

.generate-export-btn {
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    background: #3a3a1a;
    color: #cccc88;
    border: 1px solid #666633;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.generate-export-btn:hover {
    background: #4a4a2a;
}

.generate-status {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    flex: 1;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ========================================
   Sequencer Preview (Generate Screen)
   ======================================== */

.gen-seq-container {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    background: #0a0a14;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.gen-seq-nav {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    background: #111122;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #9999bb;
}

.gen-seq-nav button {
    background: #2a2a4a;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.gen-seq-nav button:hover {
    background: #3a3a5a;
}

.gen-seq-nav button:disabled {
    opacity: 0.3;
    cursor: default;
}

.gen-seq-grid-wrap {
    display: flex;
    height: 280px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.gen-seq-keys {
    width: 36px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
}

.gen-seq-key {
    height: 6px;
    font-size: 7px;
    color: #888;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding-right: 3px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #111;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.gen-seq-key.black { background: #080812; }
.gen-seq-key.c-note { border-bottom: 1px solid #333; color: #aab; }

.gen-seq-grid {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    overflow: auto;
    background: #0c0c18;
}

.gen-seq-note {
    position: absolute;
    border-radius: 2px;
    opacity: 0.85;
    min-width: 2px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.gen-seq-bar-line {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 1px;
    background: #2a2a4a;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.gen-seq-beat-line {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 1px;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.gen-seq-row-line {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: #111;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.gen-seq-row-line.c-row {
    background: #333;
}

.gen-seq-playhead {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 2px;
    background: #f72585;
    z-index: 10;
    display: none;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.gen-seq-empty {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100%;
    color: #555;
    font-size: 12px;
}


/* === effects-screen.css === */
/**
 * effects-screen.css - EFFECTS screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Overhauled layout: instrument tabs, master mix, card grid
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-effects {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* ========================================
   Instrument Tabs
   ======================================== */

.effects-inst-tabs-bar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
}

.effects-inst-tab-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #888;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.effects-inst-tab-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: #ccc;
}

.effects-inst-tab-btn.active {
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 700;
}

/* Per-instrument color coding */
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="0"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76,201,240,0.3), rgba(76,201,240,0.1));
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="1"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(45,212,191,0.3), rgba(45,212,191,0.1));
    border-color: #2dd4bf;
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="2"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,158,11,0.3), rgba(245,158,11,0.1));
    border-color: #f59e0b;
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="3"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.3), rgba(167,139,250,0.1));
    border-color: #a78bfa;
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="4"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(247,37,133,0.3), rgba(247,37,133,0.1));
    border-color: #f72585;
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="master"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15), rgba(255,255,255,0.05));
    border-color: #ccc;
}

.effects-bypass-btn {
    padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-left: 0.5rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}

.effects-bypass-btn:hover {
    border-color: #ff6666;
}

.effects-bypass-btn.active {
    background: #ff4444;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #ff6666;
}

/* ========================================
   Master Mix Bar
   ======================================== */

.effects-master-mix-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
    margin: 0.4rem 0.6rem 0;
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.25);
    border-radius: 6px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.effects-master-mix-label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.effects-master-mix-slider {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    flex: 1;
    height: 8px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #333 0%, #4cc9f0 100%);
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
}

.effects-master-mix-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    background: #4cc9f0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.5);
}

.effects-master-mix-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    background: #4cc9f0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.effects-master-mix-value {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    min-width: 45px;
    text-align: right;
    font-family: monospace;
}

/* ========================================
   Effect List — flex-wrap layout
   Enabled effects: full-width rows with params
   Disabled effects: compact inline chips
   ======================================== */

.effects-list {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
    align-content: flex-start;
}

.effects-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Enabled effect: full-width row with params --- */
.effects-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: rgba(16, 16, 32, 0.5);
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    opacity: 0.5;
    transition: opacity 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    width: 100%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.effects-row.enabled {
    opacity: 1;
    border-color: rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.35);
    width: 100%;
    order: -1;
}

/* --- Disabled effect: compact chip --- */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    width: auto;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    gap: 4px;
}

.effects-row-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* Compact header in disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-header {
    gap: 4px;
}

.effects-row-toggle {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    accent-color: #7c6fff;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* Smaller checkbox in disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-toggle {
    width: 13px;
    height: 13px;
}

.effects-row-icon {
    font-size: 18px;
}

/* Smaller icon in disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-icon {
    font-size: 13px;
}

.effects-row-name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ccccee;
    flex: 1;
}

/* Smaller name in disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-name {
    font-size: 11px;
    flex: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.effects-row-move {
    background: none;
    border: 1px solid #3a3a5a;
    color: #8888aa;
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.effects-row-move:hover {
    border-color: #7c6fff;
    color: #ccccee;
}

/* Hide move buttons on disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-move {
    display: none;
}

.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-params {
  display: none;
}

.effects-row-params {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 6px;
    padding-left: 28px;
}

.effects-row-param {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    min-width: 180px;
}

.effects-row-param-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #8888aa;
    min-width: 50px;
}

.effects-row-param-slider {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100px;
    height: 6px;
    background: #333;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    accent-color: #7c6fff;
}

.effects-row-param-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    background: #7c6fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.effects-row-param-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    background: #7c6fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.effects-row-param-value {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #aaaacc;
    min-width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
    font-family: monospace;
}

/* Keep effects-add-select and effects-add-btn for phrase looper controls */
.effects-add-select {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 220px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.effects-add-btn {
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    background: #2a6;
    color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #3b7;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.effects-add-btn:hover {
    background: #3b7;
}

/* ========================================
   Bottom Bar
   ======================================== */

.effects-screen-bottom-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-height: 32px;
}

.effects-test-btn,
.effects-ab-btn {
    padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 600;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}

.effects-test-btn:hover {
    background: #2a3a5a;
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
    color: #fff;
}

.effects-ab-btn.active {
    background: #4a2a00;
    border-color: #f0a040;
    color: #f0a040;
}

.effects-screen-empty {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex: 1;
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* ========================================
   303 Phrase Looper
   ======================================== */

.fx-phrase-section {
    margin: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.fx-phrase-section h4 {
    margin-top: 0;
    color: #c0c0dd;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.fx-phrase-transport {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.fx-phrase-play-btn {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #a78bfa;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #a78bfa;
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.fx-phrase-play-btn:hover {
    background: #222244;
}

.fx-phrase-play-btn.playing {
    background: #a78bfa;
    color: #000;
}

.fx-phrase-grid {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.fx-phrase-step {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 3px 1px;
    background: #12122a;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a3a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 0;
    transition: border-color 0.1s, background 0.1s;
}

.fx-phrase-step.active {
    border-color: #a78bfa;
    background: #2a1a4a;
}

.fx-phrase-step .fx-phrase-note {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #c0c0dd;
    font-family: monospace;
    white-space: nowrap;
    user-select: none;
}

.fx-phrase-step.rest .fx-phrase-note {
    color: #555;
}

.fx-phrase-accent,
.fx-phrase-slide {
    width: 18px;
    height: 16px;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: transparent;
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.fx-phrase-accent:hover,
.fx-phrase-slide:hover {
    border-color: #555;
}

.fx-phrase-accent.on {
    background: #cc4400;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #ff6600;
}

.fx-phrase-slide.on {
    background: #6633cc;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #8855ff;
}

.fx-phrase-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}


/* === mix-screen.css === */
/**
 * mix-screen.css - MIX screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Multi-instrument mixer view
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-mix {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* ========================================
   Main Layout
   ======================================== */

.mix-screen-main {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
    gap: 0;
}

/* ========================================
   Channel Strips Area
   ======================================== */

.mix-channels-area {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    overflow-x: auto;
    justify-content: center;
}

/* ========================================
   Channel Strip
   ======================================== */

.mix-channel-strip {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100px;
    min-width: 80px;
    background: #111122;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.3rem;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    margin: 0 2px;
}

.mix-channel-name {
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #4cc9f0;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    width: 100%;
}

.mix-channel-type {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: #9999bb;
    text-align: center;
}

/* Volume fader */

.mix-fader-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 120px;
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
}

.mix-fader {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    writing-mode: bt-lr; /* IE */
    -webkit-appearance: slider-vertical;
    width: 24px;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 100px;
    background: transparent;
    outline: none;
}

/* Fallback for browsers not supporting vertical slider */
.mix-fader-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 120px;
    width: 40px;
    position: relative;
}

.mix-fader-track {
    position: absolute;
    width: 4px;
    height: 100%;
    background: #333;
    border-radius: 2px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.mix-fader-fill {
    position: absolute;
    width: 4px;
    bottom: 0;
    background: #4cc9f0;
    border-radius: 2px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.mix-fader-thumb {
    position: absolute;
    width: 28px;
    height: 10px;
    background: #ccc;
    border-radius: 3px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    cursor: grab;
    border: 1px solid #999;
}

.mix-fader-thumb:active {
    cursor: grabbing;
    background: #fff;
}

.mix-fader-value {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: #aaa;
    text-align: center;
    padding-top: 2px;
}

/* Pan control */

.mix-pan-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    width: 100%;
}

.mix-pan-label {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: #9999bb;
}

.mix-pan-slider {
    width: 80%;
    height: 4px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: #333;
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: none;
}

.mix-pan-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #f0a040;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.mix-pan-value {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: #aaa;
}

/* Mute/Solo buttons */

.mix-mute-solo {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
}

.mix-mute-btn,
.mix-solo-btn {
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #9999bb;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.mix-mute-btn:hover,
.mix-solo-btn:hover {
    border-color: #555;
}

.mix-mute-btn.active {
    background: #a22;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #c44;
}

.mix-solo-btn.active {
    background: #aa8800;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #ccaa00;
}

/* Level meter */

.mix-meter-container {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 2px 0;
}

.mix-meter-canvas {
    width: 20px;
    height: 80px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* Quick preset */

.mix-preset-select {
    width: 90%;
    padding: 2px 4px;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* ========================================
   Master Section
   ======================================== */

.mix-master-section {
    width: 160px;
    min-width: 140px;
    background: #0d0d1a;
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.mix-master-title {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #f0a040;
    text-align: center;
    padding-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    width: 100%;
}

.mix-master-fader-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    min-height: 140px;
    width: 100%;
}

.mix-master-fader-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 130px;
    width: 40px;
    position: relative;
}

.mix-master-value {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #f0a040;
    text-align: center;
    padding-top: 2px;
}

.mix-master-meter-canvas {
    width: 30px;
    height: 100px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* Spectrum analyzer */

.mix-spectrum-section {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
}

.mix-spectrum-label {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: #8888aa;
}

.mix-spectrum-canvas {
    width: 100%;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 60px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: #0a0a12;
}

/* ========================================
   Bottom Bar
   ======================================== */

.mix-screen-bottom-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
    background: #111122;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-height: 28px;
    justify-content: center;
}

.mix-inst-toggle {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #333355;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.mix-inst-toggle.active {
    background: #2a6;
    border-color: #3b7;
    color: #fff;
}

.mix-inst-toggle:hover {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
}


/* === loop-screen.css === */

.loop-mute-btn.active {
