  // Place a drum pattern on the sequencer (repeats across all 4 bars)
  function placeDrumPattern(pattern, instId) {
    if (!SL.sequencer || !SL.sequencer.seqNotes) {
      // no sequencer available
    } else {
      const seqNotes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
      const barsToFill = 4;
      const stepsPerBar = 16;

      // Place relative to current page
      let pageOffset = 0;
      if (SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage) {
        pageOffset = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage() * 64;
      }

      // Repeat pattern across all 4 bars
      for (let bar = 0; bar < barsToFill; bar++) {
        const barOffset = pageOffset + bar * stepsPerBar;

        pattern.pattern.forEach(track => {
          track.steps.forEach(step => {
            seqNotes.push({
              row: track.pad,
              start: barOffset + step,
              dur: 2,  // 8th note duration
              midi: SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI + track.pad,
              instrument: instId
            });
          });
        });
      }

      if (SL.sequencer.renderSeqGrid) {
        SL.sequencer.renderSeqGrid();
      }
    }
  }

  // Render patterns for selected genre
  function renderDrumPatternGrid(container, instId) {
    container.innerHTML = '';

    const group = DRUM_PATTERN_GROUPS.find(g => g.genre === selectedDrumGenre);
    if (!group) return;

    const grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'drum-genre-grid';

    // Filter by role if one is selected
    let filteredPatterns = group.patterns;
    if (selectedDrumRole && selectedDrumRole !== 'All') {
      const roleLower = selectedDrumRole.toLowerCase();
      filteredPatterns = group.patterns.filter(p => p.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(roleLower) !== -1);
    }

    // Show up to 30 patterns
    const patternsToShow = filteredPatterns.slice(0, 30);

    patternsToShow.forEach(pattern => {
      const grp = document.createElement('div');
      grp.className = 'prog-group drum-pattern-group';

      // PLACE button
      const placeBtn = document.createElement('button');
      placeBtn.className = 'prog-place-btn';
      placeBtn.textContent = 'PLACE';
      placeBtn.title = 'Place pattern on sequencer';
      placeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        placeDrumPattern(pattern, instId);
      });
      grp.appendChild(placeBtn);

      // Pattern name and usage
      const labelCol = document.createElement('div');
      labelCol.className = 'prog-label-col';
      const nameEl = document.createElement('div');
      nameEl.className = 'prog-name-label';
      nameEl.textContent = pattern.name;
      labelCol.appendChild(nameEl);
      if (pattern.usage) {
        const usageEl = document.createElement('div');
        usageEl.className = 'prog-usage-label';
        usageEl.textContent = pattern.usage;
        labelCol.appendChild(usageEl);
      }
      grp.appendChild(labelCol);

      // Pattern preview (mini grid)
      const preview = document.createElement('div');
      preview.className = 'drum-pattern-preview';
      pattern.pattern.forEach(track => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'drum-pattern-row';
        for (let step = 0; step < 16; step++) {
          const cell = document.createElement('div');
          cell.className = 'drum-pattern-cell' + (track.steps.includes(step) ? ' active' : '');
          row.appendChild(cell);
        }
        preview.appendChild(row);
      });
      grp.appendChild(preview);

      grid.appendChild(grp);
    });

    container.appendChild(grid);
  }

  // Build chord progressions section with genre dropdown
  function buildProgressions(container, root, m, chordOct) {
    container.innerHTML = '';

    // Genre selector dropdown row (above the grid)
    const selectorRow = document.createElement('div');
    selectorRow.className = 'prog-genre-selector';

    const genreLabel = document.createElement('span');
    genreLabel.textContent = 'Style: ';
    genreLabel.className = 'prog-genre-label';
    selectorRow.appendChild(genreLabel);

    const genreSelect = document.createElement('select');
    genreSelect.className = 'prog-genre-select';
    genreSelect.id = 'progGenreSelect';
    SL.PROG_GROUPS.forEach(group => {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = group.genre;
      opt.textContent = group.genre;
      if (group.genre === selectedProgGenre) opt.selected = true;
      genreSelect.appendChild(opt);
    });
    selectorRow.appendChild(genreSelect);

    selectorRow.appendChild(mkSecCtrl('prog'));

      renderProgressionGrid(gridContainer, root, m, chordOct);

    renderProgressionGrid(gridContainer, root, m, chordOct);
  }

  // Render progressions for selected genre
  function renderProgressionGrid(container, root, m, chordOct) {
    container.innerHTML = '';

    const group = SL.PROG_GROUPS.find(g => g.genre === selectedProgGenre);
    if (!group) return;

    const grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'prog-grid';

    // Show max 8 progressions
    const progsToShow = group.progressions.slice(0, 8);

    progsToShow.forEach(prog => {
      const grp = document.createElement('div');
      grp.className = 'prog-group';

      // Draggable DRAG button on the left
      const nameEl = document.createElement('button');
      nameEl.className = 'prog-drag-btn';
      nameEl.textContent = 'DRAG';
      nameEl.draggable = true;
      nameEl.title = prog.name;
      nameEl.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
        const seqChords = [];
        prog.degs.forEach(d => {
          if (m.scale.length > d) {
            const pc = (root + m.scale[d % m.scale.length]) % 12;
            const type = m.triads[d % m.triads.length];
            const baseMidi = chordOct * 12 + pc;
            const notes = applyInv(getExtendedNotes(baseMidi, type, getNoteCount('prog')), getInv('prog'));
            seqChords.push({ notes, name: SL.NOTES[pc] + SL.CHORD_NAME[type] });
          }
        });
        const dragData = { sequence: true, chords: seqChords, name: prog.name };
        e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', JSON.stringify(dragData));
        SL.currentDragData = dragData;
      });
      nameEl.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
        SL.currentDragData = null;
      });
      grp.appendChild(nameEl);

      // PLACE button
      const placeBtn = document.createElement('button');
      placeBtn.className = 'prog-place-btn';
      placeBtn.textContent = 'PLACE';
      placeBtn.title = 'Left-click: 1 bar per chord | Right-click: choose duration';

      // Helper to get chords for this progression
      const getProgChords = () => {
        const seqChords = [];
        prog.degs.forEach(d => {
          if (m.scale.length > d) {
            const pc = (root + m.scale[d % m.scale.length]) % 12;
            const type = m.triads[d % m.triads.length];
            const baseMidi = chordOct * 12 + pc;
            const notes = applyInv(getExtendedNotes(baseMidi, type, getNoteCount('prog')), getInv('prog'));
            seqChords.push({ notes, name: SL.NOTES[pc] + SL.CHORD_NAME[type] });
          }
        });
        return seqChords;
      };

      placeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const seqChords = getProgChords();
        if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.placeProgression) {
          SL.sequencer.placeProgression(seqChords, prog.name);
        }
      });

      placeBtn.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const seqChords = getProgChords();
        if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.showPlaceDurationPicker) {
          SL.sequencer.showPlaceDurationPicker(seqChords, prog.name, e.clientX, e.clientY);
        }
      });

      grp.appendChild(placeBtn);

      // Progression name and usage label
      const labelCol = document.createElement('div');
      labelCol.className = 'prog-label-col';
      const progNameEl = document.createElement('div');
      progNameEl.className = 'prog-name-label';
      progNameEl.textContent = prog.name;
      labelCol.appendChild(progNameEl);
      if (prog.usage) {
        const usageEl = document.createElement('div');
        usageEl.className = 'prog-usage-label';
        usageEl.textContent = prog.usage;
        labelCol.appendChild(usageEl);
      }
      grp.appendChild(labelCol);

      // Chord items with degree labels above each chord
      const chords = document.createElement('div');
      chords.className = 'prog-chords';
      prog.degs.forEach(d => {
        if (m.scale.length > d) {
          const pc = (root + m.scale[d % m.scale.length]) % 12;
          const type = m.triads[d % m.triads.length];

          const item = document.createElement('div');
          item.className = 'prog-chord-item';

          const degLabel = document.createElement('div');
          degLabel.className = 'prog-deg-label';
          const num = type === 'maj' ? SL.NUMS[d] : SL.NUMS[d].toLowerCase();
          degLabel.textContent = num;
          item.appendChild(degLabel);

          item.appendChild(mkBtn(pc, type, null, chordOct, 'prog'));

          chords.appendChild(item);
        }
      });
      grp.appendChild(chords);
      grid.appendChild(grp);
    });

    container.appendChild(grid);
  }

  // Build all chord sections (progressions, function, degree, palette)
  function buildChords() {
    const orgFunc = document.getElementById('orgFunction');
    const orgDeg = document.getElementById('orgDegree');
    const orgProg = document.getElementById('orgProg');
    const orgPal = document.getElementById('orgPalette');

    if (!orgFunc || !orgDeg || !orgProg || !orgPal) return;

    // Check if in sampler mode
    const sampler = isSamplerMode();

    // Update section titles based on mode
    const progTitle = orgProg.previousElementSibling;
    if (progTitle && progTitle.classList.contains('org-title')) {
      progTitle.textContent = sampler ? 'Drum Patterns' : 'Progressions';
    }

    orgFunc.innerHTML = '';
    orgDeg.innerHTML = '';
    orgProg.innerHTML = '';

    // In sampler mode, show drum patterns instead of chord progressions
    if (sampler) {
      buildDrumPatterns(orgProg);
      // Hide chord sections in sampler mode
      orgFunc.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#666;font-size:0.38rem">Switch to synth for chords</span>';
      orgDeg.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#666;font-size:0.38rem">Switch to synth for chords</span>';
      orgPal.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#666;font-size:0.38rem">Switch to synth for chords</span>';
      return;
    }
    orgPal.innerHTML = '';

    const rootEl = document.getElementById('rootNote');
    const modeEl = document.getElementById('mode');
    if (!rootEl || !modeEl) return;

    const root = parseInt(rootEl.value);
    const m = SL.MODES[modeEl.value];
    const baseOct = SL.ui ? SL.ui.getBaseOctave() : 4;
    const chordOct = baseOct + 2;

    // Build progressions section with genre selector
    buildProgressions(orgProg, root, m, chordOct);

    // Build function section (Tonic, Subdominant, Dominant)
    orgFunc.appendChild(mkSecCtrl('func'));
    if (m.scale.length >= 7) {
      const groups = [
        { label: 'Tonic', degs: [0, 2, 5] },
        { label: 'Subdom', degs: [1, 3] },
        { label: 'Dom', degs: [4, 6] }
      ];
      const funcRow = document.createElement('div');
      funcRow.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:0.25rem;';
      groups.forEach(gr => {
