  // Write Euclidean pattern to sequencer grid
  var generateEuclidean = () => {
    saveEucSettingsForInstrument();
    var instId = SL.audio ? SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument() : 0;
    var totalSteps = getTotalSteps();

    var eucPadEl = document.getElementById('eucPad');
    var padTarget = parseInt(eucPadEl ? eucPadEl.value : '0') || 0;
    var instType = SL.audio.getInstrumentType ? SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instId) : 'synth';
    var isSamplerInst = (instType === 'sampler');

    // Read kit pads for clearing
    var eucKitEl = document.getElementById('eucKit');
    var kitStr = eucKitEl ? eucKitEl.value.trim() : '';
    var kitPadsForClear = null;
    if (kitStr && isSamplerInst) {
      kitPadsForClear = kitStr.split(',').map(s => parseInt(s.trim())).filter(n => !isNaN(n) && n >= 0 && n < 16);
      if (kitPadsForClear.length === 0) { kitPadsForClear = null; }
    }

    // Clear old euclidean notes — for sampler rhythm mode, only clear notes on the same pad(s)
    var eucModeEl = document.getElementById('eucMode');
    var eucMode = eucModeEl ? eucModeEl.value : 'rhythm';
    for (var i = seqNotes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (seqNotes[i].euclidean && seqNotes[i].instrument === instId) {
        if (isSamplerInst && eucMode === 'rhythm') {
          if (kitPadsForClear) {
            if (kitPadsForClear.indexOf(seqNotes[i].row) !== -1) {
              seqNotes.splice(i, 1);
            }
          } else {
            if (seqNotes[i].row === padTarget) {
              seqNotes.splice(i, 1);
            }
          }
        } else {
          seqNotes.splice(i, 1);
        } // end if/else isSamplerInst (clear old)
      } // end if euclidean && instId
    } // end for clear old euclidean notes

    var built = buildEuclideanPattern();
    var pattern = built.notes;
    var patLen = built.patternLength;

    // Scale pattern steps to sequencer grid
    for (var ni = 0; ni < pattern.length; ni++) {
      var n = pattern[ni];
      var step = (patLen > 0) ? Math.round(n.start * totalSteps / patLen) : n.start;
      if (step < totalSteps) {
        var noteObj = {
          row: n.row,
          start: step,
          dur: n.dur,
          vel: n.vel,
          instrument: instId,
          euclidean: true
        };
        if (n.midi) { noteObj.midi = n.midi; }
        seqNotes.push(noteObj);
      } // end if step < totalSteps
    } // end for each pattern note

    renderSeqNotes();
  }; // end var generateEuclidean

  // Live Euclidean playback — plays pattern directly without writing to grid (per-instrument)
  var startEuclideanLive = () => {
    var instId = SL.audio ? SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument() : 0;

    // Stop existing live pattern for this instrument
    if (eucLiveIntervals[instId]) {
      clearInterval(eucLiveIntervals[instId]);
      eucLiveIntervals[instId] = null;
    }

    // Save settings before generating
    saveEucSettingsForInstrument();

    // Clear any euclidean grid notes for this instrument to prevent double-play
    // (when switching from Sequencer output to Live, old generated notes remain)
    for (var i = seqNotes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (seqNotes[i].euclidean && (seqNotes[i].instrument || 0) === instId) {
        seqNotes.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
    if (typeof renderSeqNotes === 'function') renderSeqNotes();

    var built = buildEuclideanPattern();
    if (built.notes.length === 0) return;

    var bpm = parseInt(document.getElementById('seqBpm') ? document.getElementById('seqBpm').value : '120') || 120;
    var intervalMs = 60000 / (bpm * 4);
    var patternLength = built.patternLength;

    // Capture swing and randomization amounts
    var eucSwingEl = document.getElementById('eucSwing');
    var swing = parseInt(eucSwingEl ? eucSwingEl.value : '0') || 0;
    var eucRandomEl = document.getElementById('eucRandom');
    var randomAmount = parseInt(eucRandomEl ? eucRandomEl.value : '0') || 0;

    eucLiveSteps[instId] = 0;
    eucLivePatterns[instId] = built.notes;

    var instType = SL.audio.getInstrumentType ? SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instId) : 'synth';
    var isSamplerInst = (instType === 'sampler' && SL.sampler);
    var rootNoteEl = document.getElementById('rootNote');

    // Helper to play a single note
    var playNote = (n, stepDur) => {
      var noteDur = n.dur * stepDur;
      if (isSamplerInst) {
        var padId = n.row;
        if (padId >= 0 && padId < 16) {
          SL.sampler.playPad(instId, padId, n.vel || 100, noteDur);
        }
      } else {
        var root = parseInt(rootNoteEl ? rootNoteEl.value : '0') || 0;
        var midi = n.midi || (60 + root + n.row);
        if (SL.audio.playNoteOnInstrument) {
          SL.audio.playNoteOnInstrument(midi, noteDur, instId, n.vel);
        } else if (SL.audio.playNote) {
          SL.audio.playNote(midi, noteDur);
        }
      } // end if/else isSamplerInst (playNote)
    }; // end playNote

    eucLiveIntervals[instId] = setInterval(() => {
      var stepDur = 60 / (bpm * 4);

      for (var i = 0; i < eucLivePatterns[instId].length; i++) {
        var n = eucLivePatterns[instId][i];
        if (n.start === eucLiveSteps[instId]) {
          // Swing: delay odd-indexed steps
          var swingDelayMs = (eucLiveSteps[instId] % 2 === 1 && swing > 0) ? (swing / 100) * intervalMs * 0.7 : 0;
          if (swingDelayMs > 0.5) {
            var noteRef = n;
            var dur = stepDur;
            setTimeout(() => {
              playNote(noteRef, dur);
            }, swingDelayMs); // end setTimeout swing
          } else {
            playNote(n, stepDur);
          }
        } // end if n.start === current step
      } // end for each live pattern note

      eucLiveSteps[instId] = (eucLiveSteps[instId] + 1) % patternLength;

      // Randomization: on cycle wrap, rebuild pattern with jitter
      if (eucLiveSteps[instId] === 0 && randomAmount > 0) {
        var newBuilt = buildEuclideanPattern();
        var notes = newBuilt.notes;

        // Randomize velocity of each note
        var velJitter = Math.round(randomAmount * 0.3);
        for (var j = 0; j < notes.length; j++) {
          notes[j].vel = Math.max(1, Math.min(127, notes[j].vel + Math.floor(Math.random() * velJitter * 2) - velJitter));
        }

        // Randomly drop some notes
        var dropChance = randomAmount * 0.15;
        var filtered = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < notes.length; j++) {
          if (Math.random() * 100 > dropChance) {
            filtered.push(notes[j]);
          }
        }

        // Randomly shift some note start times by ±1 step
        if (randomAmount > 30) {
          var shiftChance = (randomAmount - 30) * 0.5;
          for (var j = 0; j < filtered.length; j++) {
            if (Math.random() * 100 < shiftChance) {
              var shift = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
              filtered[j].start = Math.max(0, Math.min(patternLength - 1, filtered[j].start + shift));
            }
          }
        }

        eucLivePatterns[instId] = filtered;
      } // end if randomAmount > 0
    }, intervalMs); // end setInterval eucLive

    if (!eucAnimFrameId) {
      eucAnimFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animateEuclideanRing);
    }

  }; // end var startEuclideanLive

  // --- Euclidean Ring Visualization ---
  var eucAnimFrameId = null;

  var renderEuclideanRing = () => {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('eucCanvas');
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    var cx = w / 2;
    var cy = h / 2;
    var radius = Math.min(cx, cy) - 10;

    // Clear
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Read current parameters
    var eucPulsesEl = document.getElementById('eucPulses');
    var eucStepsEl = document.getElementById('eucSteps');
    var eucRotationEl = document.getElementById('eucRotation');

    var pulses = parseInt(eucPulsesEl ? eucPulsesEl.value : '3') || 3;
    var steps = parseInt(eucStepsEl ? eucStepsEl.value : '8') || 8;
    var rotation = parseInt(eucRotationEl ? eucRotationEl.value : '0') || 0;

    // Generate pattern
    var indices = bjorklund(pulses, steps);
    var rotated = rotatePattern(indices, rotation, steps);
    var activeSet = new Set(rotated);

    // Outer circle (subtle)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Draw connecting lines between active steps (polygon)
    if (rotated.length > 1) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      var sortedIdx = rotated.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
      for (var i = 0; i < sortedIdx.length; i++) {
        var angle = (sortedIdx[i] / steps) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
        var x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
        var y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
        if (i === 0) {
          ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        } else {
          ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
      } // end for polygon vertices
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(74, 138, 186, 0.3)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(74, 138, 186, 0.05)';
      ctx.fill();
    } // end if draw polygon

    // Draw step dots
    var dotRadius = 4;
    var activeDotRadius = 6;

    for (var i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      var angle = (i / steps) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      var x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
      var y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius;

      ctx.beginPath();
      if (activeSet.has(i)) {
        ctx.arc(x, y, activeDotRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4a8aba';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#6ab0e0';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        ctx.arc(x, y, dotRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a3e';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#444';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();
      } // end if/else active dot
    } // end for each step dot

    // Highlight current live step if running
    var instId = SL.audio ? SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument() : 0;
    if (eucLiveIntervals[instId] && eucLivePatterns[instId]) {
      var liveStep = eucLiveSteps[instId];
      var eucDivisionEl = document.getElementById('eucDivision');
      var divFactor = parseFloat(eucDivisionEl ? eucDivisionEl.value : '1') || 1;
      var patternLength = Math.round(steps * divFactor);
      var eucStep = Math.round(liveStep * steps / patternLength) % steps;

      var angle = (eucStep / steps) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      var x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
      var y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, activeDotRadius + 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff0';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Center text: E(pulses,steps)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('E(' + pulses + ',' + steps + ')', cx, cy);
  }; // end var renderEuclideanRing

  var animateEuclideanRing = () => {
    renderEuclideanRing();
    var anyLive = false;

  }; // end var animateEuclideanRing

  // Render drum notes in the rhythm grid

    var stepsPerPage = 64;
    var pageOffset = currentPage * stepsPerPage;
    var pageEnd = pageOffset + stepsPerPage;

      return n.instrument === 3 && n.start >= pageOffset && n.start < pageEnd;
    });

    drumNotes.forEach(function(n) {
      var localCol = n.start - pageOffset;
      var cellIdx = n.row * stepsPerPage + localCol;
      var cells = rhythmGridEl.children;
      if (cellIdx >= 0 && cellIdx < cells.length) {
        var noteDiv = document.createElement('div');
        noteDiv.className = 'seq-note inst-3';
        noteDiv.style.background = '#4cc9f0';
        noteDiv.style.width = Math.min(n.dur, stepsPerPage - localCol) * (100 / stepsPerPage) + '%';

        noteDiv.style.height = '100%';
        noteDiv.style.position = 'absolute';
        cells[cellIdx].style.position = 'relative';
        cells[cellIdx].appendChild(noteDiv);
      }
    }); // end forEach drumNotes
  } // end function renderRhythmNotes

  // Setup event listeners for menus and controls
  function setupEventListeners() {
    initDOMRefs();

    // Duration picker buttons
    durPicker.querySelectorAll('button[data-dur]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        var dur = parseInt(btn.dataset.dur);

        // Check for pending place operation first
        if (pendingPlace) {
          placeProgression(pendingPlace.chords, pendingPlace.progName, dur);
          pendingPlace = null;
          hideDurPicker();
          return;
        }

        if (!pendingDrop) return;
        var { step: rawStep, row, data } = pendingDrop;
        var baseMidi = SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI;
        var instrument = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
        var totalSteps = getTotalSteps();

        // Snap step to nearest grid line based on duration
        var step = Math.round(rawStep / dur) * dur;

        // Helper to snap a MIDI note to scale and clamp to grid
        var snapAndClamp = (midi) => {
          var snapped = snapToScale(midi);
          var rowNum = snapped - baseMidi;
          return { midi: snapped, row: Math.max(0, Math.min(SL.SEQ_ROWS - 1, rowNum)) };
        };

        if (data.sequence && data.chords) {
          var firstChordNotes = data.chords[0].notes;
          var minNote = Math.min(...firstChordNotes);
          var targetMidi = snapToScale(baseMidi + row);
          var offset = targetMidi - snapToScale(minNote);
          data.chords.forEach((ch, i) => {
            var st = step + i * dur;
            if (st < totalSteps) {
              var snappedNotes = ch.notes.map(n => snapToScale(n + offset));
              seqNotes.push({ isChord: true, notes: snappedNotes, name: ch.name, start: st, dur, instrument });
            }
          }); // end forEach chord
        } else if (data.notes && data.name) {
          var minNote = Math.min(...data.notes);
          var targetMidi = snapToScale(baseMidi + row);
          var offset = targetMidi - snapToScale(minNote);
          var snappedNotes = data.notes.map(n => snapToScale(n + offset));
          seqNotes.push({ isChord: true, notes: snappedNotes, name: data.name, start: step, dur, instrument });
        } else if (data.midi !== undefined) {
          var targetMidi = baseMidi + row;
          var { midi: snappedMidi, row: snappedRow } = snapAndClamp(targetMidi);
          seqNotes.push({ row: snappedRow, start: step, dur, midi: snappedMidi, instrument });
        } else {
          var targetMidi = baseMidi + row;
          var { midi: snappedMidi, row: snappedRow } = snapAndClamp(targetMidi);
          seqNotes.push({ row: snappedRow, start: step, dur, midi: snappedMidi, instrument });
        } // end if/else data type

        renderSeqNotes();
        hideDurPicker();
      }); // end addEventListener click (dur button)
    }); // end forEach durPicker buttons

    // Note menu action buttons
    noteMenu.querySelectorAll('button[data-action]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        var idx = parseInt(noteMenu.dataset.noteIdx);
        var note = seqNotes[idx];
        if (!note) return;

        var action = btn.dataset.action;
        if (action === 'delete') {
          seqNotes.splice(idx, 1);
          selectedNote = null;
        } else if (action === 'duplicate') {
          var copy = { ...note };
          if (note.isChord) copy.notes = [...note.notes];
          copy.start = Math.min(note.start + note.dur, getTotalSteps() - note.dur);
          seqNotes.push(copy);
        }

        renderSeqNotes();
        hideNoteMenu();
      }); // end addEventListener click (note action)
    }); // end forEach noteMenu action buttons

    // Note menu arpeggio buttons
    noteMenu.querySelectorAll('button[data-arp]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {

        if (!note || note.isChord) return;

        var arpType = btn.dataset.arp;
        var baseMidi = SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI;
        var noteMidi = note.midi || baseMidi + note.row;
        var startNotes = [noteMidi, noteMidi + 4, noteMidi + 7];
        var noteList = [...startNotes].sort((a, b) => a - b);

        if (arpType === 'down') noteList.reverse();
        else if (arpType === 'updown') noteList = [...noteList, ...noteList.slice(1, -1).reverse()];
        else if (arpType === 'random') noteList.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

        var sourceInstrument = note.instrument !== undefined ? note.instrument : 0;
        var totalSteps = getTotalSteps();

        seqNotes.splice(idx, 1);
        var stepPer = 4;
        var numNotes = Math.floor(note.dur / stepPer) || 1;

        for (var i = 0; i < numNotes && note.start + i * stepPer < totalSteps; i++) {
          var midi = noteList[Math.min(i, noteList.length - 1)];
          var r = midi - baseMidi;
          if (r >= 0 && r < SL.SEQ_ROWS) {
            seqNotes.push({ row: r, start: note.start + i * stepPer, dur: stepPer, midi, instrument: sourceInstrument });
          }
        } // end for arpeggio notes

        renderSeqNotes();
        hideNoteMenu();
      }); // end addEventListener click (note arp)
    }); // end forEach noteMenu arp buttons

        var pattern = btn.dataset.rhythm;
        var sourceInstrument = note.instrument !== undefined ? note.instrument : 0;
        var totalSteps = getTotalSteps();
        seqNotes.splice(idx, 1);
        var stepLen = Math.floor(note.dur / 4) || 1;

        var addChord = (st, d) => {
          seqNotes.push({ isChord: true, notes: [...note.notes], name: note.name, start: st, dur: d, instrument: sourceInstrument });
        };

        if (pattern === 'straight') {
          for (var i = 0; i < 4 && note.start + i * stepLen < totalSteps; i++) {
            addChord(note.start + i * stepLen, stepLen);
          }
        } else if (pattern === 'offbeat') {
          for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            var st = note.start + i * stepLen + Math.floor(stepLen / 2);
            if (st < totalSteps) addChord(st, Math.floor(stepLen / 2) || 1);

        } else if (pattern === 'syncopated') {

  /**
   * Place a progression on the sequencer at the lowest visible note
   */
  function placeProgression(chords, progName, dur) {
    if (!chords || chords.length === 0) return;

    var baseMidi = SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI;
    var wrapper = document.querySelector('.seq-wrapper');
    var cellH = SL.SEQ_CELL_H;
    var totalSteps = getTotalSteps();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;

    var scrollTop = wrapper ? wrapper.scrollTop : 0;
    var visibleHeight = wrapper ? wrapper.clientHeight : (SL.SEQ_ROWS * cellH);

    var topRow = SL.SEQ_ROWS - 1 - Math.floor(scrollTop / cellH);
    var bottomRow = SL.SEQ_ROWS - 1 - Math.floor((scrollTop + visibleHeight) / cellH);
    var lowestVisibleMidi = baseMidi + Math.max(0, bottomRow);
    var highestVisibleMidi = baseMidi + Math.min(SL.SEQ_ROWS - 1, topRow);

    var firstChordNotes = chords[0].notes;
    var minChordNote = Math.min(...firstChordNotes);
    var minChordPc = minChordNote % 12;

    var targetMidi = lowestVisibleMidi;
    for (var midi = lowestVisibleMidi; midi <= highestVisibleMidi; midi++) {
      if (midi % 12 === minChordPc) {
        targetMidi = midi;
        break;
      }
    }

    var offset = targetMidi - minChordNote;
    var noteDur = dur || 16;
    var instrument = SL.audio && SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument ? SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument() : 0;

    // Place chords starting at current page offset
    chords.forEach((ch, i) => {
      var st = pageOffset + i * noteDur;
      if (st < totalSteps) {
        var transposedNotes = ch.notes.map(n => snapToScale(n + offset));
        seqNotes.push({ isChord: true, notes: transposedNotes, name: ch.name, start: st, dur: noteDur, instrument });

    }); // end forEach chords

    renderSeqNotes();
  } // end function placeProgression

  function handlePendingPlace(dur) {
    if (!pendingPlace) return false;

    for (let i = 0; i < styles.length; i++) {
      if (styles[i].id === styleId) {
        return styles[i].category || 'Other';
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function populateArrangementPresets(genreId, selectElementId) {
    var selectEl = document.getElementById(selectElementId);
    if (selectEl) {
      selectEl.innerHTML = '';

      // Add default empty option
      var emptyOpt = document.createElement('option');
      emptyOpt.value = '';
      emptyOpt.textContent = '-- Select Arrangement --';
      selectEl.appendChild(emptyOpt);

      var category = getCategoryForStyle(genreId);
      if (category && ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category]) {
        var presets = ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category];
        for (let i = 0; i < presets.length; i++) {
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = String(i);
          opt.textContent = presets[i].name;
          selectEl.appendChild(opt);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function populateInstrumentationDropdown(selectId, genreId) {
    var sel = document.getElementById(selectId);
    if (!sel) return;
    sel.innerHTML = '';

    var category = getCategoryForStyle(genreId);

    // Filter styles to matching category
    var filtered = [];
    styles.forEach(function(s) {
      var cat = s.category || 'Other';
      if (cat === category) {
        filtered.push(s);
      }
    });

    // Sort alphabetically
    filtered.sort(function(a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name); });

    filtered.forEach(function(s) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = s.id;
      opt.textContent = s.name;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }

  function applyInstrumentationPreset(styleId, panelPrefix) {
    var hintStyle = styles.find(function(s) { return s.id === styleId; });
    if (hintStyle && hintStyle.instruments && currentStyle) {
      // Update currentStyle instruments
      currentStyle.instruments = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(hintStyle.instruments));

      // Update UI selects
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        var instDef = hintStyle.instruments[i] || {};
        var selType = document.getElementById(panelPrefix + 'InstType' + i);
        var selPreset = document.getElementById(panelPrefix + 'InstPreset' + i);
        if (selType && instDef.type) {
          selType.value = instDef.type;
          selType.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        }
        if (selPreset && instDef.preset) {
          (function(sel, val) {
            setTimeout(function() { sel.value = val; }, 50);
          })(selPreset, instDef.preset);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function applyArrangementPreset(genreId, presetIndex, panelPrefix) {
    var category = getCategoryForStyle(genreId);
    if (category && ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category]) {
      var idx = parseInt(presetIndex, 10);
      if (!isNaN(idx) && idx >= 0 && idx < ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category].length) {
        var preset = ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category][idx];
        if (preset && preset.structure && currentStyle) {
          // Apply structure
          currentStyle.structure = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(preset.structure));
          renderStructureEditor();

          // Reset structure preset dropdown to Custom
          var structPresetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
          if (structPresetSel) {
            structPresetSel.value = '';
          }

          // Auto-select matching instrumentation
          if (preset.styleHint) {
            var instSel = document.getElementById(panelPrefix + 'Instrumentation');
            if (instSel) {
              instSel.value = preset.styleHint;
            }
            applyInstrumentationPreset(preset.styleHint, panelPrefix);

            // Also update BPM from the hint style
            var hintStyle = styles.find(function(s) { return s.id === preset.styleHint; });
            if (hintStyle && hintStyle.bpm) {
              var bpmEl = document.getElementById('songBpm');
              if (bpmEl) {
                var bpmVal = hintStyle.bpm[0] + Math.floor(Math.random() * (hintStyle.bpm[1] - hintStyle.bpm[0]));
                bpmEl.value = bpmVal;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Humanization Functions
  // ============================================================

  function applyHumanizationToNote(note, instrumentType) {
    if (_songHumanization > 0) {
      // instrumentType: 'bass' | 'lead' | 'pad' | 'drums'
      let velScale = 0;
      let timingScale = 0;

      if (instrumentType === 'bass') {
        velScale = 0.8;
        timingScale = 0.4;
      } else if (instrumentType === 'lead') {
        velScale = 1.0;
        timingScale = 1.0;
      } else if (instrumentType === 'pad') {
        velScale = 0.5;
        timingScale = 0;
      } else if (instrumentType === 'drums') {
        velScale = 0.6;
        timingScale = 0.3;
      }

      // Velocity jitter: +/- (humanization * 0.5) scaled by instrument — wider range for audible effect
      var velJitter = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * _songHumanization * 0.5 * velScale;
      note.vel = clamp(Math.round(note.vel + velJitter), 1, 127);

      // Timing micro-offset in ms (used by sequencer as setTimeout delay)
      if (timingScale > 0) {
        var maxOffset = _songHumanization * 0.8;
        note.timingOffset = Math.abs((Math.random() * maxOffset) * timingScale);
      }
    }

    return note;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Seeded PRNG (mulberry32)
  // ============================================================

  function mulberry32(seed) {
    var s = seed | 0;
    return function() {
      s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  var _origRandom = null;

  function seedRandom(seed) {
    _origRandom = Math.random;
    Math.random = mulberry32(seed);
  }

  function restoreRandom() {
    if (_origRandom) {
      Math.random = _origRandom;
      _origRandom = null;
    }
  }

  function getSongSeed() {
    var el = document.getElementById('songSeed');
    return el ? parseInt(el.value, 10) || 0 : 0;
  }

  function randomizeSongSeed() {
    restoreRandom(); // ensure true random, not seeded PRNG
    var el = document.getElementById('songSeed');
    if (el) el.value = Math.floor(Math.random() * 999999);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Helpers
  // ============================================================

  function pickRandom(arr) {
    return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
  }

  function clamp(val, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, val));
  }

  function findPreset(type, name) {
    let list = [];
    if (type === 'subtractive') {
      list = SL.presets.getSubtractivePresets();
    } else if (type === 'fm') {
      list = SL.presets.getFMPresets();
    } else if (type === 'physical') {
      list = SL.presets.getPhysicalPresets();
    }
    if (!list) return null;
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (list[i].name === name) return list[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function findDrumPattern(name) {
    var groups = SL._data.drumPatterns;
    if (!groups) return null;
    for (let g = 0; g < groups.length; g++) {
      var patterns = groups[g].patterns;
      if (!patterns) continue;
      for (let p = 0; p < patterns.length; p++) {
        if (patterns[p].name === name) return patterns[p];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function getScaleNotes(root, mode, lowMidi, highMidi) {
    var modeData = SL.MODES[mode];
    if (!modeData) return [];
    var scale = modeData.scale;
    var notes = [];
    for (let midi = lowMidi; midi <= highMidi; midi++) {
      var pc = ((midi % 12) - root + 12) % 12;
      if (scale.indexOf(pc) !== -1) {
        notes.push(midi);
      }
    }
    return notes;
  }

  function resolveKey(keyName) {
    // Handle numeric keys (from select value or JSON data)
    var asInt = parseInt(keyName, 10);
    if (!isNaN(asInt) && asInt >= 0 && asInt < 12) return asInt;
    var idx = SL.NOTES.indexOf(keyName);
    return idx >= 0 ? idx : 0;
  }

  function updateStatus(msg) {
    var el = document.getElementById('songStatus');
    if (el) el.textContent = msg;
  }
