  var SECTION_NAMES = ['intro', 'verse', 'chorus', 'bridge', 'outro'];

  function populateStructureDropdown(selectId, genreId) {
    var sel = document.getElementById(selectId);
    if (!sel) return;
    sel.innerHTML = '';

    // Empty/custom option
    var emptyOpt = document.createElement('option');
    emptyOpt.value = '';
    emptyOpt.textContent = 'Custom';
    sel.appendChild(emptyOpt);

    // Generic templates
    var genericGroup = document.createElement('optgroup');
    genericGroup.label = 'Templates';
    var genericLabels = {
      simple: 'Simple (V-C-V-C)',
      standard: 'Standard (I-V-C-V-C-B-C-O)',
      extended: 'Extended (I-V-PC-C-V-PC-C-B-C-O)',
      epic: 'Epic (I-V-C-V-C-B-V-C-C-O)',
      minimal: 'Minimal (V-V-O)'
    };
    Object.keys(STRUCTURE_PRESETS).forEach(function(key) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = 'tmpl:' + key;
      opt.textContent = genericLabels[key] || key;
      genericGroup.appendChild(opt);
    });
    sel.appendChild(genericGroup);

    // Genre-specific structures from arrangement presets
    var category = getCategoryForStyle(genreId);
    if (category && ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category]) {
      var genreGroup = document.createElement('optgroup');
      genreGroup.label = category;
      ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category].forEach(function(preset, i) {
        var opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = 'arr:' + i;
        // Summarize structure
        var secs = preset.structure.map(function(s) { return s.section.charAt(0).toUpperCase(); }).join('-');
        var bars = preset.structure.reduce(function(sum, s) { return sum + (s.bars || 0); }, 0);
        opt.textContent = preset.name + ' (' + bars + ' bars)';
        genreGroup.appendChild(opt);
      });
      sel.appendChild(genreGroup);
    }
  }

  function applyStructurePreset(presetId, genreId) {
    if (!presetId || !currentStyle) return;

    if (presetId.indexOf('tmpl:') === 0) {
      // Generic template
      var key = presetId.substring(5);
      if (STRUCTURE_PRESETS[key]) {
        currentStyle.structure = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(STRUCTURE_PRESETS[key]));
        renderStructureEditor();
      }
    } else if (presetId.indexOf('arr:') === 0) {
      // Arrangement-based structure
      var idx = parseInt(presetId.substring(4), 10);
      var category = getCategoryForStyle(genreId);
      if (category && ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category] && ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category][idx]) {
        currentStyle.structure = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category][idx].structure));
        renderStructureEditor();
      }
    } else if (STRUCTURE_PRESETS[presetId]) {
      // Legacy: bare key
      currentStyle.structure = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(STRUCTURE_PRESETS[presetId]));
      renderStructureEditor();
    }
  }

  function renderStructureEditor() {
    var structEl = document.getElementById('songStructure');
    if (!structEl || !currentStyle || !currentStyle.structure) return;
    structEl.innerHTML = '';
    var partNames = ['B', 'L', 'P', 'D', 'Lp'];
    var totalBars = 0;

    currentStyle.structure.forEach(function(sec, idx) {
      totalBars += sec.bars || 4;
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center;padding:1px 0;';

      // Remove button (X)
      var removeBtn = document.createElement('button');
      removeBtn.textContent = 'X';
      removeBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:1px 3px;font-size:0.4rem;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #633;background:#2a1a1a;color:#f66;';
      removeBtn.addEventListener('click', (function(i) {
        return function() {
          currentStyle.structure.splice(i, 1);
          renderStructureEditor();
          var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
          if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';
        };
      })(idx));
      row.appendChild(removeBtn);

      // Insert button (+) — inserts a new section BEFORE this index
      var insertBtn = document.createElement('button');
      insertBtn.textContent = '+';
      insertBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:1px 3px;font-size:0.4rem;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #363;background:#1a2e1a;color:#0f0;';
      insertBtn.addEventListener('click', (function(i) {
        return function() {
          var newSection = { section: 'verse', bars: 8, parts: [0, 1, 2, 3] };
          currentStyle.structure.splice(i, 0, newSection);
          renderStructureEditor();
          var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
          if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';
        };
      })(idx));
      row.appendChild(insertBtn);

      // Up arrow button
      var upBtn = document.createElement('button');
      upBtn.textContent = '\u25B2';
      var upBtnStyle = 'padding:1px 3px;font-size:0.4rem;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #333;background:#1a1a2e;color:#888;';
      if (idx === 0) {
        upBtnStyle += 'opacity:0.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none;';
      }
      upBtn.style.cssText = upBtnStyle;
      upBtn.addEventListener('click', (function(i) {
        return function() {
          if (i > 0) {
            var temp = currentStyle.structure[i];
            currentStyle.structure[i] = currentStyle.structure[i - 1];
            currentStyle.structure[i - 1] = temp;
            renderStructureEditor();
            var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
            if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';
          }
        };
      })(idx));
      row.appendChild(upBtn);

      // Down arrow button
      var downBtn = document.createElement('button');
      downBtn.textContent = '\u25BC';
      var downBtnStyle = 'padding:1px 3px;font-size:0.4rem;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #333;background:#1a1a2e;color:#888;';
      if (idx === currentStyle.structure.length - 1) {
        downBtnStyle += 'opacity:0.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none;';
      }
      downBtn.style.cssText = downBtnStyle;
      downBtn.addEventListener('click', (function(i) {
        return function() {
          if (i < currentStyle.structure.length - 1) {
            var temp = currentStyle.structure[i];
            currentStyle.structure[i] = currentStyle.structure[i + 1];
            currentStyle.structure[i + 1] = temp;
            renderStructureEditor();
            var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
            if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';
          }
        };
      })(idx));
      row.appendChild(downBtn);

      // Section name dropdown
      var secSelect = document.createElement('select');
      secSelect.style.cssText = 'background:#0a0a1a;color:#ccc;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:2px;padding:1px 2px;font-size:0.45rem;width:60px;';
      SECTION_NAMES.forEach(function(name) {
        var opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = name;
        opt.textContent = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1);
        if (name === (sec.section || sec.name)) opt.selected = true;
        secSelect.appendChild(opt);
      });
      secSelect.addEventListener('change', (function(i) {
        return function() {
          currentStyle.structure[i].section = this.value;
          currentStyle.structure[i].name = this.value;
          updateStructureTotalBars();
          // Set preset dropdown to Custom
          var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
          if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';
        };
      })(idx));
      row.appendChild(secSelect);

      // Bars input
      var barsInput = document.createElement('input');
      barsInput.type = 'number';
      barsInput.min = '4';
      barsInput.max = '32';
      barsInput.step = '4';
      barsInput.value = sec.bars || 4;
      barsInput.style.cssText = 'background:#0a0a1a;color:#ccc;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:2px;padding:1px 2px;font-size:0.45rem;width:32px;text-align:center;';
      barsInput.addEventListener('change', (function(i) {
        return function() {
          var val = parseInt(this.value, 10) || 4;
          val = Math.max(4, Math.min(32, Math.round(val / 4) * 4));
          this.value = val;
          currentStyle.structure[i].bars = val;
          updateStructureTotalBars();
          var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
          if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';
        };
      })(idx));
      row.appendChild(barsInput);

      // Part toggle buttons
      var parts = sec.parts || [];
      for (var pi = 0; pi < 5; pi++) {
        var partBtn = document.createElement('button');
        var isOn = parts.indexOf(pi) !== -1;
        partBtn.textContent = partNames[pi];
        partBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:1px 3px;font-size:0.4rem;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid ' + (isOn ? '#4a8aba' : '#333') + ';background:' + (isOn ? '#2a4a6a' : '#1a1a2e') + ';color:' + (isOn ? '#8cf' : '#666') + ';';
        partBtn.dataset.secIdx = idx;
        partBtn.dataset.partIdx = pi;
        partBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var si = parseInt(this.dataset.secIdx);
          var pIdx = parseInt(this.dataset.partIdx);
          var p = currentStyle.structure[si].parts || [];
          var pos = p.indexOf(pIdx);
          if (pos === -1) {
            p.push(pIdx);
            p.sort();
          } else {
            p.splice(pos, 1);
          }
          currentStyle.structure[si].parts = p;
          renderStructureEditor();
          var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
          if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';
        });
        row.appendChild(partBtn);
      }

      structEl.appendChild(row);
    });

    updateStructureTotalBars();
  }

  function updateStructureTotalBars() {
    var totalBars = 0;
    if (currentStyle && currentStyle.structure) {
      currentStyle.structure.forEach(function(sec) {
        totalBars += sec.bars || 4;
      });
    }
    var el = document.getElementById('songTotalBars');
    if (el) el.textContent = totalBars + ' bars';
  }

  function addStructureSection() {
    if (!currentStyle) return;
    if (!currentStyle.structure) currentStyle.structure = [];
    currentStyle.structure.push({ section: 'verse', bars: 8, parts: [0, 1, 2, 3] });
    renderStructureEditor();
    var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
    if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init
  // ============================================================

  function init() {
    var data = SL._data && SL._data.songStyles;
    if (data && data.styles) {
      styles = data.styles;
    }

    var genreSelect = document.getElementById('songGenre');
    if (genreSelect && styles.length > 0) {
      // Group by category
      var categories = {};
      styles.forEach(function(s) {
        var cat = s.category || 'Other';
        if (!categories[cat]) categories[cat] = [];
        categories[cat].push(s);
      });

      genreSelect.innerHTML = '';
      Object.keys(categories).forEach(function(cat) {
        var group = document.createElement('optgroup');
        group.label = cat;
        categories[cat].forEach(function(s) {
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = s.id;
          opt.textContent = s.name;
          group.appendChild(opt);
        });
        genreSelect.appendChild(group);
      });

      genreSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        loadStyleDefaults(genreSelect.value);
        populateArrangementPresets(genreSelect.value, 'songArrangementPreset');
        populateInstrumentationDropdown('songInstrumentation', genreSelect.value);
        populateStructureDropdown('songStructurePreset', genreSelect.value);
      });
    }

    // Wire song arrangement preset dropdown
    var songArrPreset = document.getElementById('songArrangementPreset');
    if (songArrPreset) {
      songArrPreset.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var genreSel = document.getElementById('songGenre');
        if (genreSel && songArrPreset.value !== '') {
          applyArrangementPreset(genreSel.value, songArrPreset.value, 'song');
        }
      });

    }

    // Wire song instrumentation dropdown (populated on genre change + initial load)
    var songInstPresetSel = document.getElementById('songInstrumentation');
    if (songInstPresetSel) {
      songInstPresetSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
        applyInstrumentationPreset(songInstPresetSel.value, 'song');
      });
    }

    // Wire humanization slider display
    var humSlider = document.getElementById('songHumanization');
    var humVal = document.getElementById('songHumVal');
    if (humSlider && humVal) {
      humVal.textContent = humSlider.value;
      humSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
        humVal.textContent = humSlider.value;
      });
    }

    // Wire buttons
    var genBtn = document.getElementById('songGenerate');
    if (genBtn) genBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { generateSong(); });

    var clearBtn = document.getElementById('songClear');
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      SL.sequencer.clearSeq();
      SL.sequencer.renderSeqGrid();
    });

    var randBtn = document.getElementById('songRandomize');
    if (randBtn) randBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { randomizeStyle(); });

    // Wire structure preset dropdown
    var structPresetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
    if (structPresetSel) {
      structPresetSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var genreSel = document.getElementById('songGenre');
        applyStructurePreset(this.value, genreSel ? genreSel.value : '');
      });
    }

    // Wire add-section button
    var addSectionBtn = document.getElementById('songAddSection');
    if (addSectionBtn) {
      addSectionBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        addStructureSection();
      });
    }

    // Wire song panel mix volume sliders
    for (let mi = 0; mi < 5; mi++) {
      (function(idx) {
        var slider = document.getElementById('songMixVol' + idx);
        var valSpan = document.getElementById('songMixVal' + idx);
        if (slider) {
          slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
            var v = parseInt(slider.value, 10);
            if (valSpan) valSpan.textContent = v;
            if (SL.audio && SL.audio.setInstrumentVolume) {
              SL.audio.setInstrumentVolume(idx, v);
            }
          });
        }
      })(mi);
    }

    // Set a random default seed
    randomizeSongSeed();

    // Load first style and populate all genre-filtered dropdowns
    if (styles.length > 0) {
      loadStyleDefaults(styles[0].id);
      populateArrangementPresets(styles[0].id, 'songArrangementPreset');
      populateInstrumentationDropdown('songInstrumentation', styles[0].id);
      populateStructureDropdown('songStructurePreset', styles[0].id);
    }

    // Initialize arrange panel
    initArrangePanel();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Load Style Defaults
  // ============================================================

  function loadStyleDefaults(styleId) {
    let style = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < styles.length; i++) {
      if (styles[i].id === styleId) {
        style = styles[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!style) return;

    // Deep clone
    currentStyle = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(style));

    // Resolve BPM: may be [min, max] array or single number
    let bpmVal = currentStyle.bpm;
    if (Array.isArray(bpmVal)) {
      bpmVal = Math.round((bpmVal[0] + bpmVal[1]) / 2);
      currentStyle.bpm = bpmVal;
    }

    // Resolve key: may be array of integers, pick first
    let keyVal = currentStyle.key;
    if (!keyVal && keyVal !== 0) {
      if (currentStyle.keys && currentStyle.keys.length > 0) {
        keyVal = currentStyle.keys[0];
      } else {
        keyVal = 0;
      }
    }
    if (Array.isArray(keyVal)) keyVal = keyVal[0];
    currentStyle.key = keyVal;

    // Populate UI
    var bpmInput = document.getElementById('songBpm');
    if (bpmInput) bpmInput.value = bpmVal || 120;

    var keySelect = document.getElementById('songKey');
    if (keySelect) keySelect.value = String(keyVal);

    var modeSelect = document.getElementById('songMode');
    if (modeSelect) modeSelect.value = currentStyle.mode || 'ionian';

    // Populate melody UI sliders from genre defaults
    var melDefaults = currentStyle.melody || {};
    var melUiMap = [
      { id: 'songMelodyDensity',    key: 'density',     valId: 'songMelDensVal',    fallback: 50 },
      { id: 'songMelodyNoteLen',    key: 'noteLen',     valId: 'songMelNoteLenVal', fallback: 4 },
      { id: 'songMelodyMaxInterval', key: 'maxInterval', valId: 'songMelIntVal',     fallback: 7 },
      { id: 'songMelodyChordBias',  key: 'chordBias',   valId: 'songMelChordVal',   fallback: 60 },
      { id: 'songMelodySyncopation', key: 'syncopation', valId: 'songMelSyncVal',    fallback: 20 },
      { id: 'songMelodyGate',       key: 'gate',        valId: 'songMelGateVal',    fallback: 80 },
      { id: 'songMelodyVelocity',   key: 'velocity',    valId: 'songMelVelVal',     fallback: 90 }
    ];
    for (var mdi = 0; mdi < melUiMap.length; mdi++) {
      var entry = melUiMap[mdi];
      var sliderEl = document.getElementById(entry.id);
      var valEl = document.getElementById(entry.valId);
      var val = (melDefaults[entry.key] !== undefined) ? melDefaults[entry.key] : entry.fallback;
      if (sliderEl) { sliderEl.value = val; }
      if (valEl) { valEl.textContent = String(val); }
    }

    // Populate instrument preset selectors
    populateInstrumentSelectors();

    // Render structure editor
    renderStructureEditor();

    // Reset structure preset dropdown to Custom
    var presetSel = document.getElementById('songStructurePreset');
    if (presetSel) presetSel.value = '';

    // Auto-select matching instrumentation
    var instSel = document.getElementById('songInstrumentation');
    if (instSel) {
      instSel.value = styleId;
    }

    // Update genre select to match
    var genreSelect = document.getElementById('songGenre');
    if (genreSelect) genreSelect.value = styleId;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Build Section Chords
  // ============================================================

  function buildSectionChords(sectionName, sectionBars) {
    if (!currentStyle || !currentStyle.progressions) return [];

    // Fall back to related section if exact name not in progressions
    var progDef = currentStyle.progressions[sectionName];
    if (!progDef) {
      var fallbackMap = {
        'drop': 'chorus', 'buildup': 'verse', 'breakdown': 'verse',
        'pre-chorus': 'verse', 'hook': 'chorus', 'solo': 'chorus',
        'instrumental': 'chorus', 'interlude': 'bridge'
      };
      var fallback = fallbackMap[sectionName];
      if (fallback) {
        progDef = currentStyle.progressions[fallback];
      }
      if (!progDef) {
        // Last resort: use any available progression
        var progKeys = Object.keys(currentStyle.progressions);
        if (progKeys.length > 0) {
          progDef = currentStyle.progressions[progKeys[0]];
        }
      }
    }
    if (!progDef) return [];

    var mode = SL.MODES[currentStyle.mode || 'ionian'];
    if (!mode) return [];

    var root = resolveKey(currentStyle.key);
    var degs = progDef.degs || [];
    // Read pad octave range from UI selectors; convert grid-display octave to MIDI: midi = (oct+1)*12
    var loEl = document.getElementById('songOctLo2');
    var padOctave = loEl ? parseInt(loEl.value, 10) || 3 : 3;

    var totalSteps = (sectionBars || 4) * 16;
    var durPerChord = progDef.durPerChord || (degs.length > 0 ? Math.floor(totalSteps / degs.length) : totalSteps);

    var chords = [];
    degs.forEach(function(deg) {
      var scaleDeg = mode.scale[deg % mode.scale.length];
      var chordType = mode.triads[deg % mode.triads.length];
      var pc = (root + scaleDeg) % 12;
      var baseMidi = (padOctave + 1) * 12 + pc;
      var notes = SL.chords.getExtendedNotes(baseMidi, chordType, 3);
      chords.push({
        notes: notes,
        type: chordType,
        root: pc,
        dur: durPerChord
      });
    });

    return chords;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Note Generators
  // ============================================================

  function generateBassNotes(chords, startStep, bars, bassConfig) {
    var notes = [];
    var style = (bassConfig && bassConfig.style) || 'eighth';
    var velocity = (bassConfig && bassConfig.velocity) || 100;
    // Read octave range from UI selectors; convert grid-display octave to MIDI: midi = (oct+1)*12
    var loEl = document.getElementById('songOctLo0');
    var hiEl = document.getElementById('songOctHi0');
    var octLo = loEl ? parseInt(loEl.value, 10) || 2 : 2;
    var octHi = hiEl ? parseInt(hiEl.value, 10) || 3 : 3;
    var octave = octLo; // bass root defaults to low end of range
    var totalSteps = bars * 16;

    // Expand chords across the total steps
    let chordTimeline = [];
    let step = 0;
    chords.forEach(function(ch) {
      chordTimeline.push({ start: step, end: step + ch.dur, chord: ch });
      step += ch.dur;
    });

    function getChordAt(s) {
      for (let i = 0; i < chordTimeline.length; i++) {
        if (s >= chordTimeline[i].start && s < chordTimeline[i].end) {
          return chordTimeline[i].chord;
        }
      }
      return chords[0];
    }

    function pushNote(midi, s, dur) {
      if (s >= totalSteps) return;
      notes.push({
        row: midi - SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI,
        start: startStep + s,
        dur: dur,
        midi: midi,
        instrument: 0,
        vel: velocity
      });
    }

    if (style === 'eighth') {
      for (let s = 0; s < totalSteps; s += 2) {
        var ch = getChordAt(s);
        let midi;
        if (s % 8 === 0) {
          midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + ch.root;
        } else {
          var chordPCs = ch.notes.map(function(n) { return n % 12; });
          var pick = chordPCs[Math.floor(Math.random() * chordPCs.length)];
          midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + pick;
        }
        pushNote(midi, s, 2);
      }
    } else if (style === 'quarter') {
      for (let s = 0; s < totalSteps; s += 4) {
        var ch = getChordAt(s);
        let midi;
        if (s % 16 === 0) {
          midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + ch.root;
        } else {
          var chordPCs = ch.notes.map(function(n) { return n % 12; });
          var pick = chordPCs[Math.floor(Math.random() * chordPCs.length)];
          midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + pick;
        }
        pushNote(midi, s, 4);
      }
    } else if (style === 'offbeat') {
      for (let bar = 0; bar < bars; bar++) {
        var offsets = [2, 6, 10, 14];
        offsets.forEach(function(off) {
          var s = bar * 16 + off;
          if (s < totalSteps) {
            var ch = getChordAt(s);
            let midi;
            if (off === 2) {
              midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + ch.root;
            } else {
              var chordPCs = ch.notes.map(function(n) { return n % 12; });
              var pick = chordPCs[Math.floor(Math.random() * chordPCs.length)];
              midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + pick;
            }
            pushNote(midi, s, 2);
          }
        });
      }
    } else if (style === 'walking') {
      var modeData = SL.MODES[currentStyle.mode || 'ionian'];
      var scaleNotes = modeData ? modeData.scale : [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
      for (let s = 0; s < totalSteps; s += 4) {
        var ch = getChordAt(s);
        let midi;
        if (s % 16 === 0) {
          midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + ch.root;
        } else {
          var offset = pickRandom(scaleNotes);
          midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + (ch.root + offset) % 12;
        }
        pushNote(midi, s, 4);
      }
    } else if (style === 'sustained') {
      chordTimeline.forEach(function(ct) {
        var midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + ct.chord.root;
        pushNote(midi, ct.start, ct.chord.dur);
      });
    } else if (style === 'syncopated') {
      var pattern = [0, 3, 6, 10, 12];
      for (let bar = 0; bar < bars; bar++) {
        pattern.forEach(function(off) {
          var s = bar * 16 + off;
          if (s < totalSteps) {
            var ch = getChordAt(s);
            let midi;
            if (off === 0) {
              midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + ch.root;
            } else {
              var chordPCs = ch.notes.map(function(n) { return n % 12; });
              var pick = chordPCs[Math.floor(Math.random() * chordPCs.length)];
              midi = (octave + 1) * 12 + pick;
            }
            pushNote(midi, s, 2);
          }
        });
      }
    } else if (style === 'arp') {
      chordTimeline.forEach(function(ct) {
        var ch = ct.chord;
        var chordMidis = ch.notes.map(function(n) {
          return (n % 12) + (octave + 1) * 12;
        });
        let idx = 0;
        for (let s = ct.start; s < ct.end; s += 2) {
          pushNote(chordMidis[idx % chordMidis.length], s, 2);
          idx++;
        }
      });
    }

    return notes;
  }

  function generatePadNotes(chords, startStep, bars) {
    var notes = [];
    if (!chords || chords.length === 0) return notes;
    // Read pad octave range from UI selectors; convert grid-display octave to MIDI: midi = (oct+1)*12
    var loEl = document.getElementById('songOctLo2');
    var padOctave = loEl ? parseInt(loEl.value, 10) || 3 : 3;
    var totalSteps = bars * 16;
    let step = 0;
    var chordIdx = 0;

    // Repeat chords to fill the entire section length
    while (step < totalSteps) {
      for (var ci = 0; ci < chords.length; ci++) {
        if (step >= totalSteps) break;
        var ch = chords[ci];
        var dur = Math.min(ch.dur, totalSteps - step);
        var doStagger = (chordIdx % 3 === 1); // every 3rd chord gets staggered entry
        ch.notes.forEach(function(midiNote, noteIdx) {
          // Re-base notes to pad octave
          var pc = midiNote % 12;
          var midi = (padOctave + 1) * 12 + pc;
          var noteStart = startStep + step;
          var noteDur = dur;
          if (doStagger) {
            var offset = noteIdx * 2; // stagger by 2 steps per voice
            noteStart += offset;
            noteDur = Math.max(1, dur - offset);
          }
          // Vary velocity per voice — inner voices quieter
          var vel = 80;
          if (noteIdx === 0) { vel = 85; } // root strongest
          else if (noteIdx === ch.notes.length - 1) { vel = 75; } // top voice slightly softer
          else { vel = 70; } // inner voices softest
          notes.push({
            row: midi - SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI,
            start: noteStart,
            dur: noteDur,
            midi: midi,
            instrument: 2,
            vel: vel
          });
        });
        step += ch.dur;
        chordIdx++;
      }
    }

    return notes;
  }

  function generateLeadMelody(chords, startStep, bars, sectionName) {
    var notes = [];
    var melody = (currentStyle && currentStyle.melody) || {};
    var baseDensity = melody.density || 50;
    var sectionDensityMult = 1.0;
    if (sectionName === 'chorus' || sectionName === 'drop') {
      sectionDensityMult = 1.4;
    } else if (sectionName === 'bridge' || sectionName === 'breakdown') {
      sectionDensityMult = 0.6;
    } else if (sectionName === 'intro' || sectionName === 'outro') {
      sectionDensityMult = 0.7;
    } else if (sectionName === 'buildup') {
      sectionDensityMult = 1.2;
    } else if (sectionName === 'solo' || sectionName === 'instrumental') {
      sectionDensityMult = 1.5;
    }
    var density = Math.min(90, Math.round(baseDensity * sectionDensityMult));
    var chordBias = melody.chordBias || 60;
    var syncopation = melody.syncopation || 20;
    var maxInterval = melody.maxInterval || 7;
    var noteLen = melody.noteLen || 4;
    var gate = melody.gate || 80;
    var velocity = melody.velocity || 90;
    // Read lead octave range from UI selectors; convert grid-display octave to MIDI: midi = (oct+1)*12
    var loEl = document.getElementById('songOctLo1');
    var hiEl = document.getElementById('songOctHi1');
    var leadOctave = loEl ? parseInt(loEl.value, 10) || 4 : 4;
    var leadOctaveHi = hiEl ? parseInt(hiEl.value, 10) || 5 : 5;

    var mode = currentStyle.mode || 'ionian';
    var root = resolveKey(currentStyle.key || 'C');
    var lowMidi = (leadOctave + 1) * 12;
    var highMidi = (leadOctaveHi + 1) * 12 + 11;
    var scaleNotes = getScaleNotes(root, mode, lowMidi, highMidi);
    if (scaleNotes.length === 0) return notes;

    // Build set of chord tone pitch classes
    var chordPCs = {};
    chords.forEach(function(ch) {
      ch.notes.forEach(function(n) { chordPCs[n % 12] = true; });
    });

    // Build chord timeline
    let chordTimeline = [];
    let cStep = 0;
    chords.forEach(function(ch) {
      chordTimeline.push({ start: cStep, end: cStep + ch.dur, chord: ch });
      cStep += ch.dur;
    });

    function getChordAt(s) {
      for (let i = 0; i < chordTimeline.length; i++) {
        if (s >= chordTimeline[i].start && s < chordTimeline[i].end) {
          return chordTimeline[i].chord;
        }
      }
      return chords[0];
    }

    var totalSteps = bars * 16;
    let lastMidi = scaleNotes[Math.floor(scaleNotes.length / 2)];
    var direction = 0; // -1 = descending, 0 = neutral, 1 = ascending
    var directionMomentum = 0; // how many notes in same direction

    for (let s = 0; s < totalSteps; s++) {
      var isStrong = (s % 4 === 0);
      let prob = density / 100;
      if (isStrong) prob += 0.2;

      if (Math.random() > prob) continue;

      // Apply syncopation: shift some strong beat notes to weak beats
      let actualStep = s;
      if (isStrong && Math.random() * 100 < syncopation) {
        actualStep = s + (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1);
        if (actualStep < 0) actualStep = 0;
        if (actualStep >= totalSteps) actualStep = totalSteps - 1;
      }

      // Pick pitch
      var ch = getChordAt(s);
      let midi;
      if (Math.random() * 100 < chordBias) {
        // Prefer chord tones
        var chordNotes = ch.notes.filter(function(n) {
          return n >= lowMidi && n <= highMidi;
        });
        if (chordNotes.length > 0) {
          // Pick closest to last note within maxInterval
          var candidates = chordNotes.filter(function(n) {
            return Math.abs(n - lastMidi) <= maxInterval;
          });
          midi = candidates.length > 0 ? pickRandom(candidates) : pickRandom(chordNotes);
        } else {
          midi = pickRandom(scaleNotes);
        }
      } else {
        // Scale tone within maxInterval of last note
        var candidates = scaleNotes.filter(function(n) {
          return Math.abs(n - lastMidi) <= maxInterval;
        });
        midi = candidates.length > 0 ? pickRandom(candidates) : pickRandom(scaleNotes);
      }

      // Apply directional momentum — bias toward continuing in same direction
      if (directionMomentum >= 3) {
        direction = -direction; // reverse after 3 notes in same direction
        directionMomentum = 0;
      }
      if (direction !== 0) {
        // Filter candidates to prefer notes in current direction
        var dirCandidates = scaleNotes.filter(function(n) {
          var diff = n - lastMidi;
          return (direction > 0 ? diff > 0 : diff < 0) && Math.abs(diff) <= maxInterval;
        });
        if (dirCandidates.length > 0 && Math.random() < 0.7) {
          midi = pickRandom(dirCandidates);
        }
      }
      // Track direction
      if (midi > lastMidi) {
        if (direction === 1) { directionMomentum++; }
        else { direction = 1; directionMomentum = 1; }
      } else if (midi < lastMidi) {
        if (direction === -1) { directionMomentum++; }
        else { direction = -1; directionMomentum = 1; }
      }

      var len = Math.max(1, Math.round(noteLen * gate / 100));

      notes.push({
        row: midi - SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI,
        start: startStep + actualStep,
        dur: len,
        midi: midi,
        instrument: 1,
        vel: velocity,
        melody: true
      });

      lastMidi = midi;
    }

    return notes;
  }

  function generateDrumNotes(patternName, startStep, bars) {
    var notes = [];
    var pat = findDrumPattern(patternName);
    if (!pat || !pat.pattern) return notes;

    for (let bar = 0; bar < bars; bar++) {
      var isFillBar = (bar > 0 && ((bar + 1) % 4 === 0));
      pat.pattern.forEach(function(entry) {
        var pad = entry.pad;
        var steps = entry.steps;
        if (!steps) return;
        steps.forEach(function(stepIdx) {
          var absoluteStep = startStep + (bar * 16) + stepIdx;
          var vel = 100;
          if (isFillBar) {
            if (pad <= 2 && stepIdx >= 12) {
              vel = 110;
            }
          }
          notes.push({
            row: pad,
            start: absoluteStep,
            dur: 2,
            midi: SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI + pad,
            instrument: 3,
            vel: vel
          });
        });
      });
      if (isFillBar) {
        var fillSteps = [12, 13, 14, 15];
        var fillPad = 1;
        for (var fi = 0; fi < fillSteps.length; fi++) {
          if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
            var absStep = startStep + (bar * 16) + fillSteps[fi];
            var alreadyHas = false;
            for (var ni = notes.length - 1; ni >= Math.max(0, notes.length - 20); ni--) {
              if (notes[ni].start === absStep && notes[ni].row === fillPad) {
                alreadyHas = true;
                break;
              }
            }
            if (!alreadyHas) {
              notes.push({
                row: fillPad,
                start: absStep,
                dur: 1,
                midi: SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI + fillPad,
                instrument: 3,
                vel: 90
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return notes;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Effect Chain Presets
  // ============================================================

  var FX_PRESETS = {
    'None': {},
    'Warm Reverb': { reverb: { enabled: true, mix: 30, decay: 2.5 } },
    'Ambient': { reverb: { enabled: true, mix: 50, decay: 4.0 }, delay: { enabled: true, mix: 20, time: 375 } },
    'Lo-fi': { lofi: { enabled: true, mix: 60, bitDepth: 10, sampleRate: 12000 }, tape: { enabled: true, mix: 40 } },
    'Tape Warmth': { tape: { enabled: true, mix: 50 }, softClip: { enabled: true, mix: 30 } },
    'Chorus Shimmer': { chorus: { enabled: true, mix: 40, rate: 1.5 }, reverb: { enabled: true, mix: 25, decay: 2.0 } },
    'Distorted': { distortion: { enabled: true, mix: 50, drive: 40 }, compressor: { enabled: true, mix: 80 } },
    'Wide Pad': { chorus: { enabled: true, mix: 35 }, widener: { enabled: true, mix: 60 }, reverb: { enabled: true, mix: 40, decay: 3.0 } },
    'Tight Drums': { compressor: { enabled: true, mix: 80, threshold: -20, ratio: 4 }, gate: { enabled: true, mix: 100, threshold: -40 } },
    'Delay Echo': { delay: { enabled: true, mix: 35, time: 250, feedback: 40 } },
    'Gated Reverb': { gatedReverb: { enabled: true, mix: 45, decay: 1.5 } },
    'Phaser Swirl': { phaser: { enabled: true, mix: 40, rate: 0.5 } },
    'Clean Compress': { compressor: { enabled: true, mix: 70, threshold: -15, ratio: 3 } }
  };

  function getFxPresetNames() {
    return Object.keys(FX_PRESETS);
  }

  function applyFxPreset(instIndex, presetName) {
    var chain = SL.audio.getEffectChainForTarget
      ? SL.audio.getEffectChainForTarget(instIndex) : null;
    if (!chain) return;

    // Disable all effects first
    chain.order.forEach(function(name) {
      var eff = chain.effects.get(name);
      if (eff && eff.enabled) {
        eff.setEnabled(false);
      }
    });

    var preset = FX_PRESETS[presetName];
    if (!preset) return;

    Object.keys(preset).forEach(function(fxName) {
      var fxDef = preset[fxName];
      // Ensure the effect exists in chain (lazy creation + add to chain order)
      chain.addToChain(fxName);
      var eff = chain.getEffect(fxName);
      if (eff) {
        Object.keys(fxDef).forEach(function(param) {
          eff.setParam(param, fxDef[param]);
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Populate Instrument & FX Preset Selectors
  // ============================================================

  function populateInstrumentSelectors() {
    if (!currentStyle || !currentStyle.instruments) return;

    var roleLabels = ['Bass', 'Lead', 'Pad', 'Drums', 'Loop'];
    var defaultFxPresets = ['Clean Compress', 'Delay Echo', 'Wide Pad', 'Tight Drums', 'None'];

    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      var instDef = currentStyle.instruments[i] || {};
      var selType = document.getElementById('songInstType' + i);
      var selPreset = document.getElementById('songInstPreset' + i);
      var selFx = document.getElementById('songFxPreset' + i);

      // Populate type selector
      if (selType) {
        selType.value = instDef.type || 'subtractive';
        selType.onchange = (function(idx) {
          return function() { updatePresetOptions(idx); };
        })(i);
      }

      // Populate preset options based on type
      updatePresetOptions(i);

      // Set default preset
      if (selPreset && instDef.preset) {
        selPreset.value = instDef.preset;
      }

      // Add live preset change handler
      if (selPreset) {
        selPreset.addEventListener('change', (function(idx) {
          return function() {
            var st = document.getElementById('songInstType' + idx);
            applyInstrumentPreset(idx, st ? st.value : 'subtractive', selPreset.value);
          };
        })(i));
      }

      // Populate FX preset selector
      if (selFx) {
        selFx.innerHTML = '';
        getFxPresetNames().forEach(function(name) {
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = name;
          opt.textContent = name;
          selFx.appendChild(opt);
        });
        // Set default based on instrument role
        var defaultFx = (instDef.fxPreset) || defaultFxPresets[i] || 'None';
        selFx.value = defaultFx;

        // Add live FX change handler
        selFx.addEventListener('change', (function(idx) {
          return function() {
            var fxSel = document.getElementById('songFxPreset' + idx);
            applyFxPreset(idx, fxSel ? fxSel.value : 'None');
            if (SL.effectsUI && SL.effectsUI.setSelectedTarget) {
              SL.effectsUI.setSelectedTarget(SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument());
            }
          };
        })(i));
      }

      // Add settings shortcut button — append to the last grid cell of this row
      if (selFx && selFx.nextElementSibling) {
        var settingsBtn = document.createElement('button');
        settingsBtn.textContent = '\u2699';
        settingsBtn.title = ['Bass', 'Lead', 'Pad', 'Sampler', 'Loop'][i] + ' Settings';
        settingsBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;color:#999;border:none;padding:1px 3px;font-size:0.7rem;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;margin-left:2px;';
        settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', (function(idx) {
          return function() {
            SL.audio.setCurrentInstrument(idx);
            if (SL.audio.loadInstrumentSettings) SL.audio.loadInstrumentSettings(idx);
            var mixerBtn = document.getElementById('mixerBtn');
            if (mixerBtn) mixerBtn.click();
          };
        })(i));
        selFx.nextElementSibling.appendChild(settingsBtn);
      }

      // Set octave range selector defaults
      if (i < 3) {
        var defaultRanges = [[2, 3], [4, 5], [3, 5]]; // Bass=2-3, Lead=4-5, Pad=3-5
        var loEl = document.getElementById('songOctLo' + i);
        var hiEl = document.getElementById('songOctHi' + i);
        if (loEl && hiEl) {
          var lo = (instDef.octaveLo || defaultRanges[i][0]);
          var hi = (instDef.octaveHi || defaultRanges[i][1]);
          loEl.value = String(lo);
          hiEl.value = String(hi);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function populatePresetSelect(selectEl, type) {
    if (!selectEl) return;
    selectEl.innerHTML = '';

    if (type === 'loop') {
      // "None" = silent (no loop playing)
      var noneOpt = document.createElement('option');
      noneOpt.value = 'None';
      noneOpt.textContent = 'None';
      selectEl.appendChild(noneOpt);
      // Populate with texture names from loop engine
      if (SL.loop && SL.loop.getTextureNames) {
        var names = SL.loop.getTextureNames();
        for (var ti = 0; ti < names.length; ti++) {
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = names[ti];
          opt.textContent = names[ti];
          selectEl.appendChild(opt);
        }
      }
    } else if (type === 'sampler') {
      ['808', '909'].forEach(function(kit) {
        var opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = kit;
        opt.textContent = kit + ' Kit';
        selectEl.appendChild(opt);
      });
    } else {
      var presets = [];
      if (type === 'subtractive') presets = SL.presets.getSubtractivePresets() || [];
      if (type === 'fm') presets = SL.presets.getFMPresets() || [];
      if (type === 'physical') presets = SL.presets.getPhysicalPresets() || [];

      // Group presets by category
      var categories = {};
      presets.forEach(function(p) {
        var cat = p.category || 'Other';
        if (!categories[cat]) categories[cat] = [];
        categories[cat].push(p);
      });
      Object.keys(categories).forEach(function(cat) {
        var group = document.createElement('optgroup');
        group.label = cat;
        categories[cat].forEach(function(p) {
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = p.name;
          opt.textContent = p.name;
          group.appendChild(opt);
        });
        selectEl.appendChild(group);
      });
    }
  }

  function updatePresetOptions(instIndex, prefix) {
    prefix = prefix || 'songInst';
    var fxPrefix = (prefix === 'arrInst') ? 'arrFx' : 'songFx';
    var selType = document.getElementById(prefix + 'Type' + instIndex);
    var selPreset = document.getElementById(prefix + 'Preset' + instIndex);
    if (!selType || !selPreset) return;

    var type = selType.value;
    populatePresetSelect(selPreset, type);

    if (type === 'sampler') {
      // Set default kit
      var instDef = (currentStyle && currentStyle.instruments && currentStyle.instruments[instIndex]) || {};
      selPreset.value = instDef.kit || '808';
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Apply Instrument Preset (live, single instrument)
  // ============================================================

  function applyInstrumentPreset(instIndex, type, presetName) {
    if (!type) return;

    try {
      SL.audio.setInstrumentType(instIndex, type);
    } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] setInstrumentType error inst', instIndex, ':', e); }

    if (type === 'loop') {
      if (SL.loop) {
        if (!presetName || presetName === 'None') {
          try { SL.loop.stopLoop(); } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] loop stopLoop error:', e); }
        } else {
          try { SL.loop.startLoop(instIndex, presetName); } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] loop startLoop error inst', instIndex, ':', e); }
        }
      }
    } else if (type === 'sampler') {
      var kit = presetName || '808';
      try {
        var kitGenMap = {
          '808': 'generate808Kit',
          '909': 'generate909Kit',
          'CR78': 'generateCR78Kit',
          'Analog': 'generateAnalogKit',
          'Lofi': 'generateLofiKit',
          'Perc': 'generatePercKit',
          'Industrial': 'generateIndustrialKit',
          'Minimal': 'generateMinimalKit'
        };
        var kitGenFn = kitGenMap[kit] || 'generate808Kit';
        if (SL.drumGen[kitGenFn]) {
          SL.drumGen[kitGenFn](instIndex);
        }
      } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] drumGen error inst', instIndex, ':', e); }
    } else {
      if (presetName) {
        var preset = findPreset(type, presetName);
        if (preset) {
          try {
            if (type === 'subtractive') {
              SL.presets.applySubtractivePreset(preset, instIndex);
            } else if (type === 'fm') {
              SL.presets.applyFMPreset(preset, instIndex);
            } else if (type === 'physical') {
              SL.presets.applyPhysicalPreset(preset, instIndex);
            }
          } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] applyPreset error inst', instIndex, ':', e); }
        }
      }
    }

    // Sync UI if this is the current instrument
    var curInst = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    if (instIndex === curInst) {
      if (SL.audio.loadInstrumentSettings) SL.audio.loadInstrumentSettings(curInst);
      if (SL.mixerModal && SL.mixerModal.updateTypeToggleState) SL.mixerModal.updateTypeToggleState();
      if (SL.ui && SL.ui.updateUIFromInstrument) SL.ui.updateUIFromInstrument();
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Configure Instruments
  // ============================================================

  function configureInstruments() {
    if (!currentStyle || !currentStyle.instruments) return;

    var curInst = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var instruments = SL.audio.getInstruments ? SL.audio.getInstruments() : null;

    // Configure non-current instruments first, then current instrument last.
    // This prevents applySubtractivePreset's unconditional loadInstrumentSettings
    // from leaving stale data in the shared UI that gets saved back to the wrong instrument.
    var order = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      if (i !== curInst) order.push(i);
    }
    order.push(curInst);

    for (let idx = 0; idx < order.length; idx++) {
      var i = order[idx];
      var instDef = currentStyle.instruments[i];
      if (!instDef) {
        // Instrument 4 (loop) may not have a style definition — set type to 'loop'
        if (i === 4) {
          try { SL.audio.setInstrumentType(i, 'loop'); } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] setInstrumentType error inst', i, ':', e); }
        }
        continue;
      }

      // Read type and preset from UI selectors if available
      var selType = document.getElementById('songInstType' + i);
      var selPreset = document.getElementById('songInstPreset' + i);
      var selFx = document.getElementById('songFxPreset' + i);

      var type = (selType && selType.value) || instDef.type;
      var presetName = (selPreset && selPreset.value) || instDef.preset;

      if (!type) continue;

      try {
        SL.audio.setInstrumentType(i, type);
      } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] setInstrumentType error inst', i, ':', e); }

      if (type === 'loop') {
        if (SL.loop) {
          if (!presetName || presetName === 'None') {
            try { SL.loop.stopLoop(); } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] loop stopLoop error:', e); }
          } else {
            try { SL.loop.startLoop(i, presetName); } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] loop startLoop error inst', i, ':', e); }
          }
        }
      } else if (type === 'sampler') {
        var kit = presetName || instDef.kit || '808';
        try {
          if (kit === '909') {
            SL.drumGen.generate909Kit(i);
          } else {
            SL.drumGen.generate808Kit(i);
          }
        } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] drumGen error inst', i, ':', e); }
      } else {
        if (presetName) {
          var preset = findPreset(type, presetName);
          if (preset) {
            try {
              if (type === 'subtractive') {
                SL.presets.applySubtractivePreset(preset, i);
              } else if (type === 'fm') {
                SL.presets.applyFMPreset(preset, i);
              } else if (type === 'physical') {
                SL.presets.applyPhysicalPreset(preset, i);
              }
            } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] applyPreset error inst', i, ':', e); }
          }
        }
      }

      // Apply effect chain preset
      var fxName = (selFx && selFx.value) || 'None';
      applyFxPreset(i, fxName);
    }

    // Sync the settings UI to reflect the currently active instrument
    if (SL.audio.loadInstrumentSettings) {
      SL.audio.loadInstrumentSettings(curInst);
    }
    if (SL.effectsUI && SL.effectsUI.setSelectedTarget) {
      SL.effectsUI.setSelectedTarget(curInst);
    }
    // Sync instrument type toggle buttons in Settings panel
    if (SL.mixerModal && SL.mixerModal.updateTypeToggleState) {
      SL.mixerModal.updateTypeToggleState();
    }
    // Update UI state to show correct instrument type visibility
    if (SL.ui && SL.ui.updateUIFromInstrument) {
      SL.ui.updateUIFromInstrument();
    }

    // Update instrument dropdown labels from style roles
    if (currentStyle && currentStyle.instruments) {
      var roles = [];
      for (var ri = 0; ri < 5; ri++) {
        var instDef = currentStyle.instruments[ri];
        if (instDef && instDef.role) {
          roles.push(instDef.role);
        } else {
          roles.push(['Bass', 'Lead', 'Pad', 'Sampler', 'Loop'][ri]);
        }
      }
      updateInstrumentLabels(roles);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Generate Song
  // ============================================================

  function generateSong() {
    if (!currentStyle) return;
    updateStatus('Starting...');

    // Read humanization value from slider
    var humSlider = document.getElementById('songHumanization');
    _songHumanization = humSlider ? parseInt(humSlider.value, 10) || 0 : 30;

    // Auto-randomize seed on every generate so each click gives a new song
    randomizeSongSeed();

    // Seed the PRNG — ensure clean state first
    restoreRandom();
    var seed = getSongSeed();
    if (seed > 0) {
      seedRandom(seed);
    }

    // Read current UI values
    var bpmInput = document.getElementById('songBpm');
    var keySelect = document.getElementById('songKey');
    var modeSelect = document.getElementById('songMode');

    if (bpmInput) currentStyle.bpm = parseInt(bpmInput.value, 10) || 120;
    if (keySelect) currentStyle.key = parseInt(keySelect.value, 10) || 0;
    if (modeSelect) currentStyle.mode = modeSelect.value;

    // Read melody settings from UI and apply to currentStyle.melody
    if (!currentStyle.melody) {
      currentStyle.melody = {};
    }
    var melodyUiFields = [
      { id: 'songMelodyDensity',    key: 'density' },
      { id: 'songMelodyNoteLen',    key: 'noteLen' },
      { id: 'songMelodyMaxInterval', key: 'maxInterval' },
      { id: 'songMelodyChordBias',  key: 'chordBias' },
      { id: 'songMelodySyncopation', key: 'syncopation' },
      { id: 'songMelodyGate',       key: 'gate' },
      { id: 'songMelodyVelocity',   key: 'velocity' }
    ];
    for (var mi = 0; mi < melodyUiFields.length; mi++) {
      var melEl = document.getElementById(melodyUiFields[mi].id);
      if (melEl) {
        currentStyle.melody[melodyUiFields[mi].key] = parseInt(melEl.value, 10);
      }
    }

    // Clear sequencer and page labels
    SL.sequencer.clearSeq();
    if (SL.sequencer.clearPageLabels) SL.sequencer.clearPageLabels();

    // Set BPM
    var seqBpm = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
    if (seqBpm) {
      seqBpm.value = currentStyle.bpm;
      seqBpm.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    }

    // Set root note
    var rootNote = document.getElementById('rootNote');
    if (rootNote) {
      rootNote.value = currentStyle.key;
      rootNote.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    }

    // Set scale/mode
    var scaleType = document.getElementById('scaleType');
    if (scaleType) {
      scaleType.value = currentStyle.mode;
      scaleType.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    }

    // Ensure audio subsystems are initialized (normally deferred to first user gesture)
    updateStatus('Initializing audio...');
    try {
      var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
      if (ctx && ctx.state === 'suspended') { ctx.resume(); }
      // Init effect chains if not yet done (provides per-instrument masterOutput routing)
      if (!SL.audio.effectChain && SL.audio.initEffectChain) {
        SL.audio.initEffectChain();
      }
      // Init effects UI if not yet done
      if (SL.effectsUI && SL.effectsUI.init && !SL.effectsUI._initDone) {
        SL.effectsUI.init();
        SL.effectsUI._initDone = true;
      }
    } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] Audio init error:', e); }

    // Configure instruments
    updateStatus('Configuring instruments...');
    try { configureInstruments(); } catch(e) { console.error('[SongGen] configureInstruments error:', e); }

    // Calculate pages needed
    var structure = currentStyle.structure || [];
    let totalBars = 0;
    structure.forEach(function(sec) { totalBars += sec.bars || 0; });
    var pagesNeeded = Math.ceil(totalBars / 4);
    for (let p = 1; p < pagesNeeded; p++) {
      SL.sequencer.addPage();
    }

    // Label pages based on song structure sections
    if (SL.sequencer.setPageLabel) {
      var barCursor = 0;
      structure.forEach(function(sec) {
        var sectionName = sec.section || sec.name || 'unknown';
        var label = sectionName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + sectionName.slice(1);
        var sectionBars = sec.bars || 4;
        for (var b = 0; b < sectionBars; b += 4) {
          var pageIdx = Math.floor((barCursor + b) / 4);
          if (pageIdx < pagesNeeded) {
            SL.sequencer.setPageLabel(pageIdx, label);
          }
        }
        barCursor += sectionBars;
      });
    }

    updateStatus('Generating notes...');

    // Generate notes for each section
    let runningStep = 0;
    var allNotes = [];

    structure.forEach(function(sec, secIdx) {
      var pct = Math.round(((secIdx + 1) / structure.length) * 100);
      updateStatus('Generating... ' + pct + '%');
      var sectionBars = sec.bars || 4;
      var parts = sec.parts || [0, 1, 2, 3];
      var sectionName = sec.section || sec.name || 'verse';
      var chords = buildSectionChords(sectionName, sectionBars);

      // Section velocity dynamics
      var sectionVelMult = 1.0;
      if (sectionName === 'intro' || sectionName === 'outro') { sectionVelMult = 0.7; }
      else if (sectionName === 'buildup') { sectionVelMult = 0.85; }
      else if (sectionName === 'chorus' || sectionName === 'drop') { sectionVelMult = 1.15; }
      else if (sectionName === 'breakdown') { sectionVelMult = 0.6; }
      else if (sectionName === 'solo' || sectionName === 'instrumental') { sectionVelMult = 1.1; }

      // Drums (instrument 3)
      if (parts.indexOf(3) !== -1 && currentStyle.drumPattern) {
        // drumPattern can be a string or per-section object
        let patName = currentStyle.drumPattern;
        if (typeof patName === 'object' && patName !== null) {
          patName = patName[sectionName] || patName['verse'] || patName['chorus'] || patName['drop'] || 'Four on Floor';
        }
        if (patName) {
          var drumNotes = generateDrumNotes(patName, runningStep, sectionBars);
          console.log('[SongGen] Section "' + sectionName + '" drum pattern "' + patName + '": ' + drumNotes.length + ' notes');
          drumNotes.forEach(function(n) { n.vel = Math.min(127, Math.round((n.vel || 100) * sectionVelMult)); allNotes.push(applyHumanizationToNote(n, 'drums')); });
        }
      }

      if (chords.length > 0) {
        // Bass (instrument 0)
        if (parts.indexOf(0) !== -1) {
          var bassConfig = (currentStyle.instruments && currentStyle.instruments[0]) || {};
          var bassNotes = generateBassNotes(chords, runningStep, sectionBars, bassConfig);
          bassNotes.forEach(function(n) { n.vel = Math.min(127, Math.round((n.vel || 100) * sectionVelMult)); allNotes.push(applyHumanizationToNote(n, 'bass')); });
        }

        // Pad (instrument 2)
        if (parts.indexOf(2) !== -1) {
          var padNotes = generatePadNotes(chords, runningStep, sectionBars);
          padNotes.forEach(function(n) { n.vel = Math.min(127, Math.round((n.vel || 100) * sectionVelMult)); allNotes.push(applyHumanizationToNote(n, 'pad')); });
        }

        // Lead (instrument 1)
        if (parts.indexOf(1) !== -1) {
          var leadNotes = generateLeadMelody(chords, runningStep, sectionBars, sectionName);
          leadNotes.forEach(function(n) { n.vel = Math.min(127, Math.round((n.vel || 100) * sectionVelMult)); allNotes.push(applyHumanizationToNote(n, 'lead')); });
        }
      }

      runningStep += sectionBars * 16;
    });

    // Push all notes into sequencer
    allNotes.forEach(function(n) {
      SL.sequencer.seqNotes.push(n);
    });

    // Navigate to page 0 and render
    updateStatus('Rendering...');
    SL.sequencer.goToPage(0);
    SL.sequencer.renderSeqNotes();
    SL.sequencer.renderRhythmNotes();
    SL.sequencer.renderSeqGrid();
    SL.sequencer.renderPageGrid();
    restoreRandom();
    var drumCount = allNotes.filter(function(n) { return n.instrument === 3; }).length;
    updateStatus('Done! ' + allNotes.length + ' notes (' + drumCount + ' drum)');
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Randomize
  // ============================================================

  function randomizeStyle() {
    if (styles.length === 0) return;

    randomizeSongSeed();
    var style = pickRandom(styles);
    loadStyleDefaults(style.id);

    if (currentStyle) {
      // Randomize BPM within range
      var bpmRange = currentStyle.bpmRange || [currentStyle.bpm - 20, currentStyle.bpm + 20];
      var bpm = Math.floor(Math.random() * (bpmRange[1] - bpmRange[0] + 1)) + bpmRange[0];
      currentStyle.bpm = clamp(bpm, 60, 200);
      var bpmInput = document.getElementById('songBpm');
      if (bpmInput) bpmInput.value = currentStyle.bpm;

      // Randomize key from full chromatic scale
      currentStyle.key = Math.floor(Math.random() * 12);
      var keySelect = document.getElementById('songKey');
      if (keySelect) keySelect.value = currentStyle.key;

      // Randomize mode (scale) — pick from available modes
      var modeNames = Object.keys(SL.MODES || {});
      if (modeNames.length > 0) {
        // Weight common modes more heavily
        var commonModes = ['ionian', 'aeolian', 'dorian', 'mixolydian', 'phrygian'];
        var modePool = commonModes.concat(commonModes).concat(modeNames); // 2x weight for common
        currentStyle.mode = pickRandom(modePool);
        var modeSelect = document.getElementById('songMode');
        if (modeSelect) modeSelect.value = currentStyle.mode;
      }

      // Randomize melody density (±15 from default)
      if (currentStyle.melody) {
        var baseDensity = currentStyle.melody.density || 50;
        currentStyle.melody.density = clamp(baseDensity + Math.floor(Math.random() * 31) - 15, 30, 85);
        // Randomize note length (2-6)
        currentStyle.melody.noteLen = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 2;
        // Randomize max interval (4-10)
        currentStyle.melody.maxInterval = Math.floor(Math.random() * 7) + 4;
        // Randomize chord bias (40-80)
        currentStyle.melody.chordBias = Math.floor(Math.random() * 41) + 40;
      }

      // Randomize bass style
      if (currentStyle.instruments && currentStyle.instruments[0]) {
        var bassStyles = ['eighth', 'quarter', 'offbeat', 'walking', 'sustained', 'syncopated', 'arp'];
        currentStyle.instruments[0].style = pickRandom(bassStyles);
      }

      // Randomize arrangement from matching category
      var category = currentStyle.category;
      if (category && ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category] && ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category].length > 1) {
        var presets = ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS[category];
        var picked = pickRandom(presets);
        currentStyle.structure = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(picked.structure));
      }

      generateSong();
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Arrange Panel
  // ============================================================

  function initArrangePanel() {
    // Populate arrangeGenre with the same options as songGenre
    var arrangeGenre = document.getElementById('arrangeGenre');
    if (arrangeGenre && styles.length > 0) {
      var categories = {};
      styles.forEach(function(s) {
        var cat = s.category || 'Other';
        if (!categories[cat]) categories[cat] = [];
        categories[cat].push(s);
      });

      arrangeGenre.innerHTML = '';
      Object.keys(categories).forEach(function(cat) {
        var group = document.createElement('optgroup');
        group.label = cat;
        categories[cat].forEach(function(s) {
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = s.id;
          opt.textContent = s.name;
          group.appendChild(opt);
        });
        arrangeGenre.appendChild(group);
      });

      arrangeGenre.addEventListener('change', function() {
        loadArrangeDefaults(arrangeGenre.value);
        populateArrangementPresets(arrangeGenre.value, 'arrangeArrangementPreset');
        populateInstrumentationDropdown('arrInstrumentation', arrangeGenre.value);
      });
    }

    // Wire arrange arrangement preset dropdown
    var arrArrPreset = document.getElementById('arrangeArrangementPreset');
    if (arrArrPreset) {
      arrArrPreset.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var arrGenreSel = document.getElementById('arrangeGenre');
        if (arrGenreSel && arrArrPreset.value !== '') {
          applyArrangementPreset(arrGenreSel.value, arrArrPreset.value, 'arrange');
        }
      });
    }

    // Wire arrange instrumentation dropdown (populated on genre change + initial load below)
    var arrInstSel = document.getElementById('arrInstrumentation');
    if (arrInstSel) {
      arrInstSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
        applyInstrumentationPreset(arrInstSel.value, 'arr');
      });
    }

    // Populate arrange instrument selectors
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      var selType = document.getElementById('arrInstType' + i);
      var selPreset = document.getElementById('arrInstPreset' + i);
      var selFx = document.getElementById('arrFxPreset' + i);

      // Populate preset options based on current type
      if (selType) {
        updatePresetOptions(i, 'arrInst');

        selType.addEventListener('change', (function(idx) {
          return function() { updatePresetOptions(idx, 'arrInst'); };
        })(i));
      }

      // Populate FX preset selector
      if (selFx) {
        selFx.innerHTML = '';
        getFxPresetNames().forEach(function(name) {
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = name;
          opt.textContent = name;
          selFx.appendChild(opt);
        });

        // Add live FX change handler
        selFx.addEventListener('change', (function(idx) {
          return function() {
            var fxSel = document.getElementById('arrFxPreset' + idx);
            applyFxPreset(idx, fxSel ? fxSel.value : 'None');
            if (SL.effectsUI && SL.effectsUI.setSelectedTarget) {
              SL.effectsUI.setSelectedTarget(SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument());
            }
          };
        })(i));
      }

      // Add live preset change handler
      if (selPreset) {
        selPreset.addEventListener('change', (function(idx) {
          return function() {
            var st = document.getElementById('arrInstType' + idx);
            var sp = document.getElementById('arrInstPreset' + idx);
            applyInstrumentPreset(idx, st ? st.value : 'subtractive', sp ? sp.value : '');
          };
        })(i));
      }

      // Add settings shortcut button — wrap with FX select in same grid cell
      if (selFx) {
        var settingsBtn = document.createElement('button');
        settingsBtn.textContent = '\u2699';
        settingsBtn.title = ['Bass', 'Lead', 'Pad', 'Sampler', 'Loop'][i] + ' Settings';

        settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', (function(idx) {

      var selFx = document.getElementById('arrFxPreset' + j);

      updatePresetOptions(j, 'arrInst');
      if (selPreset && instDef.preset) {
        selPreset.value = instDef.preset;
      }
      if (selFx) {
        var defaultFxPresets = ['Clean Compress', 'Delay Echo', 'Wide Pad', 'Tight Drums', 'None'];
        var defaultFx = instDef.fxPreset || defaultFxPresets[j] || 'None';
        selFx.value = defaultFx;
      }
    }

    // Auto-select matching instrumentation
    var arrInstSel = document.getElementById('arrInstrumentation');
    if (arrInstSel) {
      arrInstSel.value = styleId;
    }
  }

  function applyArrangement() {
    // Ensure audio is initialized
    var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (ctx && ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
    if (!SL.audio.effectChain && SL.audio.initEffectChain) SL.audio.initEffectChain();
    if (SL.effectsUI && SL.effectsUI.init && !SL.effectsUI._initDone) {
      SL.effectsUI.init();
      SL.effectsUI._initDone = true;
    }

    var curInst = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    // Apply in order: non-current first, current last
    var order = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) { if (i !== curInst) order.push(i); }
    order.push(curInst);

    for (var idx = 0; idx < order.length; idx++) {
      var i = order[idx];
      var selType = document.getElementById('arrInstType' + i);
      var selPreset = document.getElementById('arrInstPreset' + i);
      var selFx = document.getElementById('arrFxPreset' + i);
      var type = selType ? selType.value : 'subtractive';
      var presetName = selPreset ? selPreset.value : '';
      var fxName = selFx ? selFx.value : 'None';

      applyInstrumentPreset(i, type, presetName);
      applyFxPreset(i, fxName);

    // Update instrument dropdown labels from arrangement types
    var arrRoles = [];
    for (var ri = 0; ri < 5; ri++) {

      var arrType = arrSelType ? arrSelType.value : '';
      if (arrType === 'sampler') {
        arrRoles.push('Percussion');

        arrRoles.push('Loop');
      } else {
        arrRoles.push(['Bass', 'Lead', 'Pad', 'Sampler', 'Loop'][ri]);
      }
    }
    updateInstrumentLabels(arrRoles);

    // Diagnostic: verify audio chain health after apply
    var instruments = SL.audio.getInstruments ? SL.audio.getInstruments() : null;
    if (instruments) {
      for (var di = 0; di < instruments.length; di++) {
        var dinst = instruments[di];
        var volGain = dinst.volumeNode ? dinst.volumeNode.gain.value : 'NO_NODE';
        var moGain = dinst.masterOutput ? dinst.masterOutput.gain.value : 'NO_NODE';
        var chainOk = dinst.effectChain ? 'ok' : 'MISSING';
        console.log('[Arrange] Inst ' + di + ' type=' + dinst.type + ' vol=' + dinst.settings.volume + ' volGain=' + volGain + ' moGain=' + moGain + ' chain=' + chainOk);
      }
    }

    var statusEl = document.getElementById('arrangeStatus');
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Applied!';
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Instrument Label Sync
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Update the #instrumentSelect dropdown labels with role names.

   */
  function updateInstrumentLabels(roles) {
