    if (sel) {
      for (var i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) {
        var label = (roles && roles[i]) ? roles[i] : '';
        if (label) {
          // Capitalize first letter
          label = label.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + label.slice(1);
          sel.options[i].textContent = (i + 1) + ' - ' + label;
        } else {
          sel.options[i].textContent = String(i + 1);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.songGen = {
    init: init,
    generateSong: generateSong,
    loadStyleDefaults: loadStyleDefaults,
    randomizeStyle: randomizeStyle,
    applyArrangement: applyArrangement,
    applyFxPreset: applyFxPreset,
    getFxPresetNames: getFxPresetNames,
    updatePresetOptions: updatePresetOptions,
    populatePresetSelect: populatePresetSelect,
    seedRandom: seedRandom,
    restoreRandom: restoreRandom,
    mulberry32: mulberry32,
    updateInstrumentLabels: updateInstrumentLabels,
    populateArrangementPresets: populateArrangementPresets,
    ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS: ARRANGEMENT_PRESETS
  };

})();


// === sampler-engine.js ===
// Super Synth Lab - Sampler Engine Module
// v3.3 - Sample-based instrument playback, invert phase, synthesized drum sounds
(function() {
  'use strict';

  const SL = window.SynthLab;

  // ============================================================
  // Constants
  // ============================================================

  const NUM_PADS = 16;
  const MAX_VOICES = 64;
  const MAX_SAMPLE_POOL_SIZE = 100 * 1024 * 1024; // 100MB
  const MIN_ATTACK = 0.003; // 3ms minimum to prevent clicks

  // Default pad settings
  const DEFAULT_PAD = {
    name: '',
    samples: [],
    triggerMode: 'one-shot', // 'one-shot', 'loop', 'gate'
    chokeGroup: 0,
    volume: 1.0,
    pan: 0,
    pitch: 0, // semitones
    invert: false, // flip waveform phase
    filter: {
      type: 'lowpass',
      cutoff: 20000,
      q: 1
    },
    adsr: {
      a: 0.001,
      d: 0.1,
      s: 1.0,
      r: 0.1
    }
  };

  // Default sample settings
  const DEFAULT_SAMPLE = {
    buffer: null,
    name: '',
    velocityRange: [0, 127],
    startPoint: 0,
    endPoint: null, // null = full length
    loopStart: null,
    loopEnd: null,
    pitch: 0,
    reverse: false
  };

  // ============================================================
  // State
  // ============================================================

  /** Sampler instruments (one per synth instrument slot) */
  const samplerInstruments = [];

  /** Currently selected pad index */
  let selectedPadIndex = 0;

  /** Voice pool for polyphonic playback */
  const voicePool = [];

  /** Active voices by pad (for choke groups and note-off) */
  const activeVoices = new Map();

  /** Sample memory pool tracking */
  let currentPoolSize = 0;

  /** Audio context reference */
  let ctx = null;

  // ============================================================
  // Initialization
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Initialize sampler engine
   */
  function init() {
    ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();

    // Initialize sampler instrument for each instrument slot
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      samplerInstruments[i] = createSamplerInstrument(i);
    }

    // Initialize voice pool
    initVoicePool();

  }

  /**
   * Create a new sampler instrument with empty pads
   */
  function createSamplerInstrument(id) {
    const pads = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < NUM_PADS; i++) {
      pads.push({
        ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_PAD)),
        id: i,
        name: `Pad ${i + 1}`
      });
    }

    return {
      id,
      name: `Sampler ${id + 1}`,
      type: 'sampler',
      pads
    };
  }

  /**
   * Initialize voice pool
   */
  function initVoicePool() {
    voicePool.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_VOICES; i++) {
      voicePool.push({
        id: i,
        inUse: false,
        source: null,
        gain: null,
        filter: null,
        padId: -1,
        instrumentId: -1,
        startTime: 0
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Sample Loading
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Load a sample from a File object
   * @param {File} file - Audio file
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} Sample data
   */
  async function loadSampleFromFile(file) {
    if (!ctx) ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();

    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const audioBuffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);

    const sample = {
      ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_SAMPLE)),
      buffer: audioBuffer,
      name: file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ''),
      endPoint: audioBuffer.length,
      loopEnd: audioBuffer.length
    };

    // Track memory usage
    const sampleSize = audioBuffer.length * audioBuffer.numberOfChannels * 4; // float32
    currentPoolSize += sampleSize;

    return sample;
  }

  /**
   * Load sample from URL
   * @param {string} url - Sample URL
   * @param {string} name - Sample name
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} Sample data
   */
  async function loadSampleFromURL(url, name) {
    if (!ctx) ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();

    const response = await fetch(url);
    const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
    const audioBuffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);

    const sample = {
      ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_SAMPLE)),
      buffer: audioBuffer,
      name: name || url.split('/').pop().replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ''),
      endPoint: audioBuffer.length,
      loopEnd: audioBuffer.length
    };

    const sampleSize = audioBuffer.length * audioBuffer.numberOfChannels * 4;
    currentPoolSize += sampleSize;

    return sample;
  }

  /**
   * Create a sample object from an AudioBuffer
   * @param {AudioBuffer} audioBuffer - The audio buffer
   * @param {string} name - Sample name
   * @returns {Object} Sample data
   */
  function createSampleFromBuffer(audioBuffer, name) {
    const sample = {
      ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_SAMPLE)),
      buffer: audioBuffer,
      name: name || 'Sample',
      endPoint: audioBuffer.length,
      loopEnd: audioBuffer.length
    };

    const sampleSize = audioBuffer.length * audioBuffer.numberOfChannels * 4;
    currentPoolSize += sampleSize;

    return sample;
  }

  /**
   * Assign a sample to a pad
   * @param {number} instrumentId - Instrument index
   * @param {number} padId - Pad index
   * @param {Object|AudioBuffer} sample - Sample data object or AudioBuffer
   * @param {string|Array} nameOrVelocity - Name (if buffer) or velocity range
   * @param {Array} velocityRange - Optional velocity range [min, max]
   */
  function ensureInit() {
    if (!samplerInstruments.length) {
      init();
    }
  }

  function assignSampleToPad(instrumentId, padId, sample, nameOrVelocity = [0, 127], velocityRange) {
    ensureInit();
    // Handle AudioBuffer directly
    if (sample instanceof AudioBuffer) {
      const name = typeof nameOrVelocity === 'string' ? nameOrVelocity : 'Sample';
      sample = createSampleFromBuffer(sample, name);
      velocityRange = Array.isArray(nameOrVelocity) ? nameOrVelocity : (velocityRange || [0, 127]);
    } else {
      velocityRange = Array.isArray(nameOrVelocity) ? nameOrVelocity : [0, 127];
    }
    const instrument = samplerInstruments[instrumentId];
    if (!instrument) return;

    const pad = instrument.pads[padId];
    if (!pad) return;

    // Set pad name from sample name if pad is empty
    if (!pad.samples.length || pad.name === `Pad ${padId + 1}`) {
      pad.name = sample.name;
    }

    // Add sample with velocity range
    sample.velocityRange = velocityRange;
    pad.samples.push(sample);

    // Sort by velocity range
    pad.samples.sort((a, b) => a.velocityRange[0] - b.velocityRange[0]);

  }

  /**
   * Clear a pad's samples
   */
  function clearPad(instrumentId, padId) {
    const instrument = samplerInstruments[instrumentId];
    if (!instrument) return;

    const pad = instrument.pads[padId];
    if (!pad) return;

    // Free memory tracking
    pad.samples.forEach(sample => {
      if (sample.buffer) {
        const size = sample.buffer.length * sample.buffer.numberOfChannels * 4;
        currentPoolSize -= size;
      }
    });

    pad.samples = [];
    pad.name = `Pad ${padId + 1}`;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Playback
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Play a sample pad
   * @param {number} instrumentId - Instrument index
   * @param {number} padId - Pad index
   * @param {number} velocity - Velocity (0-127)
   * @param {number} duration - Duration in seconds (for gate mode)
   * @returns {Object|null} Voice object or null
   */
  function playPad(instrumentId, padId, velocity = 100, duration = null) {
    ensureInit();
    if (!ctx) ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();

    const instrument = samplerInstruments[instrumentId];
    if (!instrument) return null;

    const pad = instrument.pads[padId];
    if (!pad || !pad.samples.length) return null;

    // Select sample based on velocity
    const sample = selectVelocitySample(pad.samples, velocity);
    if (!sample || !sample.buffer) return null;

    // Handle choke group
    if (pad.chokeGroup > 0) {
      stopChokeGroup(instrumentId, pad.chokeGroup);
    }

    // Acquire voice from pool
    const voice = acquireVoice();
    if (!voice) return null;

    const now = ctx.currentTime;

    // Create source
    voice.source = ctx.createBufferSource();
    voice.source.buffer = sample.buffer;

    // Apply pitch (pad pitch + sample pitch)
    const totalPitch = pad.pitch + (sample.pitch || 0);
    voice.source.playbackRate.value = Math.pow(2, totalPitch / 12);

    // Create gain for ADSR
    voice.gain = ctx.createGain();

    // Create filter
    voice.filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    voice.filter.type = pad.filter.type;
    voice.filter.frequency.value = pad.filter.cutoff;
    voice.filter.Q.value = pad.filter.q;

    // Create panner
    const panner = ctx.createStereoPanner();
    panner.pan.value = pad.pan;
    voice.panner = panner;

    // Connect chain: source -> gain -> filter -> panner -> destination
    // Use the sampler instrument's masterOutput, not the current instrument's
    var instruments = SL.audio.getInstruments();
    var samplerDest = (instruments && instruments[instrumentId] && instruments[instrumentId].masterOutput)
      ? instruments[instrumentId].masterOutput
      : SL.audio.getFinalDestination();
    voice.source.connect(voice.gain);
    voice.gain.connect(voice.filter);
    voice.filter.connect(panner);
    panner.connect(samplerDest);

    // Apply ADSR envelope (with phase inversion support)
    const { a, d, s, r } = pad.adsr;
    const attackTime = Math.max(MIN_ATTACK, a);
    const peak = (velocity / 127) * pad.volume * (pad.invert ? -1 : 1);

    voice.gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
    voice.gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, now + attackTime);
    voice.gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak * s, now + attackTime + d);

    // Store voice metadata
    voice.padId = padId;
    voice.instrumentId = instrumentId;
    voice.startTime = now;
    voice.adsr = pad.adsr;
    voice.peak = peak;

    // Calculate start offset
    const startOffset = (sample.startPoint || 0) / sample.buffer.sampleRate;

    // Handle trigger modes
    if (pad.triggerMode === 'loop') {
      voice.source.loop = true;
      voice.source.loopStart = (sample.loopStart || 0) / sample.buffer.sampleRate;
      voice.source.loopEnd = (sample.loopEnd || sample.buffer.length) / sample.buffer.sampleRate;
      voice.source.start(now, startOffset);
    } else if (pad.triggerMode === 'one-shot') {
      const endPoint = sample.endPoint || sample.buffer.length;
      const sampleDuration = (endPoint - (sample.startPoint || 0)) / sample.buffer.sampleRate;
      voice.source.start(now, startOffset);
      voice.source.stop(now + sampleDuration + r);

      // Schedule gain fadeout at end
      voice.gain.gain.setValueAtTime(peak * s, now + sampleDuration);
      voice.gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, now + sampleDuration + r);
    } else if (pad.triggerMode === 'gate') {
      voice.source.start(now, startOffset);
      // Gate mode waits for explicit note-off or duration
      if (duration) {
        scheduleRelease(voice, now + duration);
      }
    }

    // Track active voice
    const key = `${instrumentId}:${padId}`;
    if (!activeVoices.has(key)) {
      activeVoices.set(key, []);
    }
    activeVoices.get(key).push(voice);

    // Cleanup on end
    voice.source.onended = () => {
      releaseVoice(voice);
      const voices = activeVoices.get(key);
      if (voices) {
        const idx = voices.indexOf(voice);
        if (idx !== -1) voices.splice(idx, 1);
      }
    };

    return voice;
  }

  /**
   * Stop a pad (for gate mode / note-off)
   */
  function stopPad(instrumentId, padId) {
    const key = `${instrumentId}:${padId}`;
    const voices = activeVoices.get(key);
    if (!voices || !voices.length) return;

    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    voices.forEach(voice => {
      scheduleRelease(voice, now);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Schedule release envelope
   */
  function scheduleRelease(voice, releaseStart) {
    if (!voice.gain || !voice.source) return;

    const r = voice.adsr?.r || 0.1;
    const currentGain = voice.gain.gain.value;

    voice.gain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(releaseStart);
    voice.gain.gain.setValueAtTime(currentGain, releaseStart);
    voice.gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, releaseStart + r);

    try {
      voice.source.stop(releaseStart + r + 0.01);
    } catch (e) {
      // Already stopped
    }
  }

  /**
   * Select sample based on velocity
   */
  function selectVelocitySample(samples, velocity) {
    for (const sample of samples) {
      const [min, max] = sample.velocityRange || [0, 127];
      if (velocity >= min && velocity <= max) {
        return sample;
      }
    }
    // Fallback to first sample
    return samples[0];
  }

  /**
   * Stop all voices in a choke group
   */
  function stopChokeGroup(instrumentId, groupId) {
    const instrument = samplerInstruments[instrumentId];
    if (!instrument) return;

    instrument.pads.forEach((pad, padId) => {
      if (pad.chokeGroup === groupId) {
        const key = `${instrumentId}:${padId}`;
        const voices = activeVoices.get(key);
        if (voices) {
          voices.forEach(voice => {
            if (voice.source) {
              try {
                // Quick fadeout to avoid click
                const now = ctx.currentTime;
                voice.gain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);
                voice.gain.gain.setValueAtTime(voice.gain.gain.value, now);
                voice.gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, now + 0.01);
                voice.source.stop(now + 0.02);
              } catch (e) {}
            }
          });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Voice Pool Management
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Acquire a voice from the pool
   */
  function acquireVoice() {
    // Find free voice
    let voice = voicePool.find(v => !v.inUse);

    // If no free voice, steal oldest
    if (!voice) {
      voice = voicePool.reduce((oldest, v) =>
        v.startTime < oldest.startTime ? v : oldest
      );
      releaseVoice(voice);
    }

    voice.inUse = true;
    return voice;
  }

  /**
   * Release a voice back to the pool
   */
  function releaseVoice(voice) {
    if (voice.source) {
      try {
        voice.source.stop(0);
        voice.source.disconnect();
      } catch (e) {}
      voice.source = null;
    }
    if (voice.gain) {
      voice.gain.disconnect();
      voice.gain = null;
    }
    if (voice.filter) {
      voice.filter.disconnect();
      voice.filter = null;
    }
    if (voice.panner) {
      try { voice.panner.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      voice.panner = null;
    }

    voice.inUse = false;
    voice.padId = -1;
    voice.instrumentId = -1;
  }

  /**
   * Stop all voices
   */
  function stopAllVoices() {
    voicePool.forEach(voice => {
      if (voice.inUse) {
        releaseVoice(voice);
      }
    });
    activeVoices.clear();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Pad Settings
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Get pad data
   */
  function getPad(instrumentId, padId) {
    ensureInit();
    const instrument = samplerInstruments[instrumentId];
    return instrument?.pads[padId] || null;
  }

  /**
   * Update pad settings
   */
  function updatePad(instrumentId, padId, settings) {
    const pad = getPad(instrumentId, padId);
    if (!pad) return;

    Object.assign(pad, settings);
  }

  /**
   * Get all pads for an instrument
   */
  function getPads(instrumentId) {
    ensureInit();
    const instrument = samplerInstruments[instrumentId];
    return instrument?.pads || [];
  }

  /**
   * Rename a pad
   */
  function renamePad(instrumentId, padId, name) {
    const pad = getPad(instrumentId, padId);
    if (pad) {
      pad.name = name;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Sample Editing
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Update sample start/end points
   */
  function setSamplePoints(instrumentId, padId, sampleIndex, startPoint, endPoint) {
    const pad = getPad(instrumentId, padId);
    if (!pad || !pad.samples[sampleIndex]) return;

    const sample = pad.samples[sampleIndex];
    sample.startPoint = Math.max(0, startPoint);
    sample.endPoint = Math.min(sample.buffer.length, endPoint);
  }

  /**
   * Update sample loop points
   */
  function setSampleLoopPoints(instrumentId, padId, sampleIndex, loopStart, loopEnd) {
    const pad = getPad(instrumentId, padId);
    if (!pad || !pad.samples[sampleIndex]) return;

    const sample = pad.samples[sampleIndex];
    sample.loopStart = Math.max(0, loopStart);
    sample.loopEnd = Math.min(sample.buffer.length, loopEnd);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Utility
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Get sampler instrument
   */
  function getSamplerInstrument(instrumentId) {
    return samplerInstruments[instrumentId];
  }

  /**
   * Get current memory pool size
   */
  function getPoolSize() {
    return currentPoolSize;
  }

  /**
   * Check if pad has samples
   */
  function padHasSamples(instrumentId, padId) {
    const pad = getPad(instrumentId, padId);
    return pad && pad.samples.length > 0;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.sampler = {
    init,
    loadSampleFromFile,
    loadSampleFromURL,
    createSampleFromBuffer,
    assignSampleToPad,
    clearPad,
    playPad,
    stopPad,

  /**
   * Auto-normalize the current pad's volume to maximize without clipping
   * Analyzes the sample's peak amplitude and sets volume accordingly (0-200%)
   */
  function normalizeCurrentPad() {
    const instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    const pad = SL.sampler.getPad(instId, selectedPadId);

    if (!pad || !pad.samples || pad.samples.length === 0) return;

    const sample = pad.samples[0];
    if (!sample.buffer) return;

    // Find the peak amplitude across all channels
    let peakAmplitude = 0;
    for (let channel = 0; channel < sample.buffer.numberOfChannels; channel++) {
      const data = sample.buffer.getChannelData(channel);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        const absVal = Math.abs(data[i]);
        if (absVal > peakAmplitude) {
          peakAmplitude = absVal;
        }
      }
    }

    if (peakAmplitude === 0) return; // Silent sample

    // Calculate the volume needed to reach peak of 1.0 (with small headroom)
    const targetPeak = 0.99; // Leave tiny headroom
    let optimalVolume = targetPeak / peakAmplitude;

    // Clamp to 0-200% range
    optimalVolume = Math.min(2.0, Math.max(0, optimalVolume));

    // Update the pad volume
    SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, { volume: optimalVolume });

    // Update the UI
    const volumeSlider = document.getElementById('padVolumeSlider');
    const volumeValue = document.getElementById('padVolumeValue');
    if (volumeSlider) volumeSlider.value = Math.round(optimalVolume * 100);
    if (volumeValue) volumeValue.textContent = Math.round(optimalVolume * 100) + '%';

  }

  function clearAllPads() {

  /**

  function setupUploadZone() {

    if (!uploadZone || !fileInput) return;

    // Click to open file dialog
    uploadZone.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      // Prevent double-trigger if clicking on input
      if (e.target !== fileInput) {
        fileInput.click();
      }
    });

    // Drag over
    uploadZone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      uploadZone.classList.add('drag-over');
    });

    // Drag leave
    uploadZone.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      uploadZone.classList.remove('drag-over');
    });

    // Drop
    uploadZone.addEventListener('drop', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      uploadZone.classList.remove('drag-over');

      const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
      if (files.length > 0) {
        await handleFiles(files);
      }
    });

    // File input change
    fileInput.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
      if (e.target.files.length > 0) {
        await handleFiles(e.target.files);
        fileInput.value = '';
      }
    });
  }

  function handleControlChange(e) {
    const instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    const pad = SL.sampler.getPad(instId, selectedPadId);
    if (!pad) return;

    const id = e.target.id;
    const value = e.target.value;

    switch (id) {
      case 'triggerModeSelect':
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, { triggerMode: value });
        break;

      case 'chokeGroupSelect':
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, { chokeGroup: parseInt(value) });
        break;

      case 'padVolumeSlider':
        const vol = parseInt(value) / 100;
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, { volume: vol });
        document.getElementById('padVolumeValue').textContent = value + '%';
        break;

      case 'padInvertCheckbox':
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, { invert: e.target.checked });
        break;

      case 'padPanSlider':
        const pan = parseInt(value) / 100;
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, { pan });
        document.getElementById('padPanValue').textContent =
          pan === 0 ? 'C' : (pan < 0 ? 'L' + Math.abs(value) : 'R' + value);
        break;

      case 'padPitchSlider':
        const pitch = parseInt(value);
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, { pitch });
        document.getElementById('padPitchValue').textContent =
          (pitch > 0 ? '+' : '') + pitch + ' st';
        break;

      case 'padFilterTypeSelect':
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, {
          filter: { ...pad.filter, type: value }
        });
        break;

      case 'padFilterCutoffSlider':
        const cutoff = sliderToFreq(parseInt(value));
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, {
          filter: { ...pad.filter, cutoff }
        });
        document.getElementById('padFilterCutoffValue').textContent = formatFreq(cutoff);
        break;

      case 'padFilterQSlider':
        const q = parseInt(value) / 5;
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, {
          filter: { ...pad.filter, q }
        });
        document.getElementById('padFilterQValue').textContent = 'Q ' + q.toFixed(1);
        break;

      case 'padAdsrA':
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, {
          adsr: { ...pad.adsr, a: parseInt(value) / 1000 }
        });
        e.target.nextElementSibling.textContent = value + 'ms';
        break;

      case 'padAdsrD':
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, {
          adsr: { ...pad.adsr, d: parseInt(value) / 1000 }
        });
        e.target.nextElementSibling.textContent = value + 'ms';
        break;

      case 'padAdsrS':
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, {
          adsr: { ...pad.adsr, s: parseInt(value) / 100 }
        });
        e.target.nextElementSibling.textContent = value + '%';
        break;

      case 'padAdsrR':
        SL.sampler.updatePad(instId, selectedPadId, {
          adsr: { ...pad.adsr, r: parseInt(value) / 1000 }
        });
        e.target.nextElementSibling.textContent = value + 'ms';
        break;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // File Handling
  // ============================================================

  async function handleFiles(files) {
    const instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    let padId = selectedPadId;

    for (const file of files) {
      if (!file.type.startsWith('audio/')) continue;

      try {
        const sample = await SL.sampler.loadSampleFromFile(file);

        // Find next empty pad or use selected
        const pads = SL.sampler.getPads(instId);
        let targetPad = padId;

        // If current pad has samples, find next empty
        if (SL.sampler.padHasSamples(instId, targetPad)) {
          const emptyPad = pads.findIndex((p, i) => i > padId && p.samples.length === 0);
          if (emptyPad !== -1) {
            targetPad = emptyPad;
          } else {
            // Try from beginning
            const emptyFromStart = pads.findIndex(p => p.samples.length === 0);
            if (emptyFromStart !== -1) {
              targetPad = emptyFromStart;
            }
          }
        }

        SL.sampler.assignSampleToPad(instId, targetPad, sample);
        padId = targetPad + 1; // Move to next pad for next file

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load sample:', file.name, err);
      }
    }

    // Refresh UI
    renderSamplerTab();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Pad Selection & Actions
  // ============================================================

  function selectPad(padId) {
    selectedPadId = padId;

    // Update grid selection
    document.querySelectorAll('.sampler-pad').forEach((el, i) => {
      el.classList.toggle('selected', i === padId);
    });

    // Update controls
    const instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    const controlsContainer = document.getElementById('samplerPadControls');
    if (controlsContainer) {
      controlsContainer.innerHTML = renderPadControls(instId, padId);

      // Reinit waveform canvas
      waveformCanvas = document.getElementById('samplerWaveformCanvas');
      if (waveformCanvas) {
        waveformCtx = waveformCanvas.getContext('2d');
        resizeWaveformCanvas();
        drawWaveform(instId, padId);
      }
    }
  }

  function triggerPadAnimation(padId) {
    const padEl = document.querySelector(`.sampler-pad[data-pad-id="${padId}"]`);
    if (padEl) {
      padEl.classList.add('playing');
      setTimeout(() => padEl.classList.remove('playing'), 100);
    }
  }

  function previewCurrentSample() {
    const instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    if (SL.sampler.padHasSamples(instId, selectedPadId)) {
      triggerPadAnimation(selectedPadId);
      SL.sampler.playPad(instId, selectedPadId, 100);
    }
  }

  function clearCurrentPad() {
    const instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    SL.sampler.clearPad(instId, selectedPadId);
    renderSamplerTab();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Waveform Drawing
  // ============================================================

  function resizeWaveformCanvas() {
    if (!waveformCanvas) return;

    const rect = waveformCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

    waveformCanvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
    waveformCanvas.height = rect.height * dpr;

    waveformCtx.scale(dpr, dpr);
  }

  function drawWaveform(instId, padId) {
    if (!waveformCanvas || !waveformCtx) return;

    const pad = SL.sampler.getPad(instId, padId);
    if (!pad || !pad.samples.length) return;

    const sample = pad.samples[0];
    if (!sample.buffer) return;

    const data = sample.buffer.getChannelData(0);
    const width = waveformCanvas.width / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    const height = waveformCanvas.height / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);

    // Clear
    waveformCtx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    waveformCtx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Draw center line
    waveformCtx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    waveformCtx.lineWidth = 1;
    waveformCtx.beginPath();
    waveformCtx.moveTo(0, height / 2);
    waveformCtx.lineTo(width, height / 2);
    waveformCtx.stroke();

    // Downsample for display
    const step = Math.ceil(data.length / width);
    const halfHeight = height / 2;

    waveformCtx.strokeStyle = '#4cc9f0';
    waveformCtx.lineWidth = 1;
    waveformCtx.beginPath();

    for (let i = 0; i < width; i++) {
      const idx = Math.floor(i * step);

      // Find min/max in this chunk
      let min = 0, max = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < step && idx + j < data.length; j++) {
        const val = data[idx + j];
        if (val < min) min = val;
        if (val > max) max = val;
      }

      const y1 = halfHeight + min * halfHeight;
      const y2 = halfHeight + max * halfHeight;

      waveformCtx.moveTo(i, y1);
      waveformCtx.lineTo(i, y2);
    }

    waveformCtx.stroke();

    // Draw start/end region
    const startX = (sample.startPoint / data.length) * width;
    const endX = ((sample.endPoint || data.length) / data.length) * width;

    waveformCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.1)';
    waveformCtx.fillRect(startX, 0, endX - startX, height);

    waveformCtx.strokeStyle = '#4cc9f0';
    waveformCtx.lineWidth = 2;
    waveformCtx.beginPath();
    waveformCtx.moveTo(startX, 0);
    waveformCtx.lineTo(startX, height);
    waveformCtx.moveTo(endX, 0);
    waveformCtx.lineTo(endX, height);
    waveformCtx.stroke();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Utility Functions
  // ============================================================

  function freqToSlider(freq) {
    // Logarithmic scale: 20Hz to 20kHz -> 0 to 1000
    const minLog = Math.log10(20);
    const maxLog = Math.log10(20000);
    const normalized = (Math.log10(freq) - minLog) / (maxLog - minLog);
    return Math.round(normalized * 1000);
  }

  function sliderToFreq(value) {
    const minLog = Math.log10(20);
    const maxLog = Math.log10(20000);
    const normalized = value / 1000;
    return Math.pow(10, minLog + normalized * (maxLog - minLog));
  }

  function formatFreq(freq) {
    if (freq >= 1000) {
      return (freq / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k';
    }
    return Math.round(freq) + 'Hz';
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Public API for Keyboard Integration
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Trigger a pad from keyboard
   */
  function triggerPad(padId, velocity = 100) {
    const instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    if (SL.sampler.padHasSamples(instId, padId)) {
      triggerPadAnimation(padId);
      SL.sampler.playPad(instId, padId, velocity);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Release a pad (for gate mode)
   */
  function releasePad(padId) {
    const instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    SL.sampler.stopPad(instId, padId);
  }

  /**
   * Get pad names for sequencer display
   */
  function getPadNames(instId) {
    const pads = SL.sampler.getPads(instId);
    return pads.map(p => p.name);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.samplerUI = {
    init,
    renderSamplerTab,
    selectPad,
    triggerPad,
    releasePad,
    getPadNames,
    getSelectedPadId: () => selectedPadId,
    PAD_SUGGESTIONS
  };

})();


// === analyzer.js ===
// Super Synth Lab - Analyzer Module
// Oscilloscope and Spectrum Analyzer visualization
// v12.1.150 - Added Adaptive (Hermode-style) tuning system
// v12.1.149 - Added windowing functions (Hann, Hamming, Blackman, Blackman-Harris)
//             with manual FFT for windowed spectrum display and peak detection
(function() {
  'use strict';

  const SL = window.SynthLab;

  // Canvas references
  let scopeCanvas, scopeCtx;
  let spectrumCanvas, spectrumCtx;

  // Animation
  let animationId = null;
  let isVisible = false;

  // Analyser settings
  const FFT_SIZE = 2048;
  const SMOOTHING = 0.8;

  // Buffers (pre-allocated)
  let timeDomainData;
  let frequencyData;
  let floatTimeDomainData;

  // Windowing state
  let currentWindowFunction = 'rectangular';
  let spectrumMode = 'standard'; // 'standard' or 'windowed'

  // Pre-computed window coefficients (computed once when window changes)
  let windowCoefficients = null;

  // Pre-computed spectrum bar colors (avoid string allocation in hot loop)
  const SPECTRUM_BAR_COUNT = 64;
  const spectrumColors = new Array(SPECTRUM_BAR_COUNT);
  for (let i = 0; i < SPECTRUM_BAR_COUNT; i++) {
    const hue = (i / SPECTRUM_BAR_COUNT) * 60 + 280;
    spectrumColors[i] = 'hsl(' + hue + ', 80%, 60%)';
  }

  // Peak detection colors
  const PEAK_COLOR = '#ff6b6b';
  const PEAK_LABEL_COLOR = '#ffcc00';

  // ===== Window Functions =====

  function computeWindowCoefficients(name, N) {
    const coeffs = new Float32Array(N);
    if (name === 'rectangular') {
      for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        coeffs[n] = 1.0;
      }
    } else if (name === 'hann') {
      for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        coeffs[n] = 0.5 * (1.0 - Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * n / (N - 1)));
      }
    } else if (name === 'hamming') {
      for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        coeffs[n] = 0.54 - 0.46 * Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * n / (N - 1));
      }
    } else if (name === 'blackman') {
      for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        coeffs[n] = 0.42 - 0.5 * Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * n / (N - 1))
                   + 0.08 * Math.cos(4.0 * Math.PI * n / (N - 1));
      }
    } else if (name === 'blackman-harris') {
      for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        coeffs[n] = 0.35875
                   - 0.48829 * Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * n / (N - 1))
                   + 0.14128 * Math.cos(4.0 * Math.PI * n / (N - 1))
                   - 0.01168 * Math.cos(6.0 * Math.PI * n / (N - 1));
      }
    } else {
      // Default to rectangular
      for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        coeffs[n] = 1.0;
      }
    }
    return coeffs;
  }

  // ===== Cooley-Tukey FFT (radix-2, in-place) =====

  function fft(realIn, imagIn) {
    const N = realIn.length;
    const real = new Float32Array(realIn);
    const imag = new Float32Array(imagIn);

    // Bit-reversal permutation
    let j = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
      if (i < j) {
        let tmpR = real[i];
        let tmpI = imag[i];
        real[i] = real[j];
        imag[i] = imag[j];
        real[j] = tmpR;
        imag[j] = tmpI;
      }
      let m = N >> 1;
      while (m >= 1 && j >= m) {
        j -= m;
        m >>= 1;
      }
      j += m;
    }

    // Cooley-Tukey butterfly
    for (let size = 2; size <= N; size *= 2) {
      const halfSize = size >> 1;
      const angleStep = -2.0 * Math.PI / size;
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i += size) {
        for (let k = 0; k < halfSize; k++) {
          const angle = angleStep * k;
          const wr = Math.cos(angle);
          const wi = Math.sin(angle);
          const idx1 = i + k;
          const idx2 = i + k + halfSize;
          const tR = wr * real[idx2] - wi * imag[idx2];
          const tI = wr * imag[idx2] + wi * real[idx2];
          real[idx2] = real[idx1] - tR;
          imag[idx2] = imag[idx1] - tI;
          real[idx1] = real[idx1] + tR;
          imag[idx1] = imag[idx1] + tI;
        }
      }
    }

    return { real: real, imag: imag };
  }

  // Compute magnitude spectrum in dB from windowed time-domain data
  function computeWindowedSpectrum(samples, windowCoeffs) {
    const N = samples.length;
    const realIn = new Float32Array(N);
    const imagIn = new Float32Array(N);

    // Apply window
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      realIn[i] = samples[i] * windowCoeffs[i];
    }

    // FFT
    const result = fft(realIn, imagIn);

    // Compute magnitude in dB (only first half — positive frequencies)
    const halfN = N >> 1;
    const magnitudes = new Float32Array(halfN);
    for (let i = 0; i < halfN; i++) {
      const mag = Math.sqrt(result.real[i] * result.real[i] + result.imag[i] * result.imag[i]) / N;
      // Convert to dB, floor at -100 dB
      if (mag > 0) {
        magnitudes[i] = 20.0 * Math.log10(mag);
      } else {
        magnitudes[i] = -100.0;
      }
    }
    return magnitudes;
  }

  // ===== Peak Detection =====

  function detectPeaks(magnitudes, sampleRate) {
    const peaks = [];
    const halfN = magnitudes.length;
    const binWidth = sampleRate / (halfN * 2);
    const threshold = -60; // dB threshold for peak detection

    // Find local maxima above threshold
    for (let i = 2; i < halfN - 2; i++) {
      const val = magnitudes[i];
      if (val > threshold
          && val > magnitudes[i - 1]
          && val > magnitudes[i - 2]
          && val > magnitudes[i + 1]
          && val > magnitudes[i + 2]) {
        peaks.push({
          bin: i,
          frequency: i * binWidth,
          magnitude: val
        });
      }
    }

    // Sort by magnitude descending, keep top 8
    peaks.sort(function(a, b) { return b.magnitude - a.magnitude; });
    return peaks.slice(0, 8);
  }

  function formatFrequency(freq) {
    if (freq >= 1000) {
      return (freq / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k';
    }
    return Math.round(freq) + '';
  }

  // ===== Init =====

  function init() {
    // Get canvas elements
    scopeCanvas = document.getElementById('scopeCanvas');
    spectrumCanvas = document.getElementById('spectrumCanvas');

    if (!scopeCanvas || !spectrumCanvas) return;

    scopeCtx = scopeCanvas.getContext('2d');
    spectrumCtx = spectrumCanvas.getContext('2d');

    // Set canvas resolution
    resizeCanvases();

    // Allocate buffers
    timeDomainData = new Uint8Array(FFT_SIZE);
    frequencyData = new Uint8Array(FFT_SIZE / 2);
    floatTimeDomainData = new Float32Array(FFT_SIZE);

    // Pre-compute default window coefficients
    windowCoefficients = computeWindowCoefficients('rectangular', FFT_SIZE);

    // Setup toggle button
    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('analyzerToggle');
    const panel = document.getElementById('analyzerPanel');
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('analyzerClose');

    toggleBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => toggle());
    closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => hide());

    // Window function selector
    const windowSelect = document.getElementById('analyzerWindowSelect');
    if (windowSelect) {
      windowSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        setWindowFunction(windowSelect.value);
      });
    }

    // Spectrum mode toggle
    const modeToggle = document.getElementById('analyzerModeToggle');
    if (modeToggle) {
      modeToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (spectrumMode === 'standard') {
          spectrumMode = 'windowed';
          modeToggle.textContent = 'Windowed';
          modeToggle.classList.add('active');
        } else {
          spectrumMode = 'standard';
          modeToggle.textContent = 'Standard';
          modeToggle.classList.remove('active');
        }
      });
    }

    // Click outside to close (optional)
    panel?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === panel) hide();
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvases);

  }

  function resizeCanvases() {
    if (!scopeCanvas || !spectrumCanvas) return;

    // Match display size to CSS size
    const scopeRect = scopeCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const spectrumRect = spectrumCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    // Reset transforms before resizing
    scopeCtx?.resetTransform?.();
    spectrumCtx?.resetTransform?.();

    scopeCanvas.width = scopeRect.width * window.devicePixelRatio;
    scopeCanvas.height = scopeRect.height * window.devicePixelRatio;
    spectrumCanvas.width = spectrumRect.width * window.devicePixelRatio;
    spectrumCanvas.height = spectrumRect.height * window.devicePixelRatio;

    // Scale context for retina
    scopeCtx?.scale(window.devicePixelRatio, window.devicePixelRatio);
    spectrumCtx?.scale(window.devicePixelRatio, window.devicePixelRatio);
  }

  function show() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('analyzerPanel');
    panel?.classList.remove('hidden');
    isVisible = true;
    resizeCanvases(); // Resize after showing since dimensions may have changed
    startAnimation();
  }

  function hide() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('analyzerPanel');
    panel?.classList.add('hidden');
    isVisible = false;
    stopAnimation();
  }

  function toggle() {
    isVisible ? hide() : show();
  }

  function startAnimation() {
    if (animationId) return;
    render();
  }

  function stopAnimation() {
    if (animationId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
      animationId = null;
    }
  }

  function render() {
    if (!isVisible) return;

    const analyser = SL.audio?.getAnalyser?.();
    if (analyser) {
      drawOscilloscope(analyser);
      if (spectrumMode === 'windowed') {
        drawWindowedSpectrum(analyser);
      } else {
        drawSpectrum(analyser);
      }
    }

    animationId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }

  function drawOscilloscope(analyser) {
    analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeDomainData);

    const canvas = scopeCanvas;
    const ctx = scopeCtx;
    const width = canvas.width / window.devicePixelRatio;
    const height = canvas.height / window.devicePixelRatio;

    // Clear
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Grid lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, height / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(width, height / 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Waveform
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4cc9f0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();

    const sliceWidth = width / timeDomainData.length;
    let x = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < timeDomainData.length; i++) {
      const v = timeDomainData[i] / 128.0;
      const y = (v * height) / 2;

      if (i === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      x += sliceWidth;
    }

    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawSpectrum(analyser) {
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(frequencyData);

    const canvas = spectrumCanvas;
    const ctx = spectrumCtx;
    const width = canvas.width / window.devicePixelRatio;
    const height = canvas.height / window.devicePixelRatio;

    // Clear
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Frequency bars
    const barCount = SPECTRUM_BAR_COUNT;
    const barWidth = width / barCount - 1;
    const step = Math.floor(frequencyData.length / barCount);

    for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
      // Average multiple bins for each bar
      let sum = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
        sum += frequencyData[i * step + j];
      }
      const value = sum / step;

      const barHeight = (value / 255) * height;
      const x = i * (barWidth + 1);
      const y = height - barHeight;

      // Gradient color based on frequency (pre-computed)
      ctx.fillStyle = spectrumColors[i];
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);
    }

    // Frequency labels
    ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('20Hz', 2, height - 2);
    ctx.fillText('20kHz', width - 35, height - 2);
  }

  function drawWindowedSpectrum(analyser) {
    // Get float time-domain data for windowed FFT
    if (analyser.getFloatTimeDomainData) {
      analyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(floatTimeDomainData);
    } else {
      // Fallback: convert byte data to float
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeDomainData);
      for (let i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
        floatTimeDomainData[i] = (timeDomainData[i] - 128) / 128.0;
      }
    }

    const canvas = spectrumCanvas;
    const ctx = spectrumCtx;
    const width = canvas.width / window.devicePixelRatio;
    const height = canvas.height / window.devicePixelRatio;

    // Clear
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Compute windowed FFT magnitude spectrum (dB)
    const magnitudes = computeWindowedSpectrum(floatTimeDomainData, windowCoefficients);
    const halfN = magnitudes.length;

    // dB range for display
    const dbMin = -100;
    const dbMax = 0;
    const dbRange = dbMax - dbMin;

    // Draw spectrum as filled line graph
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, height);

    for (let i = 0; i < halfN; i++) {
      const xPos = (i / halfN) * width;
      const dbVal = Math.max(dbMin, Math.min(dbMax, magnitudes[i]));
      const yNorm = (dbVal - dbMin) / dbRange; // 0..1
      const yPos = height - yNorm * height;
      ctx.lineTo(xPos, yPos);
    }

    ctx.lineTo(width, height);
    ctx.closePath();

    // Gradient fill
    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, width, 0);
    gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(114, 9, 183, 0.4)');
    gradient.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.4)');
    gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.4)');
    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
    ctx.fill();

    // Stroke the line on top
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < halfN; i++) {
      const xPos = (i / halfN) * width;
      const dbVal = Math.max(dbMin, Math.min(dbMax, magnitudes[i]));
      const yNorm = (dbVal - dbMin) / dbRange;
      const yPos = height - yNorm * height;
      if (i === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(xPos, yPos);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(xPos, yPos);
      }
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4cc9f0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Peak detection
    const sampleRate = SL.audio?.getContext?.()?.sampleRate || 44100;
    const peaks = detectPeaks(magnitudes, sampleRate);

    // Draw peak markers
    ctx.font = '9px monospace';
    for (let p = 0; p < peaks.length; p++) {
      const peak = peaks[p];
      const xPos = (peak.bin / halfN) * width;
      const dbVal = Math.max(dbMin, Math.min(dbMax, peak.magnitude));
      const yNorm = (dbVal - dbMin) / dbRange;
      const yPos = height - yNorm * height;

      // Peak dot
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(xPos, yPos, 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fillStyle = PEAK_COLOR;
      ctx.fill();

      // Frequency label (only for top 4 peaks)
      if (p < 4) {
        const label = formatFrequency(peak.frequency) + 'Hz';
        ctx.fillStyle = PEAK_LABEL_COLOR;
        // Offset label to avoid overlap
        const labelX = Math.min(xPos + 4, width - 40);
        const labelY = Math.max(yPos - 6, 12);
        ctx.fillText(label, labelX, labelY);
      }
    }

    // dB scale labels
    ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
    ctx.font = '9px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('0dB', 2, 10);
    ctx.fillText('-50dB', 2, height / 2);
    ctx.fillText('-100dB', 2, height - 2);

    // Frequency labels
    ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('20Hz', 40, height - 2);
    ctx.fillText('20kHz', width - 35, height - 2);

    // Window function label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4cc9f0';
    ctx.font = '9px monospace';
    const windowLabel = currentWindowFunction.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + currentWindowFunction.slice(1);
    ctx.fillText(windowLabel, width - ctx.measureText(windowLabel).width - 4, 10);
  }

  // ===== Public API =====

  function setWindowFunction(name) {
    const valid = ['rectangular', 'hann', 'hamming', 'blackman', 'blackman-harris'];
    if (valid.indexOf(name) === -1) {
      console.warn('Unknown window function: ' + name + '. Valid: ' + valid.join(', '));
      return;
    }
    currentWindowFunction = name;
    windowCoefficients = computeWindowCoefficients(name, FFT_SIZE);

    // If not already in windowed mode, switch to it (except rectangular)
    if (name !== 'rectangular' && spectrumMode === 'standard') {
      spectrumMode = 'windowed';
      const modeToggle = document.getElementById('analyzerModeToggle');
      if (modeToggle) {
        modeToggle.textContent = 'Windowed';
        modeToggle.classList.add('active');
      }
    }
  }

  function getWindowFunction() {
    return currentWindowFunction;
  }

  // Export
  SL.analyzer = {
    init: init,
    show: show,
    hide: hide,
    toggle: toggle,
    isVisible: function() { return isVisible; },
    setWindowFunction: setWindowFunction,
    getWindowFunction: getWindowFunction
  };
})();


// === midi.js ===
// Super Synth Lab - MIDI Module
// Web MIDI API input/output with per-channel instrument routing
// Channel 1 -> Instrument 1, Channel 2 -> Instrument 2, etc.
(function() {
  'use strict';

  var SL = window.SynthLab;
  if (!SL || !SL.audio) {
    console.error('[midi] SynthLab.audio not available');
    return;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // State
  // ============================================================

  var midiAccess = null;
  var selectedInputId = null;
  var selectedOutputId = null;
  var currentInput = null;
  var currentOutput = null;
  var midiEnabled = false;

  // Active MIDI notes per instrument channel (0-3)
  // Each is a Map: midi -> { type, oscillators, master, filterChain, releaseTime }
  var midiActiveNotes = [new Map(), new Map(), new Map(), new Map()];

  // Per-instrument MIDI configuration
  var midiConfig = [
    { midiIn: true, midiOut: false, channel: 0 },
    { midiIn: true, midiOut: false, channel: 1 },
    { midiIn: true, midiOut: false, channel: 2 },
    { midiIn: true, midiOut: false, channel: 3 }
  ];

  // Transpose offset (semitones, -24 to +24)
  var midiTranspose = 0;

  // MIDIOUT instrument settings (for instruments set to midiout type)
  var midioutSettings = [
    { channel: 0, velCurve: 'linear', program: 0 },
    { channel: 1, velCurve: 'linear', program: 0 },
    { channel: 2, velCurve: 'linear', program: 0 },
    { channel: 3, velCurve: 'linear', program: 0 }
  ];

  // ============================================================
  // Web MIDI Access
  // ============================================================

  function init() {
    if (!navigator.requestMIDIAccess) {
      console.warn('[MIDI] Web MIDI API not available in this browser');
      return;
    }
    navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: false }).then(
      function(access) {
        midiAccess = access;
        midiEnabled = true;
        access.onstatechange = onStateChange;
        updateDeviceSelectors();
        autoSelectDevices();
      },
      function(err) {
        console.error('[MIDI] Access denied:', err);
      }
    );
  }

  function onStateChange() {
    updateDeviceSelectors();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Device Management
  // ============================================================

  function getInputDevices() {
    if (!midiAccess) return [];
    var devices = [];
    midiAccess.inputs.forEach(function(input) {
      devices.push({ id: input.id, name: input.name, manufacturer: input.manufacturer });
    });
    return devices;
  }

  function getOutputDevices() {
    if (!midiAccess) return [];
    var devices = [];
    midiAccess.outputs.forEach(function(output) {
      devices.push({ id: output.id, name: output.name, manufacturer: output.manufacturer });
    });
    return devices;
  }

  function selectInput(deviceId) {
    // Disconnect old input
    if (currentInput) {
      currentInput.onmidimessage = null;
      currentInput = null;
    }
    selectedInputId = deviceId;

    if (!deviceId || !midiAccess) return;

    var input = midiAccess.inputs.get(deviceId);
    if (input) {
      input.onmidimessage = onMIDIMessage;
      currentInput = input;
    }
  }

  function selectOutput(deviceId) {
    selectedOutputId = deviceId;
    currentOutput = null;

    if (!deviceId || !midiAccess) return;

    var output = midiAccess.outputs.get(deviceId);
    if (output) {
      currentOutput = output;
    }
  }

  function autoSelectDevices() {
    // Auto-select first available input/output
    var inputs = getInputDevices();
    var outputs = getOutputDevices();
    if (inputs.length > 0 && !selectedInputId) {
      selectInput(inputs[0].id);
    }
    if (outputs.length > 0 && !selectedOutputId) {
      selectOutput(outputs[0].id);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MIDI Message Handler
  // ============================================================

  function onMIDIMessage(event) {
    var data = event.data;
    if (!data || data.length < 2) return;

    var status = data[0] & 0xF0;
    var channel = data[0] & 0x0F; // 0-15
    var byte1 = data[1];
    var byte2 = data.length > 2 ? data[2] : 0;

    // Apply transpose to note messages
    var transposedByte1 = byte1;
    if ((status === 0x90 || status === 0x80) && midiTranspose !== 0) {
      transposedByte1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(127, byte1 + midiTranspose));
    }

    // Route to instruments based on their configured channel
    for (var instId = 0; instId < 4; instId++) {
      if (midiConfig[instId].channel === channel && midiConfig[instId].midiIn) {
        if (status === 0x90 && byte2 > 0) {
          midiNoteOn(transposedByte1, byte2, instId);
        } else if (status === 0x80 || (status === 0x90 && byte2 === 0)) {
          midiNoteOff(transposedByte1, instId);
        } else if (status === 0xB0) {
          handleCC(byte1, byte2, instId);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // CC Handling
  // ============================================================

  function handleCC(cc, value, channel) {
    if (cc === 123 || cc === 120) {
      // All Notes Off / All Sound Off
      panicChannel(channel);
    } else if (cc === 1) {
      // Mod wheel — could map to filter cutoff or vibrato later
    } else if (cc === 64) {
      // Sustain pedal — TODO: hold notes
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Note On/Off with Per-Instrument Routing
  // ============================================================

  function midiNoteOn(midi, velocity, instId) {
    // Don't double-trigger
    if (midiActiveNotes[instId].has(midi)) {
      midiNoteOff(midi, instId);
    }

    var type = SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instId);

    // MIDIOUT type — send MIDI out, no local audio
    if (type === 'midiout') {
      var moSettings = midioutSettings[instId];
      var adjVel = applyVelocityCurve(velocity, moSettings.velCurve);
      sendNoteOn(midi, adjVel, moSettings.channel);
      midiActiveNotes[instId].set(midi, { type: 'midiout' });
      SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, true);
      return;
    }

    // FM synthesis
    if (type === 'fm' && SL.fm && SL.fm.noteOn) {
      SL.fm.noteOn(midi, velocity, instId);
      midiActiveNotes[instId].set(midi, { type: 'fm' });
      SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, true);
      return;
    }

    // Physical modelling
    if (type === 'physical' && SL.physical && SL.physical.noteOn) {
      SL.physical.noteOn(midi, velocity, instId);
      midiActiveNotes[instId].set(midi, { type: 'physical' });
      SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, true);
      return;
    }

    // Sampler
    if (type === 'sampler' && SL.sampler && SL.sampler.noteOn) {
      SL.sampler.noteOn(midi, velocity, instId);
      midiActiveNotes[instId].set(midi, { type: 'sampler' });
      SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, true);
      return;
    }

    // Subtractive synthesis — create oscillators routed to this instrument's masterOutput
    var instruments = SL.audio.getInstruments();
    var inst = instruments[instId];
    if (!inst) return;

    // Read saved settings for this instrument
    var settings = inst.settings;
    var c = SL.audio.getCtx();
    var f = SL.audio.m2f(midi);

    // ADSR from saved settings
    var attackTime = Math.max(0.003, SL.audio.sliderToTime(settings.adsr.a, 500, 500) / 1000);
    var decayTime = SL.audio.sliderToTime(settings.adsr.d, 500, 500) / 1000;
    var sustainLevel = settings.adsr.s / 100;
    var releaseTime = SL.audio.sliderToTime(settings.adsr.r, 1000, 1000) / 1000;

    var peak = (velocity / 127) * 0.12;
    var now = c.currentTime;

    // Master gain with ADSR attack + decay
    var master = c.createGain();
    master.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
    master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, now + attackTime);
    master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, sustainLevel * peak), now + attackTime + decayTime);

    var destination = inst.masterOutput || SL.audio.getFinalDestination();

    // Filter from saved settings
    var filterChain = null;
    if (settings.filter.enabled) {
      var filterFreq = SL.audio.sliderToFreq(settings.filter.freq);
      var filterQ = SL.audio.sliderToQ(settings.filter.q);
      var keyTrackedFreq = SL.audio.calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterFreq, f, settings.filter.keyTrack);

      var filterSettings = {
        enabled: true,
        type: settings.filter.type,
        frequency: keyTrackedFreq,
        resonance: filterQ,
        keyTrack: settings.filter.keyTrack,
        model: settings.filter.model,
        slope: settings.filter.slope
      };

      filterChain = SL.audio.createFilterChain(c, filterSettings);
    }

    if (filterChain) {
      master.connect(filterChain.input);
      filterChain.output.connect(destination);
    } else {
      master.connect(destination);
    }

    // Create oscillators from saved settings
    var oscillators = [];
    settings.osc.forEach(function(os) {
      var level = (os.level || 0) / 100;
      if (level <= 0) return;

      var oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct || 0) * Math.pow(2, (os.detune || 0) / 1200);

      if (os.wave === 'supersaw' && SL.audio.createSuperSawOscillators) {
        var ssOscs = SL.audio.createSuperSawOscillators(c, oscFreq, os.superSawSpread || 50, master, level);
        ssOscs.forEach(function(osc) {
          osc.start();
          oscillators.push({ osc: osc, gain: null });
        });
      } else if (os.wave === 'pulse' && SL.audio.createPulseWave) {
        var o = c.createOscillator();
        var g = c.createGain();
        var pw = SL.audio.createPulseWave(c, os.pulseWidth || 50);
        o.setPeriodicWave(pw);
        o.frequency.value = oscFreq;
        g.gain.value = level;
        o.connect(g);
        g.connect(master);
        o.start();
        oscillators.push({ osc: o, gain: g });
      } else {
        var o = c.createOscillator();
        o.type = os.wave || 'sine';
        o.frequency.value = oscFreq;
        var g = c.createGain();
        g.gain.value = level;
        o.connect(g);
        g.connect(master);
        o.start();
        oscillators.push({ osc: o, gain: g });
      }
    });

    midiActiveNotes[instId].set(midi, {
      type: 'subtractive',
      oscillators: oscillators,
      master: master,
      filterChain: filterChain,
      releaseTime: releaseTime
    });
    SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, true);
  }

  function midiNoteOff(midi, instId) {
    var noteData = midiActiveNotes[instId].get(midi);
    if (!noteData) return;

    if (noteData.type === 'midiout') {
      var moSettings = midioutSettings[instId];
      sendNoteOff(midi, moSettings.channel);
    } else if (noteData.type === 'fm') {
      if (SL.fm && SL.fm.noteOff) SL.fm.noteOff(midi, instId);
    } else if (noteData.type === 'physical') {
      if (SL.physical && SL.physical.noteOff) SL.physical.noteOff(midi, instId);
    } else if (noteData.type === 'sampler') {
      if (SL.sampler && SL.sampler.noteOff) SL.sampler.noteOff(midi, instId);
    } else if (noteData.type === 'subtractive') {
      var c = SL.audio.getCtx();
      var releaseTime = noteData.releaseTime || 0.2;
      var now = c.currentTime;

      // Cancel any scheduled values and do release envelope
      noteData.master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);
      noteData.master.gain.setValueAtTime(noteData.master.gain.value, now);
      noteData.master.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + releaseTime);

      // Schedule oscillator stop after release
      var stopTime = now + releaseTime + 0.02;
      noteData.oscillators.forEach(function(o) {
        try { o.osc.stop(stopTime); } catch (e) { /* already stopped */ }
      });

      // Disconnect filter chain after release
      if (noteData.filterChain) {
        setTimeout(function() {
          try {
            noteData.master.disconnect();
            if (noteData.filterChain.output) noteData.filterChain.output.disconnect();
          } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        }, (releaseTime + 0.05) * 1000);
      }
    }

    midiActiveNotes[instId].delete(midi);
    SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, false);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Velocity Curve
  // ============================================================

  function applyVelocityCurve(velocity, curve) {
    var v = velocity / 127;
    if (curve === 'soft') {
      v = Math.sqrt(v);
    } else if (curve === 'hard') {
      v = v * v;
    }
    // 'linear' — no change
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(127, Math.round(v * 127)));
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MIDI Output (echo keyboard to external devices)
  // ============================================================

  function sendNoteOn(midi, velocity, channel) {
    if (!currentOutput) return;
    var ch = (channel != null) ? channel : SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    currentOutput.send([0x90 | (ch & 0x0F), midi & 0x7F, (velocity || 100) & 0x7F]);
  }

  function sendNoteOff(midi, channel) {
    if (!currentOutput) return;
    var ch = (channel != null) ? channel : SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    currentOutput.send([0x80 | (ch & 0x0F), midi & 0x7F, 0]);
  }

  function sendAllNotesOff(channel) {
    if (!currentOutput) return;
    if (channel != null) {
      currentOutput.send([0xB0 | (channel & 0x0F), 123, 0]);
    } else {
      for (var ch = 0; ch < 16; ch++) {
        currentOutput.send([0xB0 | ch, 123, 0]);
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Panic
  // ============================================================

  function panicChannel(channel) {
    midiActiveNotes[channel].forEach(function(data, midi) {
      midiNoteOff(midi, channel);
    });
  }

  function panic() {
    // Stop all MIDI-triggered notes
    for (var ch = 0; ch < 4; ch++) {
      panicChannel(ch);
    }
    // Stop all keyboard-sustained notes
    if (SL.audio.stopAllSustained) {
      SL.audio.stopAllSustained();
    }
    // Send All Notes Off on MIDI output
    sendAllNotesOff();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // UI
  // ============================================================

  function updateDeviceSelectors() {
    var inputSelect = document.getElementById('midiInput');
    var outputSelect = document.getElementById('midiOutput');
    if (!inputSelect || !outputSelect) return;

    var inputs = getInputDevices();
    var outputs = getOutputDevices();

    // Log discovered devices to console
    console.log('[MIDI] Scanning devices...');
    if (inputs.length === 0 && outputs.length === 0) {
      console.log('[MIDI]   No MIDI devices found');
    }
    inputs.forEach(function(dev) {
      console.log('[MIDI]   INPUT:  "' + dev.name + '" (manufacturer: ' + (dev.manufacturer || 'unknown') + ', id: ' + dev.id + ')');
    });
    outputs.forEach(function(dev) {
      console.log('[MIDI]   OUTPUT: "' + dev.name + '" (manufacturer: ' + (dev.manufacturer || 'unknown') + ', id: ' + dev.id + ')');
    });
    console.log('[MIDI] Found ' + inputs.length + ' input(s), ' + outputs.length + ' output(s)');

    // Update input selector
    inputSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- None --</option>';
    inputs.forEach(function(dev) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = dev.id;
      opt.textContent = dev.name;
      if (dev.id === selectedInputId) opt.selected = true;
      inputSelect.appendChild(opt);
    });

    // Update output selector
    outputSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- None --</option>';
    outputs.forEach(function(dev) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = dev.id;
      opt.textContent = dev.name;
      if (dev.id === selectedOutputId) opt.selected = true;
      outputSelect.appendChild(opt);
    });

    updateStatusIndicator();
  }

  // Full rescan: re-request MIDI access to pick up newly connected USB devices
  function rescanDevices() {
    console.log('[MIDI] Rescan requested — re-requesting MIDI access...');
    if (!navigator.requestMIDIAccess) {
      console.warn('[MIDI] Web MIDI API not available');
      return;
    }
    navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: false }).then(
      function(access) {
        midiAccess = access;
        midiEnabled = true;
        access.onstatechange = onStateChange;
        updateDeviceSelectors();
        autoSelectDevices();
        console.log('[MIDI] Rescan complete');
      },
      function(err) {
        console.error('[MIDI] Rescan failed:', err);
      }
    );
  }

  function updateStatusIndicator() {
    var indicator = document.getElementById('midiStatus');
    if (!indicator) return;

    if (!midiEnabled) {
      indicator.className = 'midi-status midi-unavailable';
      indicator.title = 'Web MIDI not available';
    } else if (currentInput) {
      indicator.className = 'midi-status midi-connected';
      indicator.title = 'MIDI connected: ' + currentInput.name;
    } else {
      indicator.className = 'midi-status midi-disconnected';
      indicator.title = 'No MIDI device connected';
    }
  }

  function setupUI() {
    // Wire up device selectors
    var inputSelect = document.getElementById('midiInput');
    var outputSelect = document.getElementById('midiOutput');

    if (inputSelect) {
      inputSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        selectInput(this.value || null);
        updateStatusIndicator();
      });
    }
    if (outputSelect) {
      outputSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        selectOutput(this.value || null);
        updateStatusIndicator();
      });
    }

    // Panic button
    var panicBtn = document.getElementById('midiPanicBtn');
    if (panicBtn) {
      panicBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        panic();
        panicBtn.classList.add('panic-flash');
        setTimeout(function() { panicBtn.classList.remove('panic-flash'); }, 300);
      });
    }

    // Rescan button — dynamically created next to Panic button
    if (panicBtn && panicBtn.parentNode) {
      var rescanBtn = document.createElement('button');
      rescanBtn.id = 'midiRescanBtn';
      rescanBtn.textContent = 'Rescan';
      rescanBtn.title = 'Re-scan for MIDI devices (USB hubs, newly connected devices)';
      rescanBtn.style.cssText = panicBtn.style.cssText || '';
      rescanBtn.className = panicBtn.className.replace('panic-flash', '').trim();
      rescanBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        rescanBtn.textContent = 'Scanning...';
        rescanBtn.disabled = true;
        rescanDevices();
        setTimeout(function() {
          rescanBtn.textContent = 'Rescan';
          rescanBtn.disabled = false;
        }, 1000);
      });
      panicBtn.parentNode.insertBefore(rescanBtn, panicBtn.nextSibling);
    }

    // MIDI toggle button (show/hide panel)
    var midiToggle = document.getElementById('midiToggle');
    var midiPanel = document.getElementById('midiPanel');
    if (midiToggle && midiPanel) {
      midiToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
        midiPanel.classList.toggle('hidden');
      });
    }

    // Per-instrument MIDI config UI
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      (function(instId) {
        var inToggle = document.querySelector('.midi-in-toggle[data-inst="' + instId + '"]');
        var outToggle = document.querySelector('.midi-out-toggle[data-inst="' + instId + '"]');
        var chSelect = document.querySelector('.midi-ch-select[data-inst="' + instId + '"]');

        if (inToggle) {
          inToggle.addEventListener('change', function() {
            midiConfig[instId].midiIn = this.checked;
          });
        }
        if (outToggle) {
          outToggle.addEventListener('change', function() {
            midiConfig[instId].midiOut = this.checked;
          });
        }
        if (chSelect) {
          chSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
            midiConfig[instId].channel = parseInt(this.value);
          });
        }
      })(i);
    }

    // MIDIOUT panel controls
    var midioutChEl = document.getElementById('midioutChannel');
    var midioutVelEl = document.getElementById('midioutVelCurve');
    var midioutProgEl = document.getElementById('midioutProgram');

    if (midioutChEl) {
      midioutChEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
        midioutSettings[instId].channel = parseInt(this.value);
      });
    }
    if (midioutVelEl) {
      midioutVelEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
        midioutSettings[instId].velCurve = this.value;
      });
    }
    if (midioutProgEl) {
      midioutProgEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
        midioutSettings[instId].program = parseInt(this.value) || 0;
        // Send program change if output is connected
        if (currentOutput) {
          var ch = midioutSettings[instId].channel;
          currentOutput.send([0xC0 | (ch & 0x0F), midioutSettings[instId].program & 0x7F]);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Hook into keyboard for MIDI output
  // ============================================================

  function hookKeyboardOutput() {
    // Wrap startSustainedNote to also send MIDI out when configured
    var origStart = SL.audio.startSustainedNote;
    var origStop = SL.audio.stopSustainedNote;

    if (origStart) {
      SL.audio.startSustainedNote = function(midi) {
        var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
        var type = SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instId);
        // For midiout type, don't play locally — just send MIDI
        if (type === 'midiout') {
          var moSettings = midioutSettings[instId];
          var adjVel = applyVelocityCurve(100, moSettings.velCurve);
          sendNoteOn(midi, adjVel, moSettings.channel);
          SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, true);
        } else {
          origStart(midi);
          // Also send MIDI out if midiOut is enabled for this instrument
          if (midiConfig[instId].midiOut) {
            sendNoteOn(midi, 100, midiConfig[instId].channel);
          }
        }
      };
    }
    if (origStop) {
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote = function(midi) {
        var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
        var type = SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instId);
        if (type === 'midiout') {
          var moSettings = midioutSettings[instId];
          sendNoteOff(midi, moSettings.channel);
          SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, false);
        } else {
          origStop(midi);
          if (midiConfig[instId].midiOut) {
            sendNoteOff(midi, midiConfig[instId].channel);
          }
        }
      };
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init on SynthLab ready
  // ============================================================

  function setup() {
    init();
    setupUI();
    hookKeyboardOutput();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.midi = {
    setup: setup,
    init: init,
    panic: panic,
    sendNoteOn: sendNoteOn,
    sendNoteOff: sendNoteOff,
    sendAllNotesOff: sendAllNotesOff,
    getInputDevices: getInputDevices,
    getOutputDevices: getOutputDevices,
    selectInput: selectInput,
    selectOutput: selectOutput,
    rescan: rescanDevices,
    isEnabled: function() { return midiEnabled; },
    setTranspose: function(val) { midiTranspose = Math.max(-24, Math.min(24, parseInt(val) || 0)); },
    getTranspose: function() { return midiTranspose; },
    getActiveNoteCount: function() {
      var total = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) total += midiActiveNotes[i].size;
      return total;
    },
    getMidiConfig: function() { return midiConfig; },
    setMidiConfig: function(instId, cfg) {
      if (instId >= 0 && instId < 4 && cfg) {
        if (cfg.midiIn !== undefined) midiConfig[instId].midiIn = cfg.midiIn;
        if (cfg.midiOut !== undefined) midiConfig[instId].midiOut = cfg.midiOut;
        if (cfg.channel !== undefined) midiConfig[instId].channel = cfg.channel;
      }
    },
    getMidioutSettings: function() { return midioutSettings; },
    setMidioutSettings: function(instId, cfg) {
      if (instId >= 0 && instId < 4 && cfg) {
        if (cfg.channel !== undefined) midioutSettings[instId].channel = cfg.channel;
        if (cfg.velCurve !== undefined) midioutSettings[instId].velCurve = cfg.velCurve;
        if (cfg.program !== undefined) midioutSettings[instId].program = cfg.program;
      }
    },
    loadMidioutUI: function(instId) {
      var chEl = document.getElementById('midioutChannel');
      var velEl = document.getElementById('midioutVelCurve');
      var progEl = document.getElementById('midioutProgram');
      var s = midioutSettings[instId];
      if (chEl) chEl.value = s.channel;
      if (velEl) velEl.value = s.velCurve;
      if (progEl) progEl.value = s.program;
    }
  };

  // Auto-initialize MIDI on page load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      if (SL.midi && SL.midi.setup) SL.midi.setup();
    });
  } else {
    // DOM already loaded
    if (SL.midi && SL.midi.setup) SL.midi.setup();
  }

})();
