        }

        // Build header: SMF Type 1
        let numTracks = 1; // tempo track
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            if (instNotes[i].length > 0) numTracks++;
        }

        const header = [];
        header.push(...strToBytes('MThd'));
        header.push(...writeUint32(6));
        header.push(...writeUint16(1)); // format type 1
        header.push(...writeUint16(numTracks));
        header.push(...writeUint16(PPQN));

        // Tempo track (track 0)
        const tempoTrack = [];
        const usPerQuarter = Math.round(60000000 / bpm);
        tempoTrack.push({
            deltaTicks: 0,
            bytes: [0xFF, 0x51, 0x03, (usPerQuarter >> 16) & 0xFF, (usPerQuarter >> 8) & 0xFF, usPerQuarter & 0xFF]
        });
        // Time signature: 4/4
        tempoTrack.push({
            deltaTicks: 0,
            bytes: [0xFF, 0x58, 0x04, 0x04, 0x02, 0x18, 0x08]
        });
        // Track name
        const nameBytes = strToBytes('SuperSynthLab Export');
        tempoTrack.push({
            deltaTicks: 0,
            bytes: [0xFF, 0x03, nameBytes.length, ...nameBytes]
        });

        const fileBytes = [...header, ...buildTrack(tempoTrack)];

        // Instrument tracks
        for (let inst = 0; inst < 4; inst++) {
            if (instNotes[inst].length === 0) continue;

            const notes = instNotes[inst];
            const channel = inst;

            // Build note-on/note-off event list
            const rawEvents = [];

            for (let ni = 0; ni < notes.length; ni++) {
                const n = notes[ni];

                if (n.isChord && n.notes) {
                    // Chord: multiple note-ons at same time, multiple note-offs
                    for (let ci = 0; ci < n.notes.length; ci++) {
                        const midi = n.notes[ci];
                        const vel = n.vel || 100;
                        const startTick = n.start * TICKS_PER_STEP;
                        const endTick = startTick + n.dur * TICKS_PER_STEP;
                        rawEvents.push({ tick: startTick, type: 'on', midi: midi, vel: vel, channel: channel });
                        rawEvents.push({ tick: endTick, type: 'off', midi: midi, channel: channel });
                    }
                } else {
                    // Single note
                    const midi = n.midi || (baseMidi + (n.row || 0));
                    const vel = n.vel || 100;
                    const startTick = n.start * TICKS_PER_STEP;
                    const endTick = startTick + n.dur * TICKS_PER_STEP;
                    rawEvents.push({ tick: startTick, type: 'on', midi: midi, vel: vel, channel: channel });
                    rawEvents.push({ tick: endTick, type: 'off', midi: midi, channel: channel });
                }
            }

            // Sort by tick, then note-off before note-on at same tick
            rawEvents.sort((a, b) => {
                if (a.tick !== b.tick) return a.tick - b.tick;
                if (a.type === 'off' && b.type === 'on') return -1;
                if (a.type === 'on' && b.type === 'off') return 1;
                return 0;
            });

            // Convert to delta-time events
            const trackEvents = [];
            const trkName = strToBytes('Instrument ' + (inst + 1));
            trackEvents.push({ deltaTicks: 0, bytes: [0xFF, 0x03, trkName.length, ...trkName] });

            let lastTick = 0;
            for (let ei = 0; ei < rawEvents.length; ei++) {
                const ev = rawEvents[ei];
                const delta = ev.tick - lastTick;
                lastTick = ev.tick;

                if (ev.type === 'on') {
                    trackEvents.push({ deltaTicks: delta, bytes: [0x90 | ev.channel, ev.midi, ev.vel] });
                } else {
                    trackEvents.push({ deltaTicks: delta, bytes: [0x80 | ev.channel, ev.midi, 0x00] });
                }
            }

            fileBytes.push(...buildTrack(trackEvents));
        }

        // Encode as base64
        const uint8 = new Uint8Array(fileBytes);
        var binary = '';
        for (var bi = 0; bi < uint8.length; bi++) {
            binary += String.fromCharCode(uint8[bi]);
        }
        const b64 = btoa(binary);

        // Use Clairvoyance postMessage clipboard API (sandbox blocks downloads)
        var reqId = 'midi-export-' + Date.now();
        var clipboardDone = false;

        var onResponse = function(ev) {
            var d = ev.data;
            if (!d || d.type !== 'exhibit:clipboardResponse' || d.requestId !== reqId) return;
            window.removeEventListener('message', onResponse);
            clipboardDone = true;
            if (d.success) {
                showExportToast('MIDI copied to clipboard (' + seqNotes.length + ' notes, ' + bpm + ' BPM). Run save_midi.py to save.');
            } else {
                showExportToast('Clipboard write failed: ' + (d.error || 'unknown'));
            }
        };
        window.addEventListener('message', onResponse);

        window.parent.postMessage({
            type: 'exhibit:clipboardRequest',
            requestId: reqId,
            action: 'writeText',
            payload: { text: b64 }
        }, '*');

        // Fallback timeout — if no response in 500ms, clipboard API not available
        setTimeout(function() {
            if (clipboardDone) return;
            window.removeEventListener('message', onResponse);
            // Fallback: try direct download (works in standalone HTML mode)
            var dataUri = 'data:audio/midi;base64,' + b64;
            var a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = dataUri;
            a.download = 'supersynthlab-export.mid';
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
        }, 500);
    };

    // Toast notification for export feedback
    const showExportToast = (msg) => {
        var existing = document.getElementById('midiExportToast');
        if (existing) existing.remove();
        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.id = 'midiExportToast';
        toast.textContent = msg;
        toast.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);' +
            'background:#1a1a2e;color:#0f0;border:1px solid #0f0;padding:10px 20px;' +
            'border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;z-index:99999;pointer-events:none;' +
            'font-family:monospace;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.3s;';
        document.body.appendChild(toast);
        requestAnimationFrame(function() { toast.style.opacity = '1'; });
        setTimeout(function() {
            toast.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(function() { toast.remove(); }, 400);
        }, 4000);
    };

    // Expose on SL namespace
    if (!window.SL) window.SL = {};
    if (!SL.midiFile) SL.midiFile = {};
    SL.midiFile.exportMidi = exportMidi;
})();


// === midi-import.js ===
(function() {
  'use strict';

  const SL = window.SynthLab || window.SL;

  // --- SMF (Standard MIDI File) Parser ---

  const readVLQ = (data, offset) => {
    let value = 0;
    let bytesRead = 0;
    let b;
    do {
      b = data[offset + bytesRead];
      value = (value << 7) | (b & 0x7F);
      bytesRead++;
    } while (b & 0x80);
    return { value, bytesRead };
  };

  const readUint16 = (data, offset) => (data[offset] << 8) | data[offset + 1];

  const readUint32 = (data, offset) =>
    (data[offset] << 24) | (data[offset + 1] << 16) | (data[offset + 2] << 8) | data[offset + 3];

  const parseMidiFile = (arrayBuffer) => {
    const data = new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer);
    let pos = 0;

    // Read header chunk
    const headerTag = String.fromCharCode(data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]);
    if (headerTag !== 'MThd') {
      console.error('Not a MIDI file');
      return null;
    }
    pos = 4;
    const headerLen = readUint32(data, pos); pos += 4;
    const format = readUint16(data, pos); pos += 2;
    const numTracks = readUint16(data, pos); pos += 2;
    const ppqn = readUint16(data, pos); pos += 2;
    pos = 8 + headerLen; // skip any extra header bytes

    const tracks = [];

    // Parse each track
    for (let t = 0; t < numTracks && pos < data.length; t++) {
      const trackTag = String.fromCharCode(data[pos], data[pos + 1], data[pos + 2], data[pos + 3]);
      pos += 4;
      const trackLen = readUint32(data, pos);
      pos += 4;

      if (trackTag !== 'MTrk') {
        console.warn('Skipping non-MTrk chunk: ' + trackTag);
        pos += trackLen;
        continue;
      }

      const trackEnd = pos + trackLen;
      const events = [];
      let absoluteTick = 0;
      let runningStatus = 0;

      while (pos < trackEnd) {
        // Read delta time
        const vlq = readVLQ(data, pos);
        pos += vlq.bytesRead;
        absoluteTick += vlq.value;

        // Read event
        let statusByte = data[pos];

        if (statusByte === 0xFF) {
          // Meta event
          pos++;
          const metaType = data[pos]; pos++;
          const metaVlq = readVLQ(data, pos);
          pos += metaVlq.bytesRead;
          const metaLen = metaVlq.value;

          if (metaType === 0x51) {
            // Tempo change
            const usPerQuarter = (data[pos] << 16) | (data[pos + 1] << 8) | data[pos + 2];
            const bpm = Math.round(60000000 / usPerQuarter);
            events.push({ tick: absoluteTick, type: 'tempo', bpm });
          } else if (metaType === 0x2F) {
            // End of track
            pos += metaLen;
            break;
          }
          pos += metaLen;
        } else if (statusByte === 0xF0 || statusByte === 0xF7) {
          // SysEx — skip
          pos++;
          const sysVlq = readVLQ(data, pos);
          pos += sysVlq.bytesRead;
          pos += sysVlq.value;
        } else {
          // Channel event
          if (statusByte & 0x80) {
            runningStatus = statusByte;
            pos++;
          } else {
            statusByte = runningStatus;
          }

          const eventType = statusByte & 0xF0;
          const channel = statusByte & 0x0F;

          if (eventType === 0x90) {
            // Note on
            const note = data[pos]; pos++;
            const velocity = data[pos]; pos++;
            if (velocity > 0) {
              events.push({ tick: absoluteTick, type: 'noteOn', channel, note, velocity });
            } else {
              // velocity 0 = note off
              events.push({ tick: absoluteTick, type: 'noteOff', channel, note });
            }
          } else if (eventType === 0x80) {
            // Note off
            const note = data[pos]; pos++;
            pos++; // skip velocity
            events.push({ tick: absoluteTick, type: 'noteOff', channel, note });
          } else if (eventType === 0xA0 || eventType === 0xB0 || eventType === 0xE0) {
            // Aftertouch, CC, Pitch bend — 2 data bytes
            pos += 2;
          } else if (eventType === 0xC0 || eventType === 0xD0) {
            // Program change, Channel pressure — 1 data byte
            pos++;
          }
        }
      }

      pos = trackEnd; // ensure correct position for next chunk
      tracks.push(events);
    }

    return { format, numTracks, ppqn, tracks };
  };

  // --- Convert parsed MIDI into sequencer notes ---

  const convertMidiToSeqNotes = (parsed) => {
    const ppqn = parsed.ppqn;
    const ticksPerStep = ppqn / 4; // 16th note = quarter / 4
    const baseMidi = SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI || 24;
    const maxMidi = baseMidi + (SL.SEQ_ROWS || 84);

    // Find first tempo event across all tracks (default 120 BPM)
    let bpm = 120;
    for (let t = 0; t < parsed.tracks.length; t++) {
      for (let e = 0; e < parsed.tracks[t].length; e++) {
        if (parsed.tracks[t][e].type === 'tempo') {
          bpm = parsed.tracks[t][e].bpm;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (bpm !== 120) break;
    }

    // Set BPM in UI
    const bpmEl = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
    if (bpmEl) {
      bpmEl.value = bpm;
      bpmEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    }

    // Collect note events across all tracks
    // Map MIDI channel to instrument: ch0->inst0, ch1->inst1, ch2->inst2, ch3->inst3, ch4+->inst0
    const allNoteOns = [];
    const allNoteOffs = [];

    for (let t = 0; t < parsed.tracks.length; t++) {
      const events = parsed.tracks[t];
      for (let e = 0; e < events.length; e++) {
        const ev = events[e];
        if (ev.type === 'noteOn') {
          const inst = Math.min(ev.channel, 3);
          allNoteOns.push({ tick: ev.tick, note: ev.note, velocity: ev.velocity, instrument: inst });
        } else if (ev.type === 'noteOff') {
          const inst = Math.min(ev.channel, 3);
          allNoteOffs.push({ tick: ev.tick, note: ev.note, instrument: inst });
        }
      }
    }

    // Match note-ons with note-offs
    const notes = [];
    const pendingOffs = allNoteOffs.slice();

    for (let i = 0; i < allNoteOns.length; i++) {
      const on = allNoteOns[i];

      // Find closest matching note-off (same note, same instrument, tick >= note-on tick)
      let bestOff = null;
      let bestIdx = -1;
      for (let j = 0; j < pendingOffs.length; j++) {
        const off = pendingOffs[j];
        if (off.note === on.note && off.instrument === on.instrument && off.tick >= on.tick) {
          if (!bestOff || off.tick < bestOff.tick) {
            bestOff = off;
            bestIdx = j;
          }
        }
      }

      const startStep = Math.round(on.tick / ticksPerStep);
      let durSteps;
      if (bestOff) {
        durSteps = Math.max(1, Math.round((bestOff.tick - on.tick) / ticksPerStep));
        pendingOffs.splice(bestIdx, 1);
      } else {
        durSteps = 1; // default if no note-off found
      }

      // Clamp to sequencer MIDI range
      if (on.note >= baseMidi && on.note < maxMidi) {
        notes.push({
          row: on.note - baseMidi,
          start: startStep,
          dur: durSteps,
          midi: on.note,
          vel: on.velocity,
          instrument: on.instrument
        });
      }
    }

    if (notes.length === 0) {
      console.warn('No notes found in MIDI file within sequencer range (MIDI ' + baseMidi + '-' + maxMidi + ')');
      return;
    }

    // Determine how many pages are needed
    let maxStep = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      const endStep = notes[i].start + notes[i].dur;
      if (endStep > maxStep) maxStep = endStep;
    }

    const stepsPerPage = SL.SEQ_STEPS || 64;
    const pagesNeeded = Math.ceil(maxStep / stepsPerPage);

    // Expand sequencer pages if needed
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.addPage) {
      const indicator = document.getElementById('seqPageIndicator');
      let currentPages = 1;
      if (indicator) {
        const match = indicator.textContent.match(/\/(\d+)/);
        if (match) {
          currentPages = parseInt(match[1]);
        }
      }
      while (currentPages < pagesNeeded) {
        SL.sequencer.addPage();
        currentPages++;
      }
    }

    // Clear existing notes and load imported ones
    const seqNotes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    seqNotes.length = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      seqNotes.push(notes[i]);
    }

    // Refresh display
    if (SL.sequencer.renderSeqNotes) SL.sequencer.renderSeqNotes();
    if (SL.sequencer.renderPageGrid) SL.sequencer.renderPageGrid();

  };

  // --- Import entry point: open file picker ---

  const importMidi = () => {
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = '.mid,.midi,audio/midi';

    input.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      const file = e.target.files[0];
      if (!file) {
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (ev) => {
        const parsed = parseMidiFile(ev.target.result);
        if (!parsed) {
          console.error('Failed to parse MIDI file');
          return;
        }
        convertMidiToSeqNotes(parsed);
      };
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
    });

    input.click();
  };

  // --- Expose on SL.midiFile namespace ---

  if (!window.SL) window.SL = {};
  if (!SL.midiFile) SL.midiFile = {};
  SL.midiFile.importMidi = importMidi;

})();

// Super Synth Lab - Arpeggiator Module
// Generates arpeggiated patterns from held notes/chords
// Loads AFTER note-playback.js, registers on SL.arp namespace
// ES5 compatible (var, no arrow functions, no template literals)
(function() {
  'use strict';

  var SL = window.SynthLab;

  if (!SL) {
    console.error('[arpeggiator] SynthLab not available');
    return;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Constants
  // ============================================================

  var PATTERNS = ['up', 'down', 'updown', 'downup', 'random', 'order'];
  var RATES = ['1/4', '1/8', '1/8T', '1/16', '1/16T', '1/32'];
  var RATE_DIVISIONS = {
    '1/4': 1,
    '1/8': 0.5,
    '1/16': 0.25,
    '1/32': 0.125,
    '1/8T': 1 / 3,
    '1/16T': 1 / 6
  };

  // State
  // ============================================================

  var _enabled = false;
  var _running = false;
  var _pattern = 'up';
  var _rate = '1/8';
  var _octaves = 1;
  var _gate = 80;       // percentage 10-100
  var _hold = false;
  var _swing = 0;        // 0-100
  var _velocityMode = 'original'; // 'original' or 'fixed'
  var _bpm = 120;

  // Note collection
  var _heldNotes = [];      // {midi, vel, order} notes currently physically held
  var _holdBuffer = [];     // {midi, vel, order} notes retained in hold mode
  var _orderCounter = 0;

  // Sequencing state
  var _stepIndex = 0;
  var _direction = 1;       // 1 = ascending, -1 = descending (for updown/downup)
  var _schedulerTimer = null;
  var _lookAhead = 0.025;   // 25ms lookahead
  var _scheduleInterval = 20; // check every 20ms
  var _nextStepTime = 0;
  var _activeArpNotes = [];  // {midi, stopTime} currently sounding arp notes

  // Original wrapped functions
  var _origStartSustained = null;
  var _origStopSustained = null;
  var _wrapped = false;

  // ============================================================
  // Note Collection
  // ============================================================

  function addNote(midi, vel) {

    for (var i = 0; i < _heldNotes.length; i++) {

        found = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!found) {
      _heldNotes.push({ midi: midi, vel: vel, order: _orderCounter++ });
    }
    // If hold mode, also add to hold buffer
    if (_hold) {
      var hFound = false;
      for (var h = 0; h < _holdBuffer.length; h++) {
        if (_holdBuffer[h].midi === midi) {
          hFound = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!hFound) {
        _holdBuffer.push({ midi: midi, vel: vel, order: _orderCounter - 1 });
      }

    if (_enabled && !_running && getActiveNotes().length > 0) {

    if (!_hold && _heldNotes.length === 0) {

  function getActiveNotes() {
    if (_hold && _holdBuffer.length > 0) {

    return _heldNotes;
  }

  function clearAllNotes() {

    _holdBuffer = [];
    _orderCounter = 0;

  // ============================================================
  // Pattern Generation
  // ============================================================

  function buildNoteSequence() {
    var notes = getActiveNotes();
    if (notes.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    var baseMidis = [];
    var i, j, oct;

    if (_pattern === 'order') {
      // Sort by insertion order
      var sorted = notes.slice().sort(function(a, b) { return a.order - b.order; });
      for (i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
        baseMidis.push({ midi: sorted[i].midi, vel: sorted[i].vel });
      }
    } else {
      // Sort by pitch (ascending)
      var pitchSorted = notes.slice().sort(function(a, b) { return a.midi - b.midi; });
      for (i = 0; i < pitchSorted.length; i++) {
        baseMidis.push({ midi: pitchSorted[i].midi, vel: pitchSorted[i].vel });
      }
    }

    // Expand across octaves
    var expanded = [];
    for (oct = 0; oct < _octaves; oct++) {
      for (i = 0; i < baseMidis.length; i++) {
        expanded.push({
          midi: baseMidis[i].midi + (oct * 12),
          vel: baseMidis[i].vel

    // Apply pattern direction
    if (_pattern === 'down') {
      expanded.reverse();
    } else if (_pattern === 'updown') {

        var middle = expanded.slice(1, expanded.length - 1);
        middle.reverse();
        expanded = updown.concat(middle);
      }
    } else if (_pattern === 'downup') {
      if (expanded.length > 2) {
        var reversed = expanded.slice().reverse();
        var middleDown = reversed.slice(1, reversed.length - 1);
        middleDown.reverse();
        expanded = reversed.concat(middleDown);

    }

  // ============================================================

  function getStepDuration() {

    var division = RATE_DIVISIONS[_rate] || 0.5;
    return Math.max(0.001, beatDuration * division);

  function scheduleStep() {

    var sequence = buildNoteSequence();
    if (sequence.length > 0) {
      var gateDur = stepDur * (_gate / 100);

      // Apply swing (delay even-numbered steps)
      var swingDelay = 0;
      if (_swing > 0 && _stepIndex % 2 === 1) {
        swingDelay = stepDur * (_swing / 200);
      }

      var noteToPlay;
      if (_pattern === 'random') {
        var rIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * sequence.length);
        noteToPlay = sequence[rIdx];
      } else {
        noteToPlay = sequence[_stepIndex % sequence.length];

      var vel = (_velocityMode === 'fixed') ? 100 : noteToPlay.vel;
      var playTime = _nextStepTime + swingDelay;

      // Schedule note on/off
      scheduleNotePlay(noteToPlay.midi, gateDur, vel, playTime);

      _stepIndex++;

    // otherwise the while loop in schedulerLoop spins forever

// Super Synth Lab - Save/Load Manager
// Patch and Composition save/load with localStorage persistence and file import/export
(function() {
  'use strict';
  var SL = window.SynthLab;

  var MAX_PATCHES = 20;
  var MAX_COMPOSITIONS = 10;
  var LS_PATCHES_KEY = 'SSL_SavedPatches';
  var LS_COMPOSITIONS_KEY = 'SSL_SavedCompositions';

  var _currentTab = 'patches';
  var _modalEl = null;
  var _statusEl = null;
  var _statusTimer = null;

  // ============================================================
  // localStorage Helpers
  // ============================================================

  function _readStorage(key) {
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (raw) {
        return JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[save-load] Failed to read localStorage key ' + key + ':', e);
    }
    return [];
  }

  function _writeStorage(key, data) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[save-load] Failed to write localStorage key ' + key + ':', e);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Status Display
  // ============================================================

  function _showStatus(msg, isError) {
    if (_statusEl) {
      _statusEl.textContent = msg;
      if (isError) {
        _statusEl.className = 'save-load-status error';
      } else {
        _statusEl.className = 'save-load-status';
      }
      if (_statusTimer) {
        clearTimeout(_statusTimer);
      }
      _statusTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        if (_statusEl) {
          _statusEl.textContent = '';
        }
      }, 3000);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Patch Capture & Restore
  // ============================================================

  function _captureAllInstruments() {
    var instruments = SL.audio.getInstruments();
    var numInst = SL.audio.getNumInstruments();
    var currentId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();

    // Save current instrument's UI state first
    if (SL.audio.saveInstrumentSettings) {
      SL.audio.saveInstrumentSettings(currentId);
    }

    var instData = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < numInst; i++) {
      var inst = instruments[i];
      instData.push({
        id: inst.id,
        name: inst.name,
        type: inst.type,
        settings: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(inst.settings))
      });
    }
    return instData;
  }

  function _restoreAllInstruments(instData) {
    var instruments = SL.audio.getInstruments();
    var numInst = SL.audio.getNumInstruments();
    var currentId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();

    for (var i = 0; i < instData.length && i < numInst; i++) {
      var saved = instData[i];
      var inst = instruments[i];
      inst.name = saved.name || inst.name;
      inst.type = saved.type || 'subtractive';
      inst.settings = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(saved.settings));

      // Apply volume to audio node
      if (inst.volumeNode && inst.settings.volume !== undefined) {
        inst.volumeNode.gain.value = inst.settings.volume / 100;
      }
    }

    // Reload current instrument's settings into the UI
    if (SL.audio.loadInstrumentSettings) {
      SL.audio.loadInstrumentSettings(currentId);
    }

    // Update instrument type selector
    var instTypeSelect = document.getElementById('instrumentSelect');
    if (instTypeSelect) {
      // Trigger the type display update
      var typeStr = SL.audio.getInstrumentType(currentId);
      var typeSelects = document.querySelectorAll('.synth-type-select');
      for (var t = 0; t < typeSelects.length; t++) {
        typeSelects[t].value = typeStr;
      }
    }

    // Restart continuous noise for the current instrument
    if (SL.audio.restartContinuousNoise) {
      SL.audio.restartContinuousNoise();
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Sequencer State Capture & Restore
  // ============================================================

  function _captureSequencerState() {
    var state = {};

    // BPM
    var bpmEl = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
    state.bpm = bpmEl ? parseInt(bpmEl.value) || 120 : 120;

    // Root note
    var rootEl = document.getElementById('rootNote');
    state.rootNote = rootEl ? parseInt(rootEl.value) || 0 : 0;

    // Scale/mode
    var modeEl = document.getElementById('mode');
    state.mode = modeEl ? modeEl.value : 'major';

    // Sequencer notes
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.seqNotes) {
      state.seqNotes = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SL.sequencer.seqNotes));
    } else {
      state.seqNotes = [];
    }

    // Loop setting
    var loopEl = document.getElementById('seqLoop');
    state.loop = loopEl ? loopEl.checked : true;

    return state;
  }

  function _restoreSequencerState(state) {
    if (!state) {
      return;
    }

    // Stop playback if active
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.isPlaying && SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
      SL.sequencer.stopSeq();
    }

    // BPM
    var bpmEl = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
    if (bpmEl && state.bpm !== undefined) {
      bpmEl.value = state.bpm;
      // Fire input event for any listeners
      var bpmEvt = document.createEvent('Event');
      bpmEvt.initEvent('input', true, true);
      bpmEl.dispatchEvent(bpmEvt);
    }

    // Root note
    var rootEl = document.getElementById('rootNote');
    if (rootEl && state.rootNote !== undefined) {
      rootEl.value = state.rootNote;
      var rootEvt = document.createEvent('Event');
      rootEvt.initEvent('change', true, true);
      rootEl.dispatchEvent(rootEvt);
    }

    // Scale/mode
    var modeEl = document.getElementById('mode');
    if (modeEl && state.mode !== undefined) {
      modeEl.value = state.mode;
      var modeEvt = document.createEvent('Event');
      modeEvt.initEvent('change', true, true);
      modeEl.dispatchEvent(modeEvt);
    }

    // Loop
    var loopEl = document.getElementById('seqLoop');
    if (loopEl && state.loop !== undefined) {
      loopEl.checked = state.loop;
    }

    // Sequencer notes: clear and re-populate
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.seqNotes && state.seqNotes) {
      // Clear existing notes
      SL.sequencer.seqNotes.length = 0;

      // Calculate how many pages are needed
      var maxStep = 0;
      for (var ni = 0; ni < state.seqNotes.length; ni++) {
        var noteEnd = state.seqNotes[ni].start + (state.seqNotes[ni].dur || 1);
        if (noteEnd > maxStep) {
          maxStep = noteEnd;
        }
      }

      var pagesNeeded = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(maxStep / 64));

      // Add pages if needed (start at page 1 since page 0 exists)
      var currentPages = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage ? 1 : 1;
      // Use addPage to create extra pages
      if (SL.sequencer.goToPage) {
        SL.sequencer.goToPage(0);
      }
      for (var pg = 1; pg < pagesNeeded; pg++) {
        if (SL.sequencer.addPage) {
          SL.sequencer.addPage();
        }
      }

      // Push all notes
      for (var si = 0; si < state.seqNotes.length; si++) {
        SL.sequencer.seqNotes.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.seqNotes[si])));
      }

      // Re-render
      if (SL.sequencer.goToPage) {
        SL.sequencer.goToPage(0);
      }
      if (SL.sequencer.renderSeqGrid) {
        SL.sequencer.renderSeqGrid();
      }
      if (SL.sequencer.renderSeqNotes) {
        SL.sequencer.renderSeqNotes();
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Patch API
  // ============================================================

  function savePatch(name) {
    if (!name || !name.trim()) {
      _showStatus('Please enter a patch name', true);
      return null;
    }
    name = name.trim();

    var patchData = {
      type: 'SSL_Patch',
      version: 1,
      name: name,
      savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      instruments: _captureAllInstruments()
    };

    // Save to localStorage
    var patches = _readStorage(LS_PATCHES_KEY);

    // Check if name already exists; replace it
    var replaced = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < patches.length; i++) {
      if (patches[i].name === name) {
        patches[i] = patchData;
        replaced = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!replaced) {
      if (patches.length >= MAX_PATCHES) {
        _showStatus('Max ' + MAX_PATCHES + ' patches. Delete one first.', true);
        return null;
      }
      patches.push(patchData);
    }

    _writeStorage(LS_PATCHES_KEY, patches);
    _showStatus('Patch "' + name + '" saved');
    _renderCurrentTab();
    return patchData;
  }

  function loadPatch(patchData) {
    if (!patchData || !patchData.instruments) {
      _showStatus('Invalid patch data', true);
      return;
    }
    _restoreAllInstruments(patchData.instruments);
    _showStatus('Patch "' + (patchData.name || 'Untitled') + '" loaded');
  }

  function exportPatch() {
    var currentId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    if (SL.audio.saveInstrumentSettings) {
      SL.audio.saveInstrumentSettings(currentId);
    }

    var patchData = {
      type: 'SSL_Patch',
      version: 1,
      name: 'Export',
      savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      instruments: _captureAllInstruments()
    };

    var nameInput = document.getElementById('slPatchNameInput');
    if (nameInput && nameInput.value.trim()) {
      patchData.name = nameInput.value.trim();
    }

    var jsonStr = JSON.stringify(patchData, null, 2);
    var blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: 'application/json' });
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = 'SSL_Patch_' + patchData.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_') + '.json';
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    _showStatus('Patch exported as ' + a.download);
  }

  function importPatch(file) {
    if (!file) {
      return;
    }
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
      try {
        var patchData = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
        if (patchData.type !== 'SSL_Patch' || !patchData.instruments) {
          _showStatus('Invalid patch file format', true);
        } else {
          loadPatch(patchData);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        _showStatus('Failed to parse patch file: ' + err.message, true);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }

  function listPatches() {
    return _readStorage(LS_PATCHES_KEY);
  }

  function deletePatch(name) {
    var patches = _readStorage(LS_PATCHES_KEY);
    var filtered = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < patches.length; i++) {
      if (patches[i].name !== name) {
        filtered.push(patches[i]);
      }
    }
    _writeStorage(LS_PATCHES_KEY, filtered);
    _showStatus('Patch "' + name + '" deleted');
    _renderCurrentTab();
  }

  function _formatDate(isoStr) {
    try {
      var d = new Date(isoStr);
      var month = d.getMonth() + 1;
      var day = d.getDate();
      var hours = d.getHours();
      var mins = d.getMinutes();
      return month + '/' + day + ' ' + (hours < 10 ? '0' : '') + hours + ':' + (mins < 10 ? '0' : '') + mins;
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
  }

  function _buildItemList(items, type) {
    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'save-load-list';

    if (items.length === 0) {
      var empty = document.createElement('div');
      empty.className = 'save-load-list-empty';
      empty.textContent = 'No saved ' + type + ' yet';
      container.appendChild(empty);
    } else {
      for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        (function(item) {
          var row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'save-load-item';

          var nameSpan = document.createElement('span');
          nameSpan.className = 'save-load-item-name';
          nameSpan.textContent = item.name || 'Untitled';
          nameSpan.title = item.name || 'Untitled';

          row.appendChild(dateSpan);

          var loadBtn = document.createElement('button');
          loadBtn.className = 'save-load-item-btn load-btn';
          loadBtn.textContent = 'Load';
          loadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (type === 'patches') {

            if (type === 'patches') {
              deletePatch(item.name);
            } else {
              deleteComposition(item.name);
            }
          });
          row.appendChild(delBtn);

          container.appendChild(row);
        })(items[i]);
      }
    }

    return container;

    // Click outside to close
    modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === modal) {
        hideModal();
      }
    });

    return modal;
  }

  function showModal() {
    if (!_modalEl) {
      _modalEl = _buildModal();
      document.body.appendChild(_modalEl);
      _statusEl = document.getElementById('saveLoadStatus');
    }
    _modalEl.className = 'save-load-modal';
    _renderCurrentTab();
  }

  function hideModal() {
    if (_modalEl) {
      _modalEl.className = 'save-load-modal hidden';
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init — wire up the SAVE/LOAD button
  // ============================================================

  function init() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('saveLoadBtn');
    if (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showModal();
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export API
  // ============================================================

  SL.saveLoad = {
    init: init,
    savePatch: savePatch,
    loadPatch: loadPatch,
    exportPatch: exportPatch,
    importPatch: importPatch,
    listPatches: listPatches,
    deletePatch: deletePatch,
    saveComposition: saveComposition,
    loadComposition: loadComposition,
    exportComposition: exportComposition,
    importComposition: importComposition,
    listCompositions: listCompositions,
    deleteComposition: deleteComposition,
    showModal: showModal,
    hideModal: hideModal
  };

})();


// === record-sample.js ===
// SuperSynthLab - Record-to-Sample Module
// Captures master audio output into a reusable sample buffer (up to 8 seconds).
// Shared component that screens can embed via createUI().
// ES5 compatible (var, no arrow functions, no template literals)
(function() {
  'use strict';

  var SL = window.SynthLab;

  // ============================================================
  // Constants
  // ============================================================

  var MAX_DURATION_SEC = 8;
  var FALLBACK_SAMPLE_RATE = 44100;
  var SCRIPT_PROCESSOR_BUFFER_SIZE = 4096;
  var WAVEFORM_LINE_COLOR = '#4fc3f7';
  var WAVEFORM_BG_COLOR = '#0a0a1a';
  var TIMER_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS = 100;

  // ============================================================
  // State
  // ============================================================

  var _isRecording = false;
  var _recorder = null;        // ScriptProcessorNode
  var _buffer = null;          // Float32Array of recorded samples
  var _writePos = 0;
  var _maxSamples = 0;         // computed from sample rate * MAX_DURATION_SEC
  var _onStopCallback = null;
  var _timerIntervals = {};    // containerId -> interval handle

  // ============================================================
  // Recording API
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Start recording the master output.
   * @param {Function} onStop - callback(trimmedBuffer, sampleCount) when recording stops
   */
  function startRecording(onStop) {
    if (_isRecording) {
      return;
    }

    var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (!ctx) {
      return;
    }

    var sampleRate = ctx.sampleRate || FALLBACK_SAMPLE_RATE;
    _maxSamples = MAX_DURATION_SEC * sampleRate;
    _buffer = new Float32Array(_maxSamples);
    _writePos = 0;
    _isRecording = true;
    _onStopCallback = onStop || null;

    // Create ScriptProcessorNode to tap the master output
    _recorder = ctx.createScriptProcessor(SCRIPT_PROCESSOR_BUFFER_SIZE, 1, 1);

    // Tap from the analyser node (which sits between masterChain.output and ctx.destination)
    // The analyser carries the final mixed signal
    var analyser = SL.audio.getAnalyser();
    if (analyser) {
      analyser.connect(_recorder);
      // ScriptProcessorNode requires an output connection to process audio
      // Connect to destination — it passes through silence (output buffer is zeroed)
      _recorder.connect(ctx.destination);
    }

    _recorder.onaudioprocess = function(e) {
      if (!_isRecording) {
        return;
      }
      var input = e.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0);
      var remaining = _maxSamples - _writePos;
      if (remaining <= 0) {
        stopRecording();
        return;
      }
      var toCopy = Math.min(input.length, remaining);
      var i;
      for (i = 0; i < toCopy; i++) {
        _buffer[_writePos + i] = input[i];
      }
      // Zero the output to avoid doubling audio through destination
      var output = e.outputBuffer.getChannelData(0);
      for (i = 0; i < output.length; i++) {
        output[i] = 0;
      }
      _writePos += toCopy;
      if (_writePos >= _maxSamples) {
        stopRecording();
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Stop recording and trim the buffer.
   */
  function stopRecording() {
    if (!_isRecording) {
      return;
    }
    _isRecording = false;

    if (_recorder) {
      _recorder.onaudioprocess = null;
      try { _recorder.disconnect(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      _recorder = null;
    }

    // Trim buffer to actual recorded length
    var trimmed = new Float32Array(_writePos);
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < _writePos; i++) {
      trimmed[i] = _buffer[i];
    }
    _buffer = trimmed;

    if (_onStopCallback) {
      _onStopCallback(trimmed, _writePos);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get the recorded sample buffer.
   * @returns {Float32Array|null}
   */
  function getBuffer() {
    return _buffer;
  }

  /**
   * Get the duration of recorded audio in seconds.
   * @returns {number}
   */
  function getDurationSec() {
    if (!_buffer || _writePos === 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    var rate = ctx ? ctx.sampleRate : FALLBACK_SAMPLE_RATE;
    return _writePos / rate;
  }

  /**
   * Check if currently recording.
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  function isRecording() {
    return _isRecording;
  }

  /**
   * Create an AudioBuffer from the recorded data for playback.
   * @returns {AudioBuffer|null}
   */
  function toAudioBuffer() {
    if (!_buffer || _writePos === 0) {
      return null;
    }
    var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (!ctx) {
      return null;
    }
    var ab = ctx.createBuffer(1, _writePos, ctx.sampleRate);
    ab.getChannelData(0).set(_buffer.subarray(0, _writePos));
    return ab;
  }

  /**
   * Load the recorded sample into the sampler for a given instrument, pad 0.
   * @param {number} instIndex - instrument index (0-3)
   * @returns {boolean} true if loaded successfully
   */
  function loadIntoSampler(instIndex) {
    var ab = toAudioBuffer();
    if (!ab) {
      return false;
    }
    if (SL.sampler && SL.sampler.assignSampleToPad) {
      SL.sampler.assignSampleToPad(instIndex, 0, ab, 'Recorded Sample');
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Waveform Drawing
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Draw the recorded waveform onto a canvas element.
   * @param {string} canvasId - DOM id of the canvas element
   */
  function _drawWaveform(canvasId) {
    var canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    var cCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;

    // Clear
    cCtx.fillStyle = WAVEFORM_BG_COLOR;
    cCtx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    if (!_buffer || _writePos === 0) {
      return;
    }

    // Draw waveform
    cCtx.strokeStyle = WAVEFORM_LINE_COLOR;
    cCtx.lineWidth = 1;
    cCtx.beginPath();

    var step = _writePos / w;
    var mid = h / 2;
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < w; i++) {
      var sampleIdx = Math.floor(i * step);
      var val = _buffer[sampleIdx] || 0;
      var y = mid - (val * mid);
      if (i === 0) {
        cCtx.moveTo(i, y);
      } else {
        cCtx.lineTo(i, y);
      }
    }
    cCtx.stroke();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Timer Update
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Start a timer update loop for a given container.
   * @param {string} containerId - container DOM id prefix
   */
  function _updateTimer(containerId) {
    var timerEl = document.getElementById(containerId + '-timer');
    if (_timerIntervals[containerId]) {
      clearInterval(_timerIntervals[containerId]);
    }
    _timerIntervals[containerId] = setInterval(function() {
      if (!_isRecording) {
        clearInterval(_timerIntervals[containerId]);
        _timerIntervals[containerId] = null;
        if (timerEl) {
          timerEl.textContent = getDurationSec().toFixed(1) + 's / ' + MAX_DURATION_SEC + '.0s';
        }
        return;
      }
      if (timerEl) {
        var elapsed = getDurationSec().toFixed(1);
        timerEl.textContent = elapsed + 's / ' + MAX_DURATION_SEC + '.0s';
      }
    }, TIMER_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // UI Component
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Create the record-to-sample UI inside a container div.
   * @param {string} containerId - DOM id of the container element
   */
  function createUI(containerId) {
    var container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }

    var html = '<div class="rec-sample-bar">' +
      '<button class="rec-btn" id="' + containerId + '-rec">' +
      '<span class="rec-dot"></span> REC</button>' +
      '<span class="rec-timer" id="' + containerId + '-timer">0.0s / ' +
      MAX_DURATION_SEC + '.0s</span>' +
      '<canvas class="rec-waveform" id="' + containerId + '-wave" width="200" height="40"></canvas>' +
      '<button class="rec-load" id="' + containerId + '-load" disabled>Load to Sampler</button>' +
      '</div>';
    container.innerHTML = html;

    var recBtn = document.getElementById(containerId + '-rec');
    var timerEl = document.getElementById(containerId + '-timer');
    var loadBtn = document.getElementById(containerId + '-load');
    var waveCanvasId = containerId + '-wave';

    recBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (isRecording()) {
        stopRecording();
        recBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="rec-dot"></span> REC';
        recBtn.classList.remove('recording');
        loadBtn.disabled = false;
        _drawWaveform(waveCanvasId);
      } else {
        startRecording(function() {
          recBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="rec-dot"></span> REC';
          recBtn.classList.remove('recording');
          loadBtn.disabled = false;
          _drawWaveform(waveCanvasId);
        });
        recBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="rec-stop-icon"></span> STOP';
        recBtn.classList.add('recording');
        loadBtn.disabled = true;
        _updateTimer(containerId);
      }
    });

    loadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var inst = SL.audio ? SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument() : 0;
      var ok = loadIntoSampler(inst);
      if (ok) {
        loadBtn.textContent = 'Loaded!';
        setTimeout(function() {
          loadBtn.textContent = 'Load to Sampler';
        }, 1500);
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init (no-op until first use)
  // ============================================================

  function init() {
    // Nothing to initialize until first recording
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.recordSample = {
    init: init,
    startRecording: startRecording,
    stopRecording: stopRecording,
    getBuffer: getBuffer,
    getDurationSec: getDurationSec,
    isRecording: isRecording,
    toAudioBuffer: toAudioBuffer,
    loadIntoSampler: loadIntoSampler,
    createUI: createUI
  };

})();

(function() {

      ctx.lineTo(14, 12);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(1, 4);
      ctx.lineTo(15, 4);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(1, 12);
      ctx.lineTo(15, 12);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.restore();
    },

    quantize: function(ctx, x, y, size) {

      ctx.translate(x, y);

      ctx.lineTo(3, 10);
      ctx.lineTo(6, 10);
      ctx.lineTo(6, 7);
      ctx.lineTo(9, 7);
      ctx.lineTo(9, 4);
      ctx.lineTo(12, 4);
      ctx.lineTo(12, 2);
      ctx.lineTo(15, 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    },

    multiply: function(ctx, x, y, size) {

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(4, 4);

      ctx.moveTo(12, 4);

    },

    add: function(ctx, x, y, size) {

      ctx.translate(x, y);

      ctx.moveTo(8, 3);
      ctx.lineTo(8, 13);

      ctx.moveTo(1, 8);

      ctx.lineTo(3, 5);
      ctx.lineTo(6, 5);
      ctx.lineTo(6, 11);
      ctx.lineTo(9, 11);

      ctx.moveTo(1, 6);

      ctx.arc(9, 8, 2.5, -0.7, 0.7, false);

    scope: function(ctx, x, y, size) {

      // Outer rectangle
      ctx.strokeRect(1, 2, 14, 12);
      // Waveform inside

      ctx.moveTo(3, 8);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(5, 4, 6, 8);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(7, 12, 8, 8);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(9, 4, 10, 8);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(11, 12, 13, 8);

      ctx.restore();
    },

    splitter: function(ctx, x, y, size) {

      ctx.translate(x, y);

    impulse: [
      { name: 'rate', min: 0.1, max: 100, step: 0.1, default_val: 10 },
      { name: 'probability', min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01, default_val: 0.5 }
    ],
    constant: [
      { name: 'value', min: -1, max: 1, step: 0.01, default_val: 1 }
    ],
    mixer: [
      { name: 'gain1', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.01, default_val: 1 },
      { name: 'gain2', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.01, default_val: 1 },
      { name: 'gain3', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.01, default_val: 1 },
      { name: 'gain4', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.01, default_val: 1 }
    ]
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // State
  // =========================================================================

  var _canvas = null;
  var _canvasCtx = null;
  var _dpr = 1;
  var _paramPanelId = 'patchParamPanel';
  var _patchJson = null;
  var _nodePositions = {};   // nodeId -> { x, y }
  var _nodePortInfo = {};    // nodeId -> { inputs: [...], outputs: [...] }

  var _selectedNodeId = null;
  var _mouseState = MOUSE_IDLE;
  var _dragNodeOffset = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  var _dragConnFrom = null;    // { nodeId, portIndex, portType:'output' }
  var _dragConnEnd = { x: 0, y: 0 };

  var _addNodeCount = 0;       // offset counter for stacking new nodes
  var _paletteCollapsed = false;

  // =========================================================================
  // Initialization
  // =========================================================================

  function init(canvasId) {
    _canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (_canvas) {
      _canvasCtx = _canvas.getContext('2d');
      _dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      _applyDpiScaling();
      _bindCanvasEvents();
      _bindPaletteEvents();
      _bindToolbarEvents();
    }
  }

  function _applyDpiScaling() {
    if (!_canvas) {
      return;
    }
    var parent = _canvas.parentElement;
    var displayWidth = 800;
    var displayHeight = 500;
    if (parent) {
      displayWidth = parent.clientWidth || 800;
      displayHeight = parent.clientHeight || 500;
    }
    _canvas.width = Math.floor(displayWidth * _dpr);
    _canvas.height = Math.floor(displayHeight * _dpr);
    _canvas.style.width = displayWidth + 'px';
    _canvas.style.height = displayHeight + 'px';
    _canvasCtx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    _canvasCtx.scale(_dpr, _dpr);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Event binding
  // =========================================================================

  function _bindCanvasEvents() {
    if (!_canvas) {
      return;
    }
    _canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', _onMouseDown);
    _canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', _onMouseMove);
    _canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', _onMouseUp);
    _canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', _onContextMenu);
  }

  function _bindPaletteEvents() {
    var toggle = document.getElementById('paletteToggle');
    if (toggle) {
      toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var palette = document.getElementById('patchPalette');
        if (palette) {
          _paletteCollapsed = !_paletteCollapsed;
          if (_paletteCollapsed) {
            palette.className = 'patch-palette collapsed';
            toggle.textContent = '+';
          } else {
            palette.className = 'patch-palette';
            toggle.textContent = '-';
          }
          // Resize canvas after palette toggle
          setTimeout(function() {
            _applyDpiScaling();
            _render();
          }, 250);
        }
      });
    }

    // Palette item clicks
    var items = document.querySelectorAll('.palette-item');
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      items[i].addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var nodeType = e.target.getAttribute('data-type');
        if (nodeType) {
          _addNodeFromPalette(nodeType);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  function _bindToolbarEvents() {
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('patchPlayBtn');
    var stopBtn = document.getElementById('patchStopBtn');
    var clearBtn = document.getElementById('patchClearBtn');

    if (playBtn) {
      playBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.patchEngine) {
          SL.patchEngine.start();
        }
      });
    }

    if (stopBtn) {
      stopBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.patchEngine) {
          SL.patchEngine.stop();
        }
      });
    }

    if (clearBtn) {
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.patchEngine) {
          SL.patchEngine.stop();
        }
        _patchJson = null;
        _nodePositions = {};
        _nodePortInfo = {};
        _selectedNodeId = null;
        _addNodeCount = 0;
        _hideParamPanel();
        _render();
      });
    }

    // PD Import button
    var importPdBtn = document.getElementById('patchImportPdBtn');
    var pdFileInput = document.getElementById('pdFileInput');
    if (importPdBtn && pdFileInput) {
      importPdBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        pdFileInput.click();
      });
      pdFileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
        var file = e.target.files[0];
        if (file) {
          var reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = function(evt) {
            var pdText = evt.target.result;
            if (SL.pdImport) {
              var compat = SL.pdImport.getCompatibility(pdText);
              var patchJson = SL.pdImport.parse(pdText);

              // Load into engine and render
              if (SL.patchEngine) {
                SL.patchEngine.stop();
                SL.patchEngine.loadPatch(patchJson);
              }
              renderPatch(patchJson);

              // Show compatibility toast
              var statusMsg = 'PD Import: ' + compat.supported.length + '/' +
                (compat.supported.length + compat.unsupported.length) +
                ' audio objects supported (' + compat.supportedPercent + '%)';
              if (compat.unsupported.length > 0) {
                statusMsg = statusMsg + ', skipped: ' + compat.unsupported.join(', ');
              }
              _showImportToast(statusMsg);
            }
          };
          reader.readAsText(file);
          // Reset file input so the same file can be re-imported
          pdFileInput.value = '';
        }
      });
    }

    // Recipe selector
    _populateRecipeSelect();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Import toast notification
  // =========================================================================

  function _showImportToast(message) {
    var existing = document.getElementById('pdImportToast');
    if (existing) {
      existing.parentNode.removeChild(existing);
    }
    var toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.id = 'pdImportToast';
    toast.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);' +
      'background:#333;color:#ffcc88;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:6px;' +
      'font-size:13px;z-index:9999;border:1px solid #886644;max-width:600px;text-align:center;';
    toast.textContent = message;
    document.body.appendChild(toast);
    var TOAST_DURATION_MS = 5000;
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (toast.parentNode) {
        toast.parentNode.removeChild(toast);
      }
    }, TOAST_DURATION_MS);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Recipe selector
  // =========================================================================

  function _populateRecipeSelect() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('patchRecipeSelect');
    if (!sel || !SL.patchRecipes) {
      return;
    }

    // Clear existing options
    sel.innerHTML = '';

    // Default option
    var defaultOpt = document.createElement('option');
    defaultOpt.value = '';
    defaultOpt.textContent = '-- Load Recipe --';
    sel.appendChild(defaultOpt);

    // Group by category
    var categories = SL.patchRecipes.getCategories();
    for (var c = 0; c < categories.length; c++) {
      var cat = categories[c];
      var group = document.createElement('optgroup');
      group.label = cat;
      var recipes = SL.patchRecipes.getByCategory(cat);
      for (var r = 0; r < recipes.length; r++) {
        var opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = recipes[r].name;
        opt.textContent = recipes[r].name;
        group.appendChild(opt);
      }
      sel.appendChild(group);
    }

    sel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      var name = sel.value;
      if (!name) {
        return;
      }
      var recipe = SL.patchRecipes.getByName(name);
      if (recipe) {
        _loadRecipe(recipe);
      }
    });
  }

  function _loadRecipe(recipe) {
    // Deep copy the recipe so edits do not mutate the original
    var patchJson = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(recipe));

    // Stop any current playback
    if (SL.patchEngine) {
      SL.patchEngine.stop();
      SL.patchEngine.loadPatch(patchJson);
    }

    // Render on canvas
    renderPatch(patchJson);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Mouse -> canvas coordinate
  // =========================================================================

  function _canvasCoords(e) {
    var rect = _canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: e.clientX - rect.left,
      y: e.clientY - rect.top
    };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Hit testing
  // =========================================================================

  function _hitTestNode(mx, my) {
    if (!_patchJson) {
      return null;
    }
    var nodes = _patchJson.nodes || [];
    // Test in reverse (top-most drawn last)
    for (var i = nodes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var nid = nodes[i].id;
      var pos = _nodePositions[nid];
      if (pos) {
        if (mx >= pos.x && mx <= pos.x + NODE_WIDTH &&
            my >= pos.y && my <= pos.y + NODE_HEIGHT) {
          return nid;
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function _hitTestOutputPort(mx, my) {
    if (!_patchJson) {
      return null;
    }
    var nodes = _patchJson.nodes || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var nid = nodes[i].id;
      var ports = _nodePortInfo[nid];
      if (ports && ports.outputs) {
        for (var pi = 0; pi < ports.outputs.length; pi++) {
          var ppos = _getOutputPortPos(nid, pi);
          var dx = mx - ppos.x;
          var dy = my - ppos.y;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= PORT_HIT_RADIUS * PORT_HIT_RADIUS) {
            return { nodeId: nid, portIndex: pi, portName: ports.outputs[pi].name };
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function _hitTestInputPort(mx, my) {
    if (!_patchJson) {
      return null;
    }
    var nodes = _patchJson.nodes || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var nid = nodes[i].id;
      var ports = _nodePortInfo[nid];
      if (ports && ports.inputs) {
        for (var pi = 0; pi < ports.inputs.length; pi++) {
          var ppos = _getInputPortPos(nid, pi);
          var dx = mx - ppos.x;
          var dy = my - ppos.y;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= PORT_HIT_RADIUS * PORT_HIT_RADIUS) {
            return { nodeId: nid, portIndex: pi, portName: ports.inputs[pi].name };
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function _hitTestConnection(mx, my) {
    if (!_patchJson) {
      return null;
    }
    var connections = _patchJson.connections || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < connections.length; i++) {
      var conn = connections[i];
      var fromPorts = _nodePortInfo[conn.from];
      var toPorts = _nodePortInfo[conn.to];
      if (!fromPorts || !toPorts) {
        continue;
      }

      var fromPortIdx = 0;
      if (conn.fromPort && fromPorts.outputs) {
        for (var fi = 0; fi < fromPorts.outputs.length; fi++) {
          if (fromPorts.outputs[fi].name === conn.fromPort) {
            fromPortIdx = fi;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      var toPortIdx = 0;
      if (conn.toPort && toPorts.inputs) {
        for (var ti = 0; ti < toPorts.inputs.length; ti++) {
          if (toPorts.inputs[ti].name === conn.toPort) {
            toPortIdx = ti;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      var fromPos = _getOutputPortPos(conn.from, fromPortIdx);
      var toPos = _getInputPortPos(conn.to, toPortIdx);

      if (_distToBezier(mx, my, fromPos, toPos) < CONNECTION_HIT_DISTANCE) {
        return i;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function _distToBezier(mx, my, fromPos, toPos) {
    var minDist = 999999;
    var steps = 20;
    var cpOff = BEZIER_CONTROL_OFFSET;
    var cp1x = fromPos.x + cpOff;
    var cp1y = fromPos.y;
    var cp2x = toPos.x - cpOff;
    var cp2y = toPos.y;
    for (var s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
      var t = s / steps;
      var mt = 1 - t;
      var bx = mt * mt * mt * fromPos.x + 3 * mt * mt * t * cp1x + 3 * mt * t * t * cp2x + t * t * t * toPos.x;
      var by = mt * mt * mt * fromPos.y + 3 * mt * mt * t * cp1y + 3 * mt * t * t * cp2y + t * t * t * toPos.y;
      var dx = mx - bx;
      var dy = my - by;
      var dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < minDist) {
        minDist = dist;
      }
    }
    return minDist;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Mouse handlers
  // =========================================================================

  function _onMouseDown(e) {
    if (e.button === 2) {
      return; // right-click handled by contextmenu
    }
    var coords = _canvasCoords(e);

    // Check output port first (for connection dragging)
    var outPort = _hitTestOutputPort(coords.x, coords.y);
    if (outPort) {
      _mouseState = MOUSE_DRAGGING_CONNECTION;
      _dragConnFrom = outPort;
      _dragConnEnd = { x: coords.x, y: coords.y };
      return;
    }

    // Check node
    var nodeId = _hitTestNode(coords.x, coords.y);
    if (nodeId) {
      _selectNode(nodeId);
      _mouseState = MOUSE_DRAGGING_NODE;
      var pos = _nodePositions[nodeId];
      _dragNodeOffset = {
        x: coords.x - pos.x,
        y: coords.y - pos.y
      };
      return;
    }

    // Click on empty space = deselect
    _selectNode(null);
    _mouseState = MOUSE_IDLE;
  }

  function _onMouseMove(e) {
    var coords = _canvasCoords(e);

    if (_mouseState === MOUSE_DRAGGING_NODE && _selectedNodeId) {
      var newX = coords.x - _dragNodeOffset.x;
      var newY = coords.y - _dragNodeOffset.y;
      if (newX < 0) { newX = 0; }
      if (newY < 0) { newY = 0; }
      _nodePositions[_selectedNodeId] = { x: newX, y: newY };
      // Update the spec if it exists
      if (_patchJson) {
        var nodes = _patchJson.nodes || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
          if (nodes[i].id === _selectedNodeId) {
            nodes[i].x = newX;
            nodes[i].y = newY;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      _render();
    } else if (_mouseState === MOUSE_DRAGGING_CONNECTION) {
      _dragConnEnd = { x: coords.x, y: coords.y };
      _render();
    }
  }

  function _onMouseUp(e) {
    if (_mouseState === MOUSE_DRAGGING_CONNECTION && _dragConnFrom) {
      var coords = _canvasCoords(e);
      var inPort = _hitTestInputPort(coords.x, coords.y);
      if (inPort && inPort.nodeId !== _dragConnFrom.nodeId) {
        // Create the connection
        var fromPortName = _dragConnFrom.portName || 'output';
        var toPortName = inPort.portName || 'input';
        if (SL.patchEngine) {
          SL.patchEngine.createConnection(
            _dragConnFrom.nodeId, fromPortName,
            inPort.nodeId, toPortName
          );
        }
        // Add to visual patchJson
        if (_patchJson) {
          if (!_patchJson.connections) {
            _patchJson.connections = [];
          }
          var connObj = {
            from: _dragConnFrom.nodeId,
            to: inPort.nodeId
          };
          if (fromPortName !== 'output') {
            connObj.fromPort = fromPortName;
          }
          if (toPortName !== 'input') {
            connObj.toPort = toPortName;
          }
          _patchJson.connections.push(connObj);
          _nodePortInfo = _computePortInfo(_patchJson);
        }
      }
      _dragConnFrom = null;
    }

    _mouseState = MOUSE_IDLE;
    _render();
  }

  function _onContextMenu(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var coords = _canvasCoords(e);

    // Check if right-clicking on a connection
    var connIdx = _hitTestConnection(coords.x, coords.y);
    if (connIdx !== null && _patchJson && _patchJson.connections) {
      var conn = _patchJson.connections[connIdx];
      if (conn && SL.patchEngine) {
        SL.patchEngine.deleteConnection(conn.from, conn.to);
      }
      _patchJson.connections.splice(connIdx, 1);
      _nodePortInfo = _computePortInfo(_patchJson);
      _render();
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Selection & Parameter Panel
  // =========================================================================

  function _selectNode(nodeId) {
    _selectedNodeId = nodeId;
    if (nodeId) {
      _showParamPanel(nodeId);
    } else {
      _hideParamPanel();
    }
    _render();
  }

  function _showParamPanel(nodeId) {
    var panel = document.getElementById(_paramPanelId);
    if (!panel || !_patchJson) {
      return;
    }

    // Find the node spec
    var nodeSpec = null;
    var nodes = _patchJson.nodes || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      if (nodes[i].id === nodeId) {
        nodeSpec = nodes[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!nodeSpec) {
      _hideParamPanel();
      return;
    }

    var html = '';
    html += '<div class="param-panel-title">' + _escHtml(nodeSpec.id) + '</div>';
    html += '<div class="param-panel-type">' + _escHtml(nodeSpec.type) + '</div>';

    var defs = PARAM_DEFS[nodeSpec.type];
    if (defs) {
      var params = nodeSpec.params || {};
      for (var d = 0; d < defs.length; d++) {
        var def = defs[d];
        if (def.type === 'select') {
          var currentVal = (params[def.name] !== undefined) ? params[def.name] : def.default_val;
          html += '<div class="param-row">';
          html += '<label>' + _escHtml(def.name) + '</label>';
          html += '<select data-node="' + _escHtml(nodeSpec.id) + '" data-param="' + _escHtml(def.name) + '">';
          for (var oi = 0; oi < def.options.length; oi++) {
            var sel = (def.options[oi] === currentVal) ? ' selected' : '';
            html += '<option value="' + _escHtml(def.options[oi]) + '"' + sel + '>' + _escHtml(def.options[oi]) + '</option>';
          }
          html += '</select>';
          html += '</div>';
        } else {
          var val = (params[def.name] !== undefined) ? params[def.name] : def.default_val;
          html += '<div class="param-row">';
          html += '<label>' + _escHtml(def.name) + ': <span class="param-value" id="pv_' + _escHtml(def.name) + '">' + _formatNum(val) + '</span></label>';
          html += '<input type="range" min="' + def.min + '" max="' + def.max + '" step="' + def.step + '" value="' + val + '"';
          html += ' data-node="' + _escHtml(nodeSpec.id) + '" data-param="' + _escHtml(def.name) + '">';
          html += '</div>';
        }
      }
    }

    html += '<button class="param-delete-btn" data-node="' + _escHtml(nodeSpec.id) + '">Delete Node</button>';

    panel.innerHTML = html;
    panel.style.display = 'block';

    // Bind slider events
    var sliders = panel.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]');
    for (var si = 0; si < sliders.length; si++) {
      sliders[si].addEventListener('input', _onParamSliderChange);
    }

    // Bind select events
    var selects = panel.querySelectorAll('select');
    for (var sei = 0; sei < selects.length; sei++) {
      selects[sei].addEventListener('change', _onParamSelectChange);
    }

    // Bind delete button
    var delBtn = panel.querySelector('.param-delete-btn');
    if (delBtn) {
      delBtn.addEventListener('click', _onDeleteNode);
    }
  }

  function _hideParamPanel() {
    var panel = document.getElementById(_paramPanelId);
    if (panel) {
      panel.style.display = 'none';
      panel.innerHTML = '';
    }
  }

  function _onParamSliderChange(e) {
    var nodeId = e.target.getAttribute('data-node');
    var param = e.target.getAttribute('data-param');
    var value = parseFloat(e.target.value);
    if (SL.patchEngine && nodeId && param) {
      SL.patchEngine.setParam(nodeId, param, value);
    }
    // Update value display
    var valSpan = document.getElementById('pv_' + param);
    if (valSpan) {
      valSpan.textContent = _formatNum(value);
    }
    // Update the patchJson spec
    if (_patchJson) {
      var nodes = _patchJson.nodes || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
        if (nodes[i].id === nodeId) {
          if (!nodes[i].params) {
            nodes[i].params = {};
          }
          nodes[i].params[param] = value;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    _render();
  }

  function _onParamSelectChange(e) {
    var nodeId = e.target.getAttribute('data-node');
    var param = e.target.getAttribute('data-param');
    var value = e.target.value;
    if (SL.patchEngine && nodeId && param) {
      SL.patchEngine.setParam(nodeId, param, value);
    }
    if (_patchJson) {
      var nodes = _patchJson.nodes || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
        if (nodes[i].id === nodeId) {
          if (!nodes[i].params) {
            nodes[i].params = {};
          }
          nodes[i].params[param] = value;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    _render();
  }

  function _onDeleteNode(e) {
    var nodeId = e.target.getAttribute('data-node');
    if (!nodeId) {
      return;
    }
    if (SL.patchEngine) {
      SL.patchEngine.deleteNode(nodeId);
    }
    // Remove from visual patchJson
    if (_patchJson) {
      var nodes = _patchJson.nodes || [];
      for (var i = nodes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (nodes[i].id === nodeId) {
          nodes.splice(i, 1);
        }
      }
      var conns = _patchJson.connections || [];
      for (var c = conns.length - 1; c >= 0; c--) {
        if (conns[c].from === nodeId || conns[c].to === nodeId) {
          conns.splice(c, 1);
        }
      }
      _nodePortInfo = _computePortInfo(_patchJson);
    }
    delete _nodePositions[nodeId];
    _selectedNodeId = null;
    _hideParamPanel();
    _render();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Add node from palette
  // =========================================================================

  function _addNodeFromPalette(nodeType) {
    if (!_patchJson) {
      _patchJson = { name: 'Untitled', nodes: [], connections: [], macros: [] };
    }

    var newX = DEFAULT_ADD_X + (_addNodeCount % 5) * ADD_OFFSET_STEP;
    var newY = DEFAULT_ADD_Y + Math.floor(_addNodeCount / 5) * (NODE_HEIGHT + LAYOUT_V_SPACING);
    _addNodeCount++;

    var defaultParams = {};
    var defs = PARAM_DEFS[nodeType];
    if (defs) {
      for (var d = 0; d < defs.length; d++) {
        if (defs[d].default_val !== undefined) {
          defaultParams[defs[d].name] = defs[d].default_val;
        }
      }
    }

    var nodeSpec = {
      type: nodeType,
      params: defaultParams,
      x: newX,
      y: newY
    };

    if (SL.patchEngine) {
      var result = SL.patchEngine.addNode(nodeSpec);
      if (result) {
        nodeSpec.id = result.id;
      }
    }

    if (!nodeSpec.id) {
      nodeSpec.id = nodeType + '_' + Date.now();
    }

    _patchJson.nodes.push(nodeSpec);
    _nodePositions[nodeSpec.id] = { x: newX, y: newY };
    _nodePortInfo = _computePortInfo(_patchJson);
    _selectNode(nodeSpec.id);
    _render();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Utility
  // =========================================================================

  function _escHtml(str) {
    return String(str).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"');
  }

    '*~': {

    'send~': {
      type: null,
      isSend: true,

    'receive~': {
      type: null,

      type: null,
      isSend: true,

    },

      type: null,
      isReceive: true,
