  // =========================================================================
  // Port name lookup per SSL node type
  // =========================================================================

  var SSL_PORT_NAMES = {
    oscillator: { inputs: ['frequency', 'detune'], outputs: ['out'] },
    noise: { inputs: [], outputs: ['out'] },
    filter: { inputs: ['in', 'frequency', 'Q'], outputs: ['out'] },
    gain: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    add: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    multiply: { inputs: ['in1', 'in2'], outputs: ['out'] },
    output: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: [] },
    constant: { inputs: [], outputs: ['out'] },
    envelope: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    clip: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    waveshaper: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    delay: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    envelope_follower: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    sample_hold: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    lfo: { inputs: [], outputs: ['out'] },
    impulse: { inputs: [], outputs: ['out'] },
    compressor: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    quantize: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out'] },
    mixer: { inputs: ['in1', 'in2', 'in3', 'in4'], outputs: ['out'] },
    splitter: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: ['out1', 'out2'] },
    meter: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: [] },
    scope: { inputs: ['in'], outputs: [] }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // PD parser: text -> record list
  // =========================================================================

  function tokenizeRecords(pdText) {
    // PD records are terminated by semicolons.
    // Records may span multiple lines.
    // Strip comments and normalize whitespace.
    var normalized = pdText.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');

    // Split on semicolons, handling multi-line records
    var records = [];
    var current = '';
    var lines = normalized.split('\n');
    for (var li = 0; li < lines.length; li++) {
      var line = lines[li];
      // Skip empty lines
      if (line.trim().length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      current = current + (current.length > 0 ? ' ' : '') + line.trim();
      // Check if record ends with semicolon
      if (current.charAt(current.length - 1) === ';') {
        // Remove trailing semicolon and push
        records.push(current.substring(0, current.length - 1).trim());
        current = '';
      }
    }
    // Handle any remaining content without a trailing semicolon
    if (current.trim().length > 0) {
      records.push(current.trim());
    }
    return records;
  }

  function parseRecord(record) {
    // Split on whitespace
    var tokens = record.split(/\s+/);
    if (tokens.length < 2) {
      return null;
    }
    var chunk = tokens[0];       // #N or #X or #A
    var elemType = tokens[1];    // canvas, obj, connect, msg, etc.
    var rest = tokens.slice(2);
    return { chunk: chunk, type: elemType, args: rest };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Main parser: PD text -> SSL patch JSON
  // =========================================================================

  function parse(pdText) {
    var records = tokenizeRecords(pdText);
    var pdObjects = [];        // Ordered list of PD objects (index matters for connect)
    var pdConnections = [];    // Raw PD connections
    var canvasInfo = null;
    var warnings = [];

    // Pass 1: Parse all records into structured data
    var ri;
    for (ri = 0; ri < records.length; ri++) {
      var rec = parseRecord(records[ri]);
      if (!rec) {
        continue;
      }

      if (rec.chunk === PD_CHUNK_CANVAS && rec.type === 'canvas') {
        // Canvas definition: x y width height [name] [open]
        if (!canvasInfo) {
          canvasInfo = {
            x: parseInt(rec.args[0], 10) || 0,
            y: parseInt(rec.args[1], 10) || 0,
            width: parseInt(rec.args[2], 10) || 450,
            height: parseInt(rec.args[3], 10) || 300
          };
        }
      } else if (rec.chunk === PD_CHUNK_ELEMENT) {
        if (rec.type === PD_ELEM_OBJ) {
          // obj x y objectName [arg1 arg2 ...]
          var objX = parseInt(rec.args[0], 10) || 0;
          var objY = parseInt(rec.args[1], 10) || 0;
          var objName = rec.args[2] || '';
          var objArgs = rec.args.slice(3);
          pdObjects.push({
            pdIndex: pdObjects.length,
            x: objX,
            y: objY,
            name: objName,
            args: objArgs
          });
        } else if (rec.type === PD_ELEM_CONNECT) {
          // connect fromIdx fromOutlet toIdx toInlet
          pdConnections.push({
            fromIdx: parseInt(rec.args[0], 10),
            fromOutlet: parseInt(rec.args[1], 10),
            toIdx: parseInt(rec.args[2], 10),
            toInlet: parseInt(rec.args[3], 10)
          });
        } else if (rec.type === PD_ELEM_FLOATATOM) {
          // floatatom counts as an object in PD's indexing
          pdObjects.push({
            pdIndex: pdObjects.length,
            x: parseInt(rec.args[0], 10) || 0,
            y: parseInt(rec.args[1], 10) || 0,
            name: '_floatatom',
            args: rec.args.slice(2),
            isMessageDomain: true
          });
        } else if (rec.type === PD_ELEM_SYMBOLATOM) {
          pdObjects.push({
            pdIndex: pdObjects.length,
            x: parseInt(rec.args[0], 10) || 0,
            y: parseInt(rec.args[1], 10) || 0,
            name: '_symbolatom',
            args: rec.args.slice(2),
            isMessageDomain: true
          });
        } else if (rec.type === PD_ELEM_MSG) {
          // msg counts as an object in PD's indexing
          pdObjects.push({
            pdIndex: pdObjects.length,
            x: parseInt(rec.args[0], 10) || 0,
            y: parseInt(rec.args[1], 10) || 0,
            name: '_msg',
            args: rec.args.slice(2),
            isMessageDomain: true
          });
        } else if (rec.type === PD_ELEM_TEXT) {
          // text (comment) counts as object in indexing
          pdObjects.push({
            pdIndex: pdObjects.length,
            x: parseInt(rec.args[0], 10) || 0,
            y: parseInt(rec.args[1], 10) || 0,
            name: '_text',
            args: rec.args.slice(2),
            isMessageDomain: true
          });
        } else if (rec.type === 'restore') {
          // Subpatch restore: counts as object in indexing
          pdObjects.push({
            pdIndex: pdObjects.length,
            x: parseInt(rec.args[0], 10) || 0,
            y: parseInt(rec.args[1], 10) || 0,
            name: '_restore',
            args: rec.args.slice(2),
            isMessageDomain: true
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Pass 2: Map PD objects to SSL nodes
    var sslNodes = [];
    var pdIndexToSslId = {};  // pdIndex -> SSL node ID
    var nodeCounter = 0;
    var skippedObjects = [];
    var supportedNames = [];
    var unsupportedNames = [];
    var audioObjectCount = 0;
    var messageObjectCount = 0;

    // Track delay write/read pairs for merging
    var delayWritesByName = {};

    var oi;
    for (oi = 0; oi < pdObjects.length; oi++) {
      var pdObj = pdObjects[oi];
      var objName = pdObj.name;

      // Skip internal types
      if (objName.charAt(0) === '_') {
        messageObjectCount++;
        continue;
      }

      // Check if it is a message-domain object
      if (MESSAGE_DOMAIN_OBJECTS[objName]) {
        messageObjectCount++;
        skippedObjects.push(objName);
        continue;
      }

      // Check if it should be skipped with warning
      if (SKIP_WITH_WARNING[objName]) {
        audioObjectCount++;
        warnings.push(objName + ' ignored (' + SKIP_WITH_WARNING[objName] + ')');
        unsupportedNames.push(objName);
        continue;
      }

      // Look up the mapping
      var mapping = PD_TO_SSL[objName];
      if (mapping) {
        audioObjectCount++;
        supportedNames.push(objName);

        // Handle send~/receive~/throw~/catch~ — virtual routing, no SSL node
        if (mapping.isSend || mapping.isReceive) {
          // Store mapping but do not create a node (handled via connection rewriting)
          var busParams = mapping.mapParams(pdObj.args);
          pdObj._busName = busParams._busName;
          pdObj._isSend = mapping.isSend || false;
          pdObj._isReceive = mapping.isReceive || false;
          continue;
        }

        // Handle delwrite~ — store for merging with delread~
        if (mapping.isDelayWrite) {
          var dwParams = mapping.mapParams(pdObj.args);
          nodeCounter++;
          var dwId = NODE_ID_PREFIX + nodeCounter;
          var dwNode = {
            id: dwId,
            type: mapping.type,
            params: { time: dwParams.time, feedback: dwParams.feedback },
            position: {
              x: LAYOUT_X_BASE + Math.round(pdObj.x * LAYOUT_X_SCALE),
              y: LAYOUT_Y_BASE + Math.round(pdObj.y * LAYOUT_Y_SCALE)
            }
          };
          sslNodes.push(dwNode);
          pdIndexToSslId[pdObj.pdIndex] = dwId;
          delayWritesByName[dwParams._delayName] = dwId;
          continue;
        }

        // Handle delread~ — link to existing delwrite~ if available
        if (mapping.isDelayRead) {
          var drParams = mapping.mapParams(pdObj.args);
          var existingWriteId = delayWritesByName[drParams._delayName];
          if (existingWriteId) {
            // Map this PD index to the same SSL delay node
            pdIndexToSslId[pdObj.pdIndex] = existingWriteId;
          } else {
            // No matching delwrite~, create standalone delay
            nodeCounter++;
            var drId = NODE_ID_PREFIX + nodeCounter;
            var drNode = {
              id: drId,
              type: mapping.type,
              params: { time: drParams.time, feedback: drParams.feedback },
              position: {
                x: LAYOUT_X_BASE + Math.round(pdObj.x * LAYOUT_X_SCALE),
                y: LAYOUT_Y_BASE + Math.round(pdObj.y * LAYOUT_Y_SCALE)
              }
            };
            sslNodes.push(drNode);
            pdIndexToSslId[pdObj.pdIndex] = drId;
          }
          continue;
        }

        // Standard mapping
        nodeCounter++;
        var sslId = NODE_ID_PREFIX + nodeCounter;
        var params = mapping.mapParams(pdObj.args);

        // Remove internal params (prefixed with _)
        var cleanParams = {};
        var paramKeys = Object.keys(params);
        for (var pk = 0; pk < paramKeys.length; pk++) {
          if (paramKeys[pk].charAt(0) !== '_') {
            cleanParams[paramKeys[pk]] = params[paramKeys[pk]];
          }
        }

        var sslNode = {
          id: sslId,
          type: mapping.type,
          params: cleanParams,
          position: {
            x: LAYOUT_X_BASE + Math.round(pdObj.x * LAYOUT_X_SCALE),
            y: LAYOUT_Y_BASE + Math.round(pdObj.y * LAYOUT_Y_SCALE)
          }
        };

        // Mark multiply nodes for special connection handling
        if (mapping.isMultiply) {
          sslNode._isMultiply = true;
        }

        sslNodes.push(sslNode);
        pdIndexToSslId[pdObj.pdIndex] = sslId;
      } else {
        // Unknown/unsupported audio object
        if (objName.indexOf('~') >= 0) {
          audioObjectCount++;
          unsupportedNames.push(objName);
        } else {
          messageObjectCount++;
          skippedObjects.push(objName);
        }
      }
    }

    // Pass 3: Map PD connections to SSL connections
    var sslConnections = [];
    var ci;
    for (ci = 0; ci < pdConnections.length; ci++) {
      var pdConn = pdConnections[ci];
      var fromSslId = pdIndexToSslId[pdConn.fromIdx];
      var toSslId = pdIndexToSslId[pdConn.toIdx];

      if (fromSslId && toSslId) {
        // Determine port names based on node types
        var fromNode = _findNodeById(sslNodes, fromSslId);
        var toNode = _findNodeById(sslNodes, toSslId);

        if (fromNode && toNode) {
          var fromPortName = _getOutputPortName(fromNode.type, pdConn.fromOutlet);
          var toPortName = _getInputPortName(toNode, pdConn.toInlet);

          sslConnections.push({
            from: fromSslId,
            fromPort: fromPortName,
            to: toSslId,
            toPort: toPortName
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Clean up internal markers from nodes
    for (var ni = 0; ni < sslNodes.length; ni++) {
      if (sslNodes[ni]._isMultiply) {
        delete sslNodes[ni]._isMultiply;
      }
    }

    // Build the final patch JSON
    var patchJson = {
      name: 'PD Import',
      category: 'Imported',
      description: 'Imported from Pure Data patch',
      nodes: sslNodes,
      connections: sslConnections,
      macros: []
    };

    return patchJson;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Helper: find node by ID
  // =========================================================================

  function _findNodeById(nodes, id) {
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      if (nodes[i].id === id) {
        return nodes[i];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Helper: get output port name for a node type at outlet index
  // =========================================================================

  function _getOutputPortName(nodeType, outletIndex) {
    var ports = SSL_PORT_NAMES[nodeType];
    if (ports && ports.outputs && outletIndex < ports.outputs.length) {
      return ports.outputs[outletIndex];
    }
    return 'out';
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Helper: get input port name for a node at inlet index
  // =========================================================================

  function _getInputPortName(node, inletIndex) {
    var nodeType = node.type;

    // Special handling for dac~: inlet 0 = left, inlet 1 = right, both map to 'in'
    if (nodeType === 'output') {
      return 'in';
    }

    // For gain nodes mapped from *~: inlet 0 = audio in, inlet 1 = gain modulation
    if (nodeType === 'gain' && inletIndex === 1) {
      return 'gain';
    }

    // For filter nodes: inlet 0 = audio, inlet 1 = frequency, inlet 2 = Q
    if (nodeType === 'filter') {
      if (inletIndex === 0) {
        return 'in';
      } else if (inletIndex === 1) {
        return 'frequency';
      } else if (inletIndex === 2) {
        return 'Q';
      }
    }

    var ports = SSL_PORT_NAMES[nodeType];
    if (ports && ports.inputs && inletIndex < ports.inputs.length) {
      return ports.inputs[inletIndex];
    }
    return 'in';
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Compatibility report
  // =========================================================================

  function getCompatibility(pdText) {
    var records = tokenizeRecords(pdText);
    var supported = [];
    var unsupported = [];
    var warningsList = [];
    var audioCount = 0;
    var messageCount = 0;
    var seenObjects = {};

    for (var ri = 0; ri < records.length; ri++) {
      var rec = parseRecord(records[ri]);
      if (!rec) {
        continue;
      }
      if (rec.chunk === PD_CHUNK_ELEMENT && rec.type === PD_ELEM_OBJ) {
        var objName = rec.args[2] || '';

        // Skip duplicates for the report
        if (seenObjects[objName]) {
          continue;
        }
        seenObjects[objName] = true;

        if (MESSAGE_DOMAIN_OBJECTS[objName]) {
          messageCount++;
        } else if (SKIP_WITH_WARNING[objName]) {
          audioCount++;
          warningsList.push(objName + ' ignored (' + SKIP_WITH_WARNING[objName] + ')');
          unsupported.push(objName);
        } else if (PD_TO_SSL[objName]) {
          audioCount++;
          supported.push(objName);
        } else if (objName.indexOf('~') >= 0) {
          audioCount++;
          unsupported.push(objName);
        } else {
          messageCount++;
        }
      }
    }

    var totalMappable = supported.length + unsupported.length;
    var pct = (totalMappable > 0) ? Math.round((supported.length / totalMappable) * 100) : 100;

    return {
      supported: supported,
      unsupported: unsupported,
      warnings: warningsList,
      supportedPercent: pct,
      audioObjectCount: audioCount,
      messageObjectCount: messageCount
    };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // List all supported PD objects
  // =========================================================================

  function getSupportedObjects() {
    var result = [];
    var keys = Object.keys(PD_TO_SSL);
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      result.push(keys[i]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Self-test
  // =========================================================================

  var PD_TEST_PATCH = '#N canvas 0 0 450 300;\n' +
    '#X obj 50 50 noise~;\n' +
    '#X obj 50 120 lop~ 800;\n' +
    '#X obj 50 190 *~ 0.5;\n' +
    '#X obj 50 260 dac~;\n' +
    '#X connect 0 0 1 0;\n' +
    '#X connect 1 0 2 0;\n' +
    '#X connect 2 0 3 0;\n' +
    '#X connect 2 0 3 1;\n';

  function runSelfTest() {
    var result = { pass: true, errors: [] };
    var patch = parse(PD_TEST_PATCH);

    // Validate 4 nodes
    if (patch.nodes.length !== 4) {
      result.pass = false;
      result.errors.push('Expected 4 nodes, got ' + patch.nodes.length);
    }

    // Validate 4 connections
    if (patch.connections.length !== 4) {
      result.pass = false;
      result.errors.push('Expected 4 connections, got ' + patch.connections.length);
    }

    // Validate node types
    var expectedTypes = ['noise', 'filter', 'gain', 'output'];
    for (var i = 0; i < expectedTypes.length; i++) {
      if (i >= patch.nodes.length || patch.nodes[i].type !== expectedTypes[i]) {
        result.pass = false;
        result.errors.push('Node ' + i + ': expected type "' + expectedTypes[i] +
          '", got "' + (patch.nodes[i] ? patch.nodes[i].type : 'undefined') + '"');
      }
    }

    // Validate filter frequency is 800
    if (patch.nodes.length >= 2) {
      var filterParams = patch.nodes[1].params || {};
      if (filterParams.frequency !== 800) {
        result.pass = false;
        result.errors.push('Filter frequency: expected 800, got ' + filterParams.frequency);
      }
      if (filterParams.filterType !== 'lowpass') {
        result.pass = false;
        result.errors.push('Filter type: expected lowpass, got ' + filterParams.filterType);
      }
    }

    // Validate gain is 0.5
    if (patch.nodes.length >= 3) {
      var gainParams = patch.nodes[2].params || {};
      if (gainParams.gain !== 0.5) {
        result.pass = false;
        result.errors.push('Gain: expected 0.5, got ' + gainParams.gain);
      }
    }

    // Validate connection chain: noise -> filter -> gain -> output
    if (patch.connections.length >= 3) {
      var c0 = patch.connections[0];
      var c1 = patch.connections[1];
      var c2 = patch.connections[2];
      if (c0.from !== patch.nodes[0].id || c0.to !== patch.nodes[1].id) {
        result.pass = false;
        result.errors.push('Connection 0: expected noise->filter');
      }
      if (c1.from !== patch.nodes[1].id || c1.to !== patch.nodes[2].id) {
        result.pass = false;
        result.errors.push('Connection 1: expected filter->gain');
      }
      if (c2.from !== patch.nodes[2].id || c2.to !== patch.nodes[3].id) {
        result.pass = false;
        result.errors.push('Connection 2: expected gain->output');
      }
    }

    // Validate compatibility report
    var compat = getCompatibility(PD_TEST_PATCH);
    if (compat.supportedPercent !== 100) {
      result.pass = false;

    parse: parse,
    getCompatibility: getCompatibility,
    getSupportedObjects: getSupportedObjects,
    runSelfTest: runSelfTest,

  };

})();

        if (!contextMenuEl) {
            return;
        }
        currentTargetId = sslId;
        var displayName = ELEMENT_NAMES[sslId] || sslId;
        var itemEl = contextMenuEl.querySelector(".ssl-context-menu-item");
        if (itemEl) {
            itemEl.textContent = "Provide Feedback on " + displayName;

        var menuW = contextMenuEl.offsetWidth;
        var menuH = contextMenuEl.offsetHeight;
        var winW = window.innerWidth;
        var winH = window.innerHeight;
        var posX = x;
        var posY = y;
        if (posX + menuW > winW) {
            posX = winW - menuW - 4;
        }
        if (posY + menuH > winH) {
            posY = winH - menuH - 4;
        }
        contextMenuEl.style.left = posX + "px";
        contextMenuEl.style.top = posY + "px";

    var feedbackOverlay = null;

    function openFeedbackModal(sslId) {
        hideContextMenu();
        if (!feedbackOverlay) {
            feedbackOverlay = document.getElementById("sslFeedbackOverlay");
        }
        if (!feedbackOverlay) {
            return;
        }

        var displayName = ELEMENT_NAMES[sslId] || sslId;
        var elIdDiv = feedbackOverlay.querySelector(".ssl-feedback-element-id");
        if (elIdDiv) {
            elIdDiv.textContent = sslId + " (" + displayName + ")";
        }

        selectedRating = null;
        var btns = feedbackOverlay.querySelectorAll(".ssl-feedback-rating-btn");
        for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
            btns[i].className = "ssl-feedback-rating-btn";
        }
        var textarea = feedbackOverlay.querySelector(".ssl-feedback-textarea");
        if (textarea) {
            textarea.value = "";

        var successEl = feedbackOverlay.querySelector(".ssl-feedback-success");
        if (successEl) {
            successEl.style.display = "none";

        if (feedbackOverlay) {
            feedbackOverlay.className = "ssl-feedback-overlay";

        if (!selectedRating) {
            return;
        }
        var textarea = feedbackOverlay.querySelector(".ssl-feedback-textarea");
        var comment = textarea ? textarea.value.trim() : "";

        var record = {
            elementId: currentTargetId,
            rating: selectedRating,
            comment: comment,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            sslVersion: SSL_VERSION

        var items = getFeedback();

        var blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: "application/json" });
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var now = new Date();
        var y = now.getFullYear();
        var m = ("0" + (now.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2);
        var d = ("0" + now.getDate()).slice(-2);

        document.addEventListener("contextmenu", function(e) {
            var target = e.target;
            var sslId = null;

            // Walk up to find nearest data-ssl-id
            while (target && target !== document.body) {
                if (target.getAttribute && target.getAttribute("data-ssl-id")) {
                    sslId = target.getAttribute("data-ssl-id");
                    break;
                }
                target = target.parentElement;
            }

            if (sslId) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                showContextMenu(e.clientX, e.clientY, sslId);
            } else {
                hideContextMenu();
            }
        });

        // Click elsewhere dismisses context menu
        document.addEventListener("click", function() {
            hideContextMenu();
        });

        // Context menu item click
        var menuItem = document.querySelector("#sslContextMenu .ssl-context-menu-item");

                    btn.addEventListener("click", function() {

                        var allBtns = feedbackOvl.querySelectorAll(".ssl-feedback-rating-btn");
                        for (var j = 0; j < allBtns.length; j++) {

        var submitBtn = document.querySelector("#sslFeedbackOverlay .ssl-feedback-submit");
        if (submitBtn) {
            submitBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
                submitFeedback();
            });
        }

        if (feedbackOvl) {
            feedbackOvl.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
                if (e.target === feedbackOvl) {
                    closeFeedbackModal();
                }
            });
        }

        var aboutBtn = document.getElementById("sslAboutBtn");
        if (aboutBtn) {
            aboutBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
                openAbout();
            });
        }

        // About overlay click-to-close
        var aboutOvl = document.getElementById("sslAboutOverlay");
        if (aboutOvl) {
            aboutOvl.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
                if (e.target === aboutOvl) {

  'use strict';

  var MIN_BPM = 40;
  var MAX_BPM = 300;
  var DEFAULT_BPM = 120;

  // Track which container was last built into
  var _lastContainerId = null;

  function build(containerId) {
    var container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    _lastContainerId = containerId;

    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.className = 'shared-transport-bar';

    // Play button
    var playBtn = document.createElement('button');
    playBtn.className = 'st-play-btn';
    playBtn.id = containerId + '-st-play';
    playBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
    playBtn.title = 'Play / Pause';
    playBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
        SL.sequencer.stopSeq();
      } else if (SL.sequencer) {
        SL.sequencer.startSeq();
      }
      sync(containerId);
    });
    container.appendChild(playBtn);

    // Stop button
    var stopBtn = document.createElement('button');
    stopBtn.className = 'st-stop-btn';
    stopBtn.id = containerId + '-st-stop';
    stopBtn.textContent = '\u25A0';
    stopBtn.title = 'Stop';
    stopBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (SL.sequencer) {
        SL.sequencer.stopSeq();
      }
      sync(containerId);
    });
    container.appendChild(stopBtn);

    // BPM label
    var bpmLabel = document.createElement('span');
    bpmLabel.className = 'st-bpm-label';
    bpmLabel.textContent = 'BPM';
    container.appendChild(bpmLabel);

    // BPM input
    var bpmInput = document.createElement('input');
    bpmInput.type = 'number';
    bpmInput.className = 'st-bpm-input';
    bpmInput.id = containerId + '-st-bpm';
    bpmInput.min = MIN_BPM;
    bpmInput.max = MAX_BPM;
    bpmInput.value = DEFAULT_BPM;
    bpmInput.addEventListener('change', function() {
      var val = parseInt(bpmInput.value, 10);
      if (!isNaN(val) && val >= MIN_BPM && val <= MAX_BPM) {
        // Sync to main sequencer BPM input
        var mainBpm = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
        if (mainBpm) {

    var oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
    return NOTES[pc] + oct;
  }

  function isBlackKey(pc) {
    for (var i = 0; i < BLACK_KEYS.length; i++) {
      if (BLACK_KEYS[i] === pc) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Keyboard Builder
  // ============================================================

  function _updateOctRange() {
    if (_octRangeEl) {
      _octRangeEl.textContent = 'C' + _baseOctave + '-C' + (_baseOctave + _numOctaves);
    }
  }

  function _buildKeyboard() {
    if (!_keyboardEl) {
      return;
    }
    _stopAllNotes();
    _keyboardEl.innerHTML = '';

    if (_keyMode === 'iso4') {
      _buildIsoKeyboard(5, false);
    } else if (_keyMode === 'iso5') {
      _buildIsoKeyboard(7, false);
    } else if (_keyMode === 'hex') {
      _buildIsoKeyboard(7, true);
    } else if (_keyMode === 'pads') {
      _buildDrumPads();
    } else {
      _buildPianoKeyboard();
    }

    _updateOctRange();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Piano Keyboard (default mode)
  // ============================================================

  function _buildPianoKeyboard() {
    var startMidi = (_baseOctave + 1) * 12;
    var endMidi = (_baseOctave + _numOctaves + 1) * 12;

    // Determine how many octaves fit based on container width
    var containerWidth = _keyboardEl.parentElement ? _keyboardEl.parentElement.clientWidth : 800;
    // Each white key is ~60px + 2px margin = 62px. 7 white keys per octave = 434px
    var WHITE_KEY_WIDTH = 62;
    var WHITES_PER_OCT = 7;
    var maxOctaves = Math.floor(containerWidth / (WHITE_KEY_WIDTH * WHITES_PER_OCT));
    if (maxOctaves < MIN_OCTAVES) {
      maxOctaves = MIN_OCTAVES;
    }
    if (_numOctaves > maxOctaves) {
      _numOctaves = maxOctaves;
      endMidi = (_baseOctave + _numOctaves + 1) * 12;
    }

    // Build computer keyboard binding map for display
    var bindingMap = {};
    var baseComputerMidi = (_baseOctave + 1) * 12;
    var keys = Object.keys(KEY_TO_SEMITONE);
    for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
      var code = keys[k];
      var semitone = KEY_TO_SEMITONE[code];
      var boundMidi = baseComputerMidi + semitone;
      // Show just the letter
      bindingMap[boundMidi] = code.replace('Key', '');
    }

    for (var midi = startMidi; midi <= endMidi; midi++) {
      var pc = midi % 12;
      var black = isBlackKey(pc);

      var keyEl = document.createElement('div');
      keyEl.className = 'perf-key ' + (black ? 'perf-black' : 'perf-white') + ' pc-' + pc;
      keyEl.setAttribute('data-midi', midi);

      // Note label
      var lbl = document.createElement('span');
      lbl.className = 'perf-key-label';
      lbl.textContent = midiToName(midi);
      keyEl.appendChild(lbl);

      // Computer key binding label
      if (bindingMap[midi]) {
        var bindLbl = document.createElement('span');
        bindLbl.className = 'perf-key-binding';
        bindLbl.textContent = bindingMap[midi];
        keyEl.appendChild(bindLbl);
      }

      // Mouse/touch event listeners
      (function(m, el) {
        el.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _noteOn(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
          _noteOff(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(e) {
          if (e.buttons === 0) {
            _noteOff(m);
          }
        });
        el.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(e) {
          if (e.buttons > 0) {
            _noteOn(m);
          }
        });
        // Touch support
        el.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _noteOn(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _noteOff(m);
        });
      })(midi, keyEl);

      _keyboardEl.appendChild(keyEl);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Isomorphic Grid Keyboard
  // ============================================================

  var ISO_ROWS = 6;
  var ISO_COLS = 10;

  function _wireIsoKeyEvents(midi, el) {
    (function(m, keyEl) {
      keyEl.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        _noteOn(m);
      });
      keyEl.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
        _noteOff(m);
      });
      keyEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(e) {
        if (e.buttons === 0) {
          _noteOff(m);
        }
      });
      keyEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(e) {
        if (e.buttons > 0) {
          _noteOn(m);
        }
      });
      keyEl.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        _noteOn(m);
      });
      keyEl.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        _noteOff(m);
      });
    })(midi, el);
  }

  function _buildIsoKeyboard(interval, isHex) {
    var baseNote = (_baseOctave + 1) * 12;

    // Compute available space and size cells to fill it
    var containerW = _keyboardEl.clientWidth || 800;
    var containerH = _keyboardEl.clientHeight || 500;
    var GAP = 3;

    if (isHex) {
      // Hex: size from available space
      // totalW = cols * colStep + colStep/2, totalH = (rows-1)*rowStep + hexH
      // colStep = hexW + GAP, rowStep = hexH * 0.75
      var hexW = Math.floor((containerW - GAP) / (ISO_COLS + 0.5)) - GAP;
      var hexH = Math.floor(containerH / (1 + (ISO_ROWS - 1) * 0.75));
      // Pick the smaller to keep aspect ratio close to original 52:46
      var scale = Math.min(hexW / 52, hexH / 46);
      hexW = Math.floor(52 * scale);
      hexH = Math.floor(46 * scale);
      var HEX_ROW_STEP = Math.round(hexH * 0.75);
      var HEX_COL_STEP = hexW + GAP;
      var fontSize = Math.max(9, Math.min(14, Math.floor(hexW / 4.5)));

      var grid = document.createElement('div');
      grid.className = 'perf-iso-grid perf-hex-grid';
      var totalH = (ISO_ROWS - 1) * HEX_ROW_STEP + hexH;
      var totalW = ISO_COLS * HEX_COL_STEP + Math.round(HEX_COL_STEP / 2);
      grid.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:' + totalW + 'px;height:' + totalH + 'px;';

      for (var r = 0; r < ISO_ROWS; r++) {
        var rowIdx = ISO_ROWS - 1 - r;
        var isOddRow = (r % 2 === 1);
        var offsetX = isOddRow ? Math.round(HEX_COL_STEP / 2) : 0;
        var top = r * HEX_ROW_STEP;

        for (var c = 0; c < ISO_COLS; c++) {
          var midi = baseNote + (rowIdx * interval) + c;
          var pc = midi % 12;
          var oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
          var isRoot = (pc === 0);

          var keyEl = document.createElement('div');
          keyEl.className = 'perf-iso-key hex pc-' + pc + (isRoot ? ' root' : '');
          keyEl.setAttribute('data-midi', midi);
          keyEl.textContent = NOTES[pc] + oct;

          var left = c * HEX_COL_STEP + offsetX;
          keyEl.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:' + left + 'px;top:' + top + 'px;width:' + hexW + 'px;height:' + hexH + 'px;font-size:' + fontSize + 'px;';

          _wireIsoKeyEvents(midi, keyEl);
          grid.appendChild(keyEl);
        }
      }

      _keyboardEl.appendChild(grid);
    } else {
      // Rectangular: compute cell size to fill container
      var cellW = Math.floor((containerW - 20 - (ISO_COLS - 1) * GAP) / ISO_COLS);
      var cellH = Math.floor((containerH - 20 - (ISO_ROWS - 1) * GAP) / ISO_ROWS);
      var fontSize = Math.max(9, Math.min(14, Math.floor(Math.min(cellW, cellH) / 4.5)));

      var grid = document.createElement('div');
      grid.className = 'perf-iso-grid';

      for (var r = 0; r < ISO_ROWS; r++) {
        var row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'perf-iso-row';

        var rowIdx = ISO_ROWS - 1 - r;

        for (var c = 0; c < ISO_COLS; c++) {
          var midi = baseNote + (rowIdx * interval) + c;
          var pc = midi % 12;
          var oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
          var isRoot = (pc === 0);

          var keyEl = document.createElement('div');
          keyEl.className = 'perf-iso-key pc-' + pc + (isRoot ? ' root' : '');
          keyEl.setAttribute('data-midi', midi);
          keyEl.textContent = NOTES[pc] + oct;
          keyEl.style.cssText = 'width:' + cellW + 'px;height:' + cellH + 'px;font-size:' + fontSize + 'px;';

          _wireIsoKeyEvents(midi, keyEl);
          row.appendChild(keyEl);
        }

        grid.appendChild(row);
      }

      _keyboardEl.appendChild(grid);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Drum Pads
  // ============================================================

  var GM_DRUM_PADS = [
    { midi: 36, name: 'Kick' },
    { midi: 38, name: 'Snare' },
    { midi: 42, name: 'HH Cl' },
    { midi: 46, name: 'HH Op' },
    { midi: 45, name: 'Tom L' },
    { midi: 48, name: 'Tom M' },

    { midi: 75, name: 'Claves' },
    { midi: 60, name: 'Bongo H' },

  function _buildDrumPads() {
    var grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'perf-pad-grid';

    for (var i = 0; i < GM_DRUM_PADS.length; i++) {
      var pad = GM_DRUM_PADS[i];
      var padEl = document.createElement('div');
      padEl.className = 'perf-drum-pad';
      padEl.setAttribute('data-midi', pad.midi);
      padEl.textContent = pad.name;

      (function(m, el) {
        el.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _noteOn(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
          _noteOff(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(e) {
          if (e.buttons === 0) {
            _noteOff(m);
          }
        });
        el.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _noteOn(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _noteOff(m);
        });
      })(pad.midi, padEl);

      grid.appendChild(padEl);
    }

    _keyboardEl.appendChild(grid);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Note On / Off
  // ============================================================

  function _noteOn(midi) {
    if (_activeNotes[midi]) {
      return; // already playing
    }
    _activeNotes[midi] = true;
    SL.audio.startSustainedNote(midi);
    _highlightKey(midi, true);

    // Update filter effect key tracking with current note frequency
    var noteFreq = SL.audio.m2f(midi);
    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var chain = SL.audio.getInstrumentChain ? SL.audio.getInstrumentChain(instIdx) : null;
    if (chain) {
      var filterFx = chain.getEffect ? chain.getEffect('filter') : null;
      if (filterFx && filterFx.setNoteFreq) {
        filterFx.setNoteFreq(noteFreq);
      }
    }

    if (_noteReadoutEl) {
      var name = midiToName(midi);
      var freqStr = noteFreq.toFixed(1);
      _noteReadoutEl.textContent = name + ' (' + freqStr + ' Hz)';
    }
  }

  function _noteOff(midi) {
    if (!_activeNotes[midi]) {
      return; // not playing
    }
    delete _activeNotes[midi];
    SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi);
    _highlightKey(midi, false);
  }

  function _highlightKey(midi, on) {
    if (!_keyboardEl) {
      return;
    }
    var keys = _keyboardEl.querySelectorAll('[data-midi="' + midi + '"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      if (on) {
        keys[i].classList.add('perf-active');
        keys[i].classList.add('playing');
      } else {
        keys[i].classList.remove('perf-active');
        keys[i].classList.remove('playing');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Computer Keyboard Input
  // ============================================================

  function _onKeyDown(e) {
    if (!_active) {
      return;
    }
    // Don't capture if typing in an input/select
    if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || e.target.tagName === 'SELECT') {
      return;
    }

    // Octave shift with Z/X
    if (e.code === 'KeyZ') {
      _octaveDown();
      return;
    }
    if (e.code === 'KeyX') {
      _octaveUp();
      return;
    }

    var semitone = KEY_TO_SEMITONE[e.code];
    if (semitone !== undefined && !_keyboardNotes[e.code]) {
      var midi = (_baseOctave + 1) * 12 + semitone;
      _keyboardNotes[e.code] = midi;
      _noteOn(midi);
    }
  }

  function _onKeyUp(e) {
    if (!_active) {
      return;
    }

    var midi = _keyboardNotes[e.code];
    if (midi !== undefined) {
      _noteOff(midi);
      delete _keyboardNotes[e.code];
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Octave Controls
  // ============================================================

  function _octaveDown() {
    if (_baseOctave > 0) {
      _stopAllNotes();
      _baseOctave--;
      _buildKeyboard();
    }
  }

  function _octaveUp() {
    if (_baseOctave < 7) {
      _stopAllNotes();
      _baseOctave++;
      _buildKeyboard();
    }
  }

  function _stopAllNotes() {
    var midiKeys = Object.keys(_activeNotes);
    for (var i = 0; i < midiKeys.length; i++) {
      var midi = parseInt(midiKeys[i]);
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi);
      _highlightKey(midi, false);
    }
    _activeNotes = {};
    _keyboardNotes = {};
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Preset Selector
  // ============================================================

  function _populatePresetCategories() {
    if (!_catSelectEl) {
      return;
    }

    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var instType = SL.audio.getInstrumentType
      ? SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instIdx)
      : 'subtractive';

    var categories = SL.presets && SL.presets.getCategories
      ? SL.presets.getCategories(instType)
      : [];

    _catSelectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Category --</option>';
    for (var i = 0; i < categories.length; i++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = categories[i];
      opt.textContent = categories[i];
      _catSelectEl.appendChild(opt);
    }

    if (_presetSelectEl) {
      _presetSelectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Preset --</option>';
    }
    _presetList = [];
  }

  function _populatePresetList(category) {
    if (!_presetSelectEl) {
      return;
    }

    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var instType = SL.audio.getInstrumentType
      ? SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instIdx)
      : 'subtractive';

    _presetList = SL.presets && SL.presets.getPresetsByCategory
      ? SL.presets.getPresetsByCategory(instType, category)
      : [];

    _presetSelectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Preset --</option>';
    for (var i = 0; i < _presetList.length; i++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = i;
      opt.textContent = _presetList[i].name;
      _presetSelectEl.appendChild(opt);
    }
  }

  function _applySelectedPreset() {
    if (!_presetSelectEl || _presetSelectEl.value === '') {
      return;
    }
    var idx = parseInt(_presetSelectEl.value);
    var preset = _presetList[idx];
    if (!preset) {
      return;
    }

    var instIndex = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var instType = SL.audio.getInstrumentType
      ? SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instIndex)
      : 'subtractive';

    // Use the same preset apply pattern as preset-ui.js
    var applyMap = {
      'subtractive': 'applySubtractivePreset',
      'fm': 'applyFMPreset',
      'physical': 'applyPhysicalPreset',
      'additive': 'applyAdditivePreset',
      'granular': 'applyGranularPreset',
      'vocoder': 'applyVocoderPreset',
      'wavefolder': 'applyWavefoldPreset',
      'formant': 'applyFormantPreset',
      'modal': 'applyModalPreset',
      'ringmod': 'applyRingmodPreset',
      'chord': 'applyChordPreset',
      'superwave': 'applySuperwavePreset',
      'wavetable': 'applyWavetableSynthPreset',
      'phasedist': 'applyPhasedistPreset',
      'chip': 'applyChipPreset',
      'bytebeat': 'applyBytebeatPreset',
      'vector': 'applyVectorPreset',
      'drumsyn': 'applyDrumsynPreset',
      'pulsar': 'applyPulsarPreset',
      'reed': 'applyReedPreset'
    };

    var fnName = applyMap[instType];
    if (fnName && SL.presets && SL.presets[fnName]) {
      SL.presets[fnName](preset, instIndex);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Analyzer (HiDPI canvas, waveform from SL.audio analyser)
  // ============================================================

  function _initAnalyzer() {
    _analyserCanvas = document.getElementById('performAnalyzer');
    if (!_analyserCanvas) {
      return;
    }

    // HiDPI setup
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var displayW = _analyserCanvas.clientWidth || 200;
    var displayH = _analyserCanvas.clientHeight || 100;
    _analyserCanvas.width = displayW * dpr;
    _analyserCanvas.height = displayH * dpr;
    _analyserCtx = _analyserCanvas.getContext('2d');
    _analyserCtx.scale(dpr, dpr);
    // Store display dimensions for drawing
    _analyserCanvas._displayW = displayW;
    _analyserCanvas._displayH = displayH;
  }

  function _drawAnalyzer() {
    if (!_active) {
      return;
    }

    _animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(_drawAnalyzer);

    var analyser = SL.audio.getAnalyser ? SL.audio.getAnalyser() : null;
    if (!analyser || !_analyserCtx || !_analyserCanvas) {
      return;
    }

    if (!_analyserData || _analyserData.length !== analyser.fftSize) {
      _analyserData = new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);
    }

    analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(_analyserData);

    var w = _analyserCanvas._displayW;
    var h = _analyserCanvas._displayH;
    var ctx = _analyserCtx;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a14';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Draw center line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222244';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(w, h / 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Draw waveform
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4cc9f0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();

    var sliceWidth = w / _analyserData.length;
    var x = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < _analyserData.length; i++) {
      var v = _analyserData[i] / 128.0;
      var y = (v * h) / 2;
      if (i === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      x += sliceWidth;
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function _startAnalyzer() {
    if (!_animFrameId) {
      _drawAnalyzer();
    }
  }

  function _stopAnalyzer() {
    if (_animFrameId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(_animFrameId);
      _animFrameId = null;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Compact Effects/ADSR Controls
  // ============================================================

  function _buildCompactControls() {
    var sidePanel = document.querySelector('#screen-perform .perform-side');
    if (!sidePanel) {
      return;
    }

    // Shared transport
    var transportDiv = document.createElement('div');
    transportDiv.id = 'perform-transport';
    transportDiv.className = 'shared-transport-container';
    sidePanel.insertBefore(transportDiv, sidePanel.firstChild);

    // ADSR mini-sliders
    var adsrDiv = document.createElement('div');
    adsrDiv.className = 'perform-compact-section';
    adsrDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="perform-compact-title">ADSR</div>';
    var adsrParams = [
      { id: 'perfA', label: 'Attack', param: 'attack', max: 100 },
      { id: 'perfD', label: 'Decay', param: 'decay', max: 100 },
      { id: 'perfS', label: 'Sustain', param: 'sustain', max: 100 },
      { id: 'perfR', label: 'Release', param: 'release', max: 100 }
    ];
    for (var ai = 0; ai < adsrParams.length; ai++) {
      var p = adsrParams[ai];
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'perform-compact-row';
      row.innerHTML = '<span class="perform-compact-lbl">' + p.label + '</span>' +
        '<input type="range" class="perform-compact-slider" id="' + p.id + '" min="0" max="' + p.max + '" value="50">';
      adsrDiv.appendChild(row);
    }
    sidePanel.appendChild(adsrDiv);

    // Wire ADSR sliders
    for (var wi = 0; wi < adsrParams.length; wi++) {
      (function(param) {
        var slider = document.getElementById(param.id);
        if (slider) {
          // Sync from engine
          var adsr = SL.audio.getADSR ? SL.audio.getADSR() : null;
          if (adsr) {
            if (param.param === 'attack') { slider.value = SL.audio.timeToSlider ? SL.audio.timeToSlider(adsr.a) : 50; }
            if (param.param === 'decay') { slider.value = SL.audio.timeToSlider ? SL.audio.timeToSlider(adsr.d) : 50; }
            if (param.param === 'sustain') { slider.value = Math.round(adsr.s * 100); }
            if (param.param === 'release') { slider.value = SL.audio.timeToSlider ? SL.audio.timeToSlider(adsr.r) : 50; }
          }
          slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
            var el;
            if (param.param === 'attack') {
              el = document.getElementById('attackSlider');
              if (el) { el.value = slider.value; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); }
            }
            if (param.param === 'decay') {
              el = document.getElementById('decaySlider');
              if (el) { el.value = slider.value; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); }
            }
            if (param.param === 'sustain') {

  function _buildPerfIsoGrid() {
    var existing = document.getElementById('perfIsoGrid');
    if (existing) {
      existing.style.display = 'flex';
      return;
    }

    var kbArea = _keyboardEl ? _keyboardEl.parentElement : document.querySelector('#screen-perform .perform-keyboard');
    if (!kbArea) {
      return;
    }

    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.id = 'perfIsoGrid';
    container.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;padding:4px;background:#0a0a14;border:1px solid #2a2a4a;border-radius:4px;margin-top:4px;max-width:600px;';

    var ROWS = 4;
    var COLS = 8;
    var INTERVAL = 5; // fourths layout

    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        var midi = (_baseOctave + 1) * 12 + (ROWS - 1 - r) * INTERVAL + c;
        var pc = midi % 12;
        var btn = document.createElement('div');
        btn.style.cssText = 'width:36px;height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.55rem;cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px;user-select:none;transition:background 0.1s;';
        btn.style.background = (pc === 0) ? '#2a2a6a' : '#1a1a2e';
        btn.style.color = '#c0c0e0';
        btn.style.border = '1px solid #3a3a5a';
        btn.textContent = NOTES[pc];
        btn.setAttribute('data-iso-midi', midi);

        (function(m, el) {
          el.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            _noteOn(m);
            el.style.background = '#6a6aff';
          });
          el.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
            _noteOff(m);
            var pci = m % 12;
            el.style.background = (pci === 0) ? '#2a2a6a' : '#1a1a2e';
          });
          el.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            _noteOff(m);
            var pci = m % 12;
            el.style.background = (pci === 0) ? '#2a2a6a' : '#1a1a2e';
          });
        })(midi, btn);

        container.appendChild(btn);
      }
    }

    kbArea.parentElement.appendChild(container);
  }

  function _init() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }

    _keyboardEl = document.getElementById('performKeyboard');
    _noteReadoutEl = document.getElementById('performNoteReadout');
    _octRangeEl = document.getElementById('performOctRange');
    _volumeEl = document.getElementById('performVolume');
    _catSelectEl = document.getElementById('performPresetCategory');
    _presetSelectEl = document.getElementById('performPresetSelect');
    _instSelectEl = document.getElementById('performInstSelect');
    _arpToggleEl = document.getElementById('performArpToggle');
    _arpPatternEl = document.getElementById('performArpPattern');
    _keyModeSelectEl = document.getElementById('performKeyMode');

    // Wire keyboard mode selector
    if (_keyModeSelectEl) {
      _keyModeSelectEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        _keyMode = _keyModeSelectEl.value;
        _buildKeyboard();
      });
    }

    // Wire up event listeners
    var octDownBtn = document.getElementById('performOctDown');
    var octUpBtn = document.getElementById('performOctUp');
    var applyBtn = document.getElementById('performPresetApply');

    if (octDownBtn) {
      octDownBtn.addEventListener('click', _octaveDown);
    }
    if (octUpBtn) {
      octUpBtn.addEventListener('click', _octaveUp);
    }
    if (applyBtn) {
      applyBtn.addEventListener('click', _applySelectedPreset);
    }
    if (_catSelectEl) {
      _catSelectEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var cat = _catSelectEl.value;
        if (cat) {
          _populatePresetList(cat);
        } else {
          if (_presetSelectEl) {
            _presetSelectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Preset --</option>';
          }
          _presetList = [];
        }
      });
    }
    if (_instSelectEl) {
      _instSelectEl.addEventListener('change', _onInstrumentChange);
    }
    // Engine type selector
    var typeSelectEl = document.getElementById('performTypeSelect');
    if (typeSelectEl) {
      typeSelectEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
        if (SL.audio.setInstrumentType) {
          SL.audio.setInstrumentType(instId, typeSelectEl.value);
        }
        _populatePresetCategories();
        if (SL.state) { SL.state.notify('type'); }
      });
    }
    if (_volumeEl) {
      _volumeEl.addEventListener('input', _onVolumeChange);
    }
    if (_arpToggleEl) {
      _arpToggleEl.addEventListener('change', _onArpToggle);
    }
    if (_arpPatternEl) {
      _arpPatternEl.addEventListener('change', _onArpPatternChange);
    }

    // Computer keyboard listeners (global, but gated by _active flag)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', _onKeyDown);
    document.addEventListener('keyup', _onKeyUp);

    _initAnalyzer();
    _buildKeyboard();
    _buildCompactControls();

    _initialized = true;
  }

  function _syncFromModel() {
    var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var instruments = SL.audio.getInstruments();
    var settings = (instruments && instruments[instId]) ? instruments[instId].settings : null;

    // Sync instrument selector
    if (_instSelectEl) {
      _instSelectEl.value = instId;
    }

    // Sync engine type selector
    var typeSelSync = document.getElementById('performTypeSelect');
    if (typeSelSync && SL.audio.getInstrumentType) {
      typeSelSync.value = SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instId);
    }

    // Sync volume from model
    if (_volumeEl && settings && settings.volume !== undefined) {
      _volumeEl.value = settings.volume;
    }

    // Sync arp toggle
    if (_arpToggleEl && SL.arp) {
      _arpToggleEl.checked = SL.arp.isEnabled();
    }

    // Sync arp pattern
    if (_arpPatternEl && SL.arp && SL.arp.getPattern) {
      var patMap = { 'up': 'Up', 'down': 'Down', 'updown': 'Up-Down', 'random': 'Random' };
      var curPat = SL.arp.getPattern();
      if (patMap[curPat]) {
        _arpPatternEl.value = patMap[curPat];
      }
    }

    _populatePresetCategories();
  }

  function activate(tabId) {
    _init();
    _active = true;

    // Handle tabId-based mode switching
    if (tabId === 'piano') {
      _keyMode = 'piano';
    } else if (tabId === 'isomorphic') {
      _keyMode = 'iso4';
    } else if (tabId === 'live') {
      _keyMode = 'piano';
    }
    // If no tabId, keep current _keyMode

    // Sync the mode selector dropdown
    if (_keyModeSelectEl) {
      _keyModeSelectEl.value = _keyMode;
    }

    _syncFromModel();
    _buildKeyboard();
    _startAnalyzer();
    if (SL.sharedTransport) {
      SL.sharedTransport.build('perform-transport');
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _stopAllNotes();
    _stopAnalyzer();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenPerform = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };
})();

  // Debounced retrigger — restarts the sustained note (if held) or
  // plays a short preview note so parameter changes are immediately audible
  var RETRIGGER_DEBOUNCE_MS = 80;
  var PREVIEW_NOTE_DURATION = 0.35;
  var _retriggerTimerId = null;

  function _retriggerHold() {
    if (_retriggerTimerId) {
      clearTimeout(_retriggerTimerId);
    }
    _retriggerTimerId = setTimeout(function() {
      _retriggerTimerId = null;
      if (!SL.audio) {
        return;
      }
      if (_holdActive) {
        SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
        SL.audio.startSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
      } else {
        SL.audio.playNote(_holdMidi, PREVIEW_NOTE_DURATION);
      }
    }, RETRIGGER_DEBOUNCE_MS);
  }

  function midiToName(midi) {
    var pc = midi % 12;
    var oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
    return NOTES[pc] + oct;
  }

  function isBlackKey(pc) {
    for (var i = 0; i < BLACK_KEYS.length; i++) {
      if (BLACK_KEYS[i] === pc) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function _getCurrentType() {
    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    if (SL.audio.getInstrumentType) {
      return SL.audio.getInstrumentType(instIdx);
    }
    return 'subtractive';
  }

  function _makeSliderRow(label, id, min, max, step, value, suffix) {
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'design-slider-row';

    var lbl = document.createElement('span');
    lbl.className = 'design-slider-label';
    var svgStr = PARAM_SVGS[label] || '';
    if (svgStr) {
      lbl.innerHTML = svgStr + ' ' + label;
    } else {
      lbl.textContent = label;
    }
    row.appendChild(lbl);

    var slider = document.createElement('input');
    slider.type = 'range';
    slider.id = id;
    slider.min = min;
    slider.max = max;
    slider.step = step;
    slider.value = value;
    row.appendChild(slider);

    var val = document.createElement('span');
    val.className = 'design-slider-val';
    val.id = id + '-val';
    val.textContent = value + (suffix || '');
    row.appendChild(val);

    slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      val.textContent = slider.value + (suffix || '');
      _retriggerHold();
    });

    return row;
  }

  function _makeSelectRow(label, id, options, selected) {
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'design-slider-row';

    var lbl = document.createElement('span');
    lbl.className = 'design-slider-label';
    var svgStr = PARAM_SVGS[label] || '';
    if (svgStr) {
      lbl.innerHTML = svgStr + ' ' + label;
    } else {
      lbl.textContent = label;
    }
    row.appendChild(lbl);

    var sel = document.createElement('select');
    sel.id = id;
    for (var i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      if (typeof options[i] === 'object') {
        opt.value = options[i].value;
        opt.textContent = options[i].label;
      } else {
        opt.value = options[i];
        opt.textContent = options[i];
      }
      if (opt.value === selected) {
        opt.selected = true;
      }
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    }
    sel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      _retriggerHold();
    });
    row.appendChild(sel);

    return row;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Type Buttons
  // ============================================================

  function _buildTypeButtons() {
    if (!_typeGridEl) {
      return;
    }
    _typeGridEl.innerHTML = '';
    var currentType = _getCurrentType();
    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var isLoopInst = (instIdx === 4);

    for (var ci = 0; ci < TYPE_CATEGORIES.length; ci++) {
      var cat = TYPE_CATEGORIES[ci];
      var catTypes = cat.types;

      // Filter types for this instrument
      var visibleTypes = [];
      for (var ti = 0; ti < catTypes.length; ti++) {
        var t = catTypes[ti];
        if (isLoopInst && t.key !== 'loop') {
          continue;
        }
        if (!isLoopInst && t.key === 'loop') {
          continue;
        }
        visibleTypes.push(t);
      }
      if (visibleTypes.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }

      // Category group
      var group = document.createElement('div');
      group.className = 'design-type-group';

      // Category label
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'design-type-cat-label';
      label.textContent = cat.name;
      group.appendChild(label);

      // Type buttons row
      var btnRow = document.createElement('div');
      btnRow.className = 'design-type-btn-row';

      for (var vi = 0; vi < visibleTypes.length; vi++) {
        var vt = visibleTypes[vi];
        var btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'design-type-btn';
        btn.textContent = vt.label;
        btn.setAttribute('data-type', vt.key);
        if (vt.key === currentType) {
          btn.classList.add('active');
        }
        (function(typeKey) {
          btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            _onTypeChange(typeKey);
          });
        })(vt.key);
        btnRow.appendChild(btn);
      }

      group.appendChild(btnRow);
      _typeGridEl.appendChild(group);
    }
  }

  function _setActiveTypeBtn(typeKey) {
    if (!_typeGridEl) {
      return;
    }
    var btns = _typeGridEl.querySelectorAll('.design-type-btn');
    for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
      if (btns[i].getAttribute('data-type') === typeKey) {
        btns[i].classList.add('active');
      } else {
        btns[i].classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
  }

  function _onTypeChange(typeKey) {
    var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    // Stop held note before type change
    if (_holdActive) {
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
    }
    if (SL.audio.setInstrumentType) {
      SL.audio.setInstrumentType(instId, typeKey);
    }
    _setActiveTypeBtn(typeKey);
    _buildEnginePanel(typeKey);
    _buildFilterPanel(typeKey);
    _populatePresetCategories();
    if (SL.state) { SL.state.notify('type'); }
    // Restart held note with new type
    if (_holdActive) {
      SL.audio.startSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
    }
  }

    var h4 = document.createElement('h4');
    h4.innerHTML = (PARAM_SVGS['Oscillators'] || '') + ' Oscillators';
    _enginePanelEl.appendChild(h4);

    // Read real instrument settings
    var settings = SL.audio.getInstrumentSettings ? SL.audio.getInstrumentSettings() : null;

    for (var n = 1; n <= 3; n++) {
      _buildOscRow(n, settings);
    }
  }

  function _buildOscRow(n, settings) {
    var oscIdx = n - 1;
    var oscSettings = (settings && settings.osc && settings.osc[oscIdx])
      ? settings.osc[oscIdx]
      : { wave: 'sine', oct: 0, detune: 0, level: (n === 1 ? 80 : 0) };

    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'design-osc-row';

    var num = document.createElement('span');
    num.className = 'design-osc-num';
    var oscSvg = PARAM_SVGS['Osc'] || '';
    num.innerHTML = oscSvg + n;
    row.appendChild(num);

    // Wave select
    var waveSel = document.createElement('select');
    waveSel.className = 'design-osc-wave-d';
    waveSel.id = 'dOscWave' + n;
    for (var i = 0; i < WAVE_TYPES.length; i++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = WAVE_TYPES[i];
      opt.textContent = WAVE_TYPES[i];
      if (WAVE_TYPES[i] === oscSettings.wave) {
        opt.selected = true;
      }
      waveSel.appendChild(opt);
    }
    row.appendChild(waveSel);

    // Oct select
    var octSel = document.createElement('select');
    octSel.id = 'dOscOct' + n;
    octSel.style.width = '40px';
    for (var o = -3; o <= 3; o++) {
      var optO = document.createElement('option');
      optO.value = o;
      optO.textContent = (o >= 0 ? '+' : '') + o;
      if (o === oscSettings.oct) {
        optO.selected = true;
      }
      octSel.appendChild(optO);
    }
    row.appendChild(octSel);

    // Detune slider
    var detSlider = document.createElement('input');
    detSlider.type = 'range';
    detSlider.id = 'dOscDet' + n;
    detSlider.min = -100;
    detSlider.max = 100;
    detSlider.step = 1;
    detSlider.value = oscSettings.detune;
    detSlider.style.width = '50px';
    row.appendChild(detSlider);

    var detVal = document.createElement('span');
    detVal.className = 'design-osc-val';
    detVal.id = 'dOscDetVal' + n;
    detVal.textContent = String(oscSettings.detune);
    row.appendChild(detVal);

    // Level slider
    var lvlSlider = document.createElement('input');
    lvlSlider.type = 'range';
    lvlSlider.id = 'dOscLvl' + n;
    lvlSlider.min = 0;
    lvlSlider.max = 100;
    lvlSlider.step = 1;
    lvlSlider.value = oscSettings.level;
    lvlSlider.style.width = '40px';
    row.appendChild(lvlSlider);

    var lvlVal = document.createElement('span');
    lvlVal.className = 'design-osc-val';
    lvlVal.id = 'dOscLvlVal' + n;
    lvlVal.textContent = oscSettings.level + '%';
    row.appendChild(lvlVal);

    // Mirror design-page osc value to main-page DOM so getOscSettings() picks it up
    function _mirrorOscToMain() {
      var mainWave   = document.querySelector('.osc-wave[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      var mainOct    = document.querySelector('.osc-oct[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      var mainDetune = document.querySelector('.osc-detune[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      var mainLevel  = document.querySelector('.osc-level[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      if (mainWave)   { mainWave.value   = waveSel.value; }
      if (mainOct)    { mainOct.value    = octSel.value; }
      if (mainDetune) { mainDetune.value = detSlider.value; }
      if (mainLevel)  { mainLevel.value  = lvlSlider.value; }
    }

    // Wire up display updates and write back to model
    waveSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      _mirrorOscToMain();
      if (SL.audio && SL.audio.refreshActiveOscillators) {
        SL.audio.refreshActiveOscillators();
      }
      if (SL.state) { SL.state.notify('instrument'); }
      _retriggerHold();
    });
    octSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      _mirrorOscToMain();
      if (SL.audio && SL.audio.refreshActiveOscillators) {
        SL.audio.refreshActiveOscillators();
      }
      if (SL.state) { SL.state.notify('instrument'); }
      _retriggerHold();
    });
    detSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      detVal.textContent = detSlider.value;
      _mirrorOscToMain();
      if (SL.audio && SL.audio.refreshActiveOscillators) {
        SL.audio.refreshActiveOscillators();
      }
      _retriggerHold();
    });
    lvlSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      lvlVal.textContent = lvlSlider.value + '%';
      _mirrorOscToMain();
      if (SL.audio && SL.audio.refreshActiveOscillators) {
        SL.audio.refreshActiveOscillators();
      }
      _retriggerHold();
    });

    _enginePanelEl.appendChild(row);
  }

  // --- FM ---
  function _syncFMToEngine() {
    if (!SL.fm || !SL.fm.setSettings) { return; }
    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var algoEl = document.getElementById('dFmAlgo');
    var algo = algoEl ? parseInt(algoEl.value, 10) : 1;
    var ops = [];
    for (var i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
      var lvlEl = document.getElementById('dFmOp' + i + 'Lvl');
      var ratioEl = document.getElementById('dFmOp' + i + 'Ratio');
      ops.push({
        level: lvlEl ? parseFloat(lvlEl.value) / 100 : 0,
        ratio: ratioEl ? parseFloat(ratioEl.value) : i,
        detune: 0
      });
    }
    var settings = SL.fm.getSettings(instIdx);
    settings.algorithm = algo;
    for (var j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
      settings.operators[j].level = ops[j].level;
      settings.operators[j].ratio = ops[j].ratio;
    }
    SL.fm.setSettings(instIdx, settings);
    _retriggerHold();
  }

  function _buildFMEngine() {
    var h4 = document.createElement('h4');
    h4.textContent = 'FM Synthesis';
    _enginePanelEl.appendChild(h4);

    // Read current FM settings
    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var fmSettings = (SL.fm && SL.fm.getSettings) ? SL.fm.getSettings(instIdx) : null;
    var curAlgo = fmSettings ? String(fmSettings.algorithm) : '1';

    // Algorithm selector
    var algoRow = _makeSelectRow('Algorithm', 'dFmAlgo',
      [
        { value: '1', label: 'Algo 1' },
        { value: '2', label: 'Algo 2' },
        { value: '3', label: 'Algo 3' },
        { value: '4', label: 'Algo 4' },
        { value: '5', label: 'Algo 5' },
        { value: '6', label: 'Algo 6' }
      ], curAlgo);
    // Wire algo change to engine
    var algoSel = algoRow.querySelector('select');
    if (algoSel) {
      algoSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
        _syncFMToEngine();
      });
    }
    _enginePanelEl.appendChild(algoRow);

    // 6 operator levels
    var opGrid = document.createElement('div');
    opGrid.className = 'design-fm-ops';

      opLabel.className = 'design-fm-op-label';

      var curLvl = (fmSettings && fmSettings.operators[op - 1]) ? Math.round(fmSettings.operators[op - 1].level * 100) : (op === 1 ? 80 : 0);
      var curRatio = (fmSettings && fmSettings.operators[op - 1]) ? fmSettings.operators[op - 1].ratio : op;

      var lvlRow = _makeSliderRow('Level', 'dFmOp' + op + 'Lvl', 0, 100, 1, curLvl, '%');
      opDiv.appendChild(lvlRow);

      var ratioRow = _makeSliderRow('Ratio', 'dFmOp' + op + 'Ratio', 0.5, 16, 0.5, curRatio, '');

      // Wire slider changes to engine
      (function() {
        var lvlSlider = lvlRow.querySelector('input[type="range"]');

        if (lvlSlider) { lvlSlider.addEventListener('input', _syncFMToEngine); }

      })();

      opGrid.appendChild(opDiv);
    }
    _enginePanelEl.appendChild(opGrid);
  }

  function _syncPhysicalToEngine() {

    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();

  // --- Generic Engine Builder ---
  function _buildGenericEngine(title, getterName, setterName, params) {
    var h4 = document.createElement('h4');
    h4.textContent = title;
    _enginePanelEl.appendChild(h4);

    var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var settings = null;
    if (SL.audio[getterName]) {
      settings = SL.audio[getterName](instIdx);
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < params.length; i++) {
      var p = params[i];
      var currentVal = settings ? (settings[p.key] !== undefined ? settings[p.key] : (p.min || 0)) : (p.min || 0);

      if (p.type === 'select') {
        var selRow = _makeSelectRow(p.label, 'dGen_' + p.key, p.opts, String(currentVal));
        _enginePanelEl.appendChild(selRow);
        // Wire up change handler
        (function(paramKey, sName, row) {
          var sel = row.querySelector('select');
          if (sel) {
            sel.addEventListener('change', function() {
              _applyGenericParam(sName, paramKey, sel.value);
            });
          }
        })(p.key, setterName, selRow);
      } else {
        var slRow = _makeSliderRow(p.label, 'dGen_' + p.key, p.min, p.max, p.step, currentVal, p.suffix || '');
        _enginePanelEl.appendChild(slRow);
        // Wire up input handler
        (function(paramKey, sName, row) {
          var sl = row.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
          if (sl) {
            sl.addEventListener('input', function() {
              _applyGenericParam(sName, paramKey, parseFloat(sl.value));
            });
          }
        })(p.key, setterName, slRow);
      }
    }
  }

  function _applyGenericParam(setterName, paramKey, value) {
    if (SL.audio[setterName]) {
      var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
      var update = {};
      update[paramKey] = value;
      SL.audio[setterName](instIdx, update);
    }
    _retriggerHold();
  }
