    _phraseSteps = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < PHRASE_STEPS; i++) {
      _phraseSteps.push({ note: PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE, accent: false, slide: false, rest: true });
    }
  }

  function _phraseGenerateRandom() {
    _phraseSteps = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < PHRASE_STEPS; i++) {
      var isRest = Math.random() < PHRASE_REST_CHANCE;
      var scaleIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * PHRASE_MINOR_PENTATONIC.length);
      var octaveOffset = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) * 12; // 0 or 12
      var midi = PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE + PHRASE_MINOR_PENTATONIC[scaleIdx] + octaveOffset;
      _phraseSteps.push({
        note: midi,
        accent: !isRest && Math.random() < PHRASE_ACCENT_CHANCE,
        slide: !isRest && Math.random() < PHRASE_SLIDE_CHANCE,
        rest: isRest
      });
    }
  }

  function _phraseLoadPreset(presetIndex) {
    var preset = PHRASE_PRESETS[presetIndex];
    if (!preset) {
      return;
    }
    if (preset.steps === null) {
      // Random preset
      _phraseGenerateRandom();
    } else {
      _phraseSteps = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < PHRASE_STEPS; i++) {
        var src = preset.steps[i];
        _phraseSteps.push({
          note: src.note,
          accent: src.accent,
          slide: src.slide,
          rest: src.rest
        });
      }
    }
    _phraseRefreshGrid();
  }

  function _phraseCycleNote(stepIdx, direction) {
    var step = _phraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (!step) {
      return;
    }
    if (step.rest) {
      // Clicking a rest turns it into a note at base octave
      step.rest = false;
      step.note = PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE;
    } else {
      var offset = direction || 1;
      var newNote = step.note + offset;
      if (newNote >= PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE + PHRASE_NOTE_RANGE) {
        newNote = PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE;
      }
      if (newNote < PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE) {
        newNote = PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE + PHRASE_NOTE_RANGE - 1;
      }
      step.note = newNote;
    }
    _phraseRefreshStep(stepIdx);
  }

  function _phraseSetRest(stepIdx) {
    var step = _phraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (!step) {
      return;
    }
    step.rest = !step.rest;
    _phraseRefreshStep(stepIdx);
  }

  function _phraseToggleAccent(stepIdx) {
    var step = _phraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (step) {
      step.accent = !step.accent;
      _phraseRefreshStep(stepIdx);
    }
  }

  function _phraseToggleSlide(stepIdx) {
    var step = _phraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (step) {
      step.slide = !step.slide;
      _phraseRefreshStep(stepIdx);
    }
  }

  function _phraseShiftOctave(semitones) {
    for (var i = 0; i < _phraseSteps.length; i++) {
      var step = _phraseSteps[i];
      if (!step.rest) {
        var newNote = step.note + semitones;
        // Clamp to valid range
        if (newNote >= PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE && newNote < PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE + PHRASE_NOTE_RANGE) {
          step.note = newNote;
        }
      }
    }
    _phraseRefreshGrid();
  }

  function _phraseClear() {
    _phraseInitSteps();
    _phraseRefreshGrid();
  }

  function _phraseRefreshStep(stepIdx) {
    var el = _phraseStepEls[stepIdx];
    var step = _phraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (!el || !step) {
      return;
    }
    // Note display
    var noteEl = el.querySelector('.phrase-note');
    if (noteEl) {
      noteEl.textContent = step.rest ? '\u2014' : midiToName(step.note);
    }
    // Rest class
    if (step.rest) {
      el.classList.add('rest');
    } else {
      el.classList.remove('rest');
    }
    // Accent button
    var accentBtn = el.querySelector('.design-phrase-accent');
    if (accentBtn) {
      if (step.accent) {
        accentBtn.classList.add('on');
      } else {
        accentBtn.classList.remove('on');
      }
    }
    // Slide button
    var slideBtn = el.querySelector('.design-phrase-slide');
    if (slideBtn) {
      if (step.slide) {
        slideBtn.classList.add('on');
      } else {
        slideBtn.classList.remove('on');
      }
    }
  }

  function _phraseRefreshGrid() {
    for (var i = 0; i < PHRASE_STEPS; i++) {
      _phraseRefreshStep(i);
    }
  }

  function _phraseStart() {
    if (_phraseRunning) {
      return;
    }
    _phraseRunning = true;
    _phraseCurrentStep = -1;
    _phraseLastMidi = -1;

    if (_phrasePlayBtn) {
      _phrasePlayBtn.classList.add('playing');
      _phrasePlayBtn.textContent = '\u25A0'; // stop square
    }

    var stepIntervalMs = 60000 / (_phraseBpm * 4); // 16th notes

    _phraseTimerId = setInterval(function() {
      // Remove highlight from previous step
      if (_phraseCurrentStep >= 0 && _phraseStepEls[_phraseCurrentStep]) {
        _phraseStepEls[_phraseCurrentStep].classList.remove('active');
      }

      // Advance step (wrap around)
      _phraseCurrentStep = (_phraseCurrentStep + 1) % PHRASE_STEPS;

      // Highlight current step
      if (_phraseStepEls[_phraseCurrentStep]) {
        _phraseStepEls[_phraseCurrentStep].classList.add('active');
      }

      var step = _phraseSteps[_phraseCurrentStep];
      if (!step) {
        return;
      }

      // Determine next step for slide lookahead
      var nextIdx = (_phraseCurrentStep + 1) % PHRASE_STEPS;
      var nextStep = _phraseSteps[nextIdx];
      var isSliding = step.slide && nextStep && !nextStep.rest;

      // Stop previous note if not sliding from it
      if (_phraseLastMidi >= 0) {
        SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_phraseLastMidi);
        _phraseLastMidi = -1;
      }

      if (step.rest) {
        return;
      }

      var velocity = step.accent ? PHRASE_ACCENT_VEL : PHRASE_NORMAL_VEL;
      var gateFraction = isSliding ? PHRASE_GATE_SLIDE : PHRASE_GATE_NORMAL;
      var gateDurationMs = stepIntervalMs * gateFraction;

      // Play the note
      if (SL.audio && SL.audio.startSustainedNote) {
        SL.audio.startSustainedNote(step.note);
        _phraseLastMidi = step.note;

        if (!isSliding) {
          // Schedule note-off at gate end
          (function(midi) {
            setTimeout(function() {
              if (_phraseLastMidi === midi) {
                SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi);
                _phraseLastMidi = -1;
              }
            }, gateDurationMs);
          })(step.note);
        }
        // If sliding, the note stays on and the next step's startSustainedNote
        // will create the legato transition
      }

      // Highlight on mini keyboard if available
      if (SL.audio.highlightNote) {
        SL.audio.highlightNote(step.note, true);
        (function(midi) {
          setTimeout(function() {
            if (SL.audio.highlightNote) {
              SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, false);
            }
          }, gateDurationMs);
        })(step.note);
      }
    }, stepIntervalMs);
  }

  function _phraseStop() {
    if (!_phraseRunning) {
      return;
    }
    _phraseRunning = false;

    if (_phraseTimerId) {
      clearInterval(_phraseTimerId);
      _phraseTimerId = null;
    }

    // Stop lingering note
    if (_phraseLastMidi >= 0) {
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_phraseLastMidi);
      _phraseLastMidi = -1;
    }

    // Remove step highlight
    if (_phraseCurrentStep >= 0 && _phraseStepEls[_phraseCurrentStep]) {
      _phraseStepEls[_phraseCurrentStep].classList.remove('active');
    }
    _phraseCurrentStep = -1;

    if (_phrasePlayBtn) {
      _phrasePlayBtn.classList.remove('playing');
      _phrasePlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6'; // play triangle
    }
  }

  function _buildPhraseSection() {
    // Initialize steps if empty
    if (_phraseSteps.length === 0) {
      _phraseInitSteps();
    }

    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'design-phrase-section';

    // Heading
    var heading = document.createElement('h4');
    var loopSvg = _svg('<path d="M12 3 L14 5 L12 7"/><path d="M14 5 L6 5 A3 3 0 0 0 3 8"/><path d="M4 13 L2 11 L4 9"/><path d="M2 11 L10 11 A3 3 0 0 0 13 8"/>');
    heading.innerHTML = loopSvg + ' 303 Phrase';
    container.appendChild(heading);

    // --- Transport row ---
    var transport = document.createElement('div');
    transport.className = 'design-phrase-transport';

    // Play/Stop button
    _phrasePlayBtn = document.createElement('button');
    _phrasePlayBtn.className = 'design-phrase-play-btn';
    _phrasePlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6'; // play triangle
    _phrasePlayBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (_phraseRunning) {
        _phraseStop();
      } else {
        _phraseStart();
      }
    });
    transport.appendChild(_phrasePlayBtn);

    // BPM label
    var bpmLabel = document.createElement('span');
    bpmLabel.style.cssText = 'font-size:0.7rem;color:#9999bb;';
    bpmLabel.textContent = 'BPM';
    transport.appendChild(bpmLabel);

    // BPM slider
    var bpmSlider = document.createElement('input');
    bpmSlider.type = 'range';
    bpmSlider.min = PHRASE_MIN_BPM;
    bpmSlider.max = PHRASE_MAX_BPM;
    bpmSlider.step = 1;
    bpmSlider.value = _phraseBpm;
    bpmSlider.style.cssText = 'width:80px;height:16px;cursor:pointer;';
    transport.appendChild(bpmSlider);

    var bpmVal = document.createElement('span');
    bpmVal.style.cssText = 'font-size:0.7rem;color:#c0c0dd;font-family:monospace;min-width:30px;';
    bpmVal.textContent = _phraseBpm;
    transport.appendChild(bpmVal);

    bpmSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      _phraseBpm = parseInt(bpmSlider.value);
      bpmVal.textContent = _phraseBpm;
      // Restart if running so new BPM takes effect
      if (_phraseRunning) {
        _phraseStop();
        _phraseStart();
      }
    });

    // Preset dropdown
    var presetSelect = document.createElement('select');
    presetSelect.className = 'design-select';
    presetSelect.style.maxWidth = '110px';
    var defaultOpt = document.createElement('option');
    defaultOpt.value = '';
    defaultOpt.textContent = '-- Pattern --';
    presetSelect.appendChild(defaultOpt);
    for (var pi = 0; pi < PHRASE_PRESETS.length; pi++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = pi;
      opt.textContent = PHRASE_PRESETS[pi].name;
      presetSelect.appendChild(opt);
    }
    presetSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (presetSelect.value !== '') {
        _phraseLoadPreset(parseInt(presetSelect.value));
      }
    });
    transport.appendChild(presetSelect);

    container.appendChild(transport);

    // --- Step Grid ---
    var grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'design-phrase-grid';
    _phraseStepEls = [];

    for (var si = 0; si < PHRASE_STEPS; si++) {
      var stepEl = document.createElement('div');
      stepEl.className = 'design-phrase-step';
      var step = _phraseSteps[si];
      if (step.rest) {
        stepEl.classList.add('rest');
      }

      // Note display
      var noteEl = document.createElement('div');
      noteEl.className = 'phrase-note';
      noteEl.textContent = step.rest ? '\u2014' : midiToName(step.note);
      stepEl.appendChild(noteEl);

      // Click to cycle note, right-click to toggle rest
      (function(idx) {
        noteEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _phraseCycleNote(idx, 1);
        });
        noteEl.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _phraseSetRest(idx);
        });
        // Scroll wheel to change note
        noteEl.addEventListener('wheel', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          var dir = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1;
          _phraseCycleNote(idx, dir);
        });
      })(si);

      // Accent toggle
      var accentBtn = document.createElement('button');
      accentBtn.className = 'design-phrase-accent' + (step.accent ? ' on' : '');
      accentBtn.textContent = '!';
      accentBtn.title = 'Accent';
      (function(idx) {
        accentBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          _phraseToggleAccent(idx);
        });
      })(si);
      stepEl.appendChild(accentBtn);

      // Slide toggle
      var slideBtn = document.createElement('button');
      slideBtn.className = 'design-phrase-slide' + (step.slide ? ' on' : '');
      slideBtn.textContent = '/';
      slideBtn.title = 'Slide';
      (function(idx) {
        slideBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          _phraseToggleSlide(idx);
        });
      })(si);
      stepEl.appendChild(slideBtn);

      grid.appendChild(stepEl);
      _phraseStepEls.push(stepEl);
    }

    container.appendChild(grid);

    // --- Controls row ---
    var controls = document.createElement('div');
    controls.className = 'design-phrase-controls';

    var octUpBtn = document.createElement('button');
    octUpBtn.className = 'design-btn';
    octUpBtn.textContent = 'Oct +';
    octUpBtn.title = 'Shift all notes up one octave';
    octUpBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _phraseShiftOctave(12);
    });
    controls.appendChild(octUpBtn);

    var octDownBtn = document.createElement('button');
    octDownBtn.className = 'design-btn';
    octDownBtn.textContent = 'Oct -';
    octDownBtn.title = 'Shift all notes down one octave';
    octDownBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _phraseShiftOctave(-12);
    });
    controls.appendChild(octDownBtn);

    var randomBtn = document.createElement('button');
    randomBtn.className = 'design-btn';
    randomBtn.textContent = 'Randomize';
    randomBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _phraseGenerateRandom();
      _phraseRefreshGrid();
    });
    controls.appendChild(randomBtn);

    var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
    clearBtn.className = 'design-btn';
    clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear';
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _phraseClear();
    });
    controls.appendChild(clearBtn);

    container.appendChild(controls);

    _enginePanelEl.appendChild(container);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Filter + ADSR + Noise Panel
  // ============================================================

  function _buildFilterPanel(type) {
    if (!_filterPanelEl) {
      return;
    }
    _filterPanelEl.innerHTML = '';

    var heading = document.createElement('h3');
    heading.innerHTML = (PARAM_SVGS['Filter / Envelope'] || '') + ' Filter / Envelope';
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(heading);

    // Some types (sampler, loop, midiout) don't have filter/ADSR
    if (type === 'sampler' || type === 'loop' || type === 'midiout') {
      var info = document.createElement('div');
      info.className = 'design-slider-row';
      info.innerHTML = '<span class="design-slider-label" style="min-width:auto;color:#666;">N/A for this type.</span>';
      _filterPanelEl.appendChild(info);
      return;
    }

    // --- Filter Section ---
    var fh = document.createElement('h4');
    fh.innerHTML = (PARAM_SVGS['Filter'] || '') + ' Filter';
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(fh);

    // Read real settings from the model
    var settings = SL.audio.getInstrumentSettings ? SL.audio.getInstrumentSettings() : null;
    var filterS = (settings && settings.filter) ? settings.filter : { enabled: true, type: 'lowpass', freq: 850, q: 10 };
    var adsrS = (settings && settings.adsr) ? settings.adsr : { a: 10, d: 100, s: 70, r: 200 };
    var noiseS = (settings && settings.noise) ? settings.noise : { type: 'white', level: 0 };

    // Filter enable
    var checkRow = document.createElement('div');
    checkRow.className = 'design-check-row';
    var checkLabel = document.createElement('label');
    var checkBox = document.createElement('input');
    checkBox.type = 'checkbox';
    checkBox.id = 'dFilterEnabled';
    checkBox.checked = !!filterS.enabled;
    checkBox.addEventListener('change', function() {
      _retriggerHold();
    });
    checkLabel.appendChild(checkBox);
    var checkSpan = document.createElement('span');
    checkSpan.textContent = ' Enable Filter';
    checkLabel.appendChild(checkSpan);
    checkRow.appendChild(checkLabel);
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(checkRow);

    // Filter type
    var ftRow = _makeSelectRow('Type', 'dFilterType', FILTER_TYPES, filterS.type || 'lowpass');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(ftRow);

    // Cutoff (log scale, 0-1000 maps to 20-20000 Hz)
    var cutoffVal = (filterS.freq !== undefined) ? filterS.freq : 850;
    var cutRow = _makeSliderRow('Cutoff', 'dFilterCutoff', 0, 1000, 1, cutoffVal, '');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(cutRow);
    // Update display with Hz value
    var cutSlider = cutRow.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    var cutValEl = cutRow.querySelector('.design-slider-val');
    if (cutSlider && cutValEl) {
      var _updateCutoffDisplay = function() {
        var v = parseFloat(cutSlider.value);
        var minLog = Math.log(20) / Math.LN10;
        var maxLog = Math.log(20000) / Math.LN10;
        var freq = Math.pow(10, minLog + (v / 1000) * (maxLog - minLog));
        if (freq >= 1000) {
          cutValEl.textContent = (freq / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k';
        } else {
          cutValEl.textContent = Math.round(freq) + 'Hz';
        }
      };
      _updateCutoffDisplay();
      cutSlider.addEventListener('input', _updateCutoffDisplay);
    }

    // Q / Resonance
    var qVal = (filterS.q !== undefined) ? filterS.q : 10;
    var qRow = _makeSliderRow('Q', 'dFilterQ', 0, 100, 1, qVal, '');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(qRow);

    // --- ADSR Section ---
    var ah = document.createElement('h4');
    ah.innerHTML = (PARAM_SVGS['Amp Envelope (ADSR)'] || '') + ' Amp Envelope (ADSR)';
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(ah);

    var atkRow = _makeSliderRow('Attack', 'dAdsrA', 0, 500, 1, adsrS.a, '');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(atkRow);

    var decRow = _makeSliderRow('Decay', 'dAdsrD', 0, 500, 1, adsrS.d, '');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(decRow);

    var susRow = _makeSliderRow('Sustain', 'dAdsrS', 0, 100, 1, adsrS.s, '%');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(susRow);

    var relRow = _makeSliderRow('Release', 'dAdsrR', 0, 1000, 1, adsrS.r, '');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(relRow);

    // --- Noise Section ---
    var nh = document.createElement('h4');
    nh.innerHTML = (PARAM_SVGS['Noise'] || '') + ' Noise';
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(nh);

    var ntRow = _makeSelectRow('Type', 'dNoiseType', NOISE_TYPES, noiseS.type || 'white');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(ntRow);

    var nlRow = _makeSliderRow('Level', 'dNoiseLevel', 0, 100, 1, noiseS.level || 0, '%');
    _filterPanelEl.appendChild(nlRow);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Write-back: sync design-page filter/ADSR/noise controls
    // to the audio engine settings model in real time.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    function _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise() {
      if (!SL.audio || !SL.audio.getInstrumentSettings) {
        return;
      }
      var s = SL.audio.getInstrumentSettings();
      if (!s) {
        return;
      }

      // --- Filter ---
      var dFiltEnabled = document.getElementById('dFilterEnabled');
      var dFiltType    = document.getElementById('dFilterType');
      var dFiltCutoff  = document.getElementById('dFilterCutoff');
      var dFiltQ       = document.getElementById('dFilterQ');
      if (dFiltEnabled) { s.filter.enabled = dFiltEnabled.checked; }
      if (dFiltType)    { s.filter.type    = dFiltType.value; }
      if (dFiltCutoff)  { s.filter.freq    = parseFloat(dFiltCutoff.value); }
      if (dFiltQ)       { s.filter.q       = parseFloat(dFiltQ.value); }

      // --- ADSR ---
      var dAtkEl = document.getElementById('dAdsrA');
      var dDecEl = document.getElementById('dAdsrD');
      var dSusEl = document.getElementById('dAdsrS');
      var dRelEl = document.getElementById('dAdsrR');
      if (dAtkEl) { s.adsr.a = parseFloat(dAtkEl.value); }
      if (dDecEl) { s.adsr.d = parseFloat(dDecEl.value); }
      if (dSusEl) { s.adsr.s = parseFloat(dSusEl.value); }
      if (dRelEl) { s.adsr.r = parseFloat(dRelEl.value); }

      // --- Noise ---
      var dNoiseTypeEl  = document.getElementById('dNoiseType');
      var dNoiseLevelEl = document.getElementById('dNoiseLevel');
      if (dNoiseTypeEl)  { s.noise.type  = dNoiseTypeEl.value; }
      if (dNoiseLevelEl) { s.noise.level = parseFloat(dNoiseLevelEl.value); }

      // Mirror design-page values to the main-page DOM controls so that
      // getFilterSettings(), getADSR(), and getNoiseSettings() (which read
      // from those elements) pick up the updated values.
      var _mainFilterEnabled = document.getElementById('filterEnabled');
      var _mainFilterType    = document.getElementById('filterType');
      var _mainFilterFreq    = document.getElementById('filterFreq');
      var _mainFilterQ       = document.getElementById('filterQ');
      if (_mainFilterEnabled && dFiltEnabled) { _mainFilterEnabled.checked = dFiltEnabled.checked; }
      if (_mainFilterType && dFiltType)       { _mainFilterType.value = dFiltType.value; }
      if (_mainFilterFreq && dFiltCutoff)     { _mainFilterFreq.value = dFiltCutoff.value; }
      if (_mainFilterQ && dFiltQ)             { _mainFilterQ.value = dFiltQ.value; }

      var _mainAdsrA = document.getElementById('adsrA');
      var _mainAdsrD = document.getElementById('adsrD');
      var _mainAdsrS = document.getElementById('adsrS');
      var _mainAdsrR = document.getElementById('adsrR');
      if (_mainAdsrA && dAtkEl) { _mainAdsrA.value = dAtkEl.value; }
      if (_mainAdsrD && dDecEl) { _mainAdsrD.value = dDecEl.value; }
      if (_mainAdsrS && dSusEl) { _mainAdsrS.value = dSusEl.value; }
      if (_mainAdsrR && dRelEl) { _mainAdsrR.value = dRelEl.value; }

      var _mainNoiseType  = document.getElementById('noiseType');
      var _mainNoiseLevel = document.getElementById('noiseLevel');
      if (_mainNoiseType && dNoiseTypeEl)   { _mainNoiseType.value = dNoiseTypeEl.value; }
      if (_mainNoiseLevel && dNoiseLevelEl) { _mainNoiseLevel.value = dNoiseLevelEl.value; }

      // Now push updated settings to the audio engine
      if (SL.audio.refreshFilter) {
        SL.audio.refreshFilter();
      }
      if (SL.audio.updateWorkletFilter) {
        var instIdx = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
        SL.audio.updateWorkletFilter(instIdx);
      }
      if (SL.audio.restartContinuousNoise) {
        SL.audio.restartContinuousNoise();
      }

      // Retrigger the preview/held note so the change is immediately audible
      _retriggerHold();
    }

    // Attach write-back listeners to filter controls
    var _dFilterEnabledEl = document.getElementById('dFilterEnabled');
    if (_dFilterEnabledEl) {
      _dFilterEnabledEl.addEventListener('change', _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise);
    }
    var _dFilterTypeSel = ftRow.querySelector('select');
    if (_dFilterTypeSel) {
      _dFilterTypeSel.addEventListener('change', _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise);
    }
    var _dCutoffSlider = cutRow.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    if (_dCutoffSlider) {
      _dCutoffSlider.addEventListener('input', _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise);
    }
    var _dQSlider = qRow.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    if (_dQSlider) {
      _dQSlider.addEventListener('input', _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise);
    }

    // Attach write-back listeners to ADSR controls
    var _dAtkSlider = atkRow.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    if (_dAtkSlider) {
      _dAtkSlider.addEventListener('input', _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise);
    }
    var _dDecSlider = decRow.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    if (_dDecSlider) {
      _dDecSlider.addEventListener('input', _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise);
    }
    var _dSusSlider = susRow.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    if (_dSusSlider) {
      _dSusSlider.addEventListener('input', _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise);
    }
    var _dRelSlider = relRow.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    if (_dRelSlider) {
      _dRelSlider.addEventListener('input', _syncDesignFilterAdsrNoise);
    }

    // Attach write-back listeners to noise controls
    var _dNoiseTypeSel = ntRow.querySelector('select');

  // ============================================================
  // Chladni Pattern Visualization
  // ============================================================

  function _chladniValue(x, y, n, m) {
    // Chladni equation: cos(n*PI*x)*cos(m*PI*y) - cos(m*PI*x)*cos(n*PI*y)
    // x, y are normalized 0-1; nodal lines are where result equals 0
    return Math.cos(n * Math.PI * x) * Math.cos(m * Math.PI * y)
         - Math.cos(m * Math.PI * x) * Math.cos(n * Math.PI * y);
  }

  function _chladniInitParticles() {
    _chladniParticles = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < CHLADNI_PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
      _chladniParticles.push({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random()
      });
    }
  }

  function _chladniUpdateFromAudio() {
    var analyser = SL.audio.getAnalyser ? SL.audio.getAnalyser() : null;
    if (!analyser) {
      // No analyser: slowly cycle through default patterns
      _chladniCycleTime += CHLADNI_CYCLE_SPEED;
      var cyclePhase = _chladniCycleTime;
      // Cycle n between 2 and 7, m between 3 and 9
      var CYCLE_N_MIN = 2;
      var CYCLE_N_RANGE = 5;
      var CYCLE_M_MIN = 3;
      var CYCLE_M_RANGE = 6;
      _chladniTargetN = CYCLE_N_MIN + Math.abs(Math.sin(cyclePhase)) * CYCLE_N_RANGE;
      _chladniTargetM = CYCLE_M_MIN + Math.abs(Math.cos(cyclePhase * 0.7)) * CYCLE_M_RANGE;
    }
    else {
      // Read frequency data to find dominant frequency
      var bufLen = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
      var freqData = new Uint8Array(bufLen);
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);

      // Find peak frequency bin
      var maxVal = 0;
      var maxIdx = 0;
      var AUDIO_SILENCE_THRESHOLD = 20;
      for (var i = 0; i < bufLen; i++) {
        if (freqData[i] > maxVal) {
          maxVal = freqData[i];
          maxIdx = i;
        }
      }

      if (maxVal > AUDIO_SILENCE_THRESHOLD) {
        // Convert bin index to approximate frequency
        var sampleRate = SL.audio.ctx ? SL.audio.ctx.sampleRate : 44100;
        var DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE = 44100;
        var freq = maxIdx * (sampleRate || DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE) / (bufLen * 2);

        // Map frequency to n and m parameters
        var rawN = Math.floor(freq / CHLADNI_FREQ_DIVISOR_N);
        var rawM = Math.floor(freq / CHLADNI_FREQ_DIVISOR_M) + 1;
        _chladniTargetN = Math.max(CHLADNI_NM_MIN, Math.min(CHLADNI_NM_MAX, rawN));
        _chladniTargetM = Math.max(CHLADNI_NM_MIN, Math.min(CHLADNI_NM_MAX, rawM));

        // Ensure n != m for more interesting patterns
        if (_chladniTargetN === _chladniTargetM) {
          _chladniTargetM = _chladniTargetM + 1;
          if (_chladniTargetM > CHLADNI_NM_MAX) {
            _chladniTargetM = CHLADNI_NM_MAX - 1;
          }
        }
      }
      else {
        // Silence: cycle through defaults
        _chladniCycleTime += CHLADNI_CYCLE_SPEED;
        var CYCLE_N_MIN2 = 2;
        var CYCLE_N_RANGE2 = 5;
        var CYCLE_M_MIN2 = 3;
        var CYCLE_M_RANGE2 = 6;
        _chladniTargetN = CYCLE_N_MIN2 + Math.abs(Math.sin(_chladniCycleTime)) * CYCLE_N_RANGE2;
        _chladniTargetM = CYCLE_M_MIN2 + Math.abs(Math.cos(_chladniCycleTime * 0.7)) * CYCLE_M_RANGE2;
      }
    }

    // Smoothly interpolate current n/m toward target
    _chladniN += (_chladniTargetN - _chladniN) * CHLADNI_SMOOTH_FACTOR;
    _chladniM += (_chladniTargetM - _chladniM) * CHLADNI_SMOOTH_FACTOR;
  }

  function _chladniUpdateParticles() {
    for (var i = 0; i < _chladniParticles.length; i++) {
      var p = _chladniParticles[i];
      var val = _chladniValue(p.x, p.y, _chladniN, _chladniM);
      var absVal = Math.abs(val);

      if (absVal < CHLADNI_NODAL_THRESHOLD) {
        // Particle is on/near a nodal line — add slight vibration
        p.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * CHLADNI_JITTER_AMOUNT;
        p.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * CHLADNI_JITTER_AMOUNT;
      }
      else {
        // Compute gradient of |chladniValue| using finite differences
        var valPx = Math.abs(_chladniValue(p.x + CHLADNI_GRADIENT_EPSILON, p.y, _chladniN, _chladniM));
        var valNx = Math.abs(_chladniValue(p.x - CHLADNI_GRADIENT_EPSILON, p.y, _chladniN, _chladniM));
        var valPy = Math.abs(_chladniValue(p.x, p.y + CHLADNI_GRADIENT_EPSILON, _chladniN, _chladniM));
        var valNy = Math.abs(_chladniValue(p.x, p.y - CHLADNI_GRADIENT_EPSILON, _chladniN, _chladniM));

        var GRADIENT_SCALE = 0.5;  // normalizes the finite difference
        var gradX = (valPx - valNx) * GRADIENT_SCALE / CHLADNI_GRADIENT_EPSILON;
        var gradY = (valPy - valNy) * GRADIENT_SCALE / CHLADNI_GRADIENT_EPSILON;

        // Move particle down the gradient (toward nodal lines)
        p.x -= gradX * CHLADNI_SETTLE_SPEED;
        p.y -= gradY * CHLADNI_SETTLE_SPEED;

        // Add small random jitter for organic feel
        p.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * CHLADNI_JITTER_AMOUNT;
        p.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * CHLADNI_JITTER_AMOUNT;
      }

      // Clamp to [0, 1]
      if (p.x < 0) { p.x = 0; }
      if (p.x > 1) { p.x = 1; }
      if (p.y < 0) { p.y = 0; }
      if (p.y > 1) { p.y = 1; }
    }
  }

  function _chladniRender() {
    if (!_chladniCtx || !_chladniCanvas) {
      return;
    }

    var size = CHLADNI_SIZE;
    var ctx = _chladniCtx;

    // Clear background
    ctx.fillStyle = CHLADNI_BG_COLOR;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

    // Draw particles
    // Use two passes: dim particles first, then bright nodal ones on top
    var BRIGHT_OPACITY = 0.9;
    var DIM_OPACITY_MIN = 0.15;
    var DIM_OPACITY_RANGE = 0.35;
    var PROXIMITY_SCALE = 5; // multiplier to map absVal to opacity falloff

    for (var i = 0; i < _chladniParticles.length; i++) {
      var p = _chladniParticles[i];
      var px = p.x * size;
      var py = p.y * size;
      var val = Math.abs(_chladniValue(p.x, p.y, _chladniN, _chladniM));

      if (val < CHLADNI_NODAL_THRESHOLD) {
        // Bright particle on nodal line
        ctx.globalAlpha = BRIGHT_OPACITY;
        ctx.fillStyle = CHLADNI_LINE_COLOR;
        ctx.fillRect(
          px - CHLADNI_PARTICLE_SIZE_NODAL * 0.5,
          py - CHLADNI_PARTICLE_SIZE_NODAL * 0.5,
          CHLADNI_PARTICLE_SIZE_NODAL,
          CHLADNI_PARTICLE_SIZE_NODAL
        );
      }
      else {
        // Dimmer particle still settling
        var opacity = Math.max(DIM_OPACITY_MIN, DIM_OPACITY_MIN + DIM_OPACITY_RANGE - val * PROXIMITY_SCALE * DIM_OPACITY_RANGE);
        ctx.globalAlpha = opacity;
        ctx.fillStyle = CHLADNI_LINE_COLOR;
        ctx.fillRect(
          px - CHLADNI_PARTICLE_SIZE_NORMAL * 0.5,
          py - CHLADNI_PARTICLE_SIZE_NORMAL * 0.5,
          CHLADNI_PARTICLE_SIZE_NORMAL,
          CHLADNI_PARTICLE_SIZE_NORMAL
        );
      }
    }

    // Draw subtle glow overlay for nodal concentration
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15;
    ctx.shadowColor = CHLADNI_LINE_COLOR;
    ctx.shadowBlur = CHLADNI_GLOW_RADIUS;
    // Scan a subset of particles for glow effect (performance)
    var GLOW_SAMPLE_STEP = 5;
    for (var j = 0; j < _chladniParticles.length; j += GLOW_SAMPLE_STEP) {
      var gp = _chladniParticles[j];
      var gVal = Math.abs(_chladniValue(gp.x, gp.y, _chladniN, _chladniM));
      if (gVal < CHLADNI_NODAL_THRESHOLD) {
        ctx.fillStyle = CHLADNI_LINE_COLOR;
        ctx.fillRect(gp.x * size - 1, gp.y * size - 1, 2, 2);
      }
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
  }

  function _chladniAnimate() {
    if (!_chladniActive) {
      return;
    }
    _chladniUpdateFromAudio();
    _chladniUpdateParticles();
    _chladniRender();
    _chladniTimerId = setTimeout(_chladniAnimate, CHLADNI_FRAME_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  function _startChladni() {
    if (_chladniActive) {
      return;
    }
    _chladniActive = true;
    if (_chladniParticles.length === 0) {
      _chladniInitParticles();
    }
    _chladniAnimate();
  }

  function _stopChladni() {
    _chladniActive = false;
    if (_chladniTimerId) {
      clearTimeout(_chladniTimerId);
      _chladniTimerId = null;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Scope Animation
  // ============================================================

  function _drawWaveform() {
    if (!_active) {
      return;
    }
    _waveformAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(_drawWaveform);

    var analyser = SL.audio.getAnalyser ? SL.audio.getAnalyser() : null;
    if (!analyser || !_waveformCtx || !_waveformCanvas) {
      return;
    }

    if (!_waveformData || _waveformData.length !== analyser.fftSize) {
      _waveformData = new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);
    }
    analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(_waveformData);

    var w = _waveformCanvas._dw;
    var h = _waveformCanvas._dh;
    var ctx = _waveformCtx;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a14';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Center line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222244';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(w, h / 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Waveform
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4cc9f0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    var sliceW = w / _waveformData.length;
    var x = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < _waveformData.length; i++) {
      var v = _waveformData[i] / 128.0;
      var y = (v * h) / 2;
      if (i === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      x += sliceW;
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function _drawSpectrum() {
    if (!_active) {
      return;
    }
    _spectrumAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(_drawSpectrum);

    var analyser = SL.audio.getAnalyser ? SL.audio.getAnalyser() : null;
    if (!analyser || !_spectrumCtx || !_spectrumCanvas) {
      return;
    }

    var bufLen = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
    if (!_spectrumData || _spectrumData.length !== bufLen) {
      _spectrumData = new Uint8Array(bufLen);
    }
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(_spectrumData);

    var w = _spectrumCanvas._dw;
    var h = _spectrumCanvas._dh;
    var ctx = _spectrumCtx;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a14';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    var barW = w / bufLen;
    if (barW < 1) {
      barW = 1;
    }
    var numBars = Math.min(bufLen, Math.floor(w / barW));
    var step = Math.ceil(bufLen / numBars);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#7b2ff7';
    for (var i = 0; i < numBars; i++) {
      var idx = i * step;
      if (idx >= bufLen) {
        break;
      }
      var val = _spectrumData[idx];
      var barH = (val / 255) * h;
      ctx.fillRect(i * (w / numBars), h - barH, (w / numBars) - 1, barH);
    }
  }

  function _startScope() {
    if (!_waveformAnimId) {
      _drawWaveform();
    }
    if (!_spectrumAnimId) {
      _drawSpectrum();
    }
    _startChladni();
  }

  function _stopScope() {
    if (_waveformAnimId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(_waveformAnimId);
      _waveformAnimId = null;
    }
    if (_spectrumAnimId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(_spectrumAnimId);
      _spectrumAnimId = null;
    }
    _stopChladni();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Mini Keyboard (1 octave)
  // ============================================================

  function _buildMiniKeyboard() {
    if (!_miniKbEl) {
      return;
    }
    _miniKbEl.innerHTML = '';

    var startMidi = (MINI_KB_BASE_OCTAVE + 1) * 12;
    var endMidi = startMidi + 12;

    for (var midi = startMidi; midi <= endMidi; midi++) {
      var pc = midi % 12;
      var black = isBlackKey(pc);

      var keyEl = document.createElement('div');
      keyEl.className = 'design-mini-key ' + (black ? 'mini-black' : 'mini-white');
      keyEl.setAttribute('data-midi', midi);

      var lbl = document.createElement('span');
      lbl.style.fontSize = '0.55rem';
      lbl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      lbl.textContent = midiToName(midi);
      keyEl.appendChild(lbl);

      (function(m, el) {
        el.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _miniNoteOn(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
          _miniNoteOff(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(e) {
          if (e.buttons === 0) {
            _miniNoteOff(m);
          }
        });
        el.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(e) {
          if (e.buttons > 0) {
            _miniNoteOn(m);
          }
        });
        el.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _miniNoteOn(m);
        });
        el.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _miniNoteOff(m);
        });
      })(midi, keyEl);

      _miniKbEl.appendChild(keyEl);
    }
  }

  function _miniNoteOn(midi) {
    // If hold is active, switch the held note
    if (_holdActive) {
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
      _highlightMiniKey(_holdMidi, false);
      _holdMidi = midi;
      SL.audio.startSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
      _highlightMiniKey(_holdMidi, true);
      var noteDisplay = document.getElementById('designHoldNote');
      if (noteDisplay) {
        noteDisplay.textContent = midiToName(_holdMidi);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (_miniKbNotes[midi]) {
      return;
    }
    _miniKbNotes[midi] = true;
    SL.audio.startSustainedNote(midi);
    _highlightMiniKey(midi, true);
  }

  function _miniNoteOff(midi) {
    // Don't release if hold is active — note stays held
    if (_holdActive && midi === _holdMidi) {
      return;
    }
    if (!_miniKbNotes[midi]) {
      return;
    }
    delete _miniKbNotes[midi];
    SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi);
    _highlightMiniKey(midi, false);
  }

  function _highlightMiniKey(midi, on) {
    if (!_miniKbEl) {
      return;
    }
    var keys = _miniKbEl.querySelectorAll('[data-midi="' + midi + '"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      if (on) {
        keys[i].classList.add('mini-active');
      } else {
        keys[i].classList.remove('mini-active');
      }
    }
  }

  function _stopAllMiniNotes() {
    var midiKeys = Object.keys(_miniKbNotes);
    for (var i = 0; i < midiKeys.length; i++) {
      var midi = parseInt(midiKeys[i]);
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi);
      _highlightMiniKey(midi, false);
    }
    _miniKbNotes = {};
  }

  function _populatePresetCategories() {
    if (!_catSelectEl) {
      return;
    }

    var instType = _getCurrentType();
    var categories = SL.presets && SL.presets.getCategories
      ? SL.presets.getCategories(instType)
      : [];

    _catSelectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Category --</option>';
    for (var i = 0; i < categories.length; i++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = categories[i];
      opt.textContent = categories[i];
      _catSelectEl.appendChild(opt);
    }

    if (_presetSelectEl) {
      _presetSelectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Preset --</option>';
    }
    _presetList = [];
  }

  function _populatePresetList(category) {
    if (!_presetSelectEl) {
      return;
    }

    var instType = _getCurrentType();
    _presetList = SL.presets && SL.presets.getPresetsByCategory
      ? SL.presets.getPresetsByCategory(instType, category)
      : [];

    _presetSelectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Preset --</option>';
    for (var i = 0; i < _presetList.length; i++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = i;
      opt.textContent = _presetList[i].name;
      _presetSelectEl.appendChild(opt);
    }
  }

  function _applySelectedPreset() {
    if (!_presetSelectEl || _presetSelectEl.value === '') {
      return;
    }
    var idx = parseInt(_presetSelectEl.value);
    var preset = _presetList[idx];
    if (!preset) {
      return;
    }

    var instIndex = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var instType = _getCurrentType();
    var fnName = PRESET_APPLY_MAP[instType];
    if (fnName && SL.presets && SL.presets[fnName]) {
      SL.presets[fnName](preset, instIndex);
    }

    // Rebuild panels to reflect new preset values
    _buildEnginePanel(instType);
    _buildFilterPanel(instType);

    // Restart held note so user hears the new preset immediately
    if (_holdActive) {
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
      SL.audio.startSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
    }
  }

  function _applyRandomPreset() {
    var instType = _getCurrentType();
    // Get all presets for this type
    var allPresets = [];
    var categories = SL.presets && SL.presets.getCategories
      ? SL.presets.getCategories(instType)
      : [];
    for (var c = 0; c < categories.length; c++) {
      var pList = SL.presets && SL.presets.getPresetsByCategory
        ? SL.presets.getPresetsByCategory(instType, categories[c])
        : [];
      for (var p = 0; p < pList.length; p++) {
        allPresets.push(pList[p]);
      }
    }

    if (allPresets.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    var randIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * allPresets.length);
    var preset = allPresets[randIdx];
    var instIndex = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
    var fnName = PRESET_APPLY_MAP[instType];
    if (fnName && SL.presets && SL.presets[fnName]) {
      SL.presets[fnName](preset, instIndex);
    }

    // Rebuild panels to reflect new preset values
    _buildEnginePanel(instType);
    _buildFilterPanel(instType);
  }

  function _onInstrumentChange() {
    if (!_instSelectEl) {
      return;
    }
    var instIdx = parseInt(_instSelectEl.value);
    SL.audio.setCurrentInstrument(instIdx);
    var type = _getCurrentType();
    _buildTypeButtons();
    _buildEnginePanel(type);
    _buildFilterPanel(type);
    _populatePresetCategories();
    if (SL.state) { SL.state.notify('instrument'); }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init / Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _init() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }

    _instSelectEl = document.getElementById('designInstSelect');
    _typeGridEl = document.getElementById('designTypeButtons');
    _catSelectEl = document.getElementById('designPresetCat');
    _presetSelectEl = document.getElementById('designPresetList');
    _enginePanelEl = document.getElementById('designEnginePanel');
    _filterPanelEl = document.getElementById('designFilterPanel');
    _scopePanelEl = document.getElementById('designScopePanel');
    _miniKbEl = document.getElementById('designMiniKeyboard');

    // Wire up event listeners
    if (_instSelectEl) {
      // Populate instrument select
      _instSelectEl.innerHTML = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < INSTRUMENT_LABELS.length; i++) {
        var opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = i;
        opt.textContent = INSTRUMENT_LABELS[i];
        _instSelectEl.appendChild(opt);
      }
      _instSelectEl.addEventListener('change', _onInstrumentChange);
    }

    if (_catSelectEl) {
      _catSelectEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var cat = _catSelectEl.value;
        if (cat) {
          _populatePresetList(cat);
        } else {
          if (_presetSelectEl) {
            _presetSelectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Preset --</option>';
          }
          _presetList = [];
        }
      });
    }

    var applyBtn = document.getElementById('designPresetApply');
    if (applyBtn) {
      applyBtn.addEventListener('click', _applySelectedPreset);
    }

    var randomBtn = document.getElementById('designPresetRandom');
    if (randomBtn) {
      randomBtn.addEventListener('click', _applyRandomPreset);
    }

    // Hold toggle button
    var holdBtn = document.getElementById('designHoldToggle');
    if (holdBtn) {
      holdBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _holdActive = !_holdActive;
        var noteDisplay = document.getElementById('designHoldNote');
        if (_holdActive) {
          holdBtn.classList.add('active');
          holdBtn.textContent = 'HOLD ON';
          SL.audio.startSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
          _highlightMiniKey(_holdMidi, true);
          if (noteDisplay) {
            noteDisplay.textContent = midiToName(_holdMidi);
          }
        } else {
          holdBtn.classList.remove('active');
          holdBtn.textContent = 'Hold Note';
          SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
          _highlightMiniKey(_holdMidi, false);
          if (noteDisplay) {
            noteDisplay.textContent = '';
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Add shared transport and nav links
    var container = document.getElementById('screen-design');
    if (container) {
      var navBar = document.createElement('div');
      navBar.style.cssText = 'padding:4px 8px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;';

      var transportDiv = document.createElement('div');
      transportDiv.id = 'design-transport';
      transportDiv.className = 'shared-transport-container';
      navBar.appendChild(transportDiv);

      var perfLink = document.createElement('button');
      perfLink.className = 'screen-nav-link';
      perfLink.textContent = '\u2192 Perform';
      perfLink.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.screens) { SL.screens.switchTo('perform'); }
      });
      navBar.appendChild(perfLink);

      var seqLink = document.createElement('button');
      seqLink.className = 'screen-nav-link';
      seqLink.textContent = '\u2192 Sequence';
      seqLink.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.screens) { SL.screens.switchTo('sequence'); }
      });
      navBar.appendChild(seqLink);

      container.appendChild(navBar);
    }

    _initialized = true;
  }

  function _syncFromModel() {
    var instId = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();

    // Sync instrument selector
    if (_instSelectEl) {
      _instSelectEl.value = instId;
    }

    var type = _getCurrentType();
    _buildTypeButtons();
    _buildEnginePanel(type);
    _buildFilterPanel(type);
    _populatePresetCategories();
  }

  function activate() {
    _init();
    _active = true;

    _syncFromModel();
    _buildScopePanel();
    _buildMiniKeyboard();
    _startScope();
    if (SL.sharedTransport) {
      SL.sharedTransport.build('design-transport');
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    // Stop 303 phrase if running
    _phraseStop();
    // Stop held note
    if (_holdActive) {
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_holdMidi);
      _holdActive = false;
      var holdBtn = document.getElementById('designHoldToggle');
      if (holdBtn) {
        holdBtn.classList.remove('active');
        holdBtn.textContent = 'Hold Note';
      }
      var noteDisplay = document.getElementById('designHoldNote');
      if (noteDisplay) {
        noteDisplay.textContent = '';
      }
    }
    _stopAllMiniNotes();
    _stopScope();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenDesign = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };
})();


// === screen-sequence.js ===
// SuperSynthLab - SEQUENCE Screen Module
// Composition-focused view: note sequencer piano roll, transport, page navigation
// Lazy-initialized on first switch to the sequence screen.
// ES5 compatible (var, no arrow functions, no template literals)
(function() {
  'use strict';

  var SL = window.SynthLab;

  // ============================================================
  // Constants
  // ============================================================

  var NOTES = SL.NOTES;
  var SEQ_BASE_MIDI = 12;       // C0 — extended low range for bass
  var TOTAL_ROWS = 96;          // 8 octaves of piano roll (C0-B7, MIDI 12-107)
  var STEPS_PER_PAGE = 64;
  var STEPS_VISIBLE = 64;       // columns visible in grid
  var ROW_HEIGHT = 16;          // px per row
  var CELL_MIN_WIDTH = 12;      // px per step
  var BLACK_KEYS = [1, 3, 6, 8, 10];
  var INSTRUMENT_LABELS = ['1-Bass', '2-Lead', '3-Pad', '4-Sampler', '5-Loop'];
  var INST_COLORS = ['#f72585', '#7209b7', '#4361ee', '#4cc9f0', '#06d6a0'];
  var DEFAULT_NOTE_DUR = 4;     // default note duration in steps
  var DEFAULT_BPM = 120;
  var ANIM_INTERVAL_MS = 50;    // playhead update rate

  // Chord panel constants
  var CHORD_FUNC_TONIC = 'tonic';
  var CHORD_FUNC_SUBDOMINANT = 'subdominant';
  var CHORD_FUNC_DOMINANT = 'dominant';
  // Degree function map: I=tonic, ii=subdominant, iii=tonic, IV=subdominant, V=dominant, vi=tonic, vii=dominant
  var DEGREE_FUNCTIONS = [CHORD_FUNC_TONIC, CHORD_FUNC_SUBDOMINANT, CHORD_FUNC_TONIC,
    CHORD_FUNC_SUBDOMINANT, CHORD_FUNC_DOMINANT, CHORD_FUNC_TONIC, CHORD_FUNC_DOMINANT];
  var CHORD_EXTENSION_TYPES = [
    { key: '7', label: '+7' },
    { key: 'maj7', label: '+M7' },
    { key: 'sus2', label: 'sus2' },
    { key: 'sus4', label: 'sus4' }
  ];
  var QUICK_PROGRESSIONS = [
    { label: 'I - V - vi - IV (Pop)', degrees: [0, 4, 5, 3] },
    { label: 'I - IV - V - I (Classical)', degrees: [0, 3, 4, 0] },
    { label: 'ii - V - I (Jazz)', degrees: [1, 4, 0] },
    { label: 'I - vi - IV - V (50s)', degrees: [0, 5, 3, 4] },
    { label: 'i - VII - VI - V (Andalusian)', degrees: [0, 6, 5, 4] },
    { label: 'I - IV - vi - V (Axis)', degrees: [0, 3, 5, 4] },
    { label: 'vi - IV - I - V (Emo/Pop punk)', degrees: [5, 3, 0, 4] }
  ];

  // ============================================================
  // State
  // ============================================================

  var _initialized = false;
  var _active = false;
  var _currentInst = 0;
  var _loopEnabled = true;
  var _animFrameId = null;

  // Drag-to-move state
  var _dragNote = null;
  var _dragNoteIdx = -1;
  var _dragStartX = 0;
  var _dragStartY = 0;
  var _dragOrigRow = 0;
  var _dragOrigStart = 0;
  var _isDragging = false;

  // Resize state
  var _resizeNote = null;
  var _resizeNoteIdx = -1;
  var _resizeStartX = 0;
  var _resizeOrigDur = 0;
  var _isResizing = false;

  // Scale filter state
  var _scaleFilterEnabled = false;

  // Chord panel state
  var _chordRoot = 0;           // 0=C, 1=C#, etc.
  var _chordMode = 'ionian';    // mode key into SL.MODES
  var _armedChord = null;       // {notes: [midi...], name: 'Cmaj', degree: 0, func: 'tonic'}
  var _chordDuration = 16;      // steps (1 bar default)
  var _chordInversion = 0;      // 0=root, 1=1st, 2=2nd
  var _chordVoicing = 'close';  // 'close' or 'open'
  var _chordOctaveOffset = 0;   // -2 to +2
  var _chordExtension = null;   // null or extension type key

  // DOM references
  var _bpmInput = null;
  var _timeSigSelect = null;
  var _playBtn = null;
  var _stopBtn = null;
  var _clearBtn = null;
  var _loopBtn = null;
  var _pagePrevBtn = null;
  var _pageNextBtn = null;
  var _pageAddBtn = null;
  var _pageDelBtn = null;
  var _pageIndicator = null;
  var _instSelect = null;
  var _gridContainer = null;
  var _keysContainer = null;
  var _playheadEl = null;
  var _pageListEl = null;
  var _midiExportBtn = null;
  var _midiImportBtn = null;
  var _scaleFilterBtn = null;

  // Chord panel DOM references
  var _chordRootBtnsEl = null;
  var _chordModeSelect = null;
  var _chordKeyDisplayEl = null;
  var _chordPaletteEl = null;
  var _chordExtensionsEl = null;
  var _chordDurationSelect = null;
  var _chordInvBtnsEl = null;
  var _chordVoicingBtnsEl = null;
  var _chordOctBtnsEl = null;
  var _chordProgSelect = null;
  var _chordFillBtn = null;
  var _chordClearBtn = null;
  var _chordMapEl = null;

  // ============================================================
  // Helpers
  // ============================================================

  function _midiToName(midi) {
    var pc = midi % 12;
    var oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
    return NOTES[pc] + oct;
  }

  function _isBlack(pc) {
    for (var i = 0; i < BLACK_KEYS.length; i++) {
      if (BLACK_KEYS[i] === pc) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function _getBpm() {
    if (_bpmInput) {
      var val = parseInt(_bpmInput.value);
      if (val > 0) {
        return val;
      }
    }
    return DEFAULT_BPM;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Grid Builder
  // ============================================================

  function _buildKeys() {
    if (!_keysContainer) {
      return;
    }
    _keysContainer.innerHTML = '';
    for (var r = TOTAL_ROWS - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
      var midi = SEQ_BASE_MIDI + r;
      var pc = midi % 12;
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'seq-screen-key';
      if (_isBlack(pc)) {
        div.className += ' black';
      } else {
        div.className += ' white';
      }
      if (pc === 0) {
        div.className += ' c-note';
      }
      // Scale filter: hide keys not in the current scale
      if (_scaleFilterEnabled && !_isNoteInScale(pc)) {
        div.className += ' seq-row-hidden';
      }
      div.textContent = _midiToName(midi);
      _keysContainer.appendChild(div);
    }
  }

  function _isNoteInScale(pitchClass) {
    var mode = SL.MODES[_chordMode];
    if (!mode) {
      return true;
    }
    var scaleIntervals = mode.scale;
    var relPc = ((pitchClass - _chordRoot) % 12 + 12) % 12;
    for (var si = 0; si < scaleIntervals.length; si++) {
      if (scaleIntervals[si] === relPc) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function _buildGrid() {
    if (!_gridContainer) {
      return;
    }
    _gridContainer.innerHTML = '';
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;

    for (var r = TOTAL_ROWS - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
      var rowDiv = document.createElement('div');
      rowDiv.className = 'seq-screen-row';
      var midi = SEQ_BASE_MIDI + r;
      var pc = midi % 12;

      // Scale filter: hide rows not in the current scale
      if (_scaleFilterEnabled && !_isNoteInScale(pc)) {
        rowDiv.className += ' seq-row-hidden';
      }

      for (var c = 0; c < STEPS_VISIBLE; c++) {
        var cell = document.createElement('div');
        cell.className = 'seq-screen-cell';
        if (c % 16 === 0) {
          cell.className += ' bar-line';
        } else if (c % 4 === 0) {
          cell.className += ' beat-line';
        }
        cell.setAttribute('data-row', r);
        cell.setAttribute('data-col', c);
        cell.setAttribute('data-midi', midi);
        cell.addEventListener('click', _onCellClick);
        rowDiv.appendChild(cell);
      }
      _gridContainer.appendChild(rowDiv);
    }

    // Add playhead
    if (!_playheadEl) {
      _playheadEl = document.createElement('div');
      _playheadEl.className = 'seq-screen-playhead';
      _playheadEl.style.left = '-2px';
    }
    _gridContainer.appendChild(_playheadEl);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Octave Jump Bar
  // ============================================================

  var OCTAVE_MIN = 0;  // lowest octave shown (C0 = MIDI 12)
  var OCTAVE_MAX = 7;  // highest octave shown (C7 = MIDI 96)

  function _buildOctaveBar() {
    var gridArea = _gridContainer ? _gridContainer.parentNode.parentNode : null;
    if (!gridArea) {
      return;
    }
    // Remove existing octave bar if present
    var existing = gridArea.querySelector('.seq-octave-bar');
    if (existing) {
      existing.parentNode.removeChild(existing);
    }

    var bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'seq-octave-bar';

    var label = document.createElement('span');
    label.className = 'seq-octave-label';
    label.textContent = 'Oct:';
    bar.appendChild(label);

    for (var oct = OCTAVE_MAX; oct >= OCTAVE_MIN; oct--) {
      (function(octave) {
        var btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'seq-octave-btn';
        btn.textContent = octave;
        btn.title = 'Scroll to octave ' + octave + ' (C' + octave + ')';
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          _scrollToOctave(octave);
        });
        bar.appendChild(btn);
      })(oct);
    }

    // Insert before the grid wrap
    var gridWrap = gridArea.querySelector('.seq-screen-grid-wrap');
    if (gridWrap) {
      gridArea.insertBefore(bar, gridWrap);
    } else {
      gridArea.appendChild(bar);
    }
  }

  function _scrollToOctave(octave) {
    var gridWrap = _gridContainer ? _gridContainer.parentNode : null;
    if (!gridWrap) {
      return;
    }
    // MIDI note for C of the given octave: C1=24, C2=36, C3=48, C4=60, etc.
    // MIDI Cn = (n + 1) * 12
    var targetMidi = (octave + 1) * 12;
    var targetRow = targetMidi - SEQ_BASE_MIDI;
    // Clamp
    if (targetRow < 0) {
      targetRow = 0;
    }
    if (targetRow >= TOTAL_ROWS) {
      targetRow = TOTAL_ROWS - 1;
    }
    // Rows are rendered top-to-bottom: row (TOTAL_ROWS-1) is at top, row 0 at bottom
    var rowElIdx = (TOTAL_ROWS - 1) - targetRow;
    // Scroll so this octave's C is centered in view
    var visibleHeight = gridWrap.clientHeight;
    var targetScroll = (rowElIdx * ROW_HEIGHT) - (visibleHeight / 2) + (6 * ROW_HEIGHT);
    if (targetScroll < 0) {
      targetScroll = 0;
    }
    var maxScroll = (TOTAL_ROWS * ROW_HEIGHT) - visibleHeight;
    if (targetScroll > maxScroll) {
      targetScroll = maxScroll;
    }
    gridWrap.scrollTop = targetScroll;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Note Rendering
  // ============================================================

  function _renderNotes() {
    if (!_gridContainer) {
      return;
    }
    // Clear all existing note elements
    var existingNotes = _gridContainer.querySelectorAll('.seq-screen-note');
    for (var i = 0; i < existingNotes.length; i++) {
      existingNotes[i].parentNode.removeChild(existingNotes[i]);
    }

    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;
    var pageEnd = pageOffset + STEPS_PER_PAGE;

    var rows = _gridContainer.querySelectorAll('.seq-screen-row');
    var totalRowEls = rows.length;

    for (var ni = 0; ni < notes.length; ni++) {
      var note = notes[ni];
      var instId = (note.instrument !== undefined) ? note.instrument : 0;

      // Only show notes for selected instrument (or all if desired)
      if (note.start >= pageOffset && note.start < pageEnd) {
        var localCol = note.start - pageOffset;
        var rowIdx = note.row;
        // Rows are rendered top-to-bottom as (TOTAL_ROWS-1) down to 0
        var rowElIdx = (TOTAL_ROWS - 1) - rowIdx;

        if (rowElIdx >= 0 && rowElIdx < totalRowEls) {
          var rowEl = rows[rowElIdx];
          var cells = rowEl.children;
          if (localCol >= 0 && localCol < cells.length) {
            var noteEl = document.createElement('div');
            noteEl.className = 'seq-screen-note inst-' + instId;
            var durClamped = Math.min(note.dur || DEFAULT_NOTE_DUR, STEPS_VISIBLE - localCol);
            var cellWidth = cells[0].offsetWidth;
            if (cellWidth <= 0) {
              cellWidth = CELL_MIN_WIDTH;
            }
            noteEl.style.width = (durClamped * cellWidth) + 'px';
            noteEl.style.left = '0';
            noteEl.setAttribute('data-note-idx', ni);
            noteEl.addEventListener('mousedown', _onNoteMouseDown);
            noteEl.addEventListener('contextmenu', _onNoteRightClick);
            cells[localCol].style.position = 'relative';
            cells[localCol].appendChild(noteEl);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Event Handlers
  // ============================================================

  function _onCellClick(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    var row = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-row'));
    var col = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-col'));
    var midi = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-midi'));
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;

    // If a chord is armed, place the chord instead of a single note
    if (_armedChord) {
      var chordMidi = _getArmedChordMidiNotes();
      var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
      for (var cn = 0; cn < chordMidi.length; cn++) {
        var chordNoteMidi = chordMidi[cn];
        var chordRow = chordNoteMidi - SEQ_BASE_MIDI;
        if (chordRow >= 0 && chordRow < TOTAL_ROWS) {
          notes.push({
            row: chordRow,
            start: col + pageOffset,
            dur: _chordDuration,
            midi: chordNoteMidi,
            instrument: _currentInst,
            vel: 100
          });
        }
        // Play each chord note for feedback
        if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
          SL.audio.playNote(chordNoteMidi, 0.3);
        }
      }
      _renderNotes();
      _buildChordMap();
      if (_trackerVisible) {
        _renderTrackerView();
      }
    } else {
      // Normal single-note behavior
      // Check if note already exists at this position for current instrument
      var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
      var existingIdx = -1;
      for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
        if (notes[i].row === row && notes[i].start === (col + pageOffset) && notes[i].instrument === _currentInst) {
          existingIdx = i;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        // Remove existing note
        notes.splice(existingIdx, 1);
      } else {
        // Add new note
        notes.push({
          row: row,
          start: col + pageOffset,
          dur: DEFAULT_NOTE_DUR,
          midi: midi,
          instrument: _currentInst,
          vel: 100
        });
        // Play the note for feedback
        if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNoteOnInstrument) {
          SL.audio.playNoteOnInstrument(midi, 0.3, _currentInst, 100);
        } else if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
          SL.audio.playNote(midi, 0.3);
        }
      }
      _renderNotes();
    }
  }

  function _onNoteRightClick(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var idx = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-note-idx'));
    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    if (idx >= 0 && idx < notes.length) {
      notes.splice(idx, 1);
      SL.sequencer.rebuildNoteIndex();
      _renderNotes();
    }
  }

  function _onNoteMouseDown(e) {
    if (e.button !== 0) {
      return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var noteEl = this;
    var idx = parseInt(noteEl.getAttribute('data-note-idx'));
    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= notes.length) {
      return;
    }
    var note = notes[idx];

    // Check if click is near the right edge (resize zone)
    var isRightEdge = (e.offsetX > (noteEl.offsetWidth - 6));

    if (isRightEdge) {
      // Start resize operation
      _resizeNote = note;
      _resizeNoteIdx = idx;
      _resizeStartX = e.clientX;
      _resizeOrigDur = note.dur || DEFAULT_NOTE_DUR;
      _isResizing = false;

      var onResizeMove = function(me) {
        me.preventDefault();
        var dx = me.clientX - _resizeStartX;
        if (Math.abs(dx) >= 2) {
          _isResizing = true;
        }
        if (_isResizing && _resizeNote) {
          var firstRow = _gridContainer ? _gridContainer.querySelector('.seq-screen-row') : null;
          var cellWidth = CELL_MIN_WIDTH;
          if (firstRow && firstRow.children.length > 0) {
            cellWidth = firstRow.children[0].offsetWidth;
            if (cellWidth <= 0) {
              cellWidth = CELL_MIN_WIDTH;
            }
          }
          var stepDelta = Math.round(dx / cellWidth);
          var newDur = _resizeOrigDur + stepDelta;
          if (newDur < 1) {
            newDur = 1;
          }
          _resizeNote.dur = newDur;
          _renderNotes();
        }
      };

      var onResizeUp = function(me) {
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMove);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onResizeUp);
        if (_isResizing && _resizeNote) {
          SL.sequencer.rebuildNoteIndex();
        }
        _resizeNote = null;
        _resizeNoteIdx = -1;
        _isResizing = false;
      };

      document.addEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMove);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onResizeUp);
    } else {
      // Start drag-to-move operation
      _dragNote = note;
      _dragNoteIdx = idx;
      _dragStartX = e.clientX;
      _dragStartY = e.clientY;
      _dragOrigRow = note.row;
      _dragOrigStart = note.start;
      _isDragging = false;

      var onDragMove = function(me) {
        me.preventDefault();
        var dx = me.clientX - _dragStartX;
        var dy = me.clientY - _dragStartY;
        if (Math.abs(dx) >= 2 || Math.abs(dy) >= 2) {
          _isDragging = true;
        }
        if (_isDragging && _dragNote) {
          var firstRow = _gridContainer ? _gridContainer.querySelector('.seq-screen-row') : null;
          var cellWidth = CELL_MIN_WIDTH;
          if (firstRow && firstRow.children.length > 0) {
            cellWidth = firstRow.children[0].offsetWidth;
            if (cellWidth <= 0) {
              cellWidth = CELL_MIN_WIDTH;
            }
          }
          var stepDelta = Math.round(dx / cellWidth);
          var rowDelta = -Math.round(dy / ROW_HEIGHT); // negative because rows render top-to-bottom (high to low)
          var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
          var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;
          var newStart = _dragOrigStart + stepDelta;
          var newRow = _dragOrigRow + rowDelta;
          // Clamp to page boundaries
          var localCol = newStart - pageOffset;
          if (localCol < 0) {
            newStart = pageOffset;
          }
          if (localCol >= STEPS_VISIBLE) {
            newStart = pageOffset + STEPS_VISIBLE - 1;
          }
          if (newRow < 0) {
            newRow = 0;
          }
          if (newRow >= TOTAL_ROWS) {
            newRow = TOTAL_ROWS - 1;
          }
          _dragNote.row = newRow;
          _dragNote.start = newStart;
          _dragNote.midi = SEQ_BASE_MIDI + newRow;
          _renderNotes();
        }
      };

      var onDragUp = function(me) {
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onDragMove);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onDragUp);
        if (_isDragging && _dragNote) {
          SL.sequencer.rebuildNoteIndex();
        }
        _dragNote = null;
        _dragNoteIdx = -1;
        _isDragging = false;
      };

      document.addEventListener('mousemove', onDragMove);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onDragUp);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Transport
  // ============================================================

  function _onPlay() {
    if (SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
      SL.sequencer.stopSeq();
      _updateTransportUI();
    } else {
      // Sync BPM from our input to the main sequencer BPM input
      var mainBpm = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
      if (mainBpm && _bpmInput) {
        mainBpm.value = _bpmInput.value;
      }
      SL.sequencer.startSeq();
      _updateTransportUI();
      _startPlayheadAnim();
    }
  }

  function _onStop() {
    SL.sequencer.stopSeq();
    _updateTransportUI();
    _stopPlayheadAnim();
    if (_playheadEl) {
      _playheadEl.style.left = '-2px';
    }
  }

  function _onClear() {
    SL.sequencer.clearSeq();
    _renderNotes();
  }

  function _onLoopToggle() {
    _loopEnabled = !_loopEnabled;
    if (_loopBtn) {
      if (_loopEnabled) {
        _loopBtn.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        _loopBtn.classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
  }

  function _updateTransportUI() {
    if (_playBtn) {
      if (SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
        _playBtn.textContent = '\u23F8';
        _playBtn.classList.add('playing');
      } else {
        _playBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
        _playBtn.classList.remove('playing');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Playhead Animation
  // ============================================================

  function _startPlayheadAnim() {
    _stopPlayheadAnim();
    _animFrameId = setInterval(_updatePlayhead, ANIM_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  function _stopPlayheadAnim() {
    if (_animFrameId) {
      clearInterval(_animFrameId);
      _animFrameId = null;
    }
  }

  function _updatePlayhead() {
    if (!_playheadEl || !_gridContainer) {
      return;
    }
    if (!SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
      _stopPlayheadAnim();
      _playheadEl.style.left = '-2px';
      _updateTransportUI();
    } else {
      // Use sequencer API instead of reading classic screen DOM
      var currentStep = SL.sequencer.getCurrentStep();
      var stepsPerPage = SL.sequencer.getStepsPerPage ? SL.sequencer.getStepsPerPage() : STEPS_PER_PAGE;
      var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
      var pageOffset = currentPage * stepsPerPage;
      var localStep = currentStep - pageOffset;
      if (localStep >= 0 && localStep < STEPS_VISIBLE) {
        var firstRow = _gridContainer.querySelector('.seq-screen-row');
        if (firstRow) {
          var gridWidth = firstRow.offsetWidth;
          var ratio = localStep / STEPS_VISIBLE;
          _playheadEl.style.left = (ratio * gridWidth) + 'px';
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function _onPagePrev() {
    var cur = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    if (cur > 0) {
      SL.sequencer.goToPage(cur - 1);
      _refreshAfterPageChange();
    }
  }

  function _onPageNext() {
    var cur = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    SL.sequencer.goToPage(cur + 1);
    _refreshAfterPageChange();
  }

  function _onPageAdd() {
    SL.sequencer.addPage();
    _refreshAfterPageChange();
  }

  function _onPageDel() {
    SL.sequencer.deletePage();
    _refreshAfterPageChange();
  }

  function _refreshAfterPageChange() {
    _updatePageIndicator();
    _buildGrid();
    _renderNotes();
    _buildPageList();
    _buildChordMap();
  }

  function _updatePageIndicator() {
    if (_pageIndicator) {
      var cur = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
      // Count pages by checking the seqNotes for max page
      var maxPage = cur;
      var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
      for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
        var pg = Math.floor(notes[i].start / STEPS_PER_PAGE);
        if (pg > maxPage) {
          maxPage = pg;
        }
      }
      _pageIndicator.textContent = 'Page ' + (cur + 1) + '/' + (maxPage + 1);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Side Panel: Page List
  // ============================================================

  function _buildPageList() {
    if (!_pageListEl) {
      return;
    }
    _pageListEl.innerHTML = '';
    var curPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    // Determine total pages
    var maxPage = curPage;
    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      var pg = Math.floor(notes[i].start / STEPS_PER_PAGE);
      if (pg > maxPage) {
        maxPage = pg;
      }
    }

    for (var p = 0; p <= maxPage; p++) {
      var item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'seq-screen-page-item';
      if (p === curPage) {
        item.className += ' active';
      }
      item.setAttribute('data-page', p);

      var numSpan = document.createElement('span');
      numSpan.className = 'page-num';
      numSpan.textContent = (p + 1);
      item.appendChild(numSpan);

      var labelSpan = document.createElement('span');
      labelSpan.className = 'page-label';
      // Count notes on this page
      var noteCount = 0;
      var pageStart = p * STEPS_PER_PAGE;
      var pageEnd = pageStart + STEPS_PER_PAGE;
      for (var ni = 0; ni < notes.length; ni++) {
        if (notes[ni].start >= pageStart && notes[ni].start < pageEnd) {
          noteCount++;
        }
      }
      labelSpan.textContent = noteCount + ' notes';
      item.appendChild(labelSpan);

      item.addEventListener('click', (function(pageNum) {
        return function() {
          SL.sequencer.goToPage(pageNum);
          _refreshAfterPageChange();
        };
      })(p));

      _pageListEl.appendChild(item);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Chord Panel: Data Helpers
  // ============================================================

  function _getScaleChords() {
    var mode = SL.MODES[_chordMode];
    if (!mode) {
      return [];
    }
    var chords = [];
    for (var d = 0; d < mode.scale.length && d < 7; d++) {
      var pc = (_chordRoot + mode.scale[d]) % 12;
      var type = mode.triads[d];
      // Apply extension if selected
      var effectiveType = type;
      if (_chordExtension) {
        // For 7th extensions, map triad quality to 7th type
        if (_chordExtension === '7') {
          if (type === 'maj') {
            effectiveType = '7';
          } else if (type === 'min') {
            effectiveType = 'min7';
          } else if (type === 'dim') {
            effectiveType = 'm7b5';
          }
        } else if (_chordExtension === 'maj7') {
          if (type === 'maj') {
            effectiveType = 'maj7';
          } else if (type === 'min') {
            effectiveType = 'min7';
          } else if (type === 'dim') {
            effectiveType = 'm7b5';
          }
        } else if (_chordExtension === 'sus2' || _chordExtension === 'sus4') {
          effectiveType = _chordExtension;
        }
      }
      var baseMidi = 5 * 12 + pc; // octave 5
      var intervals = SL.CHORD_INT[effectiveType] || [0, 4, 7];
      var notes = [];
      for (var n = 0; n < intervals.length; n++) {
        notes.push(baseMidi + intervals[n]);
      }
      var suffix = SL.CHORD_NAME[effectiveType] || '';
      var numerals = SL.NUMS || ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII'];
      var numeral = numerals[d];
      // Lowercase for minor/dim
      if (type === 'min' || type === 'dim') {
        numeral = numeral.toLowerCase();
      }
      if (type === 'dim') {
        numeral = numeral + '\u00B0';
      }
      chords.push({
        degree: d,
        rootPc: pc,
        type: effectiveType,
        triadType: type,
        notes: notes,
        name: NOTES[pc] + suffix,
        numeral: numeral,
        func: DEGREE_FUNCTIONS[d]
      });
    }
    return chords;
  }

  function _applyInversion(notes, inversion) {
    var result = notes.slice();
    for (var i = 0; i < inversion && i < result.length - 1; i++) {
      // Move lowest note up an octave
      result[0] = result[0] + 12;
      result.sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
    }
    return result;
  }

  function _applyOpenVoicing(notes) {
    // Spread notes across octaves for open voicing
    var sorted = notes.slice().sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
    if (sorted.length >= 3) {
      // Move middle note(s) up an octave
      sorted[1] = sorted[1] + 12;
      sorted.sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
    }
    return sorted;
  }

  function _getArmedChordMidiNotes() {
    if (!_armedChord) {
      return [];
    }
    var notes = _armedChord.notes.slice();
    // Apply inversion
    if (_chordInversion > 0) {
      notes = _applyInversion(notes, _chordInversion);
    }
    // Apply open voicing
    if (_chordVoicing === 'open') {
      notes = _applyOpenVoicing(notes);
    }
    // Apply octave offset
    if (_chordOctaveOffset !== 0) {
      for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
        notes[i] = notes[i] + (_chordOctaveOffset * 12);
      }
    }
    return notes;
  }

  function _buildChordPalette() {

    _chordPaletteEl.innerHTML = '';
    var chords = _getScaleChords();
    for (var i = 0; i < chords.length; i++) {
      (function(chord, idx) {
        var btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'seq-chord-degree-btn func-' + chord.func;
        if (_armedChord && _armedChord.degree === idx) {
          btn.className += ' armed';

        var numeralSpan = document.createElement('span');
        numeralSpan.className = 'seq-chord-degree-numeral';
        numeralSpan.textContent = chord.numeral;
        btn.appendChild(numeralSpan);

        var nameSpan = document.createElement('span');
        nameSpan.className = 'seq-chord-degree-name';
        nameSpan.textContent = chord.name;
        btn.appendChild(nameSpan);

        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (_armedChord && _armedChord.degree === idx) {
            // Disarm if clicking the same chord
            _armedChord = null;
          } else {
            _armedChord = {
              notes: chord.notes.slice(),
              name: chord.name,
              degree: chord.degree,
              func: chord.func,
              type: chord.type
            };
          }
          _buildChordPalette();
          _updateChordGhostKeys();
          // Play the chord for audio feedback
          if (_armedChord) {
            var playNotes = _getArmedChordMidiNotes();
            for (var pn = 0; pn < playNotes.length; pn++) {
              if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
                SL.audio.playNote(playNotes[pn], 0.4);
              }
            }
          }
        });

        _chordPaletteEl.appendChild(btn);
      })(chords[i], i);
