  // ============================================================
  // Chord Panel: Ghost Key Highlighting
  // ============================================================

  function _updateChordGhostKeys() {
    if (!_keysContainer) {
      return;
    }
    var keys = _keysContainer.querySelectorAll('.seq-screen-key');
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      keys[i].classList.remove('chord-ghost');
    }
    if (!_armedChord) {
      return;
    }
    var chordMidi = _getArmedChordMidiNotes();
    for (var ci = 0; ci < chordMidi.length; ci++) {
      var row = chordMidi[ci] - SEQ_BASE_MIDI;
      var keyIdx = (TOTAL_ROWS - 1) - row;
      if (keyIdx >= 0 && keyIdx < keys.length) {
        keys[keyIdx].classList.add('chord-ghost');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Chord Panel: Fill Page / Clear
  // ============================================================

  function _onChordFillPage() {
    if (!_chordProgSelect) {
      return;
    }
    var progIdx = parseInt(_chordProgSelect.value, 10);
    var prog = QUICK_PROGRESSIONS[progIdx];
    if (!prog) {
      return;
    }

    var scaleChords = _getScaleChords();
    var degrees = prog.degrees;
    var numChords = degrees.length;
    var stepsPerChord = Math.floor(STEPS_PER_PAGE / numChords);
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;
    var instId = _currentInst;
    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;

    for (var ci = 0; ci < numChords; ci++) {
      var degIdx = degrees[ci];
      if (degIdx >= scaleChords.length) {
        continue;
      }
      var chord = scaleChords[degIdx];
      var chordNotes = chord.notes.slice();

      // Apply inversion
      if (_chordInversion > 0) {
        chordNotes = _applyInversion(chordNotes, _chordInversion);
      }
      // Apply open voicing
      if (_chordVoicing === 'open') {
        chordNotes = _applyOpenVoicing(chordNotes);
      }
      // Apply octave offset
      if (_chordOctaveOffset !== 0) {
        for (var oi = 0; oi < chordNotes.length; oi++) {
          chordNotes[oi] = chordNotes[oi] + (_chordOctaveOffset * 12);
        }
      }

      var startStep = pageOffset + (ci * stepsPerChord);
      var dur = stepsPerChord;

      for (var ni = 0; ni < chordNotes.length; ni++) {
        var midi = chordNotes[ni];
        var row = midi - SEQ_BASE_MIDI;
        if (row >= 0 && row < TOTAL_ROWS) {
          notes.push({
            row: row,
            start: startStep,
            dur: dur,
            midi: midi,
            instrument: instId,
            vel: 100
          });
        }
      }
    }

    _renderNotes();
    _buildChordMap();
    if (_trackerVisible) {
      _renderTrackerView();
    }
  }

  function _onChordClearPage() {
    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;
    var pageEnd = pageOffset + STEPS_PER_PAGE;

    // Remove all notes on this page for the current instrument
    for (var i = notes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (notes[i].start >= pageOffset && notes[i].start < pageEnd && notes[i].instrument === _currentInst) {
        notes.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    _renderNotes();
    _buildChordMap();
    if (_trackerVisible) {
      _renderTrackerView();
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Chord Panel: Page Chord Map
  // ============================================================

  function _buildChordMap() {
    if (!_chordMapEl) {
      return;
    }
    _chordMapEl.innerHTML = '';
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;
    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    var barsPerPage = 4;
    var stepsPerBar = STEPS_PER_PAGE / barsPerPage;

    for (var bar = 0; bar < barsPerPage; bar++) {
      var barStart = pageOffset + (bar * stepsPerBar);
      var barEnd = barStart + stepsPerBar;

      // Find notes in this bar
      var barNotes = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
        if (notes[i].start >= barStart && notes[i].start < barEnd && notes[i].instrument === _currentInst) {
          barNotes.push(notes[i]);
        }
      }

      var barEl = document.createElement('div');
      barEl.className = 'seq-chord-map-bar';

      if (barNotes.length > 0) {
        // Try to identify the chord from the notes
        var chordName = _identifyChordInBar(barNotes);
        if (chordName) {
          barEl.className += ' has-chord';
          barEl.textContent = chordName;
          // Try to color by function

  function _identifyChordInBar(barNotes) {
    // Group notes by their start step to find chord clusters

    for (var i = 0; i < barNotes.length; i++) {
      var midi = barNotes[i].midi;
      if (midi !== undefined) {
        midiSet[midi % 12] = true;
      }
    }
    var pcs = [];
    for (var pc in midiSet) {
      if (midiSet.hasOwnProperty(pc)) {
        pcs.push(parseInt(pc, 10));
      }
    }
    if (pcs.length < 2) {
      return null;
    }
    // Try to match against known chord intervals
    for (var root = 0; root < 12; root++) {
      for (var type in SL.CHORD_INT) {
        if (SL.CHORD_INT.hasOwnProperty(type)) {
          var intervals = SL.CHORD_INT[type];
          if (intervals.length > pcs.length) {
            continue;
          }
          var chordPcs = [];
          for (var ci = 0; ci < intervals.length; ci++) {
            chordPcs.push((root + intervals[ci]) % 12);
          }
          // Check if all chord pcs are in our set
          var allMatch = true;
          for (var mi = 0; mi < chordPcs.length; mi++) {
            if (!midiSet[chordPcs[mi]]) {
              allMatch = false;
              break;

          if (allMatch && chordPcs.length >= pcs.length) {
            var suffix = SL.CHORD_NAME[type] || '';
            return NOTES[root] + suffix;

        }
      }

    return null;

    var midiSet = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < barNotes.length; i++) {
      if (barNotes[i].midi !== undefined) {
        midiSet[barNotes[i].midi % 12] = true;
      }
    }
    for (var d = 0; d < scaleChords.length; d++) {
      var chord = scaleChords[d];
      var chordPcs = {};
      for (var cn = 0; cn < chord.notes.length; cn++) {
        chordPcs[chord.notes[cn] % 12] = true;
      }
      // Check if chord PCs match bar note PCs
      var match = true;
      for (var pc in chordPcs) {
        if (chordPcs.hasOwnProperty(pc) && !midiSet[pc]) {
          match = false;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (match) {
        return chord.func;
      }
    }
    return null;

  function _buildTrackerView() {
    var container = document.getElementById('screen-sequence');
    if (!container) {

    }

    var trackerEl = document.createElement('div');
    trackerEl.id = 'seqTrackerView';
    trackerEl.style.cssText = 'max-height:200px;overflow:auto;background:#0a0a14;border:1px solid #2a2a4a;margin:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-family:monospace;font-size:0.6rem;color:#c0c0e0;';
    container.appendChild(trackerEl);
    _renderTrackerView();
  }

  function _renderTrackerView() {
    var trackerEl = document.getElementById('seqTrackerView');
    if (!trackerEl) {
      return;
    }

    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * STEPS_PER_PAGE;
    var pageEnd = pageOffset + STEPS_PER_PAGE;

    // Collect notes on this page sorted by step
    var pageNotes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      if (notes[i].start >= pageOffset && notes[i].start < pageEnd) {
        pageNotes.push(notes[i]);
      }
    }
    pageNotes.sort(function(a, b) {
      if (a.start !== b.start) {
        return a.start - b.start;
      }
      return (a.instrument || 0) - (b.instrument || 0);
    });

    var html = '<div style="padding:4px">';
    html += '<div style="color:#6a6aff;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px">STEP | INST | NOTE | VEL | DUR</div>';
    html += '<div style="border-bottom:1px solid #2a2a4a;margin-bottom:2px"></div>';

    if (pageNotes.length === 0) {
      html += '<div style="color:#666">No notes on this page</div>';
    } else {
      for (var n = 0; n < pageNotes.length; n++) {
        var note = pageNotes[n];
        var localStep = note.start - pageOffset;
        var stepStr = ('  ' + localStep).slice(-3);
        var instStr = (' ' + ((note.instrument !== undefined) ? note.instrument : 0)).slice(-2);
        var noteName = _midiToName(note.midi || (SEQ_BASE_MIDI + note.row));
        var velStr = ('  ' + (note.vel || 100)).slice(-3);
        var durStr = ('  ' + (note.dur || 4)).slice(-3);
        html += '<div>' + stepStr + '  |  ' + instStr + '   | ' + noteName + ' | ' + velStr + ' | ' + durStr + '</div>';
      }
    }

    html += '</div>';
    trackerEl.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function _syncFromModel() {
    // Sync BPM from the real sequencer
    if (_bpmInput && SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.getBpm) {
      _bpmInput.value = SL.sequencer.getBpm();
    }

    // Sync instrument selector to current instrument
    if (_instSelect) {
      _currentInst = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
      _instSelect.value = _currentInst;
    }
  }

  function activate() {
    _init();
    _active = true;
    _syncFromModel();
    // Refresh display state
    _updateTransportUI();
    _buildGrid();
    _renderNotes();
    _updatePageIndicator();
    _buildPageList();
    _buildTrackerToggle();
    if (_trackerVisible) {
      _renderTrackerView();
    }
    _buildChordPalette();
    _buildChordMap();
    _updateChordGhostKeys();
    if (SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
      _startPlayheadAnim();
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _stopPlayheadAnim();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenSequence = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };

})();

  // and grouped structure for optgroup display
  var PATTERN_PRESETS = {};
  var PATTERN_GROUPS = [];

  function _convertJsonPattern(jsonPattern) {
    // Convert from JSON format { pad, steps } to screen format { rowName: [16-elem binary array] }
    var result = {};
    var pi;
    var si;
    for (pi = 0; pi < jsonPattern.length; pi++) {
      var entry = jsonPattern[pi];
      var padIdx = entry.pad;
      if (padIdx >= 0 && padIdx < PAD_TO_ROW_NAME.length) {
        var rowName = PAD_TO_ROW_NAME[padIdx];
        var steps = [];
        for (si = 0; si < NUM_PATTERN_STEPS; si++) {
          steps.push(0);
        }
        for (si = 0; si < entry.steps.length; si++) {
          var stepIdx = entry.steps[si];
          if (stepIdx >= 0 && stepIdx < NUM_PATTERN_STEPS) {
            steps[stepIdx] = 1;
          }
        }
        result[rowName] = steps;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  function _loadPatternsFromData() {
    var data = SL._data && SL._data.drumPatterns;
    if (!data || !data.length) {
      // Fallback: use hardcoded presets with a single "Classic" group
      PATTERN_PRESETS = FALLBACK_PRESETS;
      PATTERN_GROUPS = [{ genre: 'Classic', patterns: Object.keys(FALLBACK_PRESETS) }];
      return;
    }

    PATTERN_PRESETS = {};
    PATTERN_GROUPS = [];
    var gi;
    var pi;
    for (gi = 0; gi < data.length; gi++) {
      var group = data[gi];
      var genre = group.genre;
      var patternNames = [];
      var patterns = group.patterns;
      for (pi = 0; pi < patterns.length; pi++) {
        var pat = patterns[pi];
        var name = pat.name;
        // Handle duplicate names across genres by prefixing with genre
        var uniqueName = name;
        if (PATTERN_PRESETS[uniqueName]) {
          uniqueName = genre + ' - ' + name;
        }
        PATTERN_PRESETS[uniqueName] = _convertJsonPattern(pat.pattern);
        patternNames.push(uniqueName);
      }
      if (patternNames.length > 0) {
        PATTERN_GROUPS.push({ genre: genre, patterns: patternNames });
      }
    }
  }

  // Key code to pad index mapping
  var KEY_TO_PAD = {};

  // ============================================================
  // State
  // ============================================================

  var _initialized = false;
  var _active = false;
  var _swingAmount = 0;
  var _animFrameId = null;
  var _currentStep = -1;
  var _numSteps = DEFAULT_NUM_STEPS;

  // Rhythm grid state: drumRows x numSteps
  var _gridState = [];

  // Per-row mixer controls
  var _rowVolumes = [80, 80, 80, 80, 80, 80, 80, 80];
  var _rowMuted = [false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false];
  var _rowSoloed = [false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false];

  // Velocity grid state: [row][col] = velocity 0-127
  var _velocityState = [];

  // Euclidean generator state
  var _eucPulses = 4;
  var _eucSteps = 16;
  var _eucRotation = 0;
  var _eucTargetRow = 0;

  // Beatmaker state (US-25)
  var BEATMAKER_PATTERN_COUNT = 4;
  var _bmPatterns = [];  // array of 4 patterns, each is a gridState copy
  var _bmActivePattern = 0;
  var _bmInitialized = false;

  // Pattern chain / arrangement
  var CHAIN_LABELS = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'];
  var _chain = [];           // array of pattern indices (0-3)
  var _chainPos = -1;        // current position in chain (-1 = chain off)
  var _chainEnabled = false;
  var _chainContainerEl = null;
  var _lastSeqStep = -1;     // for detecting loop wraps

  // DOM references
  var _bpmInput = null;
  var _swingSlider = null;
  var _swingValue = null;
  var _genreSelect = null;
  var _presetSelect = null;
  var _playBtn = null;
  var _stopBtn = null;
  var _clearBtn = null;
  var _gridTableBody = null;
  var _padGridEl = null;
  var _eucPulsesSlider = null;
  var _eucPulsesValue = null;
  var _eucStepsSlider = null;
  var _eucStepsValue = null;
  var _eucRotSlider = null;
  var _eucRotValue = null;
  var _eucTargetSelect = null;
  var _eucApplyBtn = null;
  var _velocityStripEl = null;
  var _stepToggleBtn = null;
  var _kitSelect = null;
  var _timeSigSelect = null;
  var _beatsPerMeasure = 4;  // from time signature (e.g. 4 for 4/4, 3 for 3/4)
  var _activeKit = '808';

  // ============================================================
  // Grid State Management
  // ============================================================

  function _initGridState() {
    _gridState = [];
    _velocityState = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
      var row = [];
      var velRow = [];
      for (var c = 0; c < _numSteps; c++) {
        row.push(false);
        velRow.push(DRUM_PAD_VELOCITY);
      }
      _gridState.push(row);
      _velocityState.push(velRow);
    }
  }

  function _syncGridFromSequencer() {
    _initGridState();
    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * 64; // STEPS_PER_PAGE from sequencer

    for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      var note = notes[i];
      if (note.instrument === DRUM_INST_ID && note.start >= pageOffset && note.start < pageOffset + 64) {
        var localCol = note.start - pageOffset;
        // Map from localCol (0-63) to grid steps
        var subStepsPerGridStep = Math.floor(64 / _numSteps);
        var gridCol = Math.floor(localCol / subStepsPerGridStep);
        if (gridCol >= 0 && gridCol < _numSteps) {
          // Find matching drum row by MIDI
          for (var r = 0; r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
            if (note.midi === DRUM_ROWS[r].midi || note.row === r) {
              _gridState[r][gridCol] = true;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function _syncGridToSequencer() {
    // Remove all drum instrument notes on current page
    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var pageOffset = currentPage * 64;

    for (var i = notes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (notes[i].instrument === DRUM_INST_ID && notes[i].start >= pageOffset && notes[i].start < pageOffset + 64) {
        notes.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // Determine if any row is soloed
    var anySoloed = false;
    for (var si = 0; si < _rowSoloed.length; si++) {
      if (_rowSoloed[si]) { anySoloed = true; break; }
    }

    // Add notes from grid state with velocity and mute/solo.
    // Each grid step = one sixteenth note (1 sequencer step).
    // 16 grid steps = 1 bar of sixteenths; 32 grid steps = 2 bars.
    for (var r = 0; r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
      // Skip muted rows, and skip non-soloed rows if any row is soloed
      if (_rowMuted[r]) { continue; }
      if (anySoloed && !_rowSoloed[r]) { continue; }

      for (var c = 0; c < _numSteps; c++) {
        if (_gridState[r][c]) {
          var baseVel = (_velocityState[r] && _velocityState[r][c] !== undefined) ? _velocityState[r][c] : DRUM_PAD_VELOCITY;
          var effectiveVel = Math.round(baseVel * (_rowVolumes[r] / 100));
          notes.push({
            row: r,
            start: pageOffset + c,
            dur: 1,
            midi: DRUM_ROWS[r].midi,
            instrument: DRUM_INST_ID,
            vel: effectiveVel
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Invalidate the sequencer's note index so changes take effect immediately during playback
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.rebuildNoteIndex) {
      SL.sequencer.rebuildNoteIndex();
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Grid Builder
  // ============================================================

  function _buildThead() {
    var gridTable = _gridTableBody ? _gridTableBody.parentNode : null;
    if (!gridTable) {
      return;
    }
    var oldThead = gridTable.querySelector('thead');
    if (oldThead) {
      gridTable.removeChild(oldThead);
    }
    var thead = document.createElement('thead');
    var tr = document.createElement('tr');
    // Empty header cell for the row-label column
    tr.appendChild(document.createElement('th'));
    // Each grid step = 1 sixteenth note. Beat markers every 4 steps (quarter note).
    var SIXTEENTHS_PER_BEAT = 4;
    for (var c = 0; c < _numSteps; c++) {
      var th = document.createElement('th');
      th.className = 'step-header';
      if (c % SIXTEENTHS_PER_BEAT === 0) {
        th.classList.add('beat');
      }
      th.textContent = String(c + 1);
      tr.appendChild(th);
    }
    thead.appendChild(tr);
    gridTable.insertBefore(thead, gridTable.firstChild);
  }

  function _buildGrid() {
    if (!_gridTableBody) {
      return;
    }
    _gridTableBody.innerHTML = '';

    // Rebuild the thead to match current step count
    _buildThead();

    // Add/remove 32-step class on table
    var gridTable = _gridTableBody.parentNode;
    if (gridTable) {
      if (_numSteps > DEFAULT_NUM_STEPS) {
        gridTable.classList.add('steps-32');
      } else {
        gridTable.classList.remove('steps-32');
      }
    }

    for (var r = 0; r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
      var tr = document.createElement('tr');

      // Row controls (name + volume + mute + solo)
      var controlsTd = document.createElement('td');
      controlsTd.className = 'rhythm-grid-row-label';

      var controlsDiv = document.createElement('div');
      controlsDiv.className = 'rhythm-grid-row-controls';

      var nameSpan = document.createElement('span');
      nameSpan.className = 'row-name';
      nameSpan.textContent = DRUM_ROWS[r].name;
      controlsDiv.appendChild(nameSpan);

      // Volume slider
      var volSlider = document.createElement('input');
      volSlider.type = 'range';
      volSlider.className = 'row-vol';
      volSlider.min = '0';
      volSlider.max = '100';
      volSlider.value = String(_rowVolumes[r]);
      volSlider.setAttribute('data-row', r);
      volSlider.addEventListener('input', _onRowVolumeChange);
      controlsDiv.appendChild(volSlider);

      // Mute button
      var muteBtn = document.createElement('button');
      muteBtn.className = 'row-mute-btn';
      if (_rowMuted[r]) { muteBtn.className += ' active'; }
      muteBtn.textContent = 'M';
      muteBtn.setAttribute('data-row', r);
      muteBtn.addEventListener('click', _onRowMuteClick);
      controlsDiv.appendChild(muteBtn);

      // Solo button
      var soloBtn = document.createElement('button');
      soloBtn.className = 'row-solo-btn';
      if (_rowSoloed[r]) { soloBtn.className += ' active'; }
      soloBtn.textContent = 'S';
      soloBtn.setAttribute('data-row', r);
      soloBtn.addEventListener('click', _onRowSoloClick);
      controlsDiv.appendChild(soloBtn);

      controlsTd.appendChild(controlsDiv);
      tr.appendChild(controlsTd);

      // Step cells — beat-line every 4 sixteenths (quarter note boundary)
      for (var c = 0; c < _numSteps; c++) {
        var td = document.createElement('td');
        td.className = 'rhythm-grid-cell';
        if (c % 4 === 0) {
          td.className += ' beat-line';
        }
        td.setAttribute('data-row', r);
        td.setAttribute('data-col', c);

        var dot = document.createElement('span');
        dot.className = 'rhy-dot';
        if (_gridState[r] && _gridState[r][c]) {
          dot.className += ' active ' + DRUM_ROWS[r].cssClass;
        }
        td.appendChild(dot);

        td.addEventListener('click', _onGridCellClick);
        tr.appendChild(td);
      }

      _gridTableBody.appendChild(tr);
    }

    // Build velocity strip below grid
    _buildVelocityStrip();
  }

  function _renderGrid() {
    if (!_gridTableBody) {
      return;
    }
    var trs = _gridTableBody.querySelectorAll('tr');
    for (var r = 0; r < trs.length && r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
      var cells = trs[r].querySelectorAll('.rhythm-grid-cell');
      for (var c = 0; c < cells.length && c < _numSteps; c++) {
        var dot = cells[c].querySelector('.rhy-dot');
        if (dot) {
          if (_gridState[r] && _gridState[r][c]) {
            dot.className = 'rhy-dot active ' + DRUM_ROWS[r].cssClass;
          } else {
            dot.className = 'rhy-dot';
          }
        }
        // Playhead highlighting
        if (c === _currentStep && SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
          cells[c].classList.add('rhythm-playhead-cell');
        } else {
          cells[c].classList.remove('rhythm-playhead-cell');
        }
      }

      // Update mute/solo button states
      var muteBtn = trs[r].querySelector('.row-mute-btn');
      var soloBtn = trs[r].querySelector('.row-solo-btn');
      if (muteBtn) {
        if (_rowMuted[r]) {
          muteBtn.classList.add('active');
        } else {
          muteBtn.classList.remove('active');
        }
      }
      if (soloBtn) {
        if (_rowSoloed[r]) {
          soloBtn.classList.add('active');
        } else {
          soloBtn.classList.remove('active');
        }
      }
    }

    // Update velocity strip
    _renderVelocityStrip();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Grid Events
  // ============================================================

  function _onGridCellClick() {
    var r = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-row'));
    var c = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-col'));
    _gridState[r][c] = !_gridState[r][c];

    // Set default velocity when toggling on
    if (_gridState[r][c]) {
      if (_velocityState[r]) {
        _velocityState[r][c] = DRUM_PAD_VELOCITY;
      }
      _triggerDrumSound(DRUM_ROWS[r].midi, DRUM_PAD_VELOCITY, r);
    }

    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _renderGrid();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Row Control Events (Volume, Mute, Solo)
  // ============================================================

  function _onRowVolumeChange() {
    var r = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-row'));
    _rowVolumes[r] = parseInt(this.value);
    _syncGridToSequencer();
  }

  function _onRowMuteClick() {
    var r = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-row'));
    _rowMuted[r] = !_rowMuted[r];
    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _renderGrid();
  }

  function _onRowSoloClick() {
    var r = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-row'));
    _rowSoloed[r] = !_rowSoloed[r];
    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _renderGrid();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Velocity Strip
  // ============================================================

  function _buildVelocityStrip() {
    // Find or create the velocity strip container
    var gridArea = _gridTableBody ? _gridTableBody.closest('.rhythm-screen-grid-area') : null;
    if (!gridArea) {
      return;
    }

    // Remove existing strip
    var existing = gridArea.querySelector('.rhythm-velocity-strip');
    if (existing) {
      existing.parentNode.removeChild(existing);
    }

    var strip = document.createElement('div');
    strip.className = 'rhythm-velocity-strip';
    if (_numSteps > DEFAULT_NUM_STEPS) {
      strip.classList.add('steps-32');
    }
    _velocityStripEl = strip;

    // Empty label cell to align with grid's row-label column
    var labelCell = document.createElement('div');
    labelCell.className = 'rhythm-vel-label-cell';
    strip.appendChild(labelCell);

    for (var c = 0; c < _numSteps; c++) {
      var cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'rhythm-vel-bar-cell';
      if (c % 4 === 0) {
        cell.classList.add('beat-line');
      }
      cell.setAttribute('data-col', c);

      var bar = document.createElement('div');
      bar.className = 'rhythm-vel-bar';
      cell.appendChild(bar);

      cell.addEventListener('mousedown', _onVelBarMouseDown);
      strip.appendChild(cell);
    }

    gridArea.appendChild(strip);
    _renderVelocityStrip();
  }

  function _renderVelocityStrip() {
    if (!_velocityStripEl) {
      return;
    }
    var cells = _velocityStripEl.querySelectorAll('.rhythm-vel-bar-cell');
    for (var c = 0; c < cells.length && c < _numSteps; c++) {
      // Find max velocity across all active rows for this column
      var maxVel = 0;
      for (var r = 0; r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
        if (_gridState[r] && _gridState[r][c] && _velocityState[r] && _velocityState[r][c] > maxVel) {
          maxVel = _velocityState[r][c];
        }
      }
      var bar = cells[c].querySelector('.rhythm-vel-bar');
      if (bar) {
        var heightPct = (maxVel / MAX_VELOCITY) * 100;
        bar.style.height = heightPct + '%';
        // Intensity-mapped color: dim at low velocity, bright at high
        var brightness = 30 + Math.round((maxVel / MAX_VELOCITY) * 70);
        if (maxVel > 0) {
          bar.style.background = 'hsl(330, 90%, ' + brightness + '%)';
        } else {
          bar.style.background = '#2a2a4a';
          bar.style.height = '2px';
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function _onVelBarMouseDown(e) {
    var col = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-col'));
    var rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
    _setVelFromMouse(col, e.clientY, rect);

    var self = this;
    function onMove(me) {
      _setVelFromMouse(col, me.clientY, rect);
    }
    function onUp() {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
  }

  function _setVelFromMouse(col, clientY, rect) {
    var relY = 1 - ((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height);
    var newVel = Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_VELOCITY, Math.round(relY * MAX_VELOCITY)));

    // Set velocity for all active rows in this column
    for (var r = 0; r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
      if (_gridState[r] && _gridState[r][col]) {
        _velocityState[r][col] = newVel;
      }
    }
    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _renderVelocityStrip();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 32-Step Toggle
  // ============================================================

  function _onStepToggle() {
    if (_numSteps === DEFAULT_NUM_STEPS) {
      _numSteps = 32;
    } else {
      _numSteps = DEFAULT_NUM_STEPS;
    }

    // Resize grid state and velocity state
    for (var r = 0; r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
      while (_gridState[r].length < _numSteps) {
        _gridState[r].push(false);
      }
      while (_velocityState[r].length < _numSteps) {
        _velocityState[r].push(DRUM_PAD_VELOCITY);
      }
    }

    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _buildGrid();

    // Update button text
    if (_stepToggleBtn) {
      if (_numSteps > DEFAULT_NUM_STEPS) {
        _stepToggleBtn.textContent = '32';
        _stepToggleBtn.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        _stepToggleBtn.textContent = '16';
        _stepToggleBtn.classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Drum Pad Builder
  // ============================================================

  function _buildPads() {
    if (!_padGridEl) {
      return;
    }
    _padGridEl.innerHTML = '';

    for (var i = 0; i < PAD_LAYOUT.length; i++) {
      var pad = document.createElement('div');
      pad.className = 'rhythm-pad';
      pad.setAttribute('data-pad-idx', i);
      pad.setAttribute('data-midi', PAD_LAYOUT[i].midi);

      var lbl = document.createElement('span');
      lbl.className = 'pad-label';
      lbl.textContent = PAD_LAYOUT[i].label;
      pad.appendChild(lbl);

      var keyHint = document.createElement('span');
      keyHint.className = 'pad-key';
      keyHint.textContent = PAD_LAYOUT[i].key;
      pad.appendChild(keyHint);

      pad.addEventListener('mousedown', _onPadHit);
      pad.addEventListener('mouseup', _onPadRelease);
      pad.addEventListener('mouseleave', _onPadRelease);

      _padGridEl.appendChild(pad);
    }

    // Build key map
    KEY_TO_PAD = {};
    for (var k = 0; k < PAD_LAYOUT.length; k++) {
      KEY_TO_PAD['Key' + PAD_LAYOUT[k].key] = k;
    }
  }

  function _onPadHit() {
    var midi = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-midi'));
    this.classList.add('hit');
    _triggerDrumSound(midi, DRUM_PAD_VELOCITY, undefined);
  }

  function _onPadRelease() {
    this.classList.remove('hit');
  }

  function _applyKitForDrum(drumTypeName) {
    var kit = DRUM_KITS[_activeKit];
    if (!kit || !kit[drumTypeName]) {
      return;
    }
    var overrides = kit[drumTypeName];
    if (SL.drumsyn && SL.drumsyn.setSettings) {
      var settings = (SL.drumsyn.getSettings) ? SL.drumsyn.getSettings(DRUM_INST_ID) : {};
      settings.drumType = drumTypeName;
      settings.pitch = overrides.pitch;
      settings.decay = overrides.decay;
      settings.tone = overrides.tone;
      settings.bodyNoiseMix = overrides.bodyNoiseMix;
      settings.drive = overrides.drive;
      SL.drumsyn.setSettings(DRUM_INST_ID, settings);
    }
  }

  function _onKitChange() {
    if (_kitSelect) {
      _activeKit = _kitSelect.value;
    }
    // Apply all drum type settings from the new kit immediately
    var kit = DRUM_KITS[_activeKit];
    if (kit) {
      for (var ri = 0; ri < DRUM_ROWS.length; ri++) {
        _applyKitForDrum(DRUM_ROWS[ri].cssClass);
      }
    }
  }

  function _triggerDrumSound(midi, velocity, rowIdx) {
    var effectiveVel = velocity || DRUM_PAD_VELOCITY;

    // Check mute/solo if row is specified
    if (rowIdx !== undefined) {
      var anySoloed = false;
      for (var si = 0; si < _rowSoloed.length; si++) {
        if (_rowSoloed[si]) { anySoloed = true; break; }
      }
      if (_rowMuted[rowIdx]) { return; }
      if (anySoloed && !_rowSoloed[rowIdx]) { return; }
      effectiveVel = Math.round(effectiveVel * (_rowVolumes[rowIdx] / 100));
    }

    // Apply drum kit overrides for the triggered drum type
    var kitType = null;
    if (rowIdx !== undefined && DRUM_ROWS[rowIdx]) {
      kitType = DRUM_ROWS[rowIdx].cssClass;
    }
    if (!kitType) {
      kitType = MIDI_TO_KIT_TYPE[midi] || 'kick';
    }
    _applyKitForDrum(kitType);

    if (SL.drumsyn && SL.drumsyn.noteOn) {
      SL.drumsyn.noteOn(midi, effectiveVel, DRUM_INST_ID);
    } else if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNoteOnInstrument) {
      SL.audio.playNoteOnInstrument(midi, 0.3, DRUM_INST_ID, effectiveVel);
    } else if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
      SL.audio.playNote(midi, 0.3);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Keyboard Handler for Pads
  // ============================================================

  function _onKeyDown(e) {
    if (!_active) {
      return;
    }
    var padIdx = KEY_TO_PAD[e.code];
    if (padIdx !== undefined) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var pads = _padGridEl.querySelectorAll('.rhythm-pad');
      if (pads[padIdx]) {
        pads[padIdx].classList.add('hit');
        _triggerDrumSound(PAD_LAYOUT[padIdx].midi, DRUM_PAD_VELOCITY, undefined);
      }
    }
  }

  function _onKeyUp(e) {
    if (!_active) {
      return;
    }
    var padIdx = KEY_TO_PAD[e.code];
    if (padIdx !== undefined) {
      var pads = _padGridEl.querySelectorAll('.rhythm-pad');
      if (pads[padIdx]) {
        pads[padIdx].classList.remove('hit');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Transport
  // ============================================================

  function _onPlay() {
    if (SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
      SL.sequencer.stopSeq();
      SL.sequencer.setLoopLength(0);
      _updateTransportUI();
      _stopPlayheadAnim();
    } else {
      // Reset chain position for fresh playback
      if (_chainEnabled && _chain.length > 0) {
        _chainPos = 0;
        _bmPatterns[_bmActivePattern] = _copyGrid(_gridState);
        _bmActivePattern = _chain[0];
        _gridState = _copyGrid(_bmPatterns[_bmActivePattern]);
      }
      _lastSeqStep = -1;
      var mainBpm = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
      if (mainBpm && _bpmInput) {
        mainBpm.value = _bpmInput.value;
      }
      _syncGridToSequencer();
      // Loop after _numSteps sixteenth notes (16 = 1 bar, 32 = 2 bars)
      SL.sequencer.setLoopLength(_numSteps);
      SL.sequencer.startSeq();
      _updateTransportUI();
      _startPlayheadAnim();
    }
  }

  function _onStop() {
    SL.sequencer.stopSeq();
    SL.sequencer.setLoopLength(0);
    _updateTransportUI();
    _stopPlayheadAnim();
    _currentStep = -1;
    _renderGrid();
  }

  function _onClear() {
    _initGridState();
    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _renderGrid();
  }

  function _updateTransportUI() {
    if (_playBtn) {
      if (SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
        _playBtn.textContent = '\u23F8';
        _playBtn.classList.add('playing');
      } else {
        _playBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
        _playBtn.classList.remove('playing');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Playhead Animation
  // ============================================================

  function _startPlayheadAnim() {
    _stopPlayheadAnim();
    _animFrameId = setInterval(_updatePlayhead, ANIM_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  function _stopPlayheadAnim() {
    if (_animFrameId) {
      clearInterval(_animFrameId);
      _animFrameId = null;
    }
  }

  function _updatePlayhead() {
    if (!SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
      _stopPlayheadAnim();
      _currentStep = -1;
      _lastSeqStep = -1;
      _renderGrid();
      _updateTransportUI();
    } else {
      // Use sequencer API instead of reading classic screen DOM
      var currentStep = SL.sequencer.getCurrentStep();
      var stepsPerPage = SL.sequencer.getStepsPerPage ? SL.sequencer.getStepsPerPage() : 64;
      var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
      var pageOffset = currentPage * stepsPerPage;
      var localStep = currentStep - pageOffset;

      // Detect loop wrap — step decreased means the sequencer looped
      if (_lastSeqStep >= 0 && localStep < _lastSeqStep && _chainEnabled && _chain.length > 0) {
        _chainAdvance();
      }
      _lastSeqStep = localStep;

      // 1:1 mapping — each grid step is one sequencer step (sixteenth note)
      var newStep = localStep;
      if (newStep >= 0 && newStep < _numSteps && newStep !== _currentStep) {
        _currentStep = newStep;
        _renderGrid();
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Swing
  // ============================================================

  function _onSwingChange() {
    if (_swingSlider && _swingValue) {
      _swingAmount = parseInt(_swingSlider.value);
      _swingValue.textContent = _swingAmount + '%';

        mainSwing.value = _swingAmount;
        mainSwing.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));

  // ============================================================
  // Pattern Presets
  // ============================================================

  function _populatePresets() {
    if (!_genreSelect || !_presetSelect) {
      return;
    }
    // Load patterns from JSON data (or fallback)
    _loadPatternsFromData();

    // Populate genre dropdown
    _genreSelect.innerHTML = '';
    var gi;
    for (gi = 0; gi < PATTERN_GROUPS.length; gi++) {
      var group = PATTERN_GROUPS[gi];

      opt.value = gi;
      opt.textContent = group.genre;
      _genreSelect.appendChild(opt);
    }

    // Select first genre and populate its patterns
    if (PATTERN_GROUPS.length > 0) {

    }
    _populatePatterns();
  }

  function _populatePatterns() {
    if (!_presetSelect || !_genreSelect) {
      return;
    }
    _presetSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Pattern --</option>';

    var genreIdx = parseInt(_genreSelect.value, 10);
    if (isNaN(genreIdx) || genreIdx < 0 || genreIdx >= PATTERN_GROUPS.length) {
      return;
    }

    var group = PATTERN_GROUPS[genreIdx];
    var pi;
    for (pi = 0; pi < group.patterns.length; pi++) {
      var name = group.patterns[pi];
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = name;
      opt.textContent = name;
      _presetSelect.appendChild(opt);
    }
  }

  function _onGenreChange() {
    _populatePatterns();
  }

  function _onPresetChange() {
    if (!_presetSelect) {
      return;
    }
    var presetName = _presetSelect.value;
    if (!presetName || !PATTERN_PRESETS[presetName]) {
      return;
    }

    var preset = PATTERN_PRESETS[presetName];
    _initGridState();

    // Map preset rows to drum grid rows
    var rowMap = {
      'kick': 0,
      'snare': 1,
      'hihat': 2,
      'clap': 3,
      'rim': 4,
      'tom': 5,
      'cymbal': 6,
      'perc': 7
    };

    var keys = Object.keys(preset);
    for (var ki = 0; ki < keys.length; ki++) {
      var rowName = keys[ki];
      var rowIdx = rowMap[rowName];
      if (rowIdx !== undefined) {
        var pattern = preset[rowName];
        for (var ci = 0; ci < pattern.length && ci < _numSteps; ci++) {
          _gridState[rowIdx][ci] = (pattern[ci] === 1);
        }
      }
    }

    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _buildGrid();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Euclidean Rhythm Generator
  // ============================================================

  function _generateEuclidean(pulses, steps, rotation) {
    // Bjorklund's algorithm
    var pattern = [];
    var i;
    if (pulses >= steps) {
      for (i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
        pattern.push(true);
      }
    } else if (pulses <= 0) {
      for (i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
        pattern.push(false);
      }
    } else {
      var bucket = 0;
      for (i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
        bucket += pulses;
        if (bucket >= steps) {
          bucket -= steps;
          pattern.push(true);
        } else {
          pattern.push(false);
        }
      }
    }

    // Apply rotation
    if (rotation > 0 && pattern.length > 0) {
      var rot = rotation % pattern.length;
      var tail = pattern.splice(0, rot);
      for (i = 0; i < tail.length; i++) {
        pattern.push(tail[i]);
      }
    }

    return pattern;
  }

  function _onEucPulsesChange() {
    if (_eucPulsesSlider && _eucPulsesValue) {
      _eucPulses = parseInt(_eucPulsesSlider.value);
      _eucPulsesValue.textContent = _eucPulses;
    }
  }

  function _onEucStepsChange() {
    if (_eucStepsSlider && _eucStepsValue) {
      _eucSteps = parseInt(_eucStepsSlider.value);
      _eucStepsValue.textContent = _eucSteps;
    }
  }

  function _onEucRotChange() {
    if (_eucRotSlider && _eucRotValue) {
      _eucRotation = parseInt(_eucRotSlider.value);
      _eucRotValue.textContent = _eucRotation;
    }
  }

  function _onEucApply() {
    if (_eucTargetSelect) {
      _eucTargetRow = parseInt(_eucTargetSelect.value);
    }
    var pattern = _generateEuclidean(_eucPulses, _eucSteps, _eucRotation);

    // Apply to target row, stretching/compressing to _numSteps
    for (var c = 0; c < _numSteps; c++) {
      var srcIdx = Math.floor(c * pattern.length / _numSteps);
      if (srcIdx < pattern.length) {
        _gridState[_eucTargetRow][c] = pattern[srcIdx];
      } else {
        _gridState[_eucTargetRow][c] = false;
      }
    }

    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _buildGrid();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init / Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _init() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }

    // Cache DOM references
    _bpmInput = document.getElementById('rhyScrBpm');
    _swingSlider = document.getElementById('rhyScrSwing');

    }

    // Wire events
    if (_playBtn) { _playBtn.addEventListener('click', _onPlay); }
    if (_stopBtn) { _stopBtn.addEventListener('click', _onStop); }
    if (_clearBtn) { _clearBtn.addEventListener('click', _onClear); }
    if (_swingSlider) { _swingSlider.addEventListener('input', _onSwingChange); }
    if (_genreSelect) { _genreSelect.addEventListener('change', _onGenreChange); }
    if (_presetSelect) { _presetSelect.addEventListener('change', _onPresetChange); }
    if (_eucPulsesSlider) { _eucPulsesSlider.addEventListener('input', _onEucPulsesChange); }
    if (_eucStepsSlider) { _eucStepsSlider.addEventListener('input', _onEucStepsChange); }
    if (_eucRotSlider) { _eucRotSlider.addEventListener('input', _onEucRotChange); }
    if (_eucApplyBtn) { _eucApplyBtn.addEventListener('click', _onEucApply); }
    if (_kitSelect) { _kitSelect.addEventListener('change', _onKitChange); }

    // Time signature selector
    _timeSigSelect = document.getElementById('rhyScrTimeSig');
    if (_timeSigSelect) {
      _timeSigSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var parts = _timeSigSelect.value.split('/');
        _beatsPerMeasure = parseInt(parts[0], 10) || 4;
        _buildGrid();
      });
    }

    // Build 32-step toggle button in top bar
    var topBar = document.querySelector('.rhythm-screen-top-bar');

      _stepToggleBtn.textContent = '16';
      _stepToggleBtn.title = 'Toggle 16/32 steps';
      _stepToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', _onStepToggle);
      topBar.appendChild(_stepToggleBtn);
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', _onKeyDown);
    document.addEventListener('keyup', _onKeyUp);

    // Populate presets and euclidean target
    _populatePresets();

      _eucTargetSelect.innerHTML = '';

        var opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = r;
        opt.textContent = DRUM_ROWS[r].name;
        _eucTargetSelect.appendChild(opt);
      }
    }

    // Init grid state and build
    _syncGridFromSequencer();
    _buildGrid();
    _buildPads();

    // Add "Edit Sound" and cross-screen nav buttons
    var container = document.getElementById('screen-rhythm');

      var editBtn = document.createElement('button');
      editBtn.className = 'screen-nav-link';

      editBtn.title = 'Switch to DESIGN with drum instrument selected';
      editBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.audio && SL.audio.setCurrentInstrument) {
          SL.audio.setCurrentInstrument(DRUM_INST_ID);
        }
        if (SL.screens && SL.screens.switchTo) {
          SL.screens.switchTo('design');
        }
      });
      navBar.appendChild(editBtn);

      container.appendChild(navBar);
    }

    _initialized = true;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Beatmaker (US-25)
  // ============================================================

  function _initBeatmakerPatterns() {
    if (_bmInitialized) {
      return;
    }
    _bmInitialized = true;
    _bmPatterns = [];
    for (var pi = 0; pi < BEATMAKER_PATTERN_COUNT; pi++) {
      var pat = [];
      for (var r = 0; r < DRUM_ROWS.length; r++) {
        var row = [];
        for (var c = 0; c < _numSteps; c++) {
          row.push(false);
        }
        pat.push(row);
      }
      _bmPatterns.push(pat);
    }
  }

  function _buildBeatmaker() {
    // Pattern chain A/B/C/D goes in the top bar instead of a separate section
    var topBar = document.querySelector('.rhythm-screen-top-bar');
    if (!topBar) {
      return;
    }
    if (document.getElementById('rhythm-beatmaker')) {
      return;
    }

    _initBeatmakerPatterns();

    var patBar = document.createElement('div');
    patBar.id = 'rhythm-beatmaker';
    patBar.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;margin-left:8px;';

    var label = document.createElement('span');
    label.style.cssText = 'color:#8888aa;font-size:11px;margin-right:2px;';
    label.textContent = 'Pattern:';
    patBar.appendChild(label);

    var patLabels = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'];
    for (var p = 0; p < BEATMAKER_PATTERN_COUNT; p++) {
      (function(idx) {
        var btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'rhy-scr-btn';
        btn.style.cssText = 'padding:2px 10px;font-size:0.65rem;font-weight:bold;' + (idx === _bmActivePattern ? 'background:#6a6aff;color:#fff;' : '');
        btn.textContent = patLabels[idx];
        btn.setAttribute('data-bm-pattern', idx);
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          _bmPatterns[_bmActivePattern] = _copyGrid(_gridState);
          _bmActivePattern = idx;
          _gridState = _copyGrid(_bmPatterns[_bmActivePattern]);
          _syncGridToSequencer();
          _buildGrid();
          var allBmBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bm-pattern]');
          for (var ab = 0; ab < allBmBtns.length; ab++) {
            if (parseInt(allBmBtns[ab].getAttribute('data-bm-pattern'), 10) === idx) {
              allBmBtns[ab].style.background = '#6a6aff';
              allBmBtns[ab].style.color = '#fff';
            } else {
              allBmBtns[ab].style.background = '';
              allBmBtns[ab].style.color = '';
            }
          }
        });
        patBar.appendChild(btn);
      })(p);
    }

    topBar.appendChild(patBar);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Pattern Chain / Arrangement
  // ============================================================

  function _buildChainUI() {
    var bottomBar = document.querySelector('.rhythm-screen-bottom');
    if (!bottomBar || _chainContainerEl) {
      return;
    }

    _chainContainerEl = document.createElement('div');
    _chainContainerEl.className = 'rhythm-chain-bar';

    var chainLabel = document.createElement('span');
    chainLabel.className = 'rhythm-chain-label';
    chainLabel.textContent = 'Chain:';
    _chainContainerEl.appendChild(chainLabel);

    var slotsWrap = document.createElement('div');
    slotsWrap.className = 'rhythm-chain-slots';
    slotsWrap.id = 'rhyChainSlots';
    _chainContainerEl.appendChild(slotsWrap);

    var addBtn = document.createElement('button');
    addBtn.className = 'rhy-scr-btn rhythm-chain-add-btn';
    addBtn.textContent = '+';
    addBtn.title = 'Add pattern to chain';
    addBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _chainAddSlot(_bmActivePattern);
    });
    _chainContainerEl.appendChild(addBtn);

    var clearChainBtn = document.createElement('button');
    clearChainBtn.className = 'rhy-scr-btn rhythm-chain-clear-btn';
    clearChainBtn.textContent = 'Clear';
    clearChainBtn.title = 'Clear chain';
    clearChainBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _chain = [];
      _chainPos = -1;
      _chainEnabled = false;
      _renderChainSlots();
    });
    _chainContainerEl.appendChild(clearChainBtn);

    bottomBar.innerHTML = '';
    bottomBar.appendChild(_chainContainerEl);
  }

  function _chainAddSlot(patIdx) {
    if (_chain.length >= 16) {
      return;
    }
    _chain.push(patIdx);
    _chainEnabled = true;
    _renderChainSlots();
  }

  function _chainRemoveSlot(slotIdx) {
    _chain.splice(slotIdx, 1);
    if (_chain.length === 0) {
      _chainEnabled = false;
      _chainPos = -1;
    }
    _renderChainSlots();
  }

  function _renderChainSlots() {
    var slotsWrap = document.getElementById('rhyChainSlots');
    if (!slotsWrap) {
      return;
    }
    slotsWrap.innerHTML = '';

    if (_chain.length === 0) {
      var emptyMsg = document.createElement('span');
      emptyMsg.className = 'rhythm-chain-empty';
      emptyMsg.textContent = 'Click + to add patterns';
      slotsWrap.appendChild(emptyMsg);
      return;
    }

    for (var si = 0; si < _chain.length; si++) {
      (function(idx) {
        var slot = document.createElement('div');
        slot.className = 'rhythm-chain-slot';
        if (idx === _chainPos && SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
          slot.classList.add('active');
        }

        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.className = 'rhythm-chain-select';
        for (var pi = 0; pi < BEATMAKER_PATTERN_COUNT; pi++) {
          var opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = pi;
          opt.textContent = CHAIN_LABELS[pi];
          sel.appendChild(opt);
        }
        sel.value = _chain[idx];
        sel.addEventListener('change', function() {
          _chain[idx] = parseInt(sel.value, 10);
        });
        slot.appendChild(sel);

        var removeBtn = document.createElement('button');
        removeBtn.className = 'rhythm-chain-remove';
        removeBtn.textContent = '\u00D7';
        removeBtn.title = 'Remove';
        removeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          _chainRemoveSlot(idx);
        });
        slot.appendChild(removeBtn);

        slotsWrap.appendChild(slot);
      })(si);
    }
  }

  function _chainAdvance() {
    if (!_chainEnabled || _chain.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    // Save current pattern
    _bmPatterns[_bmActivePattern] = _copyGrid(_gridState);

    // Advance to next chain position
    _chainPos = (_chainPos + 1) % _chain.length;
    var nextPat = _chain[_chainPos];

    // Switch to the pattern
    _bmActivePattern = nextPat;
    _gridState = _copyGrid(_bmPatterns[_bmActivePattern]);
    _syncGridToSequencer();
    _renderGrid();
    _renderChainSlots();

    // Update pattern A/B/C/D button highlights
    var allBmBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bm-pattern]');
    for (var ab = 0; ab < allBmBtns.length; ab++) {
      if (parseInt(allBmBtns[ab].getAttribute('data-bm-pattern'), 10) === nextPat) {
        allBmBtns[ab].style.background = '#6a6aff';
        allBmBtns[ab].style.color = '#fff';
      } else {
        allBmBtns[ab].style.background = '';
        allBmBtns[ab].style.color = '';
      }
    }
  }

  function _copyGrid(src) {
    var copy = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < src.length; r++) {
      copy.push(src[r].slice());
    }
    return copy;
  }

  function _syncFromModel() {
    // Read BPM from real sequencer
    if (_bpmInput && SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.getBpm) {
      _bpmInput.value = SL.sequencer.getBpm();
    }

    // Sync swing from real sequencer
    if (_swingSlider && SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.getSwing) {
      var swingVal = SL.sequencer.getSwing();
      _swingSlider.value = swingVal;
      if (_swingValue) {
        _swingValue.textContent = swingVal + '%';
      }
      _swingAmount = swingVal;
    }

    // Sync drum grid from the real sequencer notes
    _syncGridFromSequencer();
  }

  function activate(tabId) {
    _init();
    _active = true;

    // Ensure instrument 3 is set to drumsyn type for drum playback
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.getInstrumentType && SL.audio.setInstrumentType) {
      if (SL.audio.getInstrumentType(DRUM_INST_ID) !== 'drumsyn') {
        SL.audio.setInstrumentType(DRUM_INST_ID, 'drumsyn');
      }
    }

    // Ensure drum instrument volume is audible (default sampler volume may be low)
    var instruments = SL.audio && SL.audio.getInstruments ? SL.audio.getInstruments() : null;
    if (instruments && instruments[DRUM_INST_ID] && instruments[DRUM_INST_ID].volumeNode) {
      var drumVol = instruments[DRUM_INST_ID].volumeNode.gain.value;
      if (drumVol < 0.7) {
        instruments[DRUM_INST_ID].volumeNode.gain.value = 0.85;
      }
    }

    _syncFromModel();
    _buildGrid();
    _updateTransportUI();
    _buildBeatmaker();
    _buildChainUI();
    _renderChainSlots();
    if (SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
      _startPlayheadAnim();
    }

    // Handle beatmaker tab routing from sidebar
    if (tabId === 'beatmaker') {
      var bmSection = document.getElementById('rhythm-beatmaker');
      if (bmSection) {
        bmSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _stopPlayheadAnim();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenRhythm = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };

})();

  function isBlackKey(pc) {
    for (var i = 0; i < BLACK_KEYS.length; i++) {
      if (BLACK_KEYS[i] === pc) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function getScaleChords() {
    var mode = SL.MODES[_currentMode];
    if (!mode) {
      return [];
    }
    var chords = [];
    for (var d = 0; d < mode.scale.length && d < 7; d++) {
      var pc = (_rootNote + mode.scale[d]) % 12;
      var type = mode.triads[d];
      var baseMidi = 5 * 12 + pc; // octave 5
      var intervals = SL.CHORD_INT[type] || [0, 4, 7];
      var notes = [];
      for (var n = 0; n < intervals.length; n++) {
        notes.push(baseMidi + intervals[n]);
      }
      var suffix = SL.CHORD_NAME[type] || '';
      chords.push({
        degree: d,
        rootPc: pc,
        type: type,
        notes: notes,
        name: NOTES[pc] + suffix,
        numeral: ROMAN_NUMERALS[d]
      });
    }
    return chords;
  }

  function getChordNotes(rootPc, type) {
    var baseMidi = 5 * 12 + rootPc;
    var intervals = SL.CHORD_INT[type] || [0, 4, 7];
    var notes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < intervals.length; i++) {
      notes.push(baseMidi + intervals[i]);
    }
    return notes;
  }

    var panels = _containerEl.querySelectorAll('.harmony-subtab-content');
    for (var ti = 0; ti < tabs.length; ti++) {
      if (tabs[ti].getAttribute('data-tab') === tabName) {
        tabs[ti].classList.add('active');
      } else {
        tabs[ti].classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
    for (var pi = 0; pi < panels.length; pi++) {
      if (panels[pi].getAttribute('data-tab') === tabName) {
        panels[pi].classList.add('active');
      } else {
        panels[pi].classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
    if (tabName === 'sequencer' && !_seqTabBuilt) {
      _buildSeqTab();
    }
  }

  function _onKeyChange() {
    _updateKeyDisplay();
    _buildPalette();
    _buildPiano();
    // Re-evaluate progression chords for new key
    _buildSlots();
    _buildPresetGrid();
    _highlightPianoNotes([]);
  }

  function _updateKeyDisplay() {
    if (_keyDisplayEl) {
      var mode = SL.MODES[_currentMode];
      var modeName = mode ? mode.name : _currentMode;
      _keyDisplayEl.textContent = NOTES[_rootNote] + ' ' + modeName;
    }
  }

  function _buildPalette() {
    if (!_paletteEl) {
      return;
    }
    _paletteEl.innerHTML = '';
    var chords = getScaleChords();
    for (var i = 0; i < chords.length; i++) {
      (function(chord, idx) {
        var btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'harmony-chord-btn ' + DEGREE_CLASSES[idx % DEGREE_CLASSES.length];
        btn.textContent = chord.numeral + ' - ' + chord.name;
        btn.title = 'Click to add ' + chord.name + ' to progression';

        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          _addToProgression(chord);
        });

        btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
          _highlightPianoNotes(chord.notes);
        });

        btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
          _highlightPianoNotes([]);
        });

        _paletteEl.appendChild(btn);
      })(chords[i], i);
    }
  }

  function _addToProgression(chord) {
    if (_progression.length >= _progLength) {
      return;
    }
    _progression.push({
      degree: chord.degree,
      rootPc: chord.rootPc,
      type: chord.type,
      notes: chord.notes.slice(),
      name: chord.name,
      numeral: chord.numeral
    });
    _buildSlots();
    // Play the chord on add
    _playChordNotes(chord.notes);
  }

  function _buildPresetGrid() {
    if (!_presetGridEl) {
      return;
    }
    _presetGridEl.innerHTML = '';

    if (!SL.PROG_GROUPS) {
      return;
    }

    // Find the genre group matching _selectedProgGenre
    var genreIdx = -1;
    var group = null;
    for (var gi = 0; gi < SL.PROG_GROUPS.length; gi++) {
      if (SL.PROG_GROUPS[gi].genre === _selectedProgGenre) {
        genreIdx = gi;
        group = SL.PROG_GROUPS[gi];
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!group) {
      return;
    }

    var mode = SL.MODES[_currentMode];
    var progs = group.progressions;

    for (var pi = 0; pi < progs.length; pi++) {
      (function(prog, progIdx, gIdx) {
        var row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'harmony-preset-row';

        // Load button
        var loadBtn = document.createElement('button');
        loadBtn.className = 'harmony-preset-load-btn';
        loadBtn.textContent = 'Load';
        loadBtn.title = 'Load "' + prog.name + '" into progression slots';
        loadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          _applyPresetFromData(gIdx, progIdx);
        });
        row.appendChild(loadBtn);

        // Name and usage label column
        var labelCol = document.createElement('div');
        labelCol.className = 'harmony-preset-label-col';
        var nameEl = document.createElement('div');
        nameEl.className = 'harmony-preset-name';
        nameEl.textContent = prog.name;
        labelCol.appendChild(nameEl);
        if (prog.usage) {
          var usageEl = document.createElement('div');
          usageEl.className = 'harmony-preset-usage';
          usageEl.textContent = prog.usage;
          labelCol.appendChild(usageEl);
        }
        row.appendChild(labelCol);

        // Chord preview: show resolved chord names for current key
        var chordPreview = document.createElement('div');
        chordPreview.className = 'harmony-preset-chords';
        if (mode) {
          for (var di = 0; di < prog.degs.length; di++) {
            var d = prog.degs[di];
            if (d < mode.scale.length) {
              var pc = (_rootNote + mode.scale[d % mode.scale.length]) % 12;
              var type = mode.triads[d % mode.triads.length];
              var suffix = SL.CHORD_NAME[type] || '';
              var numeral = (type === 'maj') ? ROMAN_NUMERALS[d] : ROMAN_NUMERALS[d].toLowerCase();

              var chordEl = document.createElement('span');
              chordEl.className = 'harmony-preset-chord';
              chordEl.textContent = NOTES[pc] + suffix;
              chordEl.title = numeral;
              chordPreview.appendChild(chordEl);
            }
          }
        }
        row.appendChild(chordPreview);

        _presetGridEl.appendChild(row);
      })(progs[pi], pi, genreIdx);
    }
  }

  function _applyPresetFromData(genreIdx, progIdx) {
    if (!SL.PROG_GROUPS) {
      return;
    }
    var group = SL.PROG_GROUPS[genreIdx];
    if (!group) {
      return;
    }
    var prog = group.progressions[progIdx];
    if (!prog) {
      return;
    }
    var degrees = prog.degs;
    _applyPresetDegrees(degrees);
  }

  function _applyPresetDegrees(degrees) {
    var chords = getScaleChords();
    _stopPlay();
    _progression = [];
    // Expand length if preset has more degrees than current length
    if (degrees.length > _progLength) {
      _progLength = degrees.length;
      if (_progLengthSelectEl) {
        var found = false;
        for (var oi = 0; oi < _progLengthSelectEl.options.length; oi++) {
          if (parseInt(_progLengthSelectEl.options[oi].value, 10) === _progLength) {
            _progLengthSelectEl.value = _progLength;
            found = true;
          }
        }
        if (!found) {
          _progLengthSelectEl.value = '';
        }
      }
    }
    for (var di = 0; di < degrees.length; di++) {
      var degIdx = degrees[di];
      if (degIdx < chords.length) {
        var chord = chords[degIdx];
        _progression.push({
          degree: chord.degree,
          rootPc: chord.rootPc,
          type: chord.type,
          notes: chord.notes.slice(),
          name: chord.name,
          numeral: chord.numeral
        });
      }
    }
    _buildSlots();
    _highlightPianoNotes([]);
  }

  function _buildSlots() {
    if (!_slotsEl) {
      return;
    }
    _slotsEl.innerHTML = '';
    var slotCount = _progLength;
    for (var i = 0; i < slotCount; i++) {
      (function(idx) {
        var slot = document.createElement('div');
        slot.className = 'harmony-slot';
        slot.setAttribute('data-index', idx);

        var numEl = document.createElement('span');
        numEl.className = 'slot-number';
        numEl.textContent = idx + 1;
        slot.appendChild(numEl);

        if (idx < _progression.length) {
          var entry = _progression[idx];
          slot.classList.add('filled');

          var numeralEl = document.createElement('span');
          numeralEl.className = 'slot-numeral';
          numeralEl.textContent = entry.numeral;
          slot.appendChild(numeralEl);

          var nameEl = document.createElement('span');
          nameEl.className = 'slot-name';
          nameEl.textContent = entry.name;
          slot.appendChild(nameEl);

          var removeEl = document.createElement('span');
          removeEl.className = 'slot-remove';
          removeEl.textContent = 'x';
          removeEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            _progression.splice(idx, 1);
            _buildSlots();
          });
          slot.appendChild(removeEl);

          slot.addEventListener('click', function() {
            _playChordNotes(entry.notes);
            _highlightPianoNotes(entry.notes);
          });

          slot.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
            _highlightPianoNotes(entry.notes);
          });

          slot.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            _highlightPianoNotes([]);
          });

          if (idx === _currentPlayIndex) {
            slot.classList.add('playing');
          }
        }

        _slotsEl.appendChild(slot);
      })(i);
    }
  }

  function _buildPiano() {
    if (!_pianoEl) {
      return;
    }
    _pianoEl.innerHTML = '';
    // Build top-down (high notes to low)
    for (var k = PIANO_TOTAL_KEYS - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
      var pc = k % 12;
      var oct = PIANO_OCTAVE_START + Math.floor(k / 12);
      var key = document.createElement('div');
      key.className = 'harmony-piano-key';
      if (isBlackKey(pc)) {
        key.classList.add('black-key');
      } else {
        key.classList.add('white-key');
      }
      key.setAttribute('data-midi', String(oct * 12 + pc));
      key.textContent = NOTES[pc] + oct;
      _pianoEl.appendChild(key);
    }
  }

  function _highlightPianoNotes(midiNotes) {
    if (!_pianoEl) {
      return;
    }
    var keys = _pianoEl.querySelectorAll('.harmony-piano-key');
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      var keyMidi = parseInt(keys[i].getAttribute('data-midi'), 10);
      keys[i].classList.remove('highlighted', 'root-key');
      var found = false;
      var isRoot = false;
      for (var n = 0; n < midiNotes.length; n++) {
        if (midiNotes[n] === keyMidi) {
          found = true;
          if (n === 0) {
            isRoot = true;
          }
        }
      }
      if (found) {
        if (isRoot) {
          keys[i].classList.add('root-key');
        } else {
          keys[i].classList.add('highlighted');
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Playback
  // ============================================================

  // Minimum release padding (seconds) so notes always fade out cleanly
  var HARMONY_MIN_RELEASE_PAD = 0.15;

  // Small gap (ms) between chord transitions to prevent clicking/popping.
  // Old notes' release envelopes begin during this window before new notes start.
  var CHORD_CROSSFADE_MS = 18;

  function _getReleasePad() {
    // Read current ADSR release to ensure playNote duration includes enough
    // time for the release ramp — prevents hard cutoff clipping
    var adsr = (SL.audio && SL.audio.getADSR) ? SL.audio.getADSR() : null;
    var releaseSec = (adsr && adsr.r) ? adsr.r : HARMONY_MIN_RELEASE_PAD;
    if (releaseSec < HARMONY_MIN_RELEASE_PAD) {
      releaseSec = HARMONY_MIN_RELEASE_PAD;
    }
    return releaseSec;
  }

  function _playChordNotes(notes) {
    if (!SL.audio || !SL.audio.playNote) {
      return;
    }
    var relPad = _getReleasePad();
    var baseDur = 0.5;
    // Total duration = audible sustain + release fade
    var dur = baseDur + relPad;

    if (_rhythmMode === 'sustained') {
      for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
        SL.audio.playNote(notes[i], dur);
      }
    } else if (_rhythmMode === 'quarter' || _rhythmMode === 'eighth') {
      var shortDur = baseDur * 0.4 + relPad;
      for (var j = 0; j < notes.length; j++) {
        SL.audio.playNote(notes[j], shortDur);
      }
    } else if (_rhythmMode === 'arp-up') {
      var sorted = notes.slice().sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
      var arpDelay = 60000 / _bpm / sorted.length;
      var arpDur = 0.3 + relPad;
      for (var a = 0; a < sorted.length; a++) {
        (function(midi, delay) {
          var tid = setTimeout(function() { SL.audio.playNote(midi, arpDur); }, delay);
          _playTimeouts.push(tid);
        })(sorted[a], a * arpDelay);
      }
    } else if (_rhythmMode === 'arp-down') {
      var sortedDown = notes.slice().sort(function(a, b) { return b - a; });
      var arpDelayD = 60000 / _bpm / sortedDown.length;
      var arpDurD = 0.3 + relPad;
      for (var ad = 0; ad < sortedDown.length; ad++) {
        (function(midi, delay) {
          var tid = setTimeout(function() { SL.audio.playNote(midi, arpDurD); }, delay);
          _playTimeouts.push(tid);
        })(sortedDown[ad], ad * arpDelayD);
      }
    } else if (_rhythmMode === 'strum') {
      var strumSorted = notes.slice().sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
      var strumDur = 0.8 + relPad;
      var STRUM_BASE_DELAY_MS = 25;
      var STRUM_JITTER_MS = 20;
      var STRUM_VEL_MIN = 60;
      var STRUM_VEL_MAX = 110;
      var STRUM_VEL_ACCENT = 120;
      var strumCount = strumSorted.length;
      var accumDelay = 0;
      for (var s = 0; s < strumCount; s++) {
        var jitter = Math.floor(Math.random() * STRUM_JITTER_MS);
        accumDelay += STRUM_BASE_DELAY_MS + jitter;
        // Velocity curve: softer at edges, louder in middle, accent last note
        var velNorm = s / (strumCount > 1 ? strumCount - 1 : 1);
        var vel;
        if (s === strumCount - 1) {
          vel = STRUM_VEL_ACCENT;
        } else {
          vel = Math.round(STRUM_VEL_MIN + (STRUM_VEL_MAX - STRUM_VEL_MIN) * Math.sin(velNorm * Math.PI));
        }
        (function(midi, delay, noteVel) {
          var tid = setTimeout(function() {
            if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNoteOnInstrument) {
              SL.audio.playNoteOnInstrument(midi, strumDur, 0, noteVel);
            } else if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
              SL.audio.playNote(midi, strumDur);
            }
          }, delay);
          _playTimeouts.push(tid);
        })(strumSorted[s], accumDelay, vel);
      }
    }
  }

  function _togglePlay() {
    if (_isPlaying) {
      _stopPlay();
    } else {
      _startPlay();
    }
  }

  function _startPlay() {
    if (_progression.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    _isPlaying = true;
    _isFirstChordAfterStart = true;
    if (_playBtnEl) {
      _playBtnEl.textContent = '\u23F8';
      _playBtnEl.classList.add('playing');
    }
    _currentPlayIndex = 0;
    _playNextChord();
  }

  function _playNextChord() {
    if (!_isPlaying) {
      _stopPlay();
      return;
    }
    if (_currentPlayIndex >= _progression.length) {
      if (_loopEnabled) {
        _currentPlayIndex = 0;
      } else {
        _stopPlay();
        return;
      }
    }
    var entry = _progression[_currentPlayIndex];
    _buildSlots(); // refresh to show playing state
    _highlightPianoNotes(entry.notes);

    // Clear any pending arp/strum note timeouts from the previous chord
    // so straggling noteOn calls don't collide with the new chord.
    // Keep only the chord-scheduling timeout (added below).
    for (var ci = 0; ci < _playTimeouts.length; ci++) {
      clearTimeout(_playTimeouts[ci]);
    }
    _playTimeouts = [];

    // On the very first chord after pressing play there is nothing to
    // crossfade from, so play immediately. On subsequent chords (including
    // loop-around), insert a tiny gap so the previous notes' release
    // envelopes can begin before new notes trigger — this eliminates the
    // click/pop artefact.
    var gapMs;
    if (_isFirstChordAfterStart) {
      _isFirstChordAfterStart = false;
      gapMs = 0;
    } else {
      gapMs = CHORD_CROSSFADE_MS;
    }

    var gapTid = setTimeout(function() {
      if (!_isPlaying) {
        return;
      }
      _playChordNotes(entry.notes);
    }, gapMs);
    _playTimeouts.push(gapTid);

    var beatMs = 60000 / _bpm;
    var chordDuration = beatMs * 2; // each chord lasts 2 beats by default

    if (_rhythmMode === 'eighth') {
      chordDuration = beatMs;
    } else if (_rhythmMode === 'quarter') {
      chordDuration = beatMs;
    }

    var nextIdx = _currentPlayIndex + 1;
    var tid = setTimeout(function() {
      _currentPlayIndex = nextIdx;
      _playNextChord();
    }, chordDuration);
    _playTimeouts.push(tid);
  }

  function _stopPlay() {
    _isPlaying = false;
    _currentPlayIndex = -1;
    for (var i = 0; i < _playTimeouts.length; i++) {
      clearTimeout(_playTimeouts[i]);
    }
    _playTimeouts = [];
    if (_playBtnEl) {
      _playBtnEl.textContent = '\u25B6';
      _playBtnEl.classList.remove('playing');
    }
    _buildSlots();
    _highlightPianoNotes([]);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Send to Sequencer
  // ============================================================

  function _sendToSequencer() {
    if (_progression.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    if (!SL.sequencer || !SL.sequencer.seqNotes) {
      return;
    }

    var notes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    var currentPage = SL.sequencer.getCurrentPage();
    var stepsPerPage = 64;
    var pageOffset = currentPage * stepsPerPage;
    var instId = SL.audio ? SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument() : 0;

    // Determine chord duration in steps based on rhythm mode
    var stepsPerChord = 16; // 1 bar = 16 steps by default (sustained)
    if (_rhythmMode === 'quarter' || _rhythmMode === 'eighth') {
      stepsPerChord = 4; // 1 beat
    }

    for (var ci = 0; ci < _progression.length; ci++) {
      var chord = _progression[ci];
      var chordStart = pageOffset + (ci * stepsPerChord);
      // Don't overflow the page
      if (chordStart >= pageOffset + stepsPerPage) {
        break;
      }
      var chordDur = Math.min(stepsPerChord, pageOffset + stepsPerPage - chordStart);

      for (var ni = 0; ni < chord.notes.length; ni++) {
        var midi = chord.notes[ni];
        var row = midi - (SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI || 36);
        if (row < 0) {
          row = 0;
        }
        notes.push({
          row: row,
          start: chordStart,
          dur: chordDur,
          midi: midi,
          instrument: instId,
          vel: 100
        });
      }
    }

    // Switch to sequence screen
    if (SL.screens && SL.screens.switchTo) {
      SL.screens.switchTo('sequence');
    }
  }

    var melGrid = document.createElement('div');

      cell.setAttribute('data-melody-step', mg);

      var target = e.target;
      if (target.hasAttribute('data-melody-step')) {

        var rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        var relY = 1 - ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height);
        // Map Y to MIDI range 60-84 (C4-C6)
        var midi = Math.round(60 + relY * 24);
        _melodySteps[step] = midi;
        _renderMelodyGrid();
        if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
          SL.audio.playNote(midi, 60, 0.2);

    });

  function _transposeProgression(semitones) {
    for (var ci = 0; ci < _progression.length; ci++) {
      var chord = _progression[ci];
      chord.rootPc = (chord.rootPc + semitones + 12) % 12;
      for (var ni = 0; ni < chord.notes.length; ni++) {
        chord.notes[ni] += semitones;
      }
      var suffix = SL.CHORD_NAME[chord.type] || '';
      chord.name = NOTES[chord.rootPc] + suffix;
    }
    _buildSlots();
  }

  function _renderMelodyGrid() {
    var cells = document.querySelectorAll('[data-melody-step]');
    for (var c = 0; c < cells.length; c++) {
      var step = parseInt(cells[c].getAttribute('data-melody-step'), 10);
      cells[c].innerHTML = '';
      if (_melodySteps[step] >= 0) {
        var dot = document.createElement('div');
        var relY = (_melodySteps[step] - 60) / 24;
        var bottomPct = Math.max(2, Math.min(90, relY * 100));
        dot.style.cssText = 'width:14px;height:14px;background:#6a6aff;border-radius:50%;position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:' + bottomPct + '%;';
        cells[c].appendChild(dot);
      }
    }
  }

  function _buildMotifControls(parent, motifNum, settings) {
    var cs = SL.chordSeq;
    if (!cs) {
      return;
    }
    var patterns = cs.getBuiltinPatterns();
    var rhythms = cs.getBuiltinRhythms();
    var clockNames = cs.getClockDivNames();
    var setFn = (motifNum === 1) ? cs.setMotif1Settings : cs.setMotif2Settings;

    // Pattern selector
    var patNames = [];
    for (var pi = 0; pi < patterns.length; pi++) {
      patNames.push(patterns[pi].name);
    }
    _addSelect(parent, 'Pat', patNames, function(v) {
      for (var fi = 0; fi < patterns.length; fi++) {
        if (patterns[fi].name === v) {
          setFn({ patternIndex: fi });
          break;
        }
      }
    }, patterns[settings.patternIndex] ? patterns[settings.patternIndex].name : patNames[0]);

    // Rhythm selector
    var rhtNames = [];
    for (var ri = 0; ri < rhythms.length; ri++) {
      rhtNames.push(rhythms[ri].name);
    }
    _addSelect(parent, 'Rhy', rhtNames, function(v) {
      for (var fi = 0; fi < rhythms.length; fi++) {
        if (rhythms[fi].name === v) {
          setFn({ rhythmIndex: fi });
          break;
        }
      }
    }, rhythms[settings.rhythmIndex] ? rhythms[settings.rhythmIndex].name : rhtNames[0]);

    // Clock div
    _addSelect(parent, 'Div', clockNames, function(v) {
      for (var ci = 0; ci < clockNames.length; ci++) {
        if (clockNames[ci] === v) {
          setFn({ clockDiv: ci });
          break;
        }
      }
    }, clockNames[settings.clockDiv] || clockNames[0]);

    // Octave
    _addNumberInput(parent, 'Oct', -2, 3, settings.octave, function(v) {
      setFn({ octave: v });
    });
