    _addSelect(parent, 'Mode', ['chord', 'scale'], function(v) {
      setFn({ noteMode: v });
    }, settings.noteMode);
  }

  // ---- Timeline Rendering ----

  function _rebuildSeqTimeline() {
    if (!_seqTimelineEl || !SL.chordSeq) {
      return;
    }
    _seqTimelineEl.innerHTML = '';
    var seq = SL.chordSeq.getSequence();
    var ROMAN = ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII'];

    for (var si = 0; si < seq.steps.length; si++) {
      (function(step, idx) {
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'cseq-step deg-' + step.degree;
        el.setAttribute('data-step-idx', idx);

        var degSpan = document.createElement('span');
        degSpan.className = 'step-degree';
        degSpan.textContent = ROMAN[step.degree] || '?';
        el.appendChild(degSpan);

        var typeSpan = document.createElement('span');
        typeSpan.className = 'step-type';
        typeSpan.textContent = step.type;
        el.appendChild(typeSpan);

        var durSpan = document.createElement('span');
        durSpan.className = 'step-dur';
        durSpan.textContent = step.duration + ' beats';
        el.appendChild(durSpan);

        var removeSpan = document.createElement('span');
        removeSpan.className = 'step-remove';
        removeSpan.textContent = 'x';
        removeSpan.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          SL.chordSeq.removeStep(idx);
          _rebuildSeqTimeline();
        });
        el.appendChild(removeSpan);

        // Click to edit (cycle chord type)
        el.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var types = ['major', 'minor', 'dim', 'aug', 'sus2', 'sus4', 'maj7', 'min7', 'dom7'];
          var curIdx = 0;
          for (var ti = 0; ti < types.length; ti++) {
            if (types[ti] === step.type) {
              curIdx = ti;
              break;
            }
          }
          var nextType = types[(curIdx + 1) % types.length];
          SL.chordSeq.updateStep(idx, { type: nextType });
          _rebuildSeqTimeline();
        });

        _seqTimelineEl.appendChild(el);
      })(seq.steps[si], si);
    }

    // Add button
    var addBtn = document.createElement('button');
    addBtn.className = 'cseq-add-btn';
    addBtn.textContent = '+';
    addBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      SL.chordSeq.addStep(0, 'major', 4);
      _rebuildSeqTimeline();
    });
    _seqTimelineEl.appendChild(addBtn);
  }

  function _updateSeqChordDisplay() {
    if (!_seqChordDisplay || !SL.chordSeq) {
      return;
    }
    var chord = SL.chordSeq.getChord();
    var ROMAN = ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII'];
    var noteName = NOTES[chord.rootPc] || '?';
    _seqChordDisplay.textContent = noteName + ' ' + chord.type + ' (' + (ROMAN[chord.degree] || '?') + ')';
  }

  function _refreshSeqParts() {
    // Refresh part toggle states after preset load
    if (!SL.chordSeq) {
      return;
    }
    var enabled = SL.chordSeq.getPartEnabled();
    var toggles = document.querySelectorAll('.cseq-part-toggle');
    // First 4 toggles are the part toggles (skip perlin toggle)
    var partToggles = [];
    var partContainer = document.getElementById('cseq-parts');
    if (partContainer) {
      var btns = partContainer.querySelectorAll('.cseq-part-toggle');
      for (var bi = 0; bi < btns.length; bi++) {
        if (bi < enabled.length) {
          if (enabled[bi]) {
            btns[bi].classList.add('on');
          } else {
            btns[bi].classList.remove('on');
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function _refreshSeqPerlin() {
    if (!SL.chordSeq) {
      return;
    }
    var ps = SL.chordSeq.getPerlinSettings();
    var toggle = document.querySelector('#cseq-perlin .cseq-part-toggle');
    if (toggle) {
      if (ps.enabled) {
        toggle.classList.add('on');
      } else {
        toggle.classList.remove('on');
      }
    }
  }

  var _seqUpdateTimer = null;
  function _startSeqUIUpdate() {
    if (_seqUpdateTimer) {
      return;
    }
    _seqUpdateTimer = setInterval(function() {
      if (!SL.chordSeq || !SL.chordSeq.isPlaying()) {
        clearInterval(_seqUpdateTimer);
        _seqUpdateTimer = null;
        // Reset play button
        if (_seqPlayBtn) {
          _seqPlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
          _seqPlayBtn.classList.remove('playing');
        }
        // Remove playing class from all steps
        if (_seqTimelineEl) {
          var steps = _seqTimelineEl.querySelectorAll('.cseq-step');
          for (var ri = 0; ri < steps.length; ri++) {
            steps[ri].classList.remove('playing');
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      _updateSeqChordDisplay();
      // Highlight current step
      if (_seqTimelineEl) {
        var curStep = SL.chordSeq.getCurrentStep();
        var seq = SL.chordSeq.getSequence();
        var allSteps = _seqTimelineEl.querySelectorAll('.cseq-step');
        for (var hi = 0; hi < allSteps.length; hi++) {
          allSteps[hi].classList.remove('playing');
        }
        // The resolved step index maps to a step in the steps array
        // We highlight whichever step is currently playing
        if (curStep.resolvedLength > 0 && curStep.index < curStep.resolvedLength) {
          // Find which step index in the sequence
          var resolved = SL.chordSeq.getSequence();
          // For simplicity, highlight based on the current chord degree
          var chord = SL.chordSeq.getChord();
          for (var ci = 0; ci < allSteps.length; ci++) {
            var stepIdx = parseInt(allSteps[ci].getAttribute('data-step-idx'), 10);
            if (stepIdx < seq.steps.length && seq.steps[stepIdx].degree === chord.degree) {
              allSteps[ci].classList.add('playing');
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }, 100);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _syncFromModel() {
    // Sync root/mode from the main (classic) screen selectors
    var mainRoot = document.getElementById('rootNote');
    var mainMode = document.getElementById('mode');
    if (_rootSelectEl && mainRoot) {
      _rootSelectEl.value = mainRoot.value;
    }
    if (_modeSelectEl && mainMode) {
      _modeSelectEl.value = mainMode.value;
    }
  }

  function activate(tabId) {
    _init();
    _active = true;
    _syncFromModel();
    _updateKeyDisplay();
    _buildPalette();
    _buildPiano();
    _buildSlots();
    _buildPresetGrid();
    _buildSongwriter();

    // Handle sub-tab routing from sidebar
    if (tabId === 'songwriter') {
      _switchSubTab('songwriter');
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _stopPlay();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenHarmony = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };
})();

  /**
   * Find ENGINE_CATALOG entry by key.
   */
  function _findEngine(engineKey) {
    for (var i = 0; i < ENGINE_CATALOG.length; i++) {
      if (ENGINE_CATALOG[i].key === engineKey) {
        return ENGINE_CATALOG[i];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Populate a <select> element with option values/labels.
   * Returns the value that was selected (first option if currentVal not found).
   */
  function _populateSelect(sel, items, currentVal) {
    sel.innerHTML = '';
    var found = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = items[i].value;
      opt.textContent = items[i].label;
      if (items[i].value === currentVal) {
        found = true;
      }
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    }
    if (found) {
      sel.value = currentVal;
    } else if (items.length > 0) {
      sel.value = items[0].value;
    }
    return sel.value;
  }

  /**
   * Apply a preset to the instrument for a given part.
   */
  function _applyPresetToPart(partIndex, engineKey, presetName) {
    var instId = PART_INSTRUMENT[partIndex];
    var eng = _findEngine(engineKey);
    if (!eng || !SL.presets || !SL.presets[eng.apply]) {
      console.warn('[VoxMachina] Cannot apply - engine not found:', engineKey);
      return;
    }
    var allPresets = SL.presets[eng.get]();
    for (var i = 0; i < allPresets.length; i++) {
      if (allPresets[i].name === presetName) {
        console.log('[VoxMachina] Part', partIndex, '-> inst', instId, ':', engineKey, '/', presetName);
        SL.presets[eng.apply](allPresets[i], instId);
        return;
      }
    }
    console.warn('[VoxMachina] Preset not found:', engineKey, '/', presetName);
  }

  /**
   * Apply voice defaults for a chord sequencer preset.
   * Updates both the dropdown UI and the actual instrument for each part.
   */
  function _applyVoiceDefaults(presetName) {
    var voices = PRESET_VOICES[presetName];
    if (!voices) {
      console.warn('[VoxMachina] No voice defaults for preset:', presetName);
      return;
    }
    console.log('[VoxMachina] Applying voice defaults for:', presetName);
    for (var pi = 0; pi < voices.length; pi++) {
      var v = voices[pi];
      var vs = _voiceSelects[pi];
      if (!v || !vs) {
        console.warn('[VoxMachina] Skipping part', pi, '- no voice or no select');
        continue;
      }
      // Update engine dropdown
      vs.engineSel.value = v.engine;
      // Repopulate category dropdown for this engine
      var typeStr = ENGINE_KEY_TO_TYPE[v.engine] || v.engine;
      var cats = SL.presets.getCategories(typeStr);
      var catItems = [];
      for (var ci = 0; ci < cats.length; ci++) {
        catItems.push({ value: cats[ci], label: cats[ci] });
      }
      _populateSelect(vs.catSel, catItems, v.category);
      // Repopulate preset dropdown for this engine+category
      var selCat = vs.catSel.value;
      var presetList = SL.presets.getPresetsByCategory(typeStr, selCat);
      var presetItems = [];
      for (var pri = 0; pri < presetList.length; pri++) {
        presetItems.push({ value: presetList[pri].name, label: presetList[pri].name });
      }
      _populateSelect(vs.presetSel, presetItems, v.preset);
      // Apply the selected preset to the instrument (no retrigger here —
      // loadPreset already stops/restarts the sequencer, so new sounds
      // will play naturally on the next step)
      var selectedPreset = vs.presetSel.value;
      if (selectedPreset) {
        _applyPresetToPart(pi, v.engine, selectedPreset);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Build cascading Engine/Category/Preset dropdowns for a part.
   * Returns a container <div> with all three selects.
   */
  function _buildVoiceSelect(partIndex) {
    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'cseq-voice-cascade';
    container.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;';

    var engineSel = document.createElement('select');
    engineSel.className = 'cseq-voice-select cseq-engine-sel';

    var catSel = document.createElement('select');
    catSel.className = 'cseq-voice-select cseq-cat-sel';

    var presetSel = document.createElement('select');
    presetSel.className = 'cseq-voice-select cseq-preset-sel';

    // Build engine options from ENGINE_CATALOG
    var engineItems = [];
    for (var ei = 0; ei < ENGINE_CATALOG.length; ei++) {
      var eng = ENGINE_CATALOG[ei];
      if (!SL.presets || !SL.presets[eng.get]) {
        continue;
      }
      var presets = SL.presets[eng.get]();
      if (!presets || presets.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      engineItems.push({ value: eng.key, label: eng.label });
    }

    var defaults = PART_DEFAULTS[partIndex];

    /**
     * Populate category dropdown for the given engine key.
     * Returns the selected category.
     */
    function populateCategories(engineKey, preferredCat) {
      var typeStr = ENGINE_KEY_TO_TYPE[engineKey] || engineKey;
      var cats = SL.presets.getCategories(typeStr);
      var catItems = [];
      for (var ci = 0; ci < cats.length; ci++) {
        catItems.push({ value: cats[ci], label: cats[ci] });
      }
      return _populateSelect(catSel, catItems, preferredCat);
    }

    /**
     * Populate preset dropdown for the given engine key and category.
     * Returns the selected preset name.
     */
    function populatePresets(engineKey, category, preferredPreset) {
      var typeStr = ENGINE_KEY_TO_TYPE[engineKey] || engineKey;
      var presetList = SL.presets.getPresetsByCategory(typeStr, category);
      var presetItems = [];
      for (var pi = 0; pi < presetList.length; pi++) {
        presetItems.push({ value: presetList[pi].name, label: presetList[pi].name });
      }
      return _populateSelect(presetSel, presetItems, preferredPreset);
    }

    // Wire up engine change
    engineSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      var selCat = populateCategories(engineSel.value, '');
      var selPreset = populatePresets(engineSel.value, selCat, '');
      if (selPreset) {
        _applyPresetToPart(partIndex, engineSel.value, selPreset);
        if (SL.chordSeq) { SL.chordSeq.retriggerPart(partIndex); }
      }
    });

    // Wire up category change
    catSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      var selPreset = populatePresets(engineSel.value, catSel.value, '');
      if (selPreset) {
        _applyPresetToPart(partIndex, engineSel.value, selPreset);
        if (SL.chordSeq) { SL.chordSeq.retriggerPart(partIndex); }
      }
    });

    // Wire up preset change
    presetSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (presetSel.value) {
        _applyPresetToPart(partIndex, engineSel.value, presetSel.value);
        if (SL.chordSeq) { SL.chordSeq.retriggerPart(partIndex); }
      }
    });

    // Initialize with defaults and apply the first preset
    _populateSelect(engineSel, engineItems, defaults.engine);
    var initialCat = populateCategories(defaults.engine, defaults.category);
    var initialPreset = populatePresets(defaults.engine, initialCat, '');
    if (initialPreset) {
      _applyPresetToPart(partIndex, defaults.engine, initialPreset);
    }

    container.appendChild(engineSel);
    container.appendChild(catSel);
    container.appendChild(presetSel);

    _voiceSelects[partIndex] = {
      container: container,
      engineSel: engineSel,
      catSel: catSel,
      presetSel: presetSel
    };

    return container;
  }

  function _addSliderWithValue(parent, labelText, min, max, val, onChange) {
    var lbl = document.createElement('label');
    lbl.textContent = labelText + ' ';
    var slider = document.createElement('input');
    slider.type = 'range';
    slider.min = min;
    slider.max = max;
    slider.value = val;
    var valSpan = document.createElement('span');
    valSpan.className = 'perlin-val';
    valSpan.textContent = val;
    slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      var v = parseInt(slider.value, 10);
      valSpan.textContent = v;
      onChange(v);
    });
    lbl.appendChild(slider);
    lbl.appendChild(valSpan);
    parent.appendChild(lbl);
  }

  function _buildMotifControls(parent, motifNum, settings) {
    var cs = SL.chordSeq;
    if (!cs) {
      return;
    }
    var patterns = cs.getBuiltinPatterns();
    var rhythms = cs.getBuiltinRhythms();
    var clockNames = cs.getClockDivNames();
    var setFn = (motifNum === 1) ? cs.setMotif1Settings : cs.setMotif2Settings;

    // Pattern selector
    var patNames = [];
    for (var pi = 0; pi < patterns.length; pi++) {
      patNames.push(patterns[pi].name);
    }
    _addSelect(parent, 'Pat', patNames, function(v) {
      for (var fi = 0; fi < patterns.length; fi++) {
        if (patterns[fi].name === v) {
          setFn({ patternIndex: fi });
          break;
        }
      }
    }, patterns[settings.patternIndex] ? patterns[settings.patternIndex].name : patNames[0]);

    // Rhythm selector
    var rhtNames = [];
    for (var ri = 0; ri < rhythms.length; ri++) {
      rhtNames.push(rhythms[ri].name);
    }
    _addSelect(parent, 'Rhy', rhtNames, function(v) {
      for (var fi = 0; fi < rhythms.length; fi++) {
        if (rhythms[fi].name === v) {
          setFn({ rhythmIndex: fi });
          break;
        }
      }
    }, rhythms[settings.rhythmIndex] ? rhythms[settings.rhythmIndex].name : rhtNames[0]);

    // Clock div
    _addSelect(parent, 'Div', clockNames, function(v) {
      for (var ci = 0; ci < clockNames.length; ci++) {
        if (clockNames[ci] === v) {
          setFn({ clockDiv: ci });
          break;
        }
      }
    }, clockNames[settings.clockDiv] || clockNames[0]);

    // Octave
    _addNumberInput(parent, 'Oct', -2, 3, settings.octave, function(v) {
      setFn({ octave: v });
    });

    // Note mode
    _addSelect(parent, 'Mode', ['chord', 'scale'], function(v) {
      setFn({ noteMode: v });
    }, settings.noteMode);
  }

  function _build() {
    var screenEl = document.getElementById('screen-voxmachina');
    if (!screenEl) {
      return;
    }

    var cs = SL.chordSeq;
    if (!cs) {
      screenEl.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#666;padding:20px;">Chord Sequencer not available.</div>';
      return;
    }

    screenEl.innerHTML = '';
    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'cseq-container';

    // ---- Title ----
    var titleEl = document.createElement('div');
    titleEl.className = 'cseq-title';
    titleEl.textContent = 'Vox Machina';
    container.appendChild(titleEl);

    // ---- Transport row ----
    var transport = document.createElement('div');
    transport.className = 'cseq-transport';

    _seqPlayBtn = document.createElement('button');
    _seqPlayBtn.className = 'cseq-play-btn st-play-btn';
    _seqPlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
    _seqPlayBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (cs.isPlaying()) {
        cs.stop();
        _seqPlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
        _seqPlayBtn.classList.remove('playing');
      } else {
        cs.start();
        _seqPlayBtn.textContent = '\u23F8';
        _seqPlayBtn.classList.add('playing');
        _startSeqUIUpdate();
      }
    });
    transport.appendChild(_seqPlayBtn);

    // Preset selector
    var presetLabel = document.createElement('label');
    presetLabel.textContent = 'Preset ';
    _seqPresetSelect = document.createElement('select');
    _seqPresetSelect.className = 'cseq-preset-select';
    var emptyOpt = document.createElement('option');
    emptyOpt.value = '';
    emptyOpt.textContent = '-- Select --';
    _seqPresetSelect.appendChild(emptyOpt);
    var presetNames = cs.getPresets();
    for (var pi = 0; pi < presetNames.length; pi++) {
      var pOpt = document.createElement('option');
      pOpt.value = presetNames[pi];
      pOpt.textContent = presetNames[pi];
      _seqPresetSelect.appendChild(pOpt);
    }
    _seqPresetSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (_seqPresetSelect.value) {
        cs.loadPreset(_seqPresetSelect.value);
        _applyVoiceDefaults(_seqPresetSelect.value);
        _rebuildSeqTimeline();
        _refreshSeqParts();
        _refreshSeqPerlin();
      }
    });
    presetLabel.appendChild(_seqPresetSelect);
    transport.appendChild(presetLabel);

    // Current chord display
    _seqChordDisplay = document.createElement('div');
    _seqChordDisplay.className = 'cseq-chord-display';
    _seqChordDisplay.textContent = '--';
    transport.appendChild(_seqChordDisplay);

    container.appendChild(transport);

    // ---- Chord degree buttons (I-VII) ----
    var degRow = document.createElement('div');
    degRow.className = 'cseq-degree-row';
    var ROMAN = ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII'];
    for (var di = 0; di < 7; di++) {
      (function(deg) {
        var btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'cseq-degree-btn cseq-deg-' + (deg + 1);
        btn.textContent = ROMAN[deg];
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var dTypes = cs.DIATONIC_TYPES;
          cs.setChord(deg, dTypes[deg] || 'major');
          _updateSeqChordDisplay();
        });
        degRow.appendChild(btn);
      })(di);
    }
    container.appendChild(degRow);

    // ---- Chord timeline ----
    var tlSection = document.createElement('div');
    tlSection.className = 'cseq-timeline-section';

    var tlLabel = document.createElement('div');
    tlLabel.className = 'cseq-timeline-label';
    tlLabel.textContent = 'Chord Steps';
    tlSection.appendChild(tlLabel);

    _seqTimelineEl = document.createElement('div');
    _seqTimelineEl.className = 'cseq-timeline';
    tlSection.appendChild(_seqTimelineEl);

    container.appendChild(tlSection);

    _rebuildSeqTimeline();

    // ---- Part controls ----
    var partsDiv = document.createElement('div');
    partsDiv.className = 'cseq-parts';
    partsDiv.id = 'vm-cseq-parts';

    var partConfigs = [
      { name: 'PAD', cls: 'pad', idx: 0 },
      { name: 'DRONE', cls: 'drone', idx: 1 },
      { name: 'MOTIF 1', cls: 'motif1', idx: 2 },
      { name: 'MOTIF 2', cls: 'motif2', idx: 3 }
    ];

    for (var pci = 0; pci < partConfigs.length; pci++) {
      (function(cfg) {
        var partEl = document.createElement('div');
        partEl.className = 'cseq-part part-' + cfg.cls;
        partEl.id = 'vm-cseq-part-' + cfg.cls;

        var header = document.createElement('div');
        header.className = 'cseq-part-header';

        var toggle = document.createElement('button');
        toggle.className = 'cseq-part-toggle';
        var enabled = cs.getPartEnabled();
        if (enabled[cfg.idx]) {
          toggle.classList.add('on');
        }
        toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var isOn = toggle.classList.contains('on');
          if (isOn) {
            toggle.classList.remove('on');
          } else {
            toggle.classList.add('on');
          }
          if (cfg.idx === 0) { cs.setPadEnabled(!isOn); }
          else if (cfg.idx === 1) { cs.setDroneEnabled(!isOn); }
          else if (cfg.idx === 2) { cs.setMotif1Enabled(!isOn); }
          else if (cfg.idx === 3) { cs.setMotif2Enabled(!isOn); }
        });
        header.appendChild(toggle);

        var nameEl = document.createElement('span');
        nameEl.className = 'cseq-part-name ' + cfg.cls;
        nameEl.textContent = cfg.name;
        header.appendChild(nameEl);
        partEl.appendChild(header);

        var controls = document.createElement('div');
        controls.className = 'cseq-part-controls';

        // Voice/preset cascading selectors for this part
        var voiceRow = document.createElement('div');
        voiceRow.className = 'cseq-voice-row';
        voiceRow.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;width:100%;margin-bottom:4px;';
        var voiceLbl = document.createElement('span');
        voiceLbl.textContent = 'Sound';
        voiceLbl.style.cssText = 'font-size:0.55rem;color:#8888aa;flex-shrink:0;';
        voiceRow.appendChild(voiceLbl);
        var voiceSel = _buildVoiceSelect(cfg.idx);
        voiceRow.appendChild(voiceSel);
        controls.appendChild(voiceRow);

        // Volume slider for this voice
        (function(partIdx) {
          var instId = PART_INSTRUMENT[partIdx];
          var volRow = document.createElement('div');
          volRow.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;width:100%;margin-bottom:4px;';
          var volLbl = document.createElement('span');
          volLbl.textContent = 'Vol';
          volLbl.style.cssText = 'font-size:0.55rem;color:#8888aa;flex-shrink:0;';
          volRow.appendChild(volLbl);
          var volSlider = document.createElement('input');
          volSlider.type = 'range';
          volSlider.min = '0';
          volSlider.max = '100';
          var curVol = 100;
          var insts = SL.audio ? SL.audio.getInstruments() : null;
          if (insts && insts[instId] && insts[instId].settings) {
            curVol = insts[instId].settings.volume || 100;
          }
          volSlider.value = curVol;
          volSlider.style.cssText = 'flex:1;height:6px;accent-color:#4cc9f0;';
          var volVal = document.createElement('span');
          volVal.style.cssText = 'font-size:0.55rem;color:#aabbcc;min-width:22px;text-align:right;';
          volVal.textContent = curVol;
          volSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
            var v = parseInt(volSlider.value, 10);
            volVal.textContent = v;
            if (SL.audio && SL.audio.setInstrumentVolume) {
              SL.audio.setInstrumentVolume(instId, v);
            }
          });
          volRow.appendChild(volSlider);
          volRow.appendChild(volVal);
          controls.appendChild(volRow);
        })(cfg.idx);

        if (cfg.idx === 0) {
          // PAD controls: voicing, strum, octave
          _addSelect(controls, 'Voicing', ['close', 'open', 'drop2', 'drop3'], function(v) {
            cs.setPadSettings({ voicing: v });
          }, cs.getPadSettings().voicing);
          _addNumberInput(controls, 'Strum', 0, 100, cs.getPadSettings().strum, function(v) {
            cs.setPadSettings({ strum: v });
          });
          _addNumberInput(controls, 'Oct', -2, 2, cs.getPadSettings().octave, function(v) {
            cs.setPadSettings({ octave: v });
          });
        } else if (cfg.idx === 1) {
          // DRONE controls: retrigger, add5th, octave
          _addSelect(controls, 'Retrig', ['chord', 'beat', 'bar'], function(v) {
            var modes = { chord: 0, beat: 1, bar: 2 };
            cs.setDroneSettings({ retrigger: modes[v] || 0 });
          }, ['chord', 'beat', 'bar'][cs.getDroneSettings().retrigger]);
          _addCheckbox(controls, '+5th', cs.getDroneSettings().add5th, function(v) {

          // MOTIF 2 controls
          _buildMotifControls(controls, 2, cs.getMotif2Settings());

  // ============================================================
  // Timeline Rendering
  // ============================================================

  function _rebuildSeqTimeline() {
    if (!_seqTimelineEl || !SL.chordSeq) {
      return;
    }
    _seqTimelineEl.innerHTML = '';
    var seq = SL.chordSeq.getSequence();
    var ROMAN = ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII'];

    for (var si = 0; si < seq.steps.length; si++) {
      (function(step, idx) {
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'cseq-step deg-' + step.degree;
        el.setAttribute('data-step-idx', idx);

        var degSpan = document.createElement('span');
        degSpan.className = 'step-degree';
        degSpan.textContent = ROMAN[step.degree] || '?';
        el.appendChild(degSpan);

        var typeSpan = document.createElement('span');
        typeSpan.className = 'step-type';
        typeSpan.textContent = step.type;
        el.appendChild(typeSpan);

        var durSpan = document.createElement('span');
        durSpan.className = 'step-dur';
        durSpan.textContent = step.duration + ' beats';
        el.appendChild(durSpan);

        var removeSpan = document.createElement('span');
        removeSpan.className = 'step-remove';
        removeSpan.textContent = 'x';
        removeSpan.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          SL.chordSeq.removeStep(idx);
          _rebuildSeqTimeline();
        });
        el.appendChild(removeSpan);

        // Click to edit (cycle chord type)
        el.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var types = ['major', 'minor', 'dim', 'aug', 'sus2', 'sus4', 'maj7', 'min7', 'dom7'];
          var curIdx = 0;
          for (var ti = 0; ti < types.length; ti++) {
            if (types[ti] === step.type) {
              curIdx = ti;
              break;
            }
          }
          var nextType = types[(curIdx + 1) % types.length];
          SL.chordSeq.updateStep(idx, { type: nextType });
          _rebuildSeqTimeline();
        });

        _seqTimelineEl.appendChild(el);
      })(seq.steps[si], si);
    }

    // Add button
    var addBtn = document.createElement('button');
    addBtn.className = 'cseq-add-btn';
    addBtn.textContent = '+';
    addBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      SL.chordSeq.addStep(0, 'major', 4);
      _rebuildSeqTimeline();
    });
    _seqTimelineEl.appendChild(addBtn);
  }

  function _updateSeqChordDisplay() {
    if (!_seqChordDisplay || !SL.chordSeq) {
      return;
    }
    var chord = SL.chordSeq.getChord();
    var ROMAN = ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII'];
    var noteName = NOTES[chord.rootPc] || '?';
    _seqChordDisplay.textContent = noteName + ' ' + chord.type + ' (' + (ROMAN[chord.degree] || '?') + ')';
  }

  function _refreshSeqParts() {
    if (!SL.chordSeq) {
      return;
    }
    var enabled = SL.chordSeq.getPartEnabled();
    var partContainer = document.getElementById('vm-cseq-parts');
    if (partContainer) {
      var btns = partContainer.querySelectorAll('.cseq-part-toggle');
      for (var bi = 0; bi < btns.length; bi++) {
        if (bi < enabled.length) {
          if (enabled[bi]) {
            btns[bi].classList.add('on');
          } else {
            btns[bi].classList.remove('on');
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function _refreshSeqPerlin() {
    if (!SL.chordSeq) {
      return;
    }
    var ps = SL.chordSeq.getPerlinSettings();
    var toggle = document.querySelector('#vm-cseq-perlin .cseq-part-toggle');
    if (toggle) {
      if (ps.enabled) {
        toggle.classList.add('on');
      } else {
        toggle.classList.remove('on');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Sequencer UI Update Timer
  // ============================================================

  function _startSeqUIUpdate() {
    if (_seqUpdateTimer) {
      return;
    }
    _seqUpdateTimer = setInterval(function() {
      if (!SL.chordSeq || !SL.chordSeq.isPlaying()) {
        clearInterval(_seqUpdateTimer);
        _seqUpdateTimer = null;
        // Reset play button
        if (_seqPlayBtn) {
          _seqPlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
          _seqPlayBtn.classList.remove('playing');
        }
        // Remove playing class from all steps
        if (_seqTimelineEl) {
          var steps = _seqTimelineEl.querySelectorAll('.cseq-step');
          for (var ri = 0; ri < steps.length; ri++) {
            steps[ri].classList.remove('playing');
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      _updateSeqChordDisplay();
      // Highlight current step
      if (_seqTimelineEl) {
        var seq = SL.chordSeq.getSequence();
        var allSteps = _seqTimelineEl.querySelectorAll('.cseq-step');
        for (var hi = 0; hi < allSteps.length; hi++) {
          allSteps[hi].classList.remove('playing');
        }
        var curStep = SL.chordSeq.getCurrentStep();
        if (curStep.resolvedLength > 0 && curStep.index < curStep.resolvedLength) {
          var chord = SL.chordSeq.getChord();
          for (var ci = 0; ci < allSteps.length; ci++) {
            var stepIdx = parseInt(allSteps[ci].getAttribute('data-step-idx'), 10);
            if (stepIdx < seq.steps.length && seq.steps[stepIdx].degree === chord.degree) {
              allSteps[ci].classList.add('playing');
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }, 100);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function activate() {
    _active = true;
    if (!_initialized) {
      _build();
      _initialized = true;
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    // Stop chord sequencer playback when leaving screen
    if (SL.chordSeq && SL.chordSeq.isPlaying()) {
      SL.chordSeq.stop();
    }
    if (_seqUpdateTimer) {
      clearInterval(_seqUpdateTimer);
      _seqUpdateTimer = null;
    }
    if (_seqPlayBtn) {
      _seqPlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
      _seqPlayBtn.classList.remove('playing');
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenVoxmachina = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };
})();

  function _buildRingtoneSteps() {
    var stepsEl = document.getElementById('gen-ring-steps');
    if (!stepsEl) {
      return;
    }
    stepsEl.innerHTML = '';
    var noteNames = ['C', 'C#', 'D', 'D#', 'E', 'F', 'F#', 'G', 'G#', 'A', 'A#', 'B'];

    for (var s = 0; s < _ringtoneSteps.length; s++) {
      var step = document.createElement('div');
      step.style.cssText = 'width:50px;height:50px;background:#1a1a2e;border:1px solid #3a3a5a;border-radius:4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;color:#c0c0e0;font-size:0.7rem;';
      step.setAttribute('data-ring-step', s);
      var pc = _ringtoneSteps[s] % 12;
      step.textContent = noteNames[pc] + Math.floor(_ringtoneSteps[s] / 12 - 1);
      stepsEl.appendChild(step);
    }

    // Click to cycle pitch
    stepsEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var target = e.target;
      if (target.hasAttribute('data-ring-step')) {
        var idx = parseInt(target.getAttribute('data-ring-step'), 10);
        _ringtoneSteps[idx] = (_ringtoneSteps[idx] + 1);
        if (_ringtoneSteps[idx] > 84) {
          _ringtoneSteps[idx] = 60;
        }
        var pc2 = _ringtoneSteps[idx] % 12;
        target.textContent = noteNames[pc2] + Math.floor(_ringtoneSteps[idx] / 12 - 1);
        _playNote(_ringtoneSteps[idx], 0.2);
      }
    });
  }

  function _previewRingtone() {
    var stepDelay = (_ringtoneDuration * 1000) / _ringtoneSteps.length;
    for (var s = 0; s < _ringtoneSteps.length; s++) {
      (function(midi, delay) {
        setTimeout(function() {
          _playNote(midi, stepDelay / 1000 * 0.8);
        }, delay);
      })(_ringtoneSteps[s], s * stepDelay);
    }

    if (_ringtoneLooping) {
      var totalMs = _ringtoneDuration * 1000;
      _ringtoneLoopId = setTimeout(function() {
        if (_ringtoneLooping) {
          _previewRingtone();
        }
      }, totalMs + 200);
    }
  }

  function _playNote(midi, duration) {
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
      SL.audio.playNote(midi, 80, duration || 0.5);
    }
  }

  function _startTempoRamp() {
    var totalBeats = _rehearsalRampBars * 4;
    var currentBpm = _rehearsalStartBpm;
    var bpmStep = (_rehearsalTargetBpm - _rehearsalStartBpm) / totalBeats;
    var beatIdx = 0;

    function _playBeat() {
      if (beatIdx >= totalBeats) {
        return;
      }
      var beatMs = 60000 / currentBpm;

      // Play a click sound
      if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
        var clickMidi = (beatIdx % 4 === 0) ? 76 : 72; // high click on downbeat
        SL.audio.playNote(clickMidi, 40, 0.05);
      }

      // Update BPM display
      var mainBpm = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
      if (mainBpm) {
        mainBpm.value = Math.round(currentBpm);
      }

      beatIdx++;
      currentBpm += bpmStep;
      setTimeout(_playBeat, beatMs);
    }

    _playBeat();
  }

  // ============================================================

  var GEN_SEQ_TOTAL_ROWS = 48;
  var GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE = 64;
  var GEN_SEQ_ROW_HEIGHT = 6;
  var GEN_SEQ_BLACK_KEYS = [1, 3, 6, 8, 10];
  var GEN_SEQ_INST_COLORS = ['#4a9eff', '#44cc88', '#aa66ff', '#ff8844', '#44dddd'];
  var GEN_SEQ_NOTE_NAMES = ['C', 'C#', 'D', 'D#', 'E', 'F', 'F#', 'G', 'G#', 'A', 'A#', 'B'];

  function _getSeqPreviewPageCount() {
    var notes = SL.sequencer ? SL.sequencer.seqNotes : [];
    if (!notes || notes.length === 0) {
      return 1;
    }
    var maxStart = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      var end = notes[i].start + (notes[i].dur || 1);
      if (end > maxStart) {
        maxStart = end;
      }
    }
    return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(maxStart / GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE));
  }

  function _buildSeqPreview(parent) {
    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'gen-seq-container';

    // Navigation bar
    var nav = document.createElement('div');
    nav.className = 'gen-seq-nav';

    _genSeqPrevBtn = document.createElement('button');
    _genSeqPrevBtn.textContent = '\u25C4';
    _genSeqPrevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (_genSeqPage > 0) {
        _genSeqPage--;
        _renderSeqPreview();
      }
    });
    nav.appendChild(_genSeqPrevBtn);

    _genSeqPageLabel = document.createElement('span');
    _genSeqPageLabel.style.cssText = 'min-width:70px;text-align:center;';
    nav.appendChild(_genSeqPageLabel);

    _genSeqNextBtn = document.createElement('button');
    _genSeqNextBtn.textContent = '\u25BA';
    _genSeqNextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var totalPages = _getSeqPreviewPageCount();
      if (_genSeqPage < totalPages - 1) {
        _genSeqPage++;
        _renderSeqPreview();
      }
    });
    nav.appendChild(_genSeqNextBtn);

    var previewLabel = document.createElement('span');
    previewLabel.style.cssText = 'margin-left:8px;color:#666;font-size:11px;';
    previewLabel.textContent = 'Note Preview (read-only)';
    nav.appendChild(previewLabel);

    container.appendChild(nav);

    // Grid wrapper (keys + grid)
    var gridWrap = document.createElement('div');
    gridWrap.className = 'gen-seq-grid-wrap';

    // Keys column
    _genSeqKeysEl = document.createElement('div');
    _genSeqKeysEl.className = 'gen-seq-keys';
    _buildSeqPreviewKeys();
    gridWrap.appendChild(_genSeqKeysEl);

    // Grid area
    _genSeqGridEl = document.createElement('div');
    _genSeqGridEl.className = 'gen-seq-grid';
    gridWrap.appendChild(_genSeqGridEl);

    // Sync scroll between keys and grid
    _genSeqGridEl.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
      _genSeqKeysEl.scrollTop = _genSeqGridEl.scrollTop;
    });

    container.appendChild(gridWrap);
    parent.appendChild(container);

    _renderSeqPreview();
  }

  function _buildSeqPreviewKeys() {
    if (!_genSeqKeysEl) {
      return;
    }
    _genSeqKeysEl.innerHTML = '';
    var baseMidi = SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI || 24;

    // Build rows from top (highest note) to bottom (lowest note)
    for (var r = GEN_SEQ_TOTAL_ROWS - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
      var midi = baseMidi + r;
      var pc = midi % 12;
      var octave = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
      var isBlack = false;
      for (var bk = 0; bk < GEN_SEQ_BLACK_KEYS.length; bk++) {
        if (pc === GEN_SEQ_BLACK_KEYS[bk]) {
          isBlack = true;
          break;
        }
      }

      var keyEl = document.createElement('div');
      keyEl.className = 'gen-seq-key';
      if (isBlack) {
        keyEl.className += ' black';
      }
      if (pc === 0) {
        keyEl.className += ' c-note';
        keyEl.textContent = 'C' + octave;
      }
      _genSeqKeysEl.appendChild(keyEl);
    }
  }

  function _renderSeqPreview() {
    if (!_genSeqGridEl) {
      return;
    }
    _genSeqGridEl.innerHTML = '';

    var notes = SL.sequencer ? SL.sequencer.seqNotes : [];
    var totalPages = _getSeqPreviewPageCount();
    var baseMidi = SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI || 24;
    var pageOffset = _genSeqPage * GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE;
    var gridHeight = GEN_SEQ_TOTAL_ROWS * GEN_SEQ_ROW_HEIGHT;

    // Clamp page
    if (_genSeqPage >= totalPages) {
      _genSeqPage = totalPages - 1;
    }
    if (_genSeqPage < 0) {
      _genSeqPage = 0;
    }

    // Update nav
    if (_genSeqPageLabel) {
      _genSeqPageLabel.textContent = 'Page ' + (_genSeqPage + 1) + '/' + totalPages;
    }
    if (_genSeqPrevBtn) {
      _genSeqPrevBtn.disabled = (_genSeqPage <= 0);
    }
    if (_genSeqNextBtn) {
      _genSeqNextBtn.disabled = (_genSeqPage >= totalPages - 1);
    }

    // Set grid content height
    _genSeqGridEl.style.position = 'relative';

    if (!notes || notes.length === 0) {
      var emptyEl = document.createElement('div');
      emptyEl.className = 'gen-seq-empty';
      emptyEl.textContent = 'No notes yet -- click GENERATE to create a song';
      _genSeqGridEl.appendChild(emptyEl);
      return;
    }

    // Create an inner container with fixed height for absolute positioning
    var inner = document.createElement('div');
    inner.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:100%;height:' + gridHeight + 'px;';

    // Draw row backgrounds (for black-key darkening)
    for (var r = GEN_SEQ_TOTAL_ROWS - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
      var midi = baseMidi + r;
      var pc = midi % 12;
      var isBlack = false;
      for (var bk = 0; bk < GEN_SEQ_BLACK_KEYS.length; bk++) {
        if (pc === GEN_SEQ_BLACK_KEYS[bk]) {
          isBlack = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      var visualRow = (GEN_SEQ_TOTAL_ROWS - 1) - r;
      var rowBg = document.createElement('div');
      rowBg.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:' + GEN_SEQ_ROW_HEIGHT + 'px;top:' + (visualRow * GEN_SEQ_ROW_HEIGHT) + 'px;';
      if (isBlack) {
        rowBg.style.background = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
      }
      inner.appendChild(rowBg);

      // Row divider line
      var rowLine = document.createElement('div');
      rowLine.className = 'gen-seq-row-line';
      if (pc === 0) {
        rowLine.className += ' c-row';
      }
      rowLine.style.top = ((visualRow + 1) * GEN_SEQ_ROW_HEIGHT) + 'px';
      inner.appendChild(rowLine);
    }

    // Draw beat and bar lines
    for (var col = 0; col <= GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE; col++) {
      if (col > 0 && col % 16 === 0) {
        var barLine = document.createElement('div');
        barLine.className = 'gen-seq-bar-line';
        barLine.style.left = (col / GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE * 100) + '%';
        inner.appendChild(barLine);
      } else if (col > 0 && col % 4 === 0) {
        var beatLine = document.createElement('div');
        beatLine.className = 'gen-seq-beat-line';
        beatLine.style.left = (col / GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE * 100) + '%';
        inner.appendChild(beatLine);
      }
    }

    // Draw notes
    for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      var n = notes[i];

      // Handle chord notes
      if (n.isChord && n.notes) {
        for (var ci = 0; ci < n.notes.length; ci++) {
          var chordMidi = n.notes[ci];
          _renderSingleNote(inner, n.start, chordMidi, n.dur, n.instrument, pageOffset, baseMidi, gridHeight);
        }
      } else {
        var noteMidi = n.midi !== undefined ? n.midi : (baseMidi + (n.row || 0));
        _renderSingleNote(inner, n.start, noteMidi, n.dur, n.instrument, pageOffset, baseMidi, gridHeight);
      }
    }

    // Playhead
    _genSeqPlayheadEl = document.createElement('div');
    _genSeqPlayheadEl.className = 'gen-seq-playhead';
    inner.appendChild(_genSeqPlayheadEl);

    _genSeqGridEl.appendChild(inner);

    // Enable keys scrolling sync
    _genSeqKeysEl.style.overflowY = 'hidden';
    _genSeqGridEl.style.overflowY = 'auto';
    _genSeqGridEl.style.overflowX = 'hidden';
  }

  function _renderSingleNote(container, start, midi, dur, instrument, pageOffset, baseMidi, gridHeight) {
    // Check if note is on this page (including notes that span into this page)
    var noteEnd = start + (dur || 1);
    var pageEnd = pageOffset + GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE;
    if (noteEnd <= pageOffset || start >= pageEnd) {
      return;
    }

    var row = midi - baseMidi;
    if (row < 0 || row >= GEN_SEQ_TOTAL_ROWS) {
      return;
    }

    // Clamp note to page boundaries
    var drawStart = Math.max(start, pageOffset) - pageOffset;
    var drawEnd = Math.min(noteEnd, pageEnd) - pageOffset;
    var drawDur = drawEnd - drawStart;

    var visualRow = (GEN_SEQ_TOTAL_ROWS - 1) - row;
    var instIdx = (instrument !== undefined) ? instrument : 0;
    var color = GEN_SEQ_INST_COLORS[instIdx % GEN_SEQ_INST_COLORS.length];

    var noteEl = document.createElement('div');
    noteEl.className = 'gen-seq-note';
    noteEl.style.cssText = 'left:' + (drawStart / GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE * 100) + '%;'
      + 'top:' + (visualRow * GEN_SEQ_ROW_HEIGHT) + 'px;'
      + 'width:' + (drawDur / GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE * 100) + '%;'
      + 'height:' + (GEN_SEQ_ROW_HEIGHT - 1) + 'px;'
      + 'background:' + color + ';';
    container.appendChild(noteEl);
  }

  function _startSeqPreviewAnim() {
    if (_genSeqAnimId) {
      return;
    }
    function _tick() {
      var seqPlaying = SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.isPlaying && SL.sequencer.isPlaying();
      if ((!_isPlaying && !seqPlaying) || !_genSeqPlayheadEl) {
        _stopSeqPreviewAnim();
        return;
      }
      if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.getCurrentStep) {
        var step = SL.sequencer.getCurrentStep();
        var playPage = Math.floor(step / GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE);
        // Auto-advance page to follow playhead
        if (playPage !== _genSeqPage) {
          var totalPages = _getSeqPreviewPageCount();
          if (playPage >= 0 && playPage < totalPages) {
            _genSeqPage = playPage;
            _renderSeqPreview();
          }
        }
        if (_genSeqPlayheadEl) {
          var localStep = step - (_genSeqPage * GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE);
          if (localStep >= 0 && localStep < GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE) {
            _genSeqPlayheadEl.style.display = 'block';
            _genSeqPlayheadEl.style.left = (localStep / GEN_SEQ_STEPS_PER_PAGE * 100) + '%';
          } else {
            _genSeqPlayheadEl.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }
      }
      _genSeqAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(_tick);
    }
    _genSeqAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(_tick);
  }

  function _stopSeqPreviewAnim() {
    if (_genSeqAnimId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(_genSeqAnimId);
      _genSeqAnimId = null;
    }
    if (_genSeqPlayheadEl) {
      _genSeqPlayheadEl.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Actions
  // ============================================================

  function _onClear() {
    if (_isPlaying) {
      _stopPlayback();
    }
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.clearSeq) {
      SL.sequencer.clearSeq();
    }
    _genSeqPage = 0;
    _renderSeqPreview();
    _setStatus('Cleared');
  }

  function _onGenerate() {
    _setStatus('Generating...');
    if (_generateBtnEl) {
      _generateBtnEl.classList.add('generating');
    }

    _syncToSongGenerator();

    setTimeout(function() {
      try {
        if (SL.songGen && SL.songGen.generateSong) {
          SL.songGen.generateSong();
          _setStatus('Song generated!');
          _genSeqPage = 0;
          _renderSeqPreview();
        } else {
          _setStatus('Song generator not available');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        _setStatus('Error: ' + e.message);
        console.error('[Generate] Error:', e);
      }
      if (_generateBtnEl) {
        _generateBtnEl.classList.remove('generating');
      }
    }, 50);
  }

  function _syncToSongGenerator() {
    var seqBpm = document.getElementById('seqBpm');
    if (seqBpm) {
      seqBpm.value = _bpm;
      seqBpm.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    }
    var songBpm = document.getElementById('songBpm');
    if (songBpm) {
      songBpm.value = _bpm;
    }

    var rootNote = document.getElementById('rootNote');
    if (rootNote) {
      rootNote.value = _rootNote;
      rootNote.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    }
    var songKey = document.getElementById('songKey');
    if (songKey) {
      songKey.value = _rootNote;
    }

    var scaleType = document.getElementById('scaleType');
    if (scaleType) {
      scaleType.value = _currentMode;
      scaleType.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    }
    var songMode = document.getElementById('songMode');
    if (songMode) {
      songMode.value = _currentMode;
    }

    var humSlider = document.getElementById('songHumanization');
    if (humSlider) {
      humSlider.value = _humanization;
    }

    // Sync melody density from generate screen slider to song panel slider
    var songMelDens = document.getElementById('songMelodyDensity');
    if (songMelDens) {
      songMelDens.value = _melodyDensity;
      var songMelDensVal = document.getElementById('songMelDensVal');
      if (songMelDensVal) { songMelDensVal.textContent = String(_melodyDensity); }
    }

    // Find the styleHint from the selected arrangement preset and load it
    var presets = _getPresetsForGenre(_currentGenre);
    var selectedPreset = (presets && _currentPresetIndex >= 0 && _currentPresetIndex < presets.length)
      ? presets[_currentPresetIndex] : null;
    var styleHint = selectedPreset ? selectedPreset.styleHint : '';

    // Load the matching style into the song generator (by style ID, not category)
    if (styleHint && SL.songGen && SL.songGen.loadStyleDefaults) {
      SL.songGen.loadStyleDefaults(styleHint);
    }

    // Override BPM/key/mode on the song-generator UI with generate-screen values
    var songBpmAfter = document.getElementById('songBpm');
    if (songBpmAfter) { songBpmAfter.value = _bpm; }
    var songKeyAfter = document.getElementById('songKey');
    if (songKeyAfter) { songKeyAfter.value = _rootNote; }
    var songModeAfter = document.getElementById('songMode');
    if (songModeAfter) { songModeAfter.value = _currentMode; }
  }

  function _onPlayStop() {
    if (_isPlaying) {
      _stopPlayback();
    } else {
      _startPlayback();
    }
  }

  function _startPlayback() {
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.startSeq) {
      SL.sequencer.startSeq();
      _isPlaying = true;
      if (_playBtnEl) {
        _playBtnEl.textContent = 'Stop';
        _playBtnEl.classList.add('playing');
      }
      _setStatus('Playing...');
      _startSeqPreviewAnim();
    }
  }

  function _stopPlayback() {
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.stopSeq) {
      SL.sequencer.stopSeq();
    }
    _isPlaying = false;
    if (_playBtnEl) {
      _playBtnEl.textContent = 'Play';
      _playBtnEl.classList.remove('playing');
    }
    _setStatus('');
    _stopSeqPreviewAnim();
  }

  function _onExport() {
    if (SL.midiFile && SL.midiFile.exportMidi) {
      try {
        SL.midiFile.exportMidi();
        _setStatus('MIDI exported!');
      } catch (e) {
        _setStatus('Export error: ' + e.message);
      }
    } else {
      _setStatus('MIDI export not available');
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _syncFromModel() {
    // Sync BPM from real sequencer
    if (_bpmInputEl && SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.getBpm) {
      _bpmInputEl.value = SL.sequencer.getBpm();
    }

    // Sync key/mode from main screen selectors
    var mainRoot = document.getElementById('rootNote');
    var mainMode = document.getElementById('mode');
    if (_keySelectEl && mainRoot) {
      _keySelectEl.value = mainRoot.value;
    }
    if (_modeSelectEl && mainMode) {
      _modeSelectEl.value = mainMode.value;
    }
  }

  function activate(tabId) {
    _init();
    _active = true;
    _syncFromModel();
    _buildInstrumentPanel();
    _populatePresetSelect();
    _loadArrangement();
    _renderSeqPreview();
    if (SL.sharedTransport) {
      SL.sharedTransport.build('generate-transport');
    }
    // Hook shared transport play button to start/stop our playhead animation
    var stPlayBtn = document.getElementById('generate-transport-st-play');
    if (stPlayBtn) {
      stPlayBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        setTimeout(function() {
          if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
            _isPlaying = true;
            _startSeqPreviewAnim();
          } else {
            _isPlaying = false;
            _stopSeqPreviewAnim();
          }
          if (_playBtnEl) {
            if (_isPlaying) {
              _playBtnEl.textContent = 'Stop';
              _playBtnEl.classList.add('playing');
            } else {
              _playBtnEl.textContent = 'Play';
              _playBtnEl.classList.remove('playing');
            }
          }
        }, 50);
      });
    }
    var stStopBtn = document.getElementById('generate-transport-st-stop');
    if (stStopBtn) {
      stStopBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        setTimeout(function() {
          _isPlaying = false;
          _stopSeqPreviewAnim();
          if (_playBtnEl) {
            _playBtnEl.textContent = 'Play';
            _playBtnEl.classList.remove('playing');
          }
        }, 50);
      });
    }

    // Handle sub-tab routing from sidebar
    if (tabId === 'film') {
      _switchSubTab('song');
      // Auto-select a cinematic genre if available
      if (_genreSelectEl && GENRE_KEYS.length > 0) {
        for (var gi = 0; gi < GENRE_KEYS.length; gi++) {
          var gLower = GENRE_KEYS[gi].toLowerCase();
          if (gLower.indexOf('cinematic') >= 0 || gLower.indexOf('ambient') >= 0 || gLower.indexOf('film') >= 0) {
            _genreSelectEl.value = GENRE_KEYS[gi];
            _currentGenre = GENRE_KEYS[gi];
            _loadArrangement();
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (tabId === 'podcast') {
      _switchSubTab('podcast');
    } else if (tabId === 'rehearsal') {
      _switchSubTab('rehearsal');
    }

    // Start playhead animation if sequencer is already playing
    if (SL.sequencer && SL.sequencer.isPlaying && SL.sequencer.isPlaying()) {
      _isPlaying = true;
      if (_playBtnEl) {
        _playBtnEl.textContent = 'Stop';
        _playBtnEl.classList.add('playing');
      }
      _startSeqPreviewAnim();
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _stopSeqPreviewAnim();
    if (_isPlaying) {
      _stopPlayback();
    }
    if (_ringtoneLoopId) {
      clearTimeout(_ringtoneLoopId);
      _ringtoneLoopId = null;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Export
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenGenerate = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };
})();
