  // ============================================================
  // Helpers
  // ============================================================

  function _getEffectChain() {
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.getEffectChainForTarget) {
      return SL.audio.getEffectChainForTarget(_selectedInst);
    }
    return null;
  }

  function _getChainOrder() {
    var chain = _getEffectChain();
    if (chain) {
      var order = chain.getOrder();
      if (order && order.length > 0) {
        return order;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }

  function _getEffectDisplayName(key) {
    for (var i = 0; i < EFFECT_LIST.length; i++) {
      if (EFFECT_LIST[i].key === key) {
        return EFFECT_LIST[i].name;
      }
    }
    return key;
  }

  function _isEffectEnabled(key) {
    var chain = _getEffectChain();
    if (chain) {
      var effect = chain.getEffect(key);
      if (effect) {
        return effect.enabled;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function _getEffectParams(key) {
    var chain = _getEffectChain();
    if (chain) {
      var effect = chain.getEffect(key);
      if (effect) {
        return effect.getParams();
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function _isInChain(key) {
    var order = _getChainOrder();
    for (var i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
      if (order[i] === key) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DOM Building
  // ============================================================

  function _buildScreen() {
    var container = document.getElementById('screen-effects');
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }

    var html = '';

    // Instrument tabs bar
    html += '<div class="effects-inst-tabs-bar">';
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_INSTRUMENTS; i++) {
      html += '<button class="effects-inst-tab-btn' + (i === _selectedInst ? ' active' : '') + '" ';
      html += 'data-inst="' + i + '">' + INSTRUMENT_LABELS[i] + '</button>';
    }
    html += '<button class="effects-bypass-btn" id="efx-bypass-all">Bypass All</button>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Master mix bar
    html += '<div class="effects-master-mix-bar">';
    html += '<span class="effects-master-mix-label">Master Mix</span>';
    html += '<input type="range" id="efx-master-slider" class="effects-master-mix-slider" min="0" max="100" value="100">';
    html += '<span id="efx-master-value" class="effects-master-mix-value">100%</span>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Effect list (replaces chain summary + add bar + card grid)
    html += '<div id="efx-effect-list" class="effects-list"></div>';

    // Bottom bar
    html += '<div class="effects-screen-bottom-bar">';
    html += '<button id="efx-test-tone" class="effects-test-btn">Test Tone</button>';
    html += '<button id="efx-ab-toggle" class="effects-ab-btn">A/B</button>';
    html += '</div>';

    container.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function _getSortedEffectList() {
    var order = _getChainOrder();
    var sorted = [];
    var inChainSet = {};

    // First: effects in the chain, in chain order
    for (var i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
      var chainKey = order[i];
      inChainSet[chainKey] = true;
      for (var j = 0; j < EFFECT_LIST.length; j++) {
        if (EFFECT_LIST[j].key === chainKey) {
          sorted.push(EFFECT_LIST[j]);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Then: remaining effects not in chain, in default order
    for (var k = 0; k < EFFECT_LIST.length; k++) {
      if (!inChainSet[EFFECT_LIST[k].key]) {
        sorted.push(EFFECT_LIST[k]);
      }
    }

    return sorted;
  }

  function _renderEffectList() {
    var listEl = document.getElementById('efx-effect-list');
    if (!listEl) {
      return;
    }

    var sorted = _getSortedEffectList();
    var order = _getChainOrder();
    var html = '';

    for (var i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      var key = sorted[i].key;
      var displayName = sorted[i].name;
      var icon = EFFECT_ICONS[key] || '';
      var inChain = _isInChain(key);
      var enabled = inChain && _isEffectEnabled(key);
      var params = _getEffectParams(key);
      var chainIdx = order.indexOf(key);

      var rowClass = 'effects-row';
      if (enabled) {
        rowClass += ' enabled';
      }

      html += '<div class="' + rowClass + '" data-effect="' + key + '">';

      // Header row
      html += '<div class="effects-row-header">';
      html += '<input type="checkbox" class="effects-row-toggle" data-toggle="' + key + '"' + (enabled ? ' checked' : '') + '>';
      html += '<span class="effects-row-icon">' + icon + '</span>';
      html += '<span class="effects-row-name">' + displayName + '</span>';

      // Move up/down buttons (only useful when in chain)
      html += '<button class="effects-row-move" data-move-up="' + key + '" title="Move Left"';
      if (!inChain || chainIdx <= 0) {
        html += ' disabled style="opacity:0.3;cursor:default"';
      }
      html += '>◀</button>';

      html += '<button class="effects-row-move" data-move-down="' + key + '" title="Move Right"';
      if (!inChain || chainIdx < 0 || chainIdx >= order.length - 1) {
        html += ' disabled style="opacity:0.3;cursor:default"';
      }
      html += '>▶</button>';

      html += '</div>';

      // Parameter sliders (always visible, dimmed when disabled)
      var keyParams = KEY_PARAMS[key];
      if (keyParams) {
        html += '<div class="effects-row-params">';
        for (var p = 0; p < keyParams.length; p++) {
          var param = keyParams[p];
          var currentVal = (params && params[param.name] !== undefined) ? params[param.name] : param.def;
          html += '<div class="effects-row-param">';
          html += '<span class="effects-row-param-label">' + param.label + '</span>';
          html += '<input type="range" class="effects-row-param-slider" ';
          html += 'data-effect-param="' + key + ':' + param.name + '" ';
          html += 'min="' + param.min + '" max="' + param.max + '" ';
          html += 'value="' + currentVal + '">';
          html += '<span class="effects-row-param-value" data-param-display="' + key + ':' + param.name + '">';
          html += Math.round(currentVal) + (param.unit ? param.unit : '');
          html += '</span>';
          html += '</div>';
        }
        html += '</div>';
      }

      html += '</div>';
    }

    listEl.innerHTML = html;
    _attachListListeners();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Event Handlers
  // ============================================================

  function _attachListListeners() {
    var listEl = document.getElementById('efx-effect-list');
    if (!listEl) {
      return;
    }

    // Toggle checkboxes: enable/disable + add/remove from chain
    var toggles = listEl.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle]');
    for (var t = 0; t < toggles.length; t++) {
      (function(cb) {
        cb.addEventListener('change', function() {
          var key = cb.getAttribute('data-toggle');
          var chain = _getEffectChain();
          if (chain) {
            if (cb.checked) {
              // Add to chain if not already there, and enable
              if (!_isInChain(key)) {
                chain.addToChain(key);
              }
              var effect = chain.getEffect(key);
              if (effect) {
                effect.setEnabled(true);
              }
            } else {
              // Disable and remove from chain
              var effect2 = chain.getEffect(key);
              if (effect2) {
                effect2.setEnabled(false);
              }
              chain.removeFromChain(key);
            }
            _renderEffectList();
          }
        });
      })(toggles[t]);
    }

    // Move up buttons
    var moveUps = listEl.querySelectorAll('[data-move-up]');
    for (var u = 0; u < moveUps.length; u++) {
      (function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (btn.disabled) {
            return;
          }
          var key = btn.getAttribute('data-move-up');
          var chain = _getEffectChain();
          if (chain) {
            var order = chain.getOrder();
            var idx = order.indexOf(key);
            if (idx > 0) {
              chain.moveEffect(key, idx - 1);
              _renderEffectList();
            }
          }
        });
      })(moveUps[u]);
    }

    // Move down buttons
    var moveDowns = listEl.querySelectorAll('[data-move-down]');
    for (var d = 0; d < moveDowns.length; d++) {
      (function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (btn.disabled) {
            return;
          }
          var key = btn.getAttribute('data-move-down');
          var chain = _getEffectChain();
          if (chain) {
            var order = chain.getOrder();
            var idx = order.indexOf(key);
            if (idx >= 0 && idx < order.length - 1) {
              chain.moveEffect(key, idx + 1);
              _renderEffectList();
            }
          }
        });
      })(moveDowns[d]);
    }

    // Parameter sliders
    var sliders = listEl.querySelectorAll('[data-effect-param]');
    for (var s = 0; s < sliders.length; s++) {
      (function(slider) {
        slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
          var parts = slider.getAttribute('data-effect-param').split(':');
          var effectKey = parts[0];
          var paramName = parts[1];
          var value = parseFloat(slider.value);
          var chain = _getEffectChain();
          if (chain) {
            var effect = chain.getEffect(effectKey);
            if (effect) {
              effect.setParam(paramName, value);
            }
          }
          // Update display
          var display = document.querySelector('[data-param-display="' + effectKey + ':' + paramName + '"]');
          if (display) {
            var paramDef = null;
            var keyParams = KEY_PARAMS[effectKey];
            if (keyParams) {
              for (var pi = 0; pi < keyParams.length; pi++) {
                if (keyParams[pi].name === paramName) {
                  paramDef = keyParams[pi];
                  break;
                }
              }
            }
            var unitStr = (paramDef && paramDef.unit) ? paramDef.unit : '';
            display.textContent = Math.round(value) + unitStr;
          }
        });
      })(sliders[s]);
    }
  }

  function _setupEventListeners() {
    // Instrument tab buttons
    var tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.effects-inst-tab-btn');
    for (var i = 0; i < tabBtns.length; i++) {
      (function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var instIdx = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-inst'), 10);
          if (isNaN(instIdx)) {
            return;
          }
          _selectedInst = instIdx;
          // Update active state on all tabs
          var allTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.effects-inst-tab-btn');
          for (var t = 0; t < allTabs.length; t++) {
            allTabs[t].classList.remove('active');
          }
          btn.classList.add('active');
          _renderEffectList();
          _syncMasterMix();
        });
      })(tabBtns[i]);
    }

    // Bypass all toggle
    var bypassBtn = document.getElementById('efx-bypass-all');
    if (bypassBtn) {
      bypassBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _bypassAll = !_bypassAll;
        if (_bypassAll) {
          bypassBtn.classList.add('active');
          var chain = _getEffectChain();
          if (chain) {
            _savedMasterMix = chain.getMasterMix();
            chain.setMasterMix(0);
          }
        } else {
          bypassBtn.classList.remove('active');
          var chain2 = _getEffectChain();
          if (chain2) {
            chain2.setMasterMix(_savedMasterMix);
          }
        }
        _syncMasterMix();
      });
    }

    // Master mix slider
    var masterSlider = document.getElementById('efx-master-slider');
    if (masterSlider) {
      masterSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
        var value = parseInt(masterSlider.value, 10);
        var chain = _getEffectChain();
        if (chain) {
          chain.setMasterMix(value);
        }
        var valDisplay = document.getElementById('efx-master-value');
        if (valDisplay) {
          valDisplay.textContent = value + '%';
        }
      });
    }

    // Test tone button
    var testBtn = document.getElementById('efx-test-tone');
    if (testBtn) {
      testBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
          // Play a C4 (MIDI 60) on the selected instrument
          var prevInst = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
          SL.audio.setCurrentInstrument(_selectedInst);
          SL.audio.playNote(60, 100);
          // Restore after a short delay
          setTimeout(function() {
            SL.audio.setCurrentInstrument(prevInst);
          }, 600);
        }
      });
    }

    // A/B toggle
    var abBtn = document.getElementById('efx-ab-toggle');
    if (abBtn) {
      abBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _abBypass = !_abBypass;
        if (_abBypass) {
          abBtn.classList.add('active');
          var chain = _getEffectChain();
          if (chain) {
            _savedMasterMix = chain.getMasterMix();
            chain.setMasterMix(0);
          }
        } else {
          abBtn.classList.remove('active');
          var chain2 = _getEffectChain();
          if (chain2) {
            chain2.setMasterMix(_savedMasterMix);
          }
        }
        _syncMasterMix();
      });
    }
  }

  function _syncMasterMix() {
    var chain = _getEffectChain();
    var slider = document.getElementById('efx-master-slider');
    var valDisplay = document.getElementById('efx-master-value');
    if (chain && slider) {
      var mix = chain.getMasterMix();
      slider.value = mix;
      if (valDisplay) {
        valDisplay.textContent = mix + '%';
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 303 Phrase Looper
  // ============================================================

  function _fxMidiToName(midi) {
    var pc = midi % 12;
    var oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
    return FX_NOTES[pc] + oct;
  }

  function _fxPhraseInitSteps() {
    _fxPhraseSteps = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < FX_PHRASE_STEPS; i++) {
      _fxPhraseSteps.push({ note: FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE, accent: false, slide: false, rest: true });
    }
  }

  function _fxPhraseGenerateRandom() {
    _fxPhraseSteps = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < FX_PHRASE_STEPS; i++) {
      var isRest = Math.random() < FX_PHRASE_REST_CHANCE;
      var scaleIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * FX_PHRASE_MINOR_PENTATONIC.length);
      var octaveOffset = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) * 12;
      var midi = FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE + FX_PHRASE_MINOR_PENTATONIC[scaleIdx] + octaveOffset;
      _fxPhraseSteps.push({
        note: midi,
        accent: !isRest && Math.random() < FX_PHRASE_ACCENT_CHANCE,
        slide: !isRest && Math.random() < FX_PHRASE_SLIDE_CHANCE,
        rest: isRest
      });
    }
  }

  function _fxPhraseLoadPreset(presetIndex) {
    var preset = FX_PHRASE_PRESETS[presetIndex];
    if (!preset) {
      return;
    }
    if (preset.steps === null) {
      _fxPhraseGenerateRandom();
    } else {
      _fxPhraseSteps = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < FX_PHRASE_STEPS; i++) {
        var src = preset.steps[i];
        _fxPhraseSteps.push({
          note: src.note,
          accent: src.accent,
          slide: src.slide,
          rest: src.rest
        });
      }
    }
    _fxPhraseRefreshGrid();
  }

  function _fxPhraseCycleNote(stepIdx, direction) {
    var step = _fxPhraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (!step) {
      return;
    }
    if (step.rest) {
      step.rest = false;
      step.note = FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE;
    } else {
      var offset = direction || 1;
      var newNote = step.note + offset;
      if (newNote >= FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE + FX_PHRASE_NOTE_RANGE) {
        newNote = FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE;
      }
      if (newNote < FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE) {
        newNote = FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE + FX_PHRASE_NOTE_RANGE - 1;
      }
      step.note = newNote;
    }
    _fxPhraseRefreshStep(stepIdx);
  }

  function _fxPhraseSetRest(stepIdx) {
    var step = _fxPhraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (!step) {
      return;
    }
    step.rest = !step.rest;
    _fxPhraseRefreshStep(stepIdx);
  }

  function _fxPhraseToggleAccent(stepIdx) {
    var step = _fxPhraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (step) {
      step.accent = !step.accent;
      _fxPhraseRefreshStep(stepIdx);
    }
  }

  function _fxPhraseToggleSlide(stepIdx) {
    var step = _fxPhraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (step) {
      step.slide = !step.slide;
      _fxPhraseRefreshStep(stepIdx);
    }
  }

  function _fxPhraseShiftOctave(semitones) {
    for (var i = 0; i < _fxPhraseSteps.length; i++) {
      var step = _fxPhraseSteps[i];
      if (!step.rest) {
        var newNote = step.note + semitones;
        if (newNote >= FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE && newNote < FX_PHRASE_OCTAVE_BASE + FX_PHRASE_NOTE_RANGE) {
          step.note = newNote;
        }
      }
    }
    _fxPhraseRefreshGrid();
  }

  function _fxPhraseClear() {
    _fxPhraseInitSteps();
    _fxPhraseRefreshGrid();
  }

  function _fxPhraseRefreshStep(stepIdx) {
    var el = _fxPhraseStepEls[stepIdx];
    var step = _fxPhraseSteps[stepIdx];
    if (!el || !step) {
      return;
    }
    var noteEl = el.querySelector('.fx-phrase-note');
    if (noteEl) {
      noteEl.textContent = step.rest ? '\u2014' : _fxMidiToName(step.note);
    }
    if (step.rest) {
      el.classList.add('rest');
    } else {
      el.classList.remove('rest');
    }
    var accentBtn = el.querySelector('.fx-phrase-accent');
    if (accentBtn) {
      if (step.accent) {
        accentBtn.classList.add('on');
      } else {
        accentBtn.classList.remove('on');
      }
    }
    var slideBtn = el.querySelector('.fx-phrase-slide');
    if (slideBtn) {
      if (step.slide) {
        slideBtn.classList.add('on');
      } else {
        slideBtn.classList.remove('on');
      }
    }
  }

  function _fxPhraseRefreshGrid() {
    for (var i = 0; i < FX_PHRASE_STEPS; i++) {
      _fxPhraseRefreshStep(i);
    }
  }

  function _fxPhraseStart() {
    if (_fxPhraseRunning) {
      return;
    }
    _fxPhraseRunning = true;
    _fxPhraseCurrentStep = -1;
    _fxPhraseLastMidi = -1;

    if (_fxPhrasePlayBtn) {
      _fxPhrasePlayBtn.classList.add('playing');
      _fxPhrasePlayBtn.textContent = '\u25A0';
    }

    var stepIntervalMs = 60000 / (_fxPhraseBpm * 4);

    _fxPhraseTimerId = setInterval(function() {
      if (_fxPhraseCurrentStep >= 0 && _fxPhraseStepEls[_fxPhraseCurrentStep]) {
        _fxPhraseStepEls[_fxPhraseCurrentStep].classList.remove('active');
      }

      _fxPhraseCurrentStep = (_fxPhraseCurrentStep + 1) % FX_PHRASE_STEPS;

      if (_fxPhraseStepEls[_fxPhraseCurrentStep]) {
        _fxPhraseStepEls[_fxPhraseCurrentStep].classList.add('active');
      }

      var step = _fxPhraseSteps[_fxPhraseCurrentStep];
      if (!step) {
        return;
      }

      var nextIdx = (_fxPhraseCurrentStep + 1) % FX_PHRASE_STEPS;
      var nextStep = _fxPhraseSteps[nextIdx];
      var isSliding = step.slide && nextStep && !nextStep.rest;

      if (_fxPhraseLastMidi >= 0) {
        SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_fxPhraseLastMidi);
        _fxPhraseLastMidi = -1;
      }

      if (step.rest) {
        return;
      }

      var velocity = step.accent ? FX_PHRASE_ACCENT_VEL : FX_PHRASE_NORMAL_VEL;
      var gateFraction = isSliding ? FX_PHRASE_GATE_SLIDE : FX_PHRASE_GATE_NORMAL;
      var gateDurationMs = stepIntervalMs * gateFraction;

      if (SL.audio && SL.audio.startSustainedNote) {
        SL.audio.startSustainedNote(step.note);
        _fxPhraseLastMidi = step.note;

        if (!isSliding) {
          (function(midi) {
            setTimeout(function() {
              if (_fxPhraseLastMidi === midi) {
                SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi);
                _fxPhraseLastMidi = -1;
              }
            }, gateDurationMs);
          })(step.note);
        }
      }

      if (SL.audio.highlightNote) {
        SL.audio.highlightNote(step.note, true);
        (function(midi) {
          setTimeout(function() {
            if (SL.audio.highlightNote) {
              SL.audio.highlightNote(midi, false);
            }
          }, gateDurationMs);
        })(step.note);
      }
    }, stepIntervalMs);
  }

  function _fxPhraseStop() {
    if (!_fxPhraseRunning) {
      return;
    }
    _fxPhraseRunning = false;

    if (_fxPhraseTimerId) {
      clearInterval(_fxPhraseTimerId);
      _fxPhraseTimerId = null;
    }

    if (_fxPhraseLastMidi >= 0) {
      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(_fxPhraseLastMidi);
      _fxPhraseLastMidi = -1;
    }

    if (_fxPhraseCurrentStep >= 0 && _fxPhraseStepEls[_fxPhraseCurrentStep]) {
      _fxPhraseStepEls[_fxPhraseCurrentStep].classList.remove('active');
    }
    _fxPhraseCurrentStep = -1;

    if (_fxPhrasePlayBtn) {
      _fxPhrasePlayBtn.classList.remove('playing');
      _fxPhrasePlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
    }
  }

  function _fxBuildPhraseSection() {
    if (_fxPhraseSteps.length === 0) {
      _fxPhraseInitSteps();
    }

    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'fx-phrase-section';

    // Heading
    var heading = document.createElement('h4');
    heading.textContent = '\u266B 303 Phrase Looper';
    container.appendChild(heading);

    // Transport row
    var transport = document.createElement('div');
    transport.className = 'fx-phrase-transport';

    // Play/Stop button
    _fxPhrasePlayBtn = document.createElement('button');
    _fxPhrasePlayBtn.className = 'fx-phrase-play-btn';
    _fxPhrasePlayBtn.textContent = '\u25B6';
    _fxPhrasePlayBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (_fxPhraseRunning) {
        _fxPhraseStop();
      } else {
        _fxPhraseStart();
      }
    });
    transport.appendChild(_fxPhrasePlayBtn);

    // BPM label
    var bpmLabel = document.createElement('span');
    bpmLabel.style.cssText = 'font-size:0.7rem;color:#9999bb;';
    bpmLabel.textContent = 'BPM';
    transport.appendChild(bpmLabel);

    // BPM slider
    var bpmSlider = document.createElement('input');
    bpmSlider.type = 'range';
    bpmSlider.min = FX_PHRASE_MIN_BPM;
    bpmSlider.max = FX_PHRASE_MAX_BPM;
    bpmSlider.step = 1;
    bpmSlider.value = _fxPhraseBpm;
    bpmSlider.style.cssText = 'width:80px;height:16px;cursor:pointer;';
    transport.appendChild(bpmSlider);

    var bpmVal = document.createElement('span');
    bpmVal.style.cssText = 'font-size:0.7rem;color:#c0c0dd;font-family:monospace;min-width:30px;';
    bpmVal.textContent = _fxPhraseBpm;
    transport.appendChild(bpmVal);

    bpmSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      _fxPhraseBpm = parseInt(bpmSlider.value);
      bpmVal.textContent = _fxPhraseBpm;
      if (_fxPhraseRunning) {
        _fxPhraseStop();
        _fxPhraseStart();
      }
    });

    // Preset dropdown
    var presetSelect = document.createElement('select');
    presetSelect.className = 'effects-add-select';
    presetSelect.style.maxWidth = '110px';
    var defaultOpt = document.createElement('option');
    defaultOpt.value = '';
    defaultOpt.textContent = '-- Pattern --';
    presetSelect.appendChild(defaultOpt);
    for (var pi = 0; pi < FX_PHRASE_PRESETS.length; pi++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = pi;
      opt.textContent = FX_PHRASE_PRESETS[pi].name;
      presetSelect.appendChild(opt);
    }
    presetSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (presetSelect.value !== '') {
        _fxPhraseLoadPreset(parseInt(presetSelect.value));
      }
    });
    transport.appendChild(presetSelect);

    container.appendChild(transport);

    // Step grid
    var grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'fx-phrase-grid';
    _fxPhraseStepEls = [];

    for (var si = 0; si < FX_PHRASE_STEPS; si++) {
      var stepEl = document.createElement('div');
      stepEl.className = 'fx-phrase-step';
      var step = _fxPhraseSteps[si];
      if (step.rest) {
        stepEl.classList.add('rest');
      }

      var noteEl = document.createElement('div');
      noteEl.className = 'fx-phrase-note';
      noteEl.textContent = step.rest ? '\u2014' : _fxMidiToName(step.note);
      stepEl.appendChild(noteEl);

      (function(idx) {
        noteEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _fxPhraseCycleNote(idx, 1);
        });
        noteEl.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _fxPhraseSetRest(idx);
        });
        noteEl.addEventListener('wheel', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          var dir = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1;
          _fxPhraseCycleNote(idx, dir);
        });
      })(si);

      var accentBtn = document.createElement('button');
      accentBtn.className = 'fx-phrase-accent' + (step.accent ? ' on' : '');
      accentBtn.textContent = '!';
      accentBtn.title = 'Accent';
      (function(idx) {
        accentBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          _fxPhraseToggleAccent(idx);
        });
      })(si);
      stepEl.appendChild(accentBtn);

      var slideBtn = document.createElement('button');
      slideBtn.className = 'fx-phrase-slide' + (step.slide ? ' on' : '');
      slideBtn.textContent = '/';
      slideBtn.title = 'Slide';
      (function(idx) {
        slideBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          _fxPhraseToggleSlide(idx);
        });
      })(si);
      stepEl.appendChild(slideBtn);

      grid.appendChild(stepEl);
      _fxPhraseStepEls.push(stepEl);
    }

    container.appendChild(grid);

    // Controls row
    var controls = document.createElement('div');
    controls.className = 'fx-phrase-controls';

    var octUpBtn = document.createElement('button');
    octUpBtn.className = 'effects-add-btn';
    octUpBtn.textContent = 'Oct +';
    octUpBtn.title = 'Shift all notes up one octave';
    octUpBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _fxPhraseShiftOctave(12);
    });
    controls.appendChild(octUpBtn);

    var octDownBtn = document.createElement('button');
    octDownBtn.className = 'effects-add-btn';
    octDownBtn.textContent = 'Oct -';
    octDownBtn.title = 'Shift all notes down one octave';
    octDownBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _fxPhraseShiftOctave(-12);
    });
    controls.appendChild(octDownBtn);

    var randomBtn = document.createElement('button');
    randomBtn.className = 'effects-add-btn';
    randomBtn.textContent = 'Randomize';
    randomBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _fxPhraseGenerateRandom();
      _fxPhraseRefreshGrid();
    });
    controls.appendChild(randomBtn);

    var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
    clearBtn.className = 'effects-add-btn';
    clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear';
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _fxPhraseClear();
    });
    controls.appendChild(clearBtn);

    container.appendChild(controls);

    var screenEl = document.getElementById('screen-effects');
    if (screenEl) {
      screenEl.appendChild(container);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init / Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _init() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }
    _initialized = true;
    _buildScreen();
    _setupEventListeners();
    _renderEffectList();
    _syncMasterMix();
    _fxBuildPhraseSection();

    // Add transport and nav links
    var container = document.getElementById('screen-effects');
    if (container) {
      var navBar = document.createElement('div');
      navBar.style.cssText = 'padding:4px 8px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;';

      var transportDiv = document.createElement('div');
      transportDiv.id = 'effects-transport';
      transportDiv.className = 'shared-transport-container';
      navBar.appendChild(transportDiv);

      var designLink = document.createElement('button');
      designLink.className = 'screen-nav-link';
      designLink.textContent = '\u2192 Design';
      designLink.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.screens) { SL.screens.switchTo('design'); }
      });
      navBar.appendChild(designLink);

      container.appendChild(navBar);
    }
  }

  function _syncFromModel() {
    // Sync instrument tab to current instrument
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument) {
      _selectedInst = SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument();
      var allTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.effects-inst-tab-btn');
      for (var t = 0; t < allTabs.length; t++) {
        var tabInst = parseInt(allTabs[t].getAttribute('data-inst'), 10);
        if (tabInst === _selectedInst) {
          allTabs[t].classList.add('active');
        } else {
          allTabs[t].classList.remove('active');
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function activate(tabId) {
    _init();
    _active = true;
    _syncFromModel();
    _renderEffectList();
    _syncMasterMix();
    if (SL.sharedTransport) {
      SL.sharedTransport.build('effects-transport');
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _fxPhraseStop();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Public API
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenEffects = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };

})();


// === screen-mix.js ===
// SuperSynthLab - MIX Screen Module
// Multi-instrument mixer view with channel strips, master section, spectrum
// Lazy-initialized on first switch to the mix screen.
// ES5 compatible (var, no arrow functions, no template literals)
(function() {
  'use strict';

  var SL = window.SynthLab;

  // ============================================================
  // Constants
  // ============================================================

  var NUM_INSTRUMENTS = 5;
  var INSTRUMENT_LABELS = ['1-Bass', '2-Lead', '3-Pad', '4-Sampler', '5-Loop'];
  var FADER_HEIGHT = 160;
  var METER_WIDTH = 20;
  var METER_HEIGHT = 80;
  var MASTER_METER_WIDTH = 30;
  var MASTER_METER_HEIGHT = 100;
  var SPECTRUM_FFT_SIZE = 256;
  var METER_SMOOTHING = 0.85;
  var METER_GREEN_THRESHOLD = 0.6;
  var METER_YELLOW_THRESHOLD = 0.85;

  // ============================================================
  // State
  // ============================================================

  var _initialized = false;
  var _active = false;
  var _animFrameId = null;

  // Per-channel state
  var _volumes = [80, 80, 80, 80, 30]; // default volumes
  var _pans = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]; // -100 to 100
  var _muted = [false, false, false, false, false];
  var _soloed = [false, false, false, false, false];
  var _enabled = [true, true, true, true, true];
  var _meterLevels = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  var _masterVolume = 80;
  var _masterMeterLevel = 0;
  var _instMeterData = []; // per-instrument Uint8Array for analyser data

  // Canvas references
  var _meterCanvases = [];
  var _meterCtxs = [];
  var _masterMeterCanvas = null;
  var _masterMeterCtx = null;
  var _spectrumCanvas = null;
  var _spectrumCtx = null;
  var _analyserNode = null;
  var _spectrumData = null;

  // Fader drag state
  var _draggingFader = null; // { index: N, startY, startVol } or null
  var _draggingMaster = null; // { startY, startVol } or null

  // ============================================================
  // Helpers
  // ============================================================

  function _getInstrumentType(idx) {
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.getInstrumentType) {
      return SL.audio.getInstrumentType(idx);
    }
    if (idx === 3) {
      return 'sampler';
    }
    if (idx === 4) {
      return 'loop';
    }
    return 'subtractive';
  }

  function _syncVolumesFromEngine() {
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.getInstruments) {
      var insts = SL.audio.getInstruments();
      for (var i = 0; i < NUM_INSTRUMENTS; i++) {
        if (insts[i] && insts[i].settings && insts[i].settings.volume !== undefined) {
          _volumes[i] = insts[i].settings.volume;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function _applyVolume(idx) {
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.setInstrumentVolume) {
      var effectiveVol = _volumes[idx];
      // Apply mute
      if (_muted[idx]) {
        effectiveVol = 0;
      }
      // Apply solo logic: if any channel is soloed, mute non-soloed channels
      var anySoloed = false;
      for (var s = 0; s < NUM_INSTRUMENTS; s++) {
        if (_soloed[s]) {
          anySoloed = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (anySoloed && !_soloed[idx]) {
        effectiveVol = 0;
      }
      SL.audio.setInstrumentVolume(idx, effectiveVol);
      if (SL.state) { SL.state.notify('volume'); }
    }
  }

  function _applyAllVolumes() {
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_INSTRUMENTS; i++) {
      _applyVolume(i);
    }
  }

  function _panDisplayStr(pan) {
    if (pan === 0) {
      return 'C';
    }
    if (pan < 0) {
      return 'L' + Math.abs(pan);
    }
    return 'R' + pan;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DOM Building
  // ============================================================

  function _buildScreen() {
    var container = document.getElementById('screen-mix');
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }

    var html = '';

    // Main layout
    html += '<div class="mix-screen-main">';

    // Channel strips area
    html += '<div class="mix-channels-area">';
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_INSTRUMENTS; i++) {
      html += _buildChannelStrip(i);
    }
    html += '</div>';

    // Master section
    html += '<div class="mix-master-section">';
    html += '<div class="mix-master-title">MASTER</div>';

    // Master fader
    html += '<div class="mix-master-fader-container">';
    html += '<div class="mix-master-fader-wrapper" id="mix-master-fader-wrapper">';
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-track"></div>';
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-fill" id="mix-master-fill"></div>';
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-thumb" id="mix-master-thumb"></div>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="mix-master-value" id="mix-master-value">' + _masterVolume + '</div>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Master meter
    html += '<canvas id="mix-master-meter" class="mix-master-meter-canvas" width="' + MASTER_METER_WIDTH + '" height="' + MASTER_METER_HEIGHT + '"></canvas>';

    // Spectrum analyzer
    html += '<div class="mix-spectrum-section">';
    html += '<div class="mix-spectrum-label">Spectrum</div>';
    html += '<canvas id="mix-spectrum-canvas" class="mix-spectrum-canvas"></canvas>';
    html += '</div>';

    html += '</div>'; // master section

    html += '</div>'; // main layout

    // Shared transport
    html += '<div id="mix-transport" class="shared-transport-container" style="margin:4px 8px;"></div>';

    // Bottom bar: per-instrument enable/disable
    html += '<div class="mix-screen-bottom-bar">';
    for (var b = 0; b < NUM_INSTRUMENTS; b++) {
      html += '<button class="mix-inst-toggle' + (_enabled[b] ? ' active' : '') + '" data-inst-toggle="' + b + '">';
      html += INSTRUMENT_LABELS[b];
      html += '</button>';
    }
    html += '</div>';

    container.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function _buildChannelStrip(idx) {
    var typeLabel = _getInstrumentType(idx);
    var html = '';

    html += '<div class="mix-channel-strip" data-channel="' + idx + '">';

    // Name + type + current preset name (US-07)
    html += '<div class="mix-channel-name">' + INSTRUMENT_LABELS[idx] + '</div>';
    html += '<div class="mix-channel-type">' + typeLabel + '</div>';
    html += '<div class="mix-channel-preset-name" id="mix-preset-name-' + idx + '" style="color:#44cc88;font-size:0.55rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:80px"></div>';

    // Level meter (above fader)
    html += '<div class="mix-meter-container">';
    html += '<canvas class="mix-meter-canvas" id="mix-meter-' + idx + '" width="' + METER_WIDTH + '" height="' + METER_HEIGHT + '"></canvas>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Volume fader (custom drawn)
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-container">';
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-wrapper" id="mix-fader-wrapper-' + idx + '">';
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-track"></div>';
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-fill" id="mix-fader-fill-' + idx + '"></div>';
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-thumb" id="mix-fader-thumb-' + idx + '"></div>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="mix-fader-value" id="mix-fader-value-' + idx + '">' + _volumes[idx] + '</div>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Pan
    html += '<div class="mix-pan-container">';
    html += '<span class="mix-pan-label">Pan</span>';
    html += '<input type="range" class="mix-pan-slider" id="mix-pan-' + idx + '" min="-100" max="100" value="' + _pans[idx] + '">';
    html += '<span class="mix-pan-value" id="mix-pan-value-' + idx + '">' + _panDisplayStr(_pans[idx]) + '</span>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Mute / Solo
    html += '<div class="mix-mute-solo">';
    html += '<button class="mix-mute-btn' + (_muted[idx] ? ' active' : '') + '" data-mute="' + idx + '">M</button>';
    html += '<button class="mix-solo-btn' + (_soloed[idx] ? ' active' : '') + '" data-solo="' + idx + '">S</button>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Quick preset selector
    html += '<select class="mix-preset-select" id="mix-preset-' + idx + '">';
    html += '<option value="">-- Preset --</option>';
    html += '</select>';

    // Cross-screen nav links per channel
    html += '<div style="margin-top:4px">';
    html += '<button class="screen-nav-link" data-mix-nav-fx="' + idx + '">\u2192 Effects</button>';
    html += '</div>';

    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Fader Logic (custom drag)
  // ============================================================

  function _updateFaderPosition(idx, volume) {
    var fill = document.getElementById('mix-fader-fill-' + idx);
    var thumb = document.getElementById('mix-fader-thumb-' + idx);
    var wrapper = document.getElementById('mix-fader-wrapper-' + idx);
    if (fill && thumb && wrapper) {
      var pct = volume / 100;
      var wrapperHeight = wrapper.offsetHeight || FADER_HEIGHT;
      var fillH = Math.round(pct * wrapperHeight);
      fill.style.height = fillH + 'px';
      thumb.style.bottom = (fillH - 5) + 'px';
    }
    var valEl = document.getElementById('mix-fader-value-' + idx);
    if (valEl) {
      valEl.textContent = Math.round(volume);
    }
  }

  function _updateMasterFaderPosition(volume) {
    var fill = document.getElementById('mix-master-fill');
    var thumb = document.getElementById('mix-master-thumb');
    var wrapper = document.getElementById('mix-master-fader-wrapper');
    if (fill && thumb && wrapper) {
      var pct = volume / 100;
      var wrapperHeight = wrapper.offsetHeight || FADER_HEIGHT;
      var fillH = Math.round(pct * wrapperHeight);
      fill.style.height = fillH + 'px';
      thumb.style.bottom = (fillH - 5) + 'px';
    }
    var valEl = document.getElementById('mix-master-value');
    if (valEl) {
      valEl.textContent = Math.round(volume);
    }
  }

  function _onFaderMouseDown(idx, e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    _draggingFader = { index: idx, startY: e.clientY, startVol: _volumes[idx] };
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', _onFaderMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', _onFaderMouseUp);
  }

  function _onFaderMouseMove(e) {
    if (_draggingFader !== null) {
      var dy = _draggingFader.startY - e.clientY;
      var newVol = _draggingFader.startVol + (dy / FADER_HEIGHT) * 100;
      newVol = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(newVol)));
      _volumes[_draggingFader.index] = newVol;
      _updateFaderPosition(_draggingFader.index, newVol);
      _applyVolume(_draggingFader.index);
    }
    if (_draggingMaster !== null) {
      var dy2 = _draggingMaster.startY - e.clientY;
      var newMaster = _draggingMaster.startVol + (dy2 / FADER_HEIGHT) * 100;
      newMaster = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(newMaster)));
      _masterVolume = newMaster;
      _updateMasterFaderPosition(newMaster);
      // Apply master volume via main volume control if available
      var volSlider = document.getElementById('volumeSlider');
      if (volSlider) {
        volSlider.value = newMaster;
        volSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
      }
    }
  }

  function _onFaderMouseUp() {
    _draggingFader = null;
    _draggingMaster = null;
    document.removeEventListener('mousemove', _onFaderMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener('mouseup', _onFaderMouseUp);
  }

  function _onMasterMouseDown(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    _draggingMaster = { startY: e.clientY, startVol: _masterVolume };

    // Level bar from bottom

    if (barH > 0) {
      var gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, height, 0, 0);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, '#2a6');
      gradient.addColorStop(METER_GREEN_THRESHOLD, '#2a6');
      gradient.addColorStop(METER_YELLOW_THRESHOLD, '#aa0');
      gradient.addColorStop(1, '#a22');
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(1, height - barH, width - 2, barH);
    }

    // Grid lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
    var numLines = 4;
    for (var g = 1; g < numLines; g++) {
      var gy = Math.round((g / numLines) * height);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(width, gy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

  function _drawSpectrum(ctx, width, height, data) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Background

    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    if (!data) {
      return;
    }

    var binCount = data.length;
    var barWidth = width / binCount;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#4cc9f0';
    for (var i = 0; i < binCount; i++) {
      var val = data[i] / 255;
      var barH = Math.round(val * height);
      if (barH > 0) {
        ctx.fillRect(Math.round(i * barWidth), height - barH, Math.max(1, Math.floor(barWidth) - 1), barH);
      }
    }

  function _animationLoop() {

      var instAnalyser = (SL.audio && SL.audio.getInstrumentAnalyser) ? SL.audio.getInstrumentAnalyser(i) : null;

      if (instAnalyser) {
        if (!_instMeterData[i] || _instMeterData[i].length !== instAnalyser.frequencyBinCount) {
          _instMeterData[i] = new Uint8Array(instAnalyser.frequencyBinCount);
        }
        instAnalyser.getByteFrequencyData(_instMeterData[i]);
        var sum = 0;
        for (var bi = 0; bi < _instMeterData[i].length; bi++) {
          sum += _instMeterData[i][bi];

        target = (sum / _instMeterData[i].length) / 255;
      } else {

        if (_muted[i]) {

        for (var s = 0; s < NUM_INSTRUMENTS; s++) {

        if (anySoloed && !_soloed[i]) {

      _meterLevels[i] = _meterLevels[i] * METER_SMOOTHING + target * (1 - METER_SMOOTHING);

        _drawMeter(_meterCtxs[i], METER_WIDTH, METER_HEIGHT, _meterLevels[i]);

  };

  // ============================================================
  // Layer Actions
  // ============================================================

  // ============================================================
  // Per-Layer Audio Engine (independent Web Audio chains)
  // ============================================================

  function _buildNoiseBuffer(ctx, color) {
    var NOISE_BUFFER_SECONDS = 2;
    var bufferSize = ctx.sampleRate * NOISE_BUFFER_SECONDS;
    var buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate);
    var data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    if (color === 'white') {
      for (var i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      }
    } else if (color === 'pink') {
      var b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0, b3 = 0, b4 = 0, b5 = 0, b6 = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        var white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        b0 = 0.99886 * b0 + white * 0.0555179;
        b1 = 0.99332 * b1 + white * 0.0750759;
        b2 = 0.96900 * b2 + white * 0.1538520;
        b3 = 0.86650 * b3 + white * 0.3104856;
        b4 = 0.55000 * b4 + white * 0.5329522;
        b5 = -0.7616 * b5 - white * 0.0168980;
        data[i] = (b0 + b1 + b2 + b3 + b4 + b5 + b6 + white * 0.5362) * 0.11;
        b6 = white * 0.115926;
      }
    } else { // brown
      var lastOut = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        var white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        data[i] = (lastOut + 0.02 * white) / 1.02;
        lastOut = data[i];
        data[i] *= 3.5;
      }
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function _startLayerAudio(idx) {
    var ctx = SL.audio ? SL.audio.getCtx() : null;
    if (ctx) {
      // Stop existing audio for this layer first
      _stopLayerAudio(idx);

      var textureName = _layerTextures[idx];
      var textureDef = _TEXTURE_DEFS[textureName];
      if (textureDef) {
        var state = _layerAudioState[idx];

        // Create per-layer gain node
        state.gainNode = ctx.createGain();
        state.gainNode.gain.value = (_layerVolumes[idx] / 100) * (_masterVolume / 100);

        // Connect directly to audio destination so all layers mix independently
        state.gainNode.connect(ctx.destination);

        if (textureDef.type === 'noise') {
          var buffer = _buildNoiseBuffer(ctx, textureDef.color);
          var source = ctx.createBufferSource();
          source.buffer = buffer;
          source.loop = true;
          state.nodes.push(source);

          if (textureDef.filter) {
            var texFilter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
            texFilter.type = textureDef.filter.type;
            texFilter.frequency.value = textureDef.filter.freq;
            if (textureDef.filter.Q) {
              texFilter.Q.value = textureDef.filter.Q;
            }
            source.connect(texFilter);
            texFilter.connect(state.gainNode);
            state.nodes.push(texFilter);
          } else {
            source.connect(state.gainNode);
          }

          source.start();
        } else if (textureDef.type === 'tone') {
          var detunes = textureDef.detune || [0];
          for (var d = 0; d < detunes.length; d++) {
            var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            osc.type = textureDef.wave || 'sine';
            osc.frequency.value = textureDef.freq || 110;
            osc.detune.value = detunes[d] * 100; // semitones to cents
            osc.connect(state.gainNode);
            osc.start();
            state.nodes.push(osc);
          }
        }

        // Create per-layer LFO for volume modulation
        var lfoOsc = ctx.createOscillator();
        lfoOsc.type = 'sine';
        lfoOsc.frequency.value = _layerLfoRate[idx] * 0.2; // 0-100 slider -> 0-20 Hz
        var lfoGainNode = ctx.createGain();
        var depth = _layerLfoDepth[idx] / 100; // 0-100 -> 0.0-1.0
        lfoGainNode.gain.value = depth * (state.gainNode.gain.value);
        lfoOsc.connect(lfoGainNode);
        lfoGainNode.connect(state.gainNode.gain);
        lfoOsc.start();
        state.lfoOsc = lfoOsc;
        state.lfoGainNode = lfoGainNode;

        state.playing = true;
      }
    }
  }

  function _stopLayerAudio(idx) {
    var state = _layerAudioState[idx];
    if (state) {
      for (var i = 0; i < state.nodes.length; i++) {
        try {
          if (state.nodes[i].stop) {
            state.nodes[i].stop();
          }
          state.nodes[i].disconnect();
        } catch (e) { /* already stopped */ }
      }
      state.nodes = [];
      if (state.lfoOsc) {
        try { state.lfoOsc.stop(); state.lfoOsc.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
        state.lfoOsc = null;
      }
      if (state.lfoGainNode) {
        try { state.lfoGainNode.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
        state.lfoGainNode = null;
      }
      if (state.gainNode) {
        try { state.gainNode.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
        state.gainNode = null;
      }
      state.playing = false;
    }
  }

  function _applyLayerGains() {
    // Determine if any layer is soloed
    var anySoloed = false;
    for (var si = 0; si < NUM_LAYERS; si++) {
      if (_layerSoloed[si]) {
        anySoloed = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Apply gain to each layer independently
    for (var li = 0; li < NUM_LAYERS; li++) {
      var state = _layerAudioState[li];
      if (state && state.gainNode) {
        var effectiveVol = (_layerVolumes[li] / 100) * (_masterVolume / 100);
        if (_layerMuted[li]) {
          effectiveVol = 0;
        }
        if (anySoloed && !_layerSoloed[li]) {
          effectiveVol = 0;
        }
        state.gainNode.gain.value = effectiveVol;
      }
    }
  }

  function _getActiveLayerIndex() {
    // Return the first layer that has a texture selected
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
      if (_layerTextures[i]) {
        return i;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  function _applyLayerLfo(idx) {
    var state = _layerAudioState[idx];
    if (state && state.lfoOsc && state.lfoGainNode && state.gainNode) {
      // Update LFO rate: slider 0-100 maps to 0-20 Hz
      state.lfoOsc.frequency.value = _layerLfoRate[idx] * 0.2;
      // Update LFO depth: slider 0-100 maps to 0.0-1.0 of current gain
      var depth = _layerLfoDepth[idx] / 100;
      state.lfoGainNode.gain.value = depth * (state.gainNode.gain.value);
    }
  }

  function _applyLayerTexture(idx) {
    if (_layerTextures[idx]) {
      if (_playing) {
        // Start this layer's audio immediately since we are in play mode
        _startLayerAudio(idx);
        _applyLayerGains();
      }
    } else {
      // Texture cleared — stop this layer
      _stopLayerAudio(idx);
    }
  }

  function _stopAllLayers() {
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
      _stopLayerAudio(i);
    }
  }

  function _clearAllLayers() {
    _playing = false;
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('loop-play-btn');
    if (playBtn) {
      playBtn.classList.remove('active');
    }
    _stopAllLayers();
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
      _layerVolumes[i] = DEFAULT_VOLUME;
      _layerMuted[i] = false;
      _layerSoloed[i] = false;
      _layerRecording[i] = false;
      _layerTextures[i] = '';
      _layerLfoRate[i] = DEFAULT_LFO_RATE;
      _layerLfoDepth[i] = DEFAULT_LFO_DEPTH;
      _layerLfoTarget[i] = 'volume';
      _layerAudioState[i] = { nodes: [], gainNode: null, lfoOsc: null, lfoGainNode: null, playing: false };
    }
    _buildScreen();
    _setupEventListeners();
    _initCanvas();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Progress Animation
  // ============================================================

  function _initCanvas() {
    _progressCanvas = document.getElementById('loop-progress-canvas');
    if (_progressCanvas) {
      _progressCtx = _progressCanvas.getContext('2d');
    }
  }

  function _getLoopDurationMs() {
    // 4 beats per bar
    var beatsPerBar = 4;
    var totalBeats = beatsPerBar * _loopBars;
    var msPerBeat = 60000 / _bpm;
    return totalBeats * msPerBeat;
  }

  function _drawProgress() {
    if (!_progressCtx) {
      return;
    }

    var size = PROGRESS_CANVAS_SIZE;
    var cx = size / 2;
    var cy = size / 2;
    var radius = (size / 2) - PROGRESS_LINE_WIDTH - 2;

    _progressCtx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);

    // Background circle
    _progressCtx.beginPath();
    _progressCtx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    _progressCtx.strokeStyle = PROGRESS_BG_COLOR;
    _progressCtx.lineWidth = PROGRESS_LINE_WIDTH;
    _progressCtx.stroke();

    if (_playing) {
      var elapsed = Date.now() - _loopStartTime;
      var duration = _getLoopDurationMs();
      var progress = (elapsed % duration) / duration;
      var angle = progress * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;

      // Progress arc
      _progressCtx.beginPath();
      _progressCtx.arc(cx, cy, radius, -Math.PI / 2, angle);
      _progressCtx.strokeStyle = PROGRESS_FG_COLOR;
      _progressCtx.lineWidth = PROGRESS_LINE_WIDTH;
      _progressCtx.stroke();

      // Dot at current position
      var dotX = cx + radius * Math.cos(angle);
      var dotY = cy + radius * Math.sin(angle);
      _progressCtx.beginPath();
      _progressCtx.arc(dotX, dotY, PROGRESS_DOT_RADIUS, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      _progressCtx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      _progressCtx.fill();

      // Info text
      var beatNum = Math.floor(progress * _loopBars * 4) + 1;
      var barNum = Math.floor((beatNum - 1) / 4) + 1;
      var beatInBar = ((beatNum - 1) % 4) + 1;
      var infoEl = document.getElementById('loop-progress-info');
      if (infoEl) {
        infoEl.textContent = 'Bar ' + barNum + ' : ' + beatInBar;
      }
    } else {
      var infoEl2 = document.getElementById('loop-progress-info');
      if (infoEl2) {
        infoEl2.textContent = 'Stopped';
      }
    }
  }

  function _animLoop() {
    _drawProgress();
    if (_active) {
      _animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(_animLoop);
    }
  }

  function _startAnimation() {
    if (!_animFrameId && _active) {
      _animLoop();
    }
  }

  function _stopAnimation() {
    if (_animFrameId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(_animFrameId);
      _animFrameId = null;
    }
  }

  function _buildDeckHtml(deckId, textures) {
    var deck = (deckId === 'a') ? _djDeckA : _djDeckB;
    var deckClass = 'dj-deck dj-deck-' + deckId;
    var deckLabel = (deckId === 'a') ? 'DECK A' : 'DECK B';

    var html = '';

    html += '<div class="' + deckClass + '">';
    html += '<div class="dj-deck-header">' + deckLabel + '</div>';

      html += '<option value="' + textures[t] + '"' + sel + '>' + textures[t] + '</option>';
    }
    html += '</select>';

    // Status
    html += '<div class="dj-deck-status" id="dj-status-' + deckId + '">' + statusText + '</div>';

    // Volume
    html += '<div class="dj-deck-slider-group">';
    html += '<span class="dj-deck-slider-label">Vol</span>';

    html += '<span class="dj-deck-slider-val" id="dj-vol-val-' + deckId + '">' + deck.volume + '</span>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Filter cutoff
    html += '<div class="dj-deck-slider-group">';
    html += '<span class="dj-deck-slider-label">Filter</span>';
    html += '<input type="range" class="dj-deck-slider" id="dj-filter-' + deckId + '" min="0" max="100" value="' + deck.filterVal + '">';
    html += '<span class="dj-deck-slider-val" id="dj-filter-val-' + deckId + '">' + Math.round(_djFilterSliderToHz(deck.filterVal)) + ' Hz</span>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Filter type
    html += '<div class="dj-deck-filter-type-group">';
    html += '<select class="dj-deck-filter-type" id="dj-filter-type-' + deckId + '">';
    for (var ft = 0; ft < DJ_FILTER_TYPES.length; ft++) {
      var ftSel = (DJ_FILTER_TYPES[ft] === deck.filterType) ? ' selected' : '';
      html += '<option value="' + DJ_FILTER_TYPES[ft] + '"' + ftSel + '>' + DJ_FILTER_TYPES[ft] + '</option>';
    }
    html += '</select>';
    html += '</div>';

    // Play button
    var playClass = 'dj-deck-play-btn';
    if (deck.playing) {
      playClass += ' active';
    }
    html += '<button class="' + playClass + '" id="dj-play-' + deckId + '">' + (deck.playing ? 'Stop' : 'Play') + '</button>';

    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DJ Mode — Event Listeners
  // ============================================================

  function _setupDjEventListeners() {
    // BPM
    var bpmEl = document.getElementById('dj-bpm');
    if (bpmEl) {
      bpmEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var val = parseInt(bpmEl.value, 10);
        if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 40 && val <= 300) {
          _djBpm = val;
        } else {
          bpmEl.value = _djBpm;
        }
      });
    }

    // Sync button
    var syncBtn = document.getElementById('dj-sync-btn');
    if (syncBtn) {
      syncBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        // Sync both decks: restart deck B to align with deck A timing
        syncBtn.classList.add('active');
        setTimeout(function() {
          syncBtn.classList.remove('active');
        }, 300);
      });
    }

    // Crossfader
    var xfader = document.getElementById('dj-crossfader');
    if (xfader) {
      xfader.addEventListener('input', function() {
        _djCrossfade = parseInt(xfader.value, 10);
        var valEl = document.getElementById('dj-xfade-val');
        if (valEl) {
          valEl.textContent = _djCrossfade;
        }
        _djUpdateCrossfade();
      });
    }

    // Deck A controls
    _setupDeckListeners('a', _djDeckA);
    // Deck B controls
    _setupDeckListeners('b', _djDeckB);

    // FX controls
    var fxSelect = document.getElementById('dj-fx-select');
    if (fxSelect) {
      fxSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        _djFxType = fxSelect.value;
        _djRebuildFx();
      });
    }

    var fxAmount = document.getElementById('dj-fx-amount');
    if (fxAmount) {
      fxAmount.addEventListener('input', function() {
        _djFxAmount = parseInt(fxAmount.value, 10);
        _djUpdateFxParams();
      });
    }

    var fxRate = document.getElementById('dj-fx-rate');
    if (fxRate) {
      fxRate.addEventListener('input', function() {
        _djFxRate = parseInt(fxRate.value, 10);
        _djUpdateFxParams();
      });
    }
  }

  function _setupDeckListeners(deckId, deck) {
    // Texture selector
    var texEl = document.getElementById('dj-texture-' + deckId);
    if (texEl) {
      texEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        deck.texture = texEl.value;
        if (deck.playing) {
          _djStartDeck(deck, deckId);
        }
      });
    }

    // Volume slider
    var volEl = document.getElementById('dj-vol-' + deckId);
    if (volEl) {
      volEl.addEventListener('input', function() {
        deck.volume = parseInt(volEl.value, 10);
        var valEl = document.getElementById('dj-vol-val-' + deckId);
        if (valEl) {
          valEl.textContent = deck.volume;
        }
        _djUpdateCrossfade();
      });
    }

    // Filter slider
    var filterEl = document.getElementById('dj-filter-' + deckId);
    if (filterEl) {
      filterEl.addEventListener('input', function() {
        deck.filterVal = parseInt(filterEl.value, 10);
        var hz = _djFilterSliderToHz(deck.filterVal);
        var valEl = document.getElementById('dj-filter-val-' + deckId);
        if (valEl) {
          valEl.textContent = Math.round(hz) + ' Hz';
        }
        if (deck.filterNode) {
          deck.filterNode.frequency.value = hz;
        }
      });
    }

    // Filter type
    var ftEl = document.getElementById('dj-filter-type-' + deckId);
    if (ftEl) {
      ftEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
        deck.filterType = ftEl.value;
        if (deck.filterNode) {
          deck.filterNode.type = deck.filterType;
        }
      });
    }

    // Play/Stop button
    var playEl = document.getElementById('dj-play-' + deckId);
    if (playEl) {
      playEl.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (deck.playing) {
          _djStopDeck(deck, deckId);
        } else {
          if (deck.texture) {
            _djStartDeck(deck, deckId);
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DJ Mode — Filter Logarithmic Mapping
  // ============================================================

  function _djFilterSliderToHz(sliderVal) {
    // Map 0-100 to 20-20000 Hz exponentially
    // hz = 20 * (1000 ^ (val/100))
    // at val=0: 20*1=20, at val=100: 20*1000=20000
    var normalized = sliderVal / 100;
    return DJ_FILTER_MIN_HZ * Math.pow(DJ_FILTER_MAX_HZ / DJ_FILTER_MIN_HZ, normalized);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DJ Mode — Audio Engine
  // ============================================================

  function _djStartDeck(deck, deckId) {
    var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (!ctx) {
      return;
    }

    _djStopDeck(deck, deckId);

    // Create gain + filter chain
    deck.gainNode = ctx.createGain();
    deck.filterNode = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    deck.filterNode.type = deck.filterType;
    deck.filterNode.frequency.value = _djFilterSliderToHz(deck.filterVal);

    // Connect: source -> filter -> gain -> FX destination or ctx.destination
    var dest = _djGetOutputNode(ctx);
    deck.filterNode.connect(deck.gainNode);
    deck.gainNode.connect(dest);

    // Build source based on texture
    var textureDef = _djGetTextureDef(deck.texture);
    if (textureDef) {
      if (textureDef.type === 'noise') {
        _djBuildNoiseSource(ctx, deck, textureDef);
      } else if (textureDef.type === 'tone') {
        _djBuildToneSource(ctx, deck, textureDef);
      }
    }

    deck.playing = true;
    _djUpdateCrossfade();
    _djUpdateDeckUI(deckId, deck);
  }

  function _djStopDeck(deck, deckId) {
    // Stop all source nodes
    for (var i = 0; i < deck.nodes.length; i++) {
      try {
        if (deck.nodes[i].stop) {
          deck.nodes[i].stop();
        }
        deck.nodes[i].disconnect();
      } catch (e) { /* already stopped */ }
    }
    deck.nodes = [];

    if (deck.filterNode) {
      try { deck.filterNode.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      deck.filterNode = null;
    }
    if (deck.gainNode) {
      try { deck.gainNode.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      deck.gainNode = null;
    }

    deck.playing = false;
    if (deckId) {
      _djUpdateDeckUI(deckId, deck);
    }
  }

  function _djBuildNoiseSource(ctx, deck, textureDef) {
    var bufferSize = ctx.sampleRate * 2; // 2 seconds looping
    var buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate);
    var data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    if (textureDef.color === 'white') {
      for (var i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      }
    } else if (textureDef.color === 'pink') {
      var b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0, b3 = 0, b4 = 0, b5 = 0, b6 = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        var white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        b0 = 0.99886 * b0 + white * 0.0555179;
        b1 = 0.99332 * b1 + white * 0.0750759;
        b2 = 0.96900 * b2 + white * 0.1538520;
        b3 = 0.86650 * b3 + white * 0.3104856;
        b4 = 0.55000 * b4 + white * 0.5329522;
        b5 = -0.7616 * b5 - white * 0.0168980;
        data[i] = (b0 + b1 + b2 + b3 + b4 + b5 + b6 + white * 0.5362) * 0.11;
        b6 = white * 0.115926;
      }
    } else { // brown
      var lastOut = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        var white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        data[i] = (lastOut + 0.02 * white) / 1.02;
        lastOut = data[i];
        data[i] *= 3.5;
      }
    }

    var source = ctx.createBufferSource();
    source.buffer = buffer;
    source.loop = true;
    deck.nodes.push(source);

    if (textureDef.filter) {
      var texFilter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      texFilter.type = textureDef.filter.type;
      texFilter.frequency.value = textureDef.filter.freq;
      if (textureDef.filter.Q) {
        texFilter.Q.value = textureDef.filter.Q;
      }
      source.connect(texFilter);
      texFilter.connect(deck.filterNode);
      deck.nodes.push(texFilter);
    } else {
      source.connect(deck.filterNode);
    }

    // Short fade-in to avoid click
    deck.gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime);
    deck.gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(deck.gainNode.gain.value || 0.5, ctx.currentTime + DJ_FADE_IN_SECONDS);
    source.start();
  }

  function _djBuildToneSource(ctx, deck, textureDef) {
    var detunes = textureDef.detune || [0];
    for (var d = 0; d < detunes.length; d++) {
      var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = textureDef.wave || 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = textureDef.freq || 110;
      osc.detune.value = detunes[d] * 100; // semitones to cents
      osc.connect(deck.filterNode);
      osc.start();
      deck.nodes.push(osc);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DJ Mode — Crossfader (Equal Power)
  // ============================================================

  function _djUpdateCrossfade() {
    // xfade 0-100; 0 = A only, 100 = B only, 50 = center
    var normalized = _djCrossfade / 100; // 0..1
    var aGain = Math.cos(normalized * Math.PI / 2); // equal power
    var bGain = Math.sin(normalized * Math.PI / 2);

    if (_djDeckA.gainNode) {
      _djDeckA.gainNode.gain.value = aGain * (_djDeckA.volume / 100);
    }
    if (_djDeckB.gainNode) {
      _djDeckB.gainNode.gain.value = bGain * (_djDeckB.volume / 100);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DJ Mode — FX
  // ============================================================

  function _djGetOutputNode(ctx) {
    // If FX are active, route through FX chain; otherwise direct to destination
    if (_djFxNodes && _djFxNodes.input) {
      return _djFxNodes.input;
    }
    return ctx.destination;
  }

  function _djRebuildFx() {
    var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (!ctx) {
      return;
    }

    // Tear down old FX
    _djCleanupFx();

    if (_djFxType === 'None') {
      // Reconnect decks directly to destination
      _djReconnectDecks(ctx);
      return;
    }

    var fxInput = ctx.createGain();
    fxInput.gain.value = 1.0;
    var fxOutput = ctx.createGain();
    fxOutput.gain.value = 1.0;

    _djFxNodes = { input: fxInput, output: fxOutput, internals: [] };

    if (_djFxType === 'Reverb') {
      // Simple convolution-free reverb using feedback delay
      var delay = ctx.createDelay(1.0);
      delay.delayTime.value = 0.03;
      var feedback = ctx.createGain();
      feedback.gain.value = (_djFxAmount / 100) * 0.85;
      var wet = ctx.createGain();
      wet.gain.value = _djFxAmount / 100;
      var dry = ctx.createGain();
      dry.gain.value = 1.0 - (_djFxAmount / 200);

      fxInput.connect(dry);
      dry.connect(fxOutput);
      fxInput.connect(delay);
      delay.connect(feedback);
      feedback.connect(delay);
      delay.connect(wet);
      wet.connect(fxOutput);

      _djFxNodes.internals.push(delay, feedback, wet, dry);
      _djFxNodes.delay = delay;
      _djFxNodes.feedback = feedback;
      _djFxNodes.wet = wet;
      _djFxNodes.dry = dry;
    } else if (_djFxType === 'Delay') {
      var delay = ctx.createDelay(2.0);
      var delayTime = 0.1 + (_djFxRate / 100) * 1.4; // 0.1 to 1.5 sec
      delay.delayTime.value = delayTime;
      var feedback = ctx.createGain();
      feedback.gain.value = (_djFxAmount / 100) * 0.7;
      var wet = ctx.createGain();
      wet.gain.value = _djFxAmount / 100;
      var dry = ctx.createGain();
      dry.gain.value = 1.0;

      fxInput.connect(dry);
      dry.connect(fxOutput);
      fxInput.connect(delay);
      delay.connect(feedback);
      feedback.connect(delay);
      delay.connect(wet);
      wet.connect(fxOutput);

      _djFxNodes.internals.push(delay, feedback, wet, dry);
      _djFxNodes.delay = delay;
      _djFxNodes.feedback = feedback;
      _djFxNodes.wet = wet;
      _djFxNodes.dry = dry;
    } else if (_djFxType === 'Filter Sweep') {
      var sweepFilter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      sweepFilter.type = 'lowpass';
      sweepFilter.frequency.value = _djFilterSliderToHz(_djFxAmount);
      sweepFilter.Q.value = 1.0 + (_djFxRate / 100) * 10;

      fxInput.connect(sweepFilter);
      sweepFilter.connect(fxOutput);

      _djFxNodes.internals.push(sweepFilter);
      _djFxNodes.sweepFilter = sweepFilter;
    } else if (_djFxType === 'Bitcrush') {
      // Simulate bitcrush with waveshaper
      var waveshaper = ctx.createWaveShaper();
      var amount = Math.max(2, Math.floor(2 + (_djFxAmount / 100) * 254));
      var curve = new Float32Array(amount);
      for (var ci = 0; ci < amount; ci++) {
        curve[ci] = (2 * ci / (amount - 1)) - 1;
      }
      waveshaper.curve = curve;
      waveshaper.oversample = 'none';

      fxInput.connect(waveshaper);
      waveshaper.connect(fxOutput);

      _djFxNodes.internals.push(waveshaper);
      _djFxNodes.waveshaper = waveshaper;
    }

    fxOutput.connect(ctx.destination);

    // Reconnect decks to FX input
    _djReconnectDecks(ctx);
  }

  function _djUpdateFxParams() {
    if (!_djFxNodes) {
      return;
    }

    if (_djFxType === 'Reverb') {
      if (_djFxNodes.feedback) {
        _djFxNodes.feedback.gain.value = (_djFxAmount / 100) * 0.85;
      }
      if (_djFxNodes.wet) {
        _djFxNodes.wet.gain.value = _djFxAmount / 100;
      }
      if (_djFxNodes.dry) {
        _djFxNodes.dry.gain.value = 1.0 - (_djFxAmount / 200);
      }
    } else if (_djFxType === 'Delay') {
      if (_djFxNodes.delay) {
        _djFxNodes.delay.delayTime.value = 0.1 + (_djFxRate / 100) * 1.4;
      }
      if (_djFxNodes.feedback) {
        _djFxNodes.feedback.gain.value = (_djFxAmount / 100) * 0.7;
      }
      if (_djFxNodes.wet) {
        _djFxNodes.wet.gain.value = _djFxAmount / 100;
      }
    } else if (_djFxType === 'Filter Sweep') {
      if (_djFxNodes.sweepFilter) {
        _djFxNodes.sweepFilter.frequency.value = _djFilterSliderToHz(_djFxAmount);
        _djFxNodes.sweepFilter.Q.value = 1.0 + (_djFxRate / 100) * 10;
      }
    } else if (_djFxType === 'Bitcrush') {
      if (_djFxNodes.waveshaper) {
        var amount = Math.max(2, Math.floor(2 + (_djFxAmount / 100) * 254));
        var curve = new Float32Array(amount);
        for (var ci = 0; ci < amount; ci++) {
          curve[ci] = (2 * ci / (amount - 1)) - 1;
        }
        _djFxNodes.waveshaper.curve = curve;
      }
    }
  }

  function _djCleanupFx() {
    if (_djFxNodes) {
      for (var i = 0; i < _djFxNodes.internals.length; i++) {
        try { _djFxNodes.internals[i].disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      }
      if (_djFxNodes.input) {
        try { _djFxNodes.input.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      }
      if (_djFxNodes.output) {
        try { _djFxNodes.output.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      }
      _djFxNodes = null;
    }
  }

  function _djReconnectDecks(ctx) {
    var dest = _djGetOutputNode(ctx);
    // Reconnect playing decks to new destination
    if (_djDeckA.gainNode) {
      try { _djDeckA.gainNode.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      _djDeckA.gainNode.connect(dest);
    }
    if (_djDeckB.gainNode) {
      try { _djDeckB.gainNode.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      _djDeckB.gainNode.connect(dest);
    }
    _djUpdateCrossfade();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DJ Mode — UI Helpers
  // ============================================================

  function _djUpdateDeckUI(deckId, deck) {
    var statusEl = document.getElementById('dj-status-' + deckId);
    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.textContent = deck.playing ? 'Playing' : 'Stopped';
      if (deck.playing) {
        statusEl.classList.add('playing');
      } else {
        statusEl.classList.remove('playing');
      }
    }

    var playEl = document.getElementById('dj-play-' + deckId);
    if (playEl) {
      playEl.textContent = deck.playing ? 'Stop' : 'Play';
      if (deck.playing) {
        playEl.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        playEl.classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
  }

  function _djStopAll() {
    _djStopDeck(_djDeckA, 'a');
    _djStopDeck(_djDeckB, 'b');
    _djCleanupFx();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DJ Mode — Show / Hide
  // ============================================================

  function _showDjMode() {
    if (!_djBuilt) {
      _buildDjMode();
    }
    // Hide loop layers UI
    var topBar = document.querySelector('.loop-top-bar');
    var mainArea = document.querySelector('.loop-screen-main');
    var bottomBar = document.querySelector('.loop-bottom-bar');
    if (topBar) { topBar.style.display = 'none'; }
    if (mainArea) { mainArea.style.display = 'none'; }
    if (bottomBar) { bottomBar.style.display = 'none'; }

    // Show DJ UI
    var djEl = document.getElementById('dj-container');
    if (djEl) { djEl.style.display = 'flex'; }
  }

  function _showLoopMode() {
    // Show loop layers UI
    var topBar = document.querySelector('.loop-top-bar');
    var mainArea = document.querySelector('.loop-screen-main');
    var bottomBar = document.querySelector('.loop-bottom-bar');
    if (topBar) { topBar.style.display = ''; }
    if (mainArea) { mainArea.style.display = ''; }
    if (bottomBar) { bottomBar.style.display = ''; }

    // Hide DJ UI
    var djEl = document.getElementById('dj-container');
    if (djEl) { djEl.style.display = 'none'; }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init / Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _initState() {
    _layerVolumes = [];
    _layerMuted = [];
    _layerSoloed = [];
    _layerRecording = [];
    _layerTextures = [];
    _layerLfoRate = [];
    _layerLfoDepth = [];
    _layerLfoTarget = [];
    _layerAudioState = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
      _layerVolumes.push(DEFAULT_VOLUME);
      _layerMuted.push(false);
      _layerSoloed.push(false);
      _layerRecording.push(false);
      _layerTextures.push('');
      _layerLfoRate.push(DEFAULT_LFO_RATE);
      _layerLfoDepth.push(DEFAULT_LFO_DEPTH);
      _layerLfoTarget.push('volume');
      _layerAudioState.push({ nodes: [], gainNode: null, lfoOsc: null, lfoGainNode: null, playing: false });
    }
  }

  function _init() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }
    _initialized = true;
    _initState();
    _buildScreen();
    _setupEventListeners();
    _initCanvas();
  }

  function _syncFromModel() {
    // The loop screen has its own independent per-layer audio chains.
    // Do NOT override _playing from SL.loop (single-loop engine) —
    // that would reset multi-layer playback state.
    // Instead, just refresh UI elements to match current state.
  }

  function activate(tabId) {
    _init();
    _active = true;
    _currentTab = tabId || null;

    if (tabId === 'dj') {
      _showDjMode();
    } else {
      _showLoopMode();
    }

    _syncFromModel();
    if (_playing) {
      // Restart all layer audio that was stopped on deactivate
      for (var ri = 0; ri < NUM_LAYERS; ri++) {
        if (_layerTextures[ri] && !_layerAudioState[ri].playing) {
          _startLayerAudio(ri);
        }
      }
      _applyLayerGains();
      _startAnimation();
    } else {
      _drawProgress();
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _stopAnimation();
    // Stop all layer audio on deactivate
    _stopAllLayers();
    _playing = false;
    // Stop both DJ decks on deactivate
    _djStopAll();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Public API
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenLoop = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };

})();

  function _staffYForMidi(midi) {
    // Note positions relative to C4=60: C=0, D=1, E=2, F=3, G=4, A=5, B=6, C5=7...
    var noteMap = [0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6]; // C through B
    var octave = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 5; // octave relative to C4(oct 5 in MIDI)
    var pc = midi % 12;
    var pos = noteMap[pc] + octave * 7; // position in note-steps from C4
    // C4 is 2 steps below bottom line (E4)
    // E4 pos=2, bottom line at staffY = STAFF_TOP_MARGIN + 4*STAFF_LINE_SPACING
    var bottomLineY = STAFF_TOP_MARGIN + 4 * STAFF_LINE_SPACING;
    var y = bottomLineY - (pos - 2) * (STAFF_LINE_SPACING / 2);
    return y;
  }
