  function _getNotesInKey(keySig) {
    var sig = KEY_SIGNATURES[keySig] || KEY_SIGNATURES['C'];
    var sharps = [];
    var flats = [];
    var si;
    for (si = 0; si < sig.sharps; si++) {
      sharps.push(SHARP_ORDER_PC[si]);
    }
    for (si = 0; si < sig.flats; si++) {
      flats.push(FLAT_ORDER_PC[si]);
    }
    return { sharps: sharps, flats: flats };
  }

  function _noteNeedsAccidental(midi, keySig) {
    if (midi === 0) {
      return ''; // rest
    }
    var pc = midi % 12;
    var keyNotes = _getNotesInKey(keySig);
    // Natural notes (white keys): 0,2,4,5,7,9,11
    var isNatural = [0,2,4,5,7,9,11].indexOf(pc) >= 0;
    // Is this note a sharp/flat in the key signature?
    var inKeySharps = keyNotes.sharps.indexOf(pc) >= 0;
    var inKeyFlats = keyNotes.flats.indexOf(pc) >= 0;
    if (isNatural) {
      // Natural note - if its pitch class is sharped in key, it needs a natural sign
      // But we only need that for notes that would be altered by the key sig
      // e.g., F in G major (F# in key) needs natural
      var wouldBeAltered = false;
      var ai;
      for (ai = 0; ai < keyNotes.sharps.length; ai++) {
        if (keyNotes.sharps[ai] === pc) { wouldBeAltered = true; }
      }
      for (ai = 0; ai < keyNotes.flats.length; ai++) {
        if ((keyNotes.flats[ai] + 12 - 1) % 12 === pc) { wouldBeAltered = true; }
      }
      return '';
    }
    // Black key note - is it covered by the key signature?
    if (inKeySharps) {
      return ''; // already in key sig, no accidental needed
    }
    if (inKeyFlats) {
      return ''; // already in key sig
    }
    // Not in key sig - needs an accidental
    // If previous natural note (pc-1) is a white key, show as sharp
    var prevIsWhite = [0,2,4,5,7,9,11].indexOf((pc + 11) % 12) >= 0;
    if (prevIsWhite) {
      return '#';
    }
    return 'b';
  }

  function _beatsPerMeasure(timeSig) {
    if (Array.isArray(timeSig)) {
      return timeSig[0];
    }
    var parts = timeSig.split('/');
    return parseInt(parts[0], 10);
  }

  function _beatUnit(timeSig) {
    if (Array.isArray(timeSig)) {
      return timeSig[1];
    }
    var parts = timeSig.split('/');
    return parseInt(parts[1], 10);
  }

  function _noteDurationInBeats(dur, beatUnitVal) {
    // dur: 1=whole, 2=half, 4=quarter, 8=eighth, 16=sixteenth
    return beatUnitVal / dur;
  }

  function _staffYForMidiNotation(midi, topMargin, lineSp) {
    var noteMap = [0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6];
    var octave = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 5;
    var pc = midi % 12;
    var pos = noteMap[pc] + octave * 7;
    var bottomLineY = topMargin + 4 * lineSp;
    var y = bottomLineY - (pos - 2) * (lineSp / 2);
    return y;
  }

  function _drawRest(ctx, x, topMargin, lineSp, dur) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6a6aff';
    if (dur === DUR_WHOLE) {
      var restY = topMargin + 1 * lineSp;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, restY, 16, lineSp / 2);
    } else if (dur === DUR_HALF) {
      var restY2 = topMargin + 2 * lineSp;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, restY2 - lineSp / 2, 16, lineSp / 2);
    } else if (dur === DUR_QUARTER) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6a6aff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      var qrY = topMargin + 1 * lineSp;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + 3, qrY);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 3, qrY + lineSp * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, qrY + lineSp * 1.0);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 3, qrY + lineSp * 1.5);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, qrY + lineSp * 2.0);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (dur === DUR_EIGHTH) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, topMargin + 2 * lineSp, 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6a6aff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, topMargin + 2 * lineSp);
      ctx.lineTo(x, topMargin + 1 * lineSp);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (dur === DUR_SIXTEENTH) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, topMargin + 2 * lineSp, 2.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, topMargin + 2.5 * lineSp, 2.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6a6aff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, topMargin + 2 * lineSp);
      ctx.lineTo(x, topMargin + 0.5 * lineSp);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function _drawNotationStaff() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('learn-notation-canvas');
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var W = NOTATION_STAFF_WIDTH;
    var H = NOTATION_STAFF_HEIGHT;
    var NR = NOTATION_NOTE_RADIUS;
    var leftMargin = NOTATION_LEFT_MARGIN;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    var staffTopMargin = 50;
    var lineSpacing = 14;

    // Draw 5 staff lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a6a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    var li;
    for (li = 0; li < 5; li++) {
      var ly = staffTopMargin + li * lineSpacing;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(leftMargin - 10, ly);
      ctx.lineTo(W - 10, ly);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Get current melody
    var melody = NOTATION_MELODIES[_notationMelodyIdx];
    var isCustom = (_notationMelodyIdx === NOTATION_MELODIES.length - 1);
    var notes;
    if (isCustom) {
      notes = _notationCustomNotes;
    } else if (melody) {
      notes = melody.notes;
    } else {
      notes = [];
    }
    var melodyKey = (melody && melody.key) ? melody.key : 'C';
    var melodyTime = (melody && melody.time) ? melody.time : '4/4';

    // Draw treble clef
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaadd';
    ctx.font = '42px serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('\uD834\uDD1E', leftMargin - 52, staffTopMargin + 2 * lineSpacing - 2);

    // Draw key signature
    var keySig = KEY_SIGNATURES[melodyKey] || KEY_SIGNATURES['C'];
    var keySigWidth = 0;
    var keySigStartX = leftMargin - 8;
    if (keySig.sharps > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ccccee';
      ctx.font = 'bold 14px serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      var shi;
      for (shi = 0; shi < keySig.sharps; shi++) {
        var sharpPos = KEY_SHARP_POSITIONS[shi];
        var sharpY = staffTopMargin + 4 * lineSpacing - sharpPos * (lineSpacing / 2);
        ctx.fillText('\u266F', keySigStartX + shi * 10, sharpY);
      }
      keySigWidth = keySig.sharps * 10 + 4;
    }
    if (keySig.flats > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ccccee';
      ctx.font = 'bold 14px serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      var fli;
      for (fli = 0; fli < keySig.flats; fli++) {
        var flatPos = KEY_FLAT_POSITIONS[fli];
        var flatY = staffTopMargin + 4 * lineSpacing - flatPos * (lineSpacing / 2);
        ctx.fillText('\u266D', keySigStartX + fli * 10, flatY);
      }
      keySigWidth = keySig.flats * 10 + 4;
    }

    // Draw time signature
    var timeSigX = keySigStartX + keySigWidth + 10;
    var timeParts = Array.isArray(melodyTime) ? melodyTime : melodyTime.split('/');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ccccee';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(timeParts[0], timeSigX, staffTopMargin + 1 * lineSpacing);
    ctx.fillText(timeParts[1], timeSigX, staffTopMargin + 3 * lineSpacing);

    var noteAreaStart = timeSigX + 20;
    var noteAreaWidth = W - noteAreaStart - 20;

    if (notes.length === 0) {
      if (isCustom && _notationInputMode) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#666688';
        ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText('Click on the staff to place notes', W / 2, staffTopMargin + 2 * lineSpacing);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Calculate measure positions
    var beatsPerBar = _beatsPerMeasure(melodyTime);
    var beatUnitVal = _beatUnit(melodyTime);

    var totalBeats = 0;
    var ni;
    for (ni = 0; ni < notes.length; ni++) {
      totalBeats += _noteDurationInBeats(notes[ni].d, beatUnitVal);
    }

    var pixelsPerBeat = noteAreaWidth / Math.max(totalBeats, 1);
    if (pixelsPerBeat < 15) { pixelsPerBeat = 15; }

    var currentBeat = 0;
    var currentX = noteAreaStart;
    var drawnFirstBarLine = false;

    for (ni = 0; ni < notes.length; ni++) {
      var note = notes[ni];
      var dur = note.d;
      var midi = note.m;
      var beatDur = _noteDurationInBeats(dur, beatUnitVal);

      // Bar line check
      if (currentBeat > 0 && Math.abs(currentBeat - Math.round(currentBeat / beatsPerBar) * beatsPerBar) < 0.01) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a5a7a';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(currentX - 4, staffTopMargin);
        ctx.lineTo(currentX - 4, staffTopMargin + 4 * lineSpacing);
        ctx.stroke();
        currentX += 6;
      }
      if (!drawnFirstBarLine && ni === 0) {
        drawnFirstBarLine = true;
      }

      var noteWidth = beatDur * pixelsPerBeat;
      var x = currentX + noteWidth / 2;

      if (midi === 0) {
        _drawRest(ctx, x, staffTopMargin, lineSpacing, dur);
      } else {
        var noteY = _staffYForMidiNotation(midi, staffTopMargin, lineSpacing);

        // Ledger lines
        var bottomLineY = staffTopMargin + 4 * lineSpacing;
        var topLineY = staffTopMargin;
        if (noteY > bottomLineY) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a6a';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          var ledgerY = bottomLineY + lineSpacing;
          while (ledgerY <= noteY + 1) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x - NR - 5, ledgerY);
            ctx.lineTo(x + NR + 5, ledgerY);
            ctx.stroke();
            ledgerY += lineSpacing;
          }
        }
        if (noteY < topLineY) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a6a';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          var ledgerYTop = topLineY - lineSpacing;
          while (ledgerYTop >= noteY - 1) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x - NR - 5, ledgerYTop);
            ctx.lineTo(x + NR + 5, ledgerYTop);
            ctx.stroke();
            ledgerYTop -= lineSpacing;
          }
        }

        // Accidental
        var accidental = _noteNeedsAccidental(midi, melodyKey);
        if (accidental) {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ccccee';
          ctx.font = 'bold 13px serif';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          if (accidental === '#') {
            ctx.fillText('\u266F', x - NR - 9, noteY);
          } else {
            ctx.fillText('\u266D', x - NR - 9, noteY);
          }
        }

        // Note head
        var isHighlighted = (ni === _notationHighlightIdx);
        var noteColor = isHighlighted ? '#ff6644' : '#6a6aff';

        if (dur <= DUR_HALF) {
          // Hollow note head (whole/half)
          ctx.strokeStyle = noteColor;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(x, noteY, NR, NR * 0.7, -0.2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
          ctx.stroke();
          if (isHighlighted) {
            ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6644';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          }
        } else {
          // Filled note head
          ctx.fillStyle = noteColor;
          if (isHighlighted) {
            ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6644';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
          }
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(x, noteY, NR, NR * 0.7, -0.2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }

        // Stem (not for whole notes)
        if (dur >= DUR_HALF) {
          var stemUp = noteY > staffTopMargin + 2 * lineSpacing;
          ctx.strokeStyle = noteColor;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          if (stemUp) {
            ctx.moveTo(x + NR - 1, noteY);
            ctx.lineTo(x + NR - 1, noteY - 35);
          } else {
            ctx.moveTo(x - NR + 1, noteY);
            ctx.lineTo(x - NR + 1, noteY + 35);
          }
          ctx.stroke();

          // Flags for eighth notes
          if (dur === DUR_EIGHTH) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = noteColor;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            if (stemUp) {
              var stemTopX = x + NR - 1;
              var stemTopY = noteY - 35;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(stemTopX, stemTopY);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(stemTopX + 12, stemTopY + 8, stemTopX + 6, stemTopY + 18);
              ctx.stroke();
            } else {
              var stemBotX = x - NR + 1;
              var stemBotY = noteY + 35;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(stemBotX, stemBotY);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(stemBotX - 12, stemBotY - 8, stemBotX - 6, stemBotY - 18);
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
          // Flags for sixteenth notes
          if (dur === DUR_SIXTEENTH) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = noteColor;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            if (stemUp) {
              var stX16 = x + NR - 1;
              var stY16 = noteY - 35;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(stX16, stY16);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(stX16 + 12, stY16 + 8, stX16 + 6, stY16 + 18);
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(stX16, stY16 + 8);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(stX16 + 12, stY16 + 16, stX16 + 6, stY16 + 26);
              ctx.stroke();
            } else {
              var stX16d = x - NR + 1;
              var stY16d = noteY + 35;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(stX16d, stY16d);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(stX16d - 12, stY16d - 8, stX16d - 6, stY16d - 18);
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(stX16d, stY16d - 8);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(stX16d - 12, stY16d - 16, stX16d - 6, stY16d - 26);
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
        }
      }

      currentBeat += beatDur;
      currentX += noteWidth;
    }

    // Double bar line at end
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a5a7a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(currentX + 6, staffTopMargin);
    ctx.lineTo(currentX + 6, staffTopMargin + 4 * lineSpacing);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(currentX + 10, staffTopMargin);
    ctx.lineTo(currentX + 10, staffTopMargin + 4 * lineSpacing);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Cursor note preview in input mode
    if (isCustom && _notationInputMode && _notationMouseY >= 0) {
      var cursorSnappedY = Math.round((_notationMouseY - staffTopMargin) / (lineSpacing / 2)) * (lineSpacing / 2) + staffTopMargin;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff44';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(_notationMouseX, cursorSnappedY, NR, NR * 0.7, -0.2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
    }

    // Update note names display
    var namesEl = document.getElementById('learn-notation-names');
    if (namesEl) {
      var nameParts = [];
      for (var nn = 0; nn < notes.length; nn++) {
        if (notes[nn].m === 0) {
          var cls2 = (nn === _notationHighlightIdx) ? 'style="color:#ff6644;font-weight:700"' : 'style="color:#666688"';
          nameParts.push('<span ' + cls2 + '>rest</span>');
        } else {
          var cls3 = (nn === _notationHighlightIdx) ? 'style="color:#ff6644;font-weight:700"' : '';
          nameParts.push('<span ' + cls3 + '>' + _midiNoteName(notes[nn].m) + '</span>');
        }
      }
      namesEl.innerHTML = nameParts.join(' ');
    }
  }

  function _buildNotationMiniKeyboard() {
    _buildLearnPianoKeyboard('learn-notation-mini-kb', 'data-notation-midi', 48, 84);
  }

  // Shared piano keyboard builder for notation & sight-reading
  // Renders a real piano layout with black keys overlapping white keys
  function _buildLearnPianoKeyboard(containerId, dataAttr, startMidi, endMidi) {
    var kbEl = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!kbEl) {
      return;
    }
    kbEl.innerHTML = '';
    kbEl.className = kbEl.className.replace(/\blearn-piano-kb\b/, '') + ' learn-piano-kb';

    var BLACK_PC = { 1: true, 3: true, 6: true, 8: true, 10: true };

    // Count white keys to calculate proportional sizing
    var whiteCount = 0;
    var midi;
    for (midi = startMidi; midi < endMidi; midi++) {
      if (!BLACK_PC[midi % 12]) {
        whiteCount++;
      }
    }

    // Size keys to fill container width (no scrollbar)
    var containerWidth = kbEl.parentElement ? kbEl.parentElement.clientWidth : 700;
    if (containerWidth < 200) {
      containerWidth = 700;
    }
    var WK_W = Math.floor((containerWidth - whiteCount) / whiteCount);
    if (WK_W < 24) { WK_W = 24; }
    if (WK_W > 60) { WK_W = 60; }
    var WK_H = Math.round(WK_W * 3.2);
    if (WK_H > 180) { WK_H = 180; }
    if (WK_H < 70) { WK_H = 70; }
    var BK_W = Math.round(WK_W * 0.65);
    var BK_H = Math.round(WK_H * 0.62);

    kbEl.style.width = (whiteCount * (WK_W + 1)) + 'px';
    kbEl.style.height = WK_H + 'px';
    kbEl.style.position = 'relative';

    // Draw white keys first
    var wx = 0;
    for (midi = startMidi; midi < endMidi; midi++) {
      var pc = midi % 12;
      if (!BLACK_PC[pc]) {
        var wkey = document.createElement('div');
        wkey.className = 'learn-piano-white pc-' + pc;
        wkey.setAttribute(dataAttr, midi);
        wkey.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:' + wx + 'px;top:0;width:' + WK_W + 'px;height:' + WK_H + 'px;';
        // Label on C notes
        if (pc === 0) {
          var oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
          wkey.textContent = 'C' + oct;
        }
        kbEl.appendChild(wkey);
        wx += WK_W + 1;
      }
    }

    // Draw black keys on top
    wx = 0;
    for (midi = startMidi; midi < endMidi; midi++) {
      var pc2 = midi % 12;
      if (!BLACK_PC[pc2]) {
        wx += WK_W + 1;
      } else {
        var bx = wx - Math.floor(BK_W / 2) - 1;
        var bkey = document.createElement('div');
        bkey.className = 'learn-piano-black pc-' + pc2;
        bkey.setAttribute(dataAttr, midi);
        bkey.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:' + bx + 'px;top:0;width:' + BK_W + 'px;height:' + BK_H + 'px;z-index:2;';
        kbEl.appendChild(bkey);
      }
    }
  }

  function _setupNotationListeners() {
    var melSel = document.getElementById('learn-notation-melody');
    if (melSel) {
      melSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
        _notationMelodyIdx = parseInt(melSel.value, 10);
        _notationHighlightIdx = -1;
        _drawNotationStaff();
      });
    }

    // Tempo slider
    var tempoSlider = document.getElementById('learn-notation-tempo');
    var bpmLabel = document.getElementById('learn-notation-bpm');
    if (tempoSlider) {
      tempoSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
        _notationBpm = parseInt(tempoSlider.value, 10);
        if (bpmLabel) {
          bpmLabel.textContent = _notationBpm + ' BPM';
        }
      });
    }

    // Input mode toggle
    var inputToggle = document.getElementById('learn-notation-input-toggle');
    if (inputToggle) {
      inputToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _notationInputMode = !_notationInputMode;
        inputToggle.textContent = 'Input Mode: ' + (_notationInputMode ? 'ON' : 'OFF');
        if (_notationInputMode) {
          inputToggle.style.background = '#446644';
          // Switch to custom melody if not already
          var customIdx = NOTATION_MELODIES.length - 1;
          if (_notationMelodyIdx !== customIdx) {
            _notationMelodyIdx = customIdx;
            var msel = document.getElementById('learn-notation-melody');
            if (msel) { msel.value = String(customIdx); }
          }
        } else {
          inputToggle.style.background = '';
        }
        _drawNotationStaff();
      });
    }

    // Play All button
    var playAllBtn = document.getElementById('learn-notation-play-all');
    if (playAllBtn) {
      playAllBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var melody = NOTATION_MELODIES[_notationMelodyIdx];
        if (!melody) {
          return;
        }
        var isCustom = (_notationMelodyIdx === NOTATION_MELODIES.length - 1);
        var notes = isCustom ? _notationCustomNotes : melody.notes;
        if (notes.length === 0) {
          return;
        }
        var melodyTime = melody.time || '4/4';
        var beatUnitVal = _beatUnit(melodyTime);
        var msPerBeat = 60000 / _notationBpm;

        var cumulativeMs = 0;
        for (var pn = 0; pn < notes.length; pn++) {
          (function(idx, noteObj, startMs) {
            var noteDurBeats = _noteDurationInBeats(noteObj.d, beatUnitVal);
            var noteDurSec = (noteDurBeats * msPerBeat) / 1000;
            _trackTimer(setTimeout(function() {
              _notationHighlightIdx = idx;
              _drawNotationStaff();
              if (noteObj.m > 0) {
                _playNote(noteObj.m, noteDurSec * 0.9);
              }
            }, startMs));
          })(pn, notes[pn], cumulativeMs);
          var bd = _noteDurationInBeats(notes[pn].d, beatUnitVal);
          cumulativeMs += bd * msPerBeat;
        }
        _trackTimer(setTimeout(function() {
          _notationHighlightIdx = -1;
          _drawNotationStaff();
        }, cumulativeMs + 300));
      });
    }

    // Staff canvas click
    var staffCanvas = document.getElementById('learn-notation-canvas');
    if (staffCanvas) {
      staffCanvas.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var rect = staffCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        var clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
        var clickY = e.clientY - rect.top;
        var isCustom = (_notationMelodyIdx === NOTATION_MELODIES.length - 1);

        if (isCustom && _notationInputMode) {
          // Input mode: add a note at clicked position
          var staffTopMargin = 50;
          var lineSp = 14;
          var snappedHalf = Math.round((clickY - staffTopMargin) / (lineSp / 2));
          var posFromBottom = 4 * 2 - snappedHalf;
          var stepsFromC4 = posFromBottom - 2;
          var stepToPC = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
          var octOffset = Math.floor(stepsFromC4 / 7);
          var stepInOct = ((stepsFromC4 % 7) + 7) % 7;
          var midiVal = 60 + octOffset * 12 + stepToPC[stepInOct];
          if (midiVal >= 36 && midiVal <= 96) {
            _notationCustomNotes.push({m: midiVal, d: DUR_QUARTER});
            _playNote(midiVal, 0.4);
            _drawNotationStaff();
          }
        } else {
          // Normal mode: click to play a note
          var melody = NOTATION_MELODIES[_notationMelodyIdx];
          if (!melody) {
            return;
          }
          var notes = isCustom ? _notationCustomNotes : melody.notes;
          if (notes.length === 0) {
            return;
          }
          var melodyTime = melody.time || '4/4';
          var beatUnitVal = _beatUnit(melodyTime);
          var noteAreaStart = NOTATION_LEFT_MARGIN + 30;
          var totalBeats = 0;
          var bi;
          for (bi = 0; bi < notes.length; bi++) {
            totalBeats += _noteDurationInBeats(notes[bi].d, beatUnitVal);
          }
          var pixPerBeat = (NOTATION_STAFF_WIDTH - noteAreaStart - 20) / Math.max(totalBeats, 1);
          if (pixPerBeat < 15) { pixPerBeat = 15; }
          var cumulX = noteAreaStart;
          var clickedIdx = -1;
          for (bi = 0; bi < notes.length; bi++) {
            var bDur = _noteDurationInBeats(notes[bi].d, beatUnitVal) * pixPerBeat;
            if (clickX >= cumulX && clickX < cumulX + bDur) {
              clickedIdx = bi;
              break;
            }
            cumulX += bDur;
          }
          if (clickedIdx >= 0) {
            _notationHighlightIdx = clickedIdx;
            _drawNotationStaff();
            if (notes[clickedIdx].m > 0) {
              _playNote(notes[clickedIdx].m, 0.5);
            }
          }
        }
      });

      // Right-click to remove last note in input mode
      staffCanvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) {
        var isCustom = (_notationMelodyIdx === NOTATION_MELODIES.length - 1);
        if (isCustom && _notationInputMode && _notationCustomNotes.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          _notationCustomNotes.pop();
          _drawNotationStaff();
        }
      });

      // Mouse move for cursor preview
      staffCanvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
        var isCustom = (_notationMelodyIdx === NOTATION_MELODIES.length - 1);
        if (isCustom && _notationInputMode) {
          var rect = staffCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
          _notationMouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
          _notationMouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;
          _drawNotationStaff();
        }
      });

      staffCanvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        _notationMouseX = -1;
        _notationMouseY = -1;
        var isCustom = (_notationMelodyIdx === NOTATION_MELODIES.length - 1);
        if (isCustom && _notationInputMode) {
          _drawNotationStaff();
        }
      });
    }

    // Mini keyboard clicks
    var kbEl = document.getElementById('learn-notation-mini-kb');
    if (kbEl) {
      kbEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var target = e.target;
        if (target.hasAttribute('data-notation-midi')) {
          var midi = parseInt(target.getAttribute('data-notation-midi'), 10);
          _playNote(midi, 0.4);
          var isCustom = (_notationMelodyIdx === NOTATION_MELODIES.length - 1);
          if (isCustom && _notationInputMode) {
            _notationCustomNotes.push({m: midi, d: DUR_QUARTER});
            _drawNotationStaff();
          } else {
            // Find this note in current melody and highlight
            var melody = NOTATION_MELODIES[_notationMelodyIdx];
            if (melody) {
              var notes = isCustom ? _notationCustomNotes : melody.notes;
              var foundIdx = -1;
              var fi;
              for (fi = 0; fi < notes.length; fi++) {
                if (notes[fi].m === midi && fi !== _notationHighlightIdx) {
                  foundIdx = fi;
                  break;
                }
              }
              if (foundIdx < 0) {
                for (fi = 0; fi < notes.length; fi++) {
                  if (notes[fi].m === midi) {
                    foundIdx = fi;
                    break;
                  }
                }
              }
              if (foundIdx >= 0) {
                _notationHighlightIdx = foundIdx;
                _drawNotationStaff();
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  function _srGenerateSequence() {
    // Stop any ongoing playback
    _srStopPlayback();

    var pool;
    var defaultLen;
    if (_srDifficulty === 'easy') {
      pool = SR_EASY_NOTES;
      defaultLen = 4;
    } else if (_srDifficulty === 'medium') {
      pool = SR_MEDIUM_NOTES;
      defaultLen = 6;
    } else {
      pool = SR_HARD_NOTES;
      defaultLen = 8;
    }
    var seqLen = (_srSeqLength > 0) ? _srSeqLength : defaultLen;

    _srSequence = [];
    for (var s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
      var idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length);
      _srSequence.push(pool[idx]);
    }
    _srPlayed = [];
    _srActive = true;
    _drawSightReadStaff();

    var feedbackEl = document.getElementById('learn-sr-feedback');
    if (feedbackEl) {
      feedbackEl.textContent = 'Play the notes on the keyboard below (0/' + _srSequence.length + ')';
      feedbackEl.style.color = '#aaaacc';
    }
  }

  function _drawSightReadStaff() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('learn-sr-canvas');
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, STAFF_WIDTH, STAFF_HEIGHT);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, STAFF_WIDTH, STAFF_HEIGHT);

    // Staff lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a6a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (var line = 0; line < 5; line++) {
      var y = STAFF_TOP_MARGIN + line * STAFF_LINE_SPACING;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(STAFF_LEFT_MARGIN - 10, y);
      ctx.lineTo(STAFF_WIDTH - 10, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Treble clef glyph
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaadd';
    ctx.font = '42px serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('\uD834\uDD1E', STAFF_LEFT_MARGIN - 45, STAFF_TOP_MARGIN + 2 * STAFF_LINE_SPACING - 2);

    if (_srSequence.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    var noteSpacing = (STAFF_WIDTH - STAFF_LEFT_MARGIN - 30) / Math.max(_srSequence.length, 1);

    for (var ni = 0; ni < _srSequence.length; ni++) {
      var midi = _srSequence[ni];
      var x = STAFF_LEFT_MARGIN + ni * noteSpacing + noteSpacing / 2;
      var noteY = _staffYForMidi(midi);

      // Ledger lines below staff
      var bottomLineY = STAFF_TOP_MARGIN + 4 * STAFF_LINE_SPACING;
      var topLineY = STAFF_TOP_MARGIN;
      if (noteY > bottomLineY) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a6a';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        var ledgerY = bottomLineY + STAFF_LINE_SPACING;
        while (ledgerY <= noteY + 1) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x - NOTE_RADIUS - 4, ledgerY);
          ctx.lineTo(x + NOTE_RADIUS + 4, ledgerY);
          ctx.stroke();
          ledgerY += STAFF_LINE_SPACING;
        }
      }
      // Ledger lines above staff
      if (noteY < topLineY) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a6a';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        var ledgerYTop = topLineY - STAFF_LINE_SPACING;
        while (ledgerYTop >= noteY - 1) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x - NOTE_RADIUS - 4, ledgerYTop);
          ctx.lineTo(x + NOTE_RADIUS + 4, ledgerYTop);
          ctx.stroke();
          ledgerYTop -= STAFF_LINE_SPACING;
        }
      }

      // Accidental
      var accidental = _noteNeedsAccidental(midi, 'C');
      if (accidental) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ccccee';
        ctx.font = 'bold 13px serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        if (accidental === '#') {
          ctx.fillText('\u266F', x - NOTE_RADIUS - 9, noteY);
        } else {
          ctx.fillText('\u266D', x - NOTE_RADIUS - 9, noteY);
        }
      }

      // Determine color
      var color = '#6a6aff';
      if (ni === _srPlayingIdx) {
        color = '#ffcc44';
      } else if (ni < _srPlayed.length) {
        if (_srPlayed[ni] === _srSequence[ni]) {
          color = '#44cc44';
        } else {
          color = '#ff4444';
        }
      }

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, noteY, NOTE_RADIUS, NOTE_RADIUS * 0.8, 0, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.fill();

      // Stem
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (noteY > STAFF_TOP_MARGIN + 2 * STAFF_LINE_SPACING) {
        ctx.moveTo(x + NOTE_RADIUS, noteY);
        ctx.lineTo(x + NOTE_RADIUS, noteY - 30);
      } else {
        ctx.moveTo(x - NOTE_RADIUS, noteY);
        ctx.lineTo(x - NOTE_RADIUS, noteY + 30);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function _srStopPlayback() {
    var ti;
    for (ti = 0; ti < _srPlayTimers.length; ti++) {
      clearTimeout(_srPlayTimers[ti]);
    }
    _srPlayTimers = [];
    _srPlayingIdx = -1;
    var stopBtn = document.getElementById('learn-sr-stop');
    if (stopBtn) {
      stopBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('learn-sr-play');
    if (playBtn) {
      playBtn.style.display = '';
    }
    _drawSightReadStaff();
  }

  function _srPlaySequence() {
    if (_srSequence.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    _srStopPlayback();

    var playBtn = document.getElementById('learn-sr-play');
    if (playBtn) {
      playBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
    var stopBtn = document.getElementById('learn-sr-stop');
    if (stopBtn) {
      stopBtn.style.display = '';
    }

    var SR_PLAY_INTERVAL = 400;
    var si;
    for (si = 0; si < _srSequence.length; si++) {
      (function(idx) {
        var timerId = setTimeout(function() {
          _srPlayingIdx = idx;
          _playNote(_srSequence[idx], 0.3);
          _drawSightReadStaff();
        }, idx * SR_PLAY_INTERVAL);
        _srPlayTimers.push(timerId);
      })(si);
    }
    // Final timer to clear highlight
    var endTimer = setTimeout(function() {
      _srPlayingIdx = -1;
      _drawSightReadStaff();
      var stopBtnEnd = document.getElementById('learn-sr-stop');
      if (stopBtnEnd) {
        stopBtnEnd.style.display = 'none';
      }
      var playBtnEnd = document.getElementById('learn-sr-play');
      if (playBtnEnd) {
        playBtnEnd.style.display = '';
      }
    }, _srSequence.length * SR_PLAY_INTERVAL);
    _srPlayTimers.push(endTimer);
  }

  function _srHandleNoteInput(midi) {
    if (!_srActive || _srPlayed.length >= _srSequence.length) {
      return;
    }

    var expectedIdx = _srPlayed.length;
    _srPlayed.push(midi);
    _srTotal++;

    if (midi === _srSequence[expectedIdx]) {
      _srScore++;
    }

    _drawSightReadStaff();

    // Update score display
    var scoreEl = document.getElementById('learn-sr-score');
    if (scoreEl) {
      scoreEl.textContent = _srScore;
    }
    var totalEl = document.getElementById('learn-sr-total');
    if (totalEl) {
      totalEl.textContent = _srTotal;
    }

    var feedbackEl = document.getElementById('learn-sr-feedback');
    if (_srPlayed.length >= _srSequence.length) {
      _srActive = false;
      var correct = 0;
      for (var c = 0; c < _srSequence.length; c++) {
        if (_srPlayed[c] === _srSequence[c]) {
          correct++;
        }
      }
      if (feedbackEl) {
        feedbackEl.textContent = 'Done! ' + correct + '/' + _srSequence.length + ' correct';
        feedbackEl.style.color = (correct === _srSequence.length) ? '#66ff66' : '#ffaa44';
      }
    } else {
      if (feedbackEl) {
        feedbackEl.textContent = 'Play the notes (' + _srPlayed.length + '/' + _srSequence.length + ')';
      }
    }
  }

  function _drawPhysicsWaveInterference() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('learn-phys-wave-canvas');
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Center line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222244';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(w, h / 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    var samplesPerPixel = 2;
    var totalSamples = w * samplesPerPixel;
    var timeScale = 0.005;

    // Wave 1 (blue)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4466cc';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var i = 0; i < w; i++) {
      var t = i * timeScale;
      var y1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * _physFreq1 * t);
      var py = h / 2 - y1 * (h / 4);
      if (i === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(i, py);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(i, py);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Wave 2 (red)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cc4466';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var j = 0; j < w; j++) {
      var t2 = j * timeScale;
      var y2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * _physFreq2 * t2);
      var py2 = h / 2 - y2 * (h / 4);
      if (j === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(j, py2);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(j, py2);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Combined wave (white)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e0e0ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var k = 0; k < w; k++) {
      var t3 = k * timeScale;
      var combined = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * _physFreq1 * t3) + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * _physFreq2 * t3);
      var py3 = h / 2 - combined * (h / 6);
      if (k === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(k, py3);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(k, py3);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function _drawStandingWave() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('learn-phys-standing-canvas');
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Center line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222244';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(w, h / 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Standing wave: sin(n*pi*x/L)
    var n = _physHarmonic;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#44cc88';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      var xNorm = x / w;
      var amp = Math.sin(n * Math.PI * xNorm);
      var py = h / 2 - amp * (h / 3);
      if (x === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, py);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, py);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Mark nodes (where amplitude = 0)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6644';
    for (var nd = 0; nd <= n; nd++) {
      var nodeX = (nd / n) * w;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(nodeX, h / 2, 4, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
    ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Harmonic ' + n + ': ' + n + ' nodes', 10, h - 8);
  }

  function _drawFourierDecomposition() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('learn-phys-fourier-canvas');
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Center line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222244';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(w, h / 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Build square wave approximation from partials
    var numPartials = _physPartials;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e0e0ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();

    for (var x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      var t = (x / w) * 4 * Math.PI; // 2 full cycles
      var sum = 0;
      for (var p = 0; p < numPartials; p++) {
        var harmonicNum = 2 * p + 1; // odd harmonics for square wave
        sum += Math.sin(harmonicNum * t) / harmonicNum;
      }
      sum *= (4 / Math.PI); // normalize amplitude
      var py = h / 2 - sum * (h / 3);
      if (x === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, py);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, py);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Draw individual partials faintly
    for (var pp = 0; pp < numPartials && pp < 6; pp++) {
      var hNum = 2 * pp + 1;
      var hue = (pp * 50) % 360;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + hue + ', 60%, 50%, 0.3)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var xi = 0; xi < w; xi++) {
        var ti = (xi / w) * 4 * Math.PI;
        var val = Math.sin(hNum * ti) / hNum * (4 / Math.PI);
        var pyi = h / 2 - val * (h / 3);
        if (xi === 0) {
          ctx.moveTo(xi, pyi);
        } else {
          ctx.lineTo(xi, pyi);
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
    ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(numPartials + ' partials -> square wave', 10, h - 8);
  }

  // ---- Section 4: What Shape Sounds Like ----

  var WAVEFORM_SHAPES = [
    { type: 'sine',     label: 'Smooth',  color: '#4488ff' },
    { type: 'square',   label: 'Buzzy',   color: '#ff4488' },
    { type: 'sawtooth', label: 'Bright',  color: '#ffaa22' },
    { type: 'triangle', label: 'Mellow',  color: '#44dd88' }
  ];

  function _drawWaveformShapes() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('phys-waveforms-canvas');
    if (!canvas) { return; }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    var slotW = w / 4;
    var pad = 8;

    for (var s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
      var shape = WAVEFORM_SHAPES[s];
      var x0 = s * slotW + pad;
      var xEnd = (s + 1) * slotW - pad;
      var segW = xEnd - x0;

      // Center line
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#222244';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x0, h / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(xEnd, h / 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Waveform
      ctx.strokeStyle = shape.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var px = 0; px <= segW; px++) {
        var phase = (px / segW) * 2 * Math.PI;
        var val = 0;
        if (shape.type === 'sine') {
          val = Math.sin(phase);
        } else if (shape.type === 'square') {
          val = phase < Math.PI ? 1 : -1;
        } else if (shape.type === 'sawtooth') {
          val = 1 - (2 * phase / (2 * Math.PI));
        } else if (shape.type === 'triangle') {
          val = phase < Math.PI ? (-1 + 2 * phase / Math.PI) : (3 - 2 * phase / Math.PI);
        }
        var py = h / 2 - val * (h / 3);
        if (px === 0) { ctx.moveTo(x0 + px, py); }
        else { ctx.lineTo(x0 + px, py); }
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      // Label
      ctx.fillStyle = shape.color;
      ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(shape.label, x0 + segW / 2, h - 6);
    }
  }

  function _drawBeatsCanvas() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('phys-beats-canvas');
    if (!canvas) { return; }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Center line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222244';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(w, h / 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    var fA = _physBeatsFreqA;
    var fB = _physBeatsFreqB;
    var timeScale = 0.005;

    // Combined wave
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e0e0ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      var t = x * timeScale;
      var combined = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * fA * t) + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * fB * t);
      var py = h / 2 - combined * (h / 6);
      if (x === 0) { ctx.moveTo(x, py); }
      else { ctx.lineTo(x, py); }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Beat envelope (dashed)
    var beatFreq = Math.abs(fA - fB);
    if (beatFreq > 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff6644';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var bx = 0; bx < w; bx++) {
        var bt = bx * timeScale;
        var env = 2 * Math.abs(Math.cos(Math.PI * beatFreq * bt));
        var epy = h / 2 - env * (h / 6);
        if (bx === 0) { ctx.moveTo(bx, epy); }
        else { ctx.lineTo(bx, epy); }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      // Negative envelope
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var bx2 = 0; bx2 < w; bx2++) {
        var bt2 = bx2 * timeScale;
        var env2 = 2 * Math.abs(Math.cos(Math.PI * beatFreq * bt2));
        var epy2 = h / 2 + env2 * (h / 6);
        if (bx2 === 0) { ctx.moveTo(bx2, epy2); }
        else { ctx.lineTo(bx2, epy2); }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }
  }

  // ---- Section 6: Resonance ----

  var RESONANCE_NATURAL_FREQ = 1.5;
  var RESONANCE_DAMPING = 0.05;
  var RESONANCE_SPRING_REST_Y = 60;
  var RESONANCE_SPRING_MAX_AMP = 50;

  function _drawResonanceCanvas() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('phys-resonance-canvas');
    if (!canvas) { return; }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // --- Top half: spring + ball ---
    var springTop = 10;
    var ballY = RESONANCE_SPRING_REST_Y + _physResonanceAmplitude;
    var ballRadius = 14;

    // Spring (zigzag)
    var coils = 8;
    var springH = ballY - springTop - ballRadius;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6a6aff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(w / 4, springTop);
    for (var c = 0; c < coils; c++) {
      var cy1 = springTop + (c + 0.25) * springH / coils;
      var cy2 = springTop + (c + 0.75) * springH / coils;
      var xOff = 12;
      ctx.lineTo(w / 4 + (c % 2 === 0 ? xOff : -xOff), cy1);
      ctx.lineTo(w / 4 + (c % 2 === 0 ? -xOff : xOff), cy2);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(w / 4, ballY - ballRadius);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Ball
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6644';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(w / 4, ballY, ballRadius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();

    // Anchor
    ctx.fillStyle = '#555577';
    ctx.fillRect(w / 4 - 20, springTop - 4, 40, 4);

    // --- Bottom half: resonance curve ---
    var curveTop = 120;
    var curveH = h - curveTop - 20;
    var curveLeft = 50;
    var curveW = w - 80;

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333355';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(curveLeft, curveTop);
    ctx.lineTo(curveLeft, curveTop + curveH);
    ctx.lineTo(curveLeft + curveW, curveTop + curveH);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Axis labels
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Push Frequency (Hz)', curveLeft + curveW / 2, h - 2);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(12, curveTop + curveH / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillText('Amplitude', 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    // Frequency ticks
    var freqMin = 0.5;
    var freqMax = 3.0;
    for (var ft = 5; ft <= 30; ft += 5) {
      var freq = ft / 10;
      var tx = curveLeft + ((freq - freqMin) / (freqMax - freqMin)) * curveW;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#555577';
      ctx.fillText(freq.toFixed(1), tx, curveTop + curveH + 12);
    }

    // Resonance curve: amplitude = 1 / sqrt((1 - (f/f0)^2)^2 + (2*zeta*f/f0)^2)
    var zeta = RESONANCE_DAMPING;
    var f0 = RESONANCE_NATURAL_FREQ;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#44cc88';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    var maxAmpOnCurve = 0;
    // Pre-compute max for scaling
    for (var fi = 0; fi <= 100; fi++) {
      var ff = freqMin + (fi / 100) * (freqMax - freqMin);
      var ratio = ff / f0;
      var denom = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(1 - ratio * ratio, 2) + Math.pow(2 * zeta * ratio, 2));
      var amp = 1 / denom;
      if (amp > maxAmpOnCurve) { maxAmpOnCurve = amp; }
    }
    for (var fi2 = 0; fi2 <= 200; fi2++) {
      var ff2 = freqMin + (fi2 / 200) * (freqMax - freqMin);
      var ratio2 = ff2 / f0;
      var denom2 = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(1 - ratio2 * ratio2, 2) + Math.pow(2 * zeta * ratio2, 2));
      var amp2 = (1 / denom2) / maxAmpOnCurve;
      var cx = curveLeft + (fi2 / 200) * curveW;
      var cy = curveTop + curveH - amp2 * curveH * 0.9;
      if (fi2 === 0) { ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); }
      else { ctx.lineTo(cx, cy); }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Current push freq marker
    var markerX = curveLeft + ((_physResonancePushFreq - freqMin) / (freqMax - freqMin)) * curveW;
    var markerRatio = _physResonancePushFreq / f0;
    var markerDenom = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(1 - markerRatio * markerRatio, 2) + Math.pow(2 * zeta * markerRatio, 2));
    var markerAmp = (1 / markerDenom) / maxAmpOnCurve;
    var markerY = curveTop + curveH - markerAmp * curveH * 0.9;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6644';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(markerX, markerY, 5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();

    // "Natural freq" label
    var natX = curveLeft + ((f0 - freqMin) / (freqMax - freqMin)) * curveW;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff664488';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(natX, curveTop);
    ctx.lineTo(natX, curveTop + curveH);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6644';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('natural', natX, curveTop - 2);
  }

  function _startResonanceAnimation() {
    if (_physResonancePlaying) {
      _stopResonanceAnimation();
      return;
    }
    _physResonancePlaying = true;
    _physResonanceTime = 0;
    _physResonanceVelocity = 0;
    _physResonanceAmplitude = 0;

    var playBtn = document.getElementById('phys-resonance-play');
    if (playBtn) { playBtn.textContent = 'Stop'; }

    var lastTime = performance.now();
    function animStep(now) {
      if (!_physResonancePlaying) { return; }
      var dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
      if (dt > 0.1) { dt = 0.1; } // clamp
      lastTime = now;
      _physResonanceTime += dt;

      // Driven damped harmonic oscillator
      var omega0 = 2 * Math.PI * RESONANCE_NATURAL_FREQ;
      var omegaD = 2 * Math.PI * _physResonancePushFreq;
      var driving = RESONANCE_SPRING_MAX_AMP * Math.sin(omegaD * _physResonanceTime);
      var springForce = -omega0 * omega0 * _physResonanceAmplitude;
      var dampingForce = -2 * RESONANCE_DAMPING * omega0 * _physResonanceVelocity;
      var driveForce = omega0 * omega0 * (driving / RESONANCE_SPRING_MAX_AMP) * RESONANCE_SPRING_MAX_AMP;

      _physResonanceVelocity += (springForce + dampingForce + driveForce) * dt;
      _physResonanceAmplitude += _physResonanceVelocity * dt;

      // Clamp amplitude
      if (_physResonanceAmplitude > RESONANCE_SPRING_MAX_AMP) { _physResonanceAmplitude = RESONANCE_SPRING_MAX_AMP; }
      if (_physResonanceAmplitude < -RESONANCE_SPRING_MAX_AMP) { _physResonanceAmplitude = -RESONANCE_SPRING_MAX_AMP; }

      _drawResonanceCanvas();
      _physResonanceAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(animStep);
    }
    _physResonanceAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(animStep);

    // Auto-stop after 8 seconds
    _trackTimer(setTimeout(function() {
      _stopResonanceAnimation();
    }, 8000));
  }

  function _stopResonanceAnimation() {
    _physResonancePlaying = false;
    if (_physResonanceAnimId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(_physResonanceAnimId);
      _physResonanceAnimId = null;
    }
    _physResonanceAmplitude = 0;
    _drawResonanceCanvas();
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('phys-resonance-play');
    if (playBtn) { playBtn.textContent = 'Animate'; }
  }

  // ---- Section 7: How We Hear (Loudness) ----

  function _drawLoudnessCanvas() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('phys-loudness-canvas');
    if (!canvas) { return; }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    var left = 50;
    var right = w - 20;
    var top = 15;
    var bottom = h - 25;
    var plotW = right - left;
    var plotH = bottom - top;

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333355';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(left, top);
    ctx.lineTo(left, bottom);
    ctx.lineTo(right, bottom);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Log scale x-axis: 20Hz - 20kHz
    var freqMin = Math.log10(20);
    var freqMax = Math.log10(20000);

    // X-axis labels
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    var tickFreqs = [20, 100, 1000, 10000, 20000];
    var tickLabels = ['20', '100', '1k', '10k', '20k'];
    for (var tf = 0; tf < tickFreqs.length; tf++) {
      var tx = left + ((Math.log10(tickFreqs[tf]) - freqMin) / (freqMax - freqMin)) * plotW;
      ctx.fillText(tickLabels[tf], tx, bottom + 14);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a2e';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx, top);
      ctx.lineTo(tx, bottom);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Y-axis label
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(10, top + plotH / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Sensitivity', 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    // Simplified Fletcher-Munson curves (3 levels)
    var curves = [
      { label: 'Quiet',  color: '#4466cc', offset: 0 },
      { label: 'Medium', color: '#44cc88', offset: -0.15 },
      { label: 'Loud',   color: '#ffaa22', offset: -0.3 }
    ];

    for (var ci = 0; ci < curves.length; ci++) {
      var curve = curves[ci];
      ctx.strokeStyle = curve.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var px = 0; px <= plotW; px++) {
        var logF = freqMin + (px / plotW) * (freqMax - freqMin);
        var freq = Math.pow(10, logF);
        // Simplified equal-loudness contour shape
        // Dip at ~3.5kHz (most sensitive), rises at low and high extremes
        var normF = Math.log10(freq);
        var sensitivity = 0.5;
        // Low frequency rolloff
        sensitivity += 0.4 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((normF - 1.5) / 0.5, 2));
        // Peak sensitivity around 3-4kHz
        sensitivity -= 0.35 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((normF - 3.5) / 0.3, 2));
        // High frequency rolloff
        sensitivity += 0.25 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((normF - 4.3) / 0.3, 2));
        sensitivity += curve.offset;
        // Clamp
        if (sensitivity < 0) { sensitivity = 0; }
        if (sensitivity > 1) { sensitivity = 1; }
        var py = top + (sensitivity) * plotH;
        if (px === 0) { ctx.moveTo(left + px, py); }
        else { ctx.lineTo(left + px, py); }
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      // Legend
      var legendY = top + 12 + ci * 14;
      ctx.fillStyle = curve.color;
      ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText(curve.label, right - 60, legendY);
    }

    // Highlight zone 1-4kHz
    var x1k = left + ((Math.log10(1000) - freqMin) / (freqMax - freqMin)) * plotW;
    var x4k = left + ((Math.log10(4000) - freqMin) / (freqMax - freqMin)) * plotW;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100, 200, 100, 0.08)';
    ctx.fillRect(x1k, top, x4k - x1k, plotH);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#44cc88';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Most Sensitive', (x1k + x4k) / 2, bottom - 4);
  }

  // ---- Section 8: Harmonics (Secret Ingredients) ----

  function _drawHarmonicsCanvas() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('phys-harmonics-canvas');
    if (!canvas) { return; }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Center line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222244';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(w, h / 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    var numH = _physHarmonicsCount;
    var harmonicColors = ['#4488ff', '#ff4488', '#ffaa22', '#44dd88', '#aa44ff', '#ff8844', '#44aaff', '#dddd44'];

    // Draw individual harmonics faintly
    for (var hi = 0; hi < numH; hi++) {
      var harmNum = hi + 1;
      ctx.strokeStyle = harmonicColors[hi % harmonicColors.length];
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var x = 0; x < w; x++) {
        var t = (x / w) * 2 * Math.PI;
        var val = Math.sin(harmNum * t) / harmNum;
        var py = h / 2 - val * (h / 3);
        if (x === 0) { ctx.moveTo(x, py); }
        else { ctx.lineTo(x, py); }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;

    // Draw combined waveform
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e0e0ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var x2 = 0; x2 < w; x2++) {
      var t2 = (x2 / w) * 2 * Math.PI;
      var sum = 0;
      for (var hi2 = 0; hi2 < numH; hi2++) {
        sum += Math.sin((hi2 + 1) * t2) / (hi2 + 1);
      }
      var py2 = h / 2 - sum * (h / 3);
      if (x2 === 0) { ctx.moveTo(x2, py2); }
      else { ctx.lineTo(x2, py2); }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
    ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(numH + ' harmonic' + (numH > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' (all integer multiples)', 10, h - 6);
  }

  function _drawHarmonicsSpectrum() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('phys-harmonics-spectrum');
    if (!canvas) { return; }
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e0e1a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    var numH = _physHarmonicsCount;
    var maxBars = 8;
    var barW = 40;
    var gap = 10;
    var totalW = maxBars * (barW + gap) - gap;
    var startX = (w - totalW) / 2;
    var barMaxH = h - 25;
    var harmonicColors = ['#4488ff', '#ff4488', '#ffaa22', '#44dd88', '#aa44ff', '#ff8844', '#44aaff', '#dddd44'];

    for (var bi = 0; bi < maxBars; bi++) {
      var bx = startX + bi * (barW + gap);
      var amplitude = (bi < numH) ? 1.0 / (bi + 1) : 0;
      var barH = amplitude * barMaxH;

      if (bi < numH) {
        ctx.fillStyle = harmonicColors[bi % harmonicColors.length];
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#222244';
      }
      ctx.fillRect(bx, h - 14 - barH, barW, barH);

      // Label
      ctx.fillStyle = (bi < numH) ? '#c0c0e0' : '#444466';
      ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText((bi + 1) + 'x', bx + barW / 2, h - 2);
    }
  }

  function _startPhysicsAudio() {
    if (!SL.audio || !SL.audio.getCtx) {
      return;
    }
    var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (!ctx) {
      return;
    }

    _physOsc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
    _physOsc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
    _physGain = ctx.createGain();
    _physGain.gain.value = 0.15;

    _physOsc1.frequency.value = _physFreq1;
    _physOsc2.frequency.value = _physFreq2;
    _physOsc1.type = 'sine';
    _physOsc2.type = 'sine';

    _physOsc1.connect(_physGain);
    _physOsc2.connect(_physGain);
    _physGain.connect(ctx.destination);

    _physOsc1.start();
    _physOsc2.start();
    _physPlaying = true;

    // Live update animation
    _physAnimId = setInterval(function() {
      if (_physOsc1) {
        _physOsc1.frequency.value = _physFreq1;
      }
      if (_physOsc2) {
        _physOsc2.frequency.value = _physFreq2;
      }
    }, 50);
  }

  function _stopPhysicsAudio() {
    if (_physOsc1) {
      _physOsc1.stop();
      _physOsc1.disconnect();
      _physOsc1 = null;
    }
    if (_physOsc2) {
      _physOsc2.stop();
      _physOsc2.disconnect();
      _physOsc2 = null;
    }
    if (_physGain) {
      _physGain.disconnect();
      _physGain = null;
    }
    if (_physAnimId) {
      clearInterval(_physAnimId);
      _physAnimId = null;
    }
    _physPlaying = false;
    // Clean up new physics sections
    _stopShapeDemo();
    _stopBeatsDemo();
    _stopResonanceAnimation();
    _stopLoudnessDemo();
    _stopHarmonicsDemo();
  }

  function _playFourierDemo() {
    if (!SL.audio || !SL.audio.getCtx) {
      return;
    }
    var ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (!ctx) {
      return;
    }

    var baseFreq = 220;
    var gain = ctx.createGain();
    gain.gain.value = 0.1;
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);

    var oscillators = [];
    for (var p = 0; p < _physPartials; p++) {
      var harmonicNum = 2 * p + 1;
      var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = baseFreq * harmonicNum;
      var partialGain = ctx.createGain();
      partialGain.gain.value = 1.0 / harmonicNum;
      osc.connect(partialGain);
      partialGain.connect(gain);
      osc.start();
      oscillators.push({ osc: osc, gain: partialGain });
    }

    // Stop after 1.5 seconds
    _trackTimer(setTimeout(function() {
      for (var oi = 0; oi < oscillators.length; oi++) {
        oscillators[oi].osc.stop();
        oscillators[oi].osc.disconnect();
        oscillators[oi].gain.disconnect();
      }
      gain.disconnect();
    }, 1500));
  }

  function _stopProgression() {

  }

  function _playProgression(chords, bpm) {
    _stopProgression();
    var beatMs = 60000 / (bpm || 100);
    var idx = 0;
    function next() {
      if (idx >= chords.length) { return; }
      _playChord(chords[idx], beatMs / 1000);
      idx++;
      _progTimer = _trackTimer(setTimeout(next, beatMs));
    }
    next();
  }

  function _degreeToMidi(root, degree, quality) {
    // root = pitch class (0=C), degree = scale degree index (0-6 for diatonic)
    // negative degrees mean flat scale degrees: -2 = bVII (10 semitones), -3 = bVI (8 semitones)
    var baseMidi = _theoryRootMidi;
    var rootSemitone;
    if (degree < 0) {
      // flat degree: -2 = bVII = 10 semitones, -3 = bVI = 8 semitones
      if (degree === -2) {
        rootSemitone = 10; // bVII
      } else if (degree === -3) {
        rootSemitone = 8; // bVI
      } else {
        rootSemitone = 0;
      }
    } else {
      rootSemitone = MAJOR_SCALE[degree % 7];
    }
    var chordRoot = baseMidi + rootSemitone;
    var notes = [];
    if (quality === 'm') {
      notes = [chordRoot, chordRoot + 3, chordRoot + 7];
    } else if (quality === 'dim') {
      notes = [chordRoot, chordRoot + 3, chordRoot + 6];
    } else if (quality === '7') {
      notes = [chordRoot, chordRoot + 4, chordRoot + 7, chordRoot + 10];
    } else {
      // major
      notes = [chordRoot, chordRoot + 4, chordRoot + 7];
    }
    return notes;
  }

  function _getChordNameForDegree(root, degree, quality) {
    var rootSemitone;
    if (degree < 0) {
      if (degree === -2) { rootSemitone = 10; }
      else if (degree === -3) { rootSemitone = 8; }
      else { rootSemitone = 0; }
    } else {
      rootSemitone = MAJOR_SCALE[degree % 7];
    }
    var noteName = NOTE_NAMES[(root + rootSemitone) % 12];
    var suffix = '';
    if (quality === 'm') { suffix = 'm'; }
    else if (quality === 'dim') { suffix = 'dim'; }
    else if (quality === '7') { suffix = '7'; }
    return noteName + suffix;
  }

  function _getProgressionChordNames(prog, root) {
    var names = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < prog.chords.length; i++) {
      var ch = prog.chords[i];
      names.push(_getChordNameForDegree(root, ch.degree, ch.q));
    }
    return names.join(' - ');
  }

      descBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _playScale(true);
      });
    }

    var stopBtn = document.getElementById('learn-stop-scale');
    if (stopBtn) {
      stopBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _stopScale();
      });
    }
  }

  function _setupIntervalsListeners() {
    var note1Btn = document.getElementById('learn-int-note1');
    if (note1Btn) {
      note1Btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _playNote(_intervalNote1, 0.5);
      });
    }

    var note2Btn = document.getElementById('learn-int-note2');
    if (note2Btn) {
      note2Btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _playNote(_intervalNote2, 0.5);
      });
    }

    var playBothBtn = document.getElementById('learn-int-play-both');
    if (playBothBtn) {
      playBothBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _playTwoNotes(_intervalNote1, _intervalNote2, 400);
      });
    }

    // Reference table rows
    var refRows = document.querySelectorAll('[data-ref-interval]');
    for (var r = 0; r < refRows.length; r++) {
      (function(row) {
        row.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var semi = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ref-interval'), 10);
          _intervalNote2 = _intervalNote1 + semi;
          _playTwoNotes(_intervalNote1, _intervalNote2, 400);
          _updateIntervalDisplay();
        });
      })(refRows[r]);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Circle of Fifths
  // ============================================================

  function _drawCircleOfFifths() {
    _cofCanvas = document.getElementById('learn-cof-canvas');
    if (!_cofCanvas) {
      return;
    }
    _cofCtx = _cofCanvas.getContext('2d');
    var cx = COF_CANVAS_SIZE / 2;
    var cy = COF_CANVAS_SIZE / 2;
    var segmentAngle = (2 * Math.PI) / 12;
    var minorInnerR = 48; // inner boundary of minor ring
    var minorOuterR = COF_INNER_RADIUS; // outer boundary of minor ring = old inner radius

    _cofCtx.clearRect(0, 0, COF_CANVAS_SIZE, COF_CANVAS_SIZE);

    // Outer ring: major keys
    for (var i = 0; i < COF_KEYS.length; i++) {
      var startAngle = (i - 0.5) * segmentAngle - Math.PI / 2;
      var endAngle = startAngle + segmentAngle;
      var midAngle = (startAngle + endAngle) / 2;

      // Segment
      _cofCtx.beginPath();
      _cofCtx.arc(cx, cy, COF_OUTER_RADIUS, startAngle, endAngle);
      _cofCtx.arc(cx, cy, minorOuterR, endAngle, startAngle, true);
      _cofCtx.closePath();
      var hue = (i * 30) % 360;
      var isSelected = (i === _selectedCofKey);
      if (isSelected) {
        _cofCtx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ', 60%, 40%)';
      } else {
        _cofCtx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ', 40%, 25%)';
      }
      _cofCtx.fill();
      _cofCtx.strokeStyle = '#2a2a4a';
      _cofCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      _cofCtx.stroke();

      // Major key label
      var labelR = (COF_OUTER_RADIUS + minorOuterR) / 2;
      var lx = cx + labelR * Math.cos(midAngle);
      var ly = cy + labelR * Math.sin(midAngle);
      _cofCtx.fillStyle = isSelected ? '#ffffff' : '#e0e0ff';
      _cofCtx.font = 'bold 13px sans-serif';
      _cofCtx.textAlign = 'center';
      _cofCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      _cofCtx.fillText(COF_KEYS[i], lx, ly);
    }

    // Inner ring: relative minor keys
    for (var j = 0; j < COF_MINOR_KEYS.length; j++) {
      var mStartAngle = (j - 0.5) * segmentAngle - Math.PI / 2;
      var mEndAngle = mStartAngle + segmentAngle;
      var mMidAngle = (mStartAngle + mEndAngle) / 2;

      _cofCtx.beginPath();
      _cofCtx.arc(cx, cy, minorOuterR, mStartAngle, mEndAngle);
      _cofCtx.arc(cx, cy, minorInnerR, mEndAngle, mStartAngle, true);
      _cofCtx.closePath();
      var mHue = (j * 30) % 360;
      var mSelected = (j === _selectedCofKey);
      if (mSelected) {
        _cofCtx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + mHue + ', 40%, 30%)';
      } else {
        _cofCtx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + mHue + ', 25%, 15%)';
      }
      _cofCtx.fill();
      _cofCtx.strokeStyle = '#2a2a4a';
      _cofCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      _cofCtx.stroke();

      // Minor key label
      var mLabelR = (minorOuterR + minorInnerR) / 2;
      var mlx = cx + mLabelR * Math.cos(mMidAngle);
      var mly = cy + mLabelR * Math.sin(mMidAngle);
      _cofCtx.fillStyle = mSelected ? '#ccccff' : '#9999bb';
      _cofCtx.font = '10px sans-serif';
      _cofCtx.textAlign = 'center';
      _cofCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      _cofCtx.fillText(COF_MINOR_KEYS[j], mlx, mly);
    }

    // Center circle
    _cofCtx.beginPath();
    _cofCtx.arc(cx, cy, minorInnerR, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    _cofCtx.fillStyle = '#0a0a12';
    _cofCtx.fill();
    _cofCtx.strokeStyle = '#2a2a4a';
    _cofCtx.stroke();

    // Center label
    _cofCtx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
    _cofCtx.font = '11px sans-serif';
    _cofCtx.textAlign = 'center';
    _cofCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    _cofCtx.fillText('Circle of', cx, cy - 8);
    _cofCtx.fillText('Fifths', cx, cy + 8);
  }

  function _updateCofKeySig(segIdx) {
    var keySigEl = document.getElementById('learn-cof-keysig');
    if (!keySigEl) { return; }
    if (segIdx < 0 || segIdx >= 12) {
      keySigEl.textContent = 'Select a key on the circle';
      return;
    }
    var keyName = COF_KEYS[segIdx];
    var minorName = COF_MINOR_KEYS[segIdx];
    var sig = COF_KEY_SIGS[segIdx];
    var sigStr = '';
    if (sig.sharps > 0) {
      sigStr = sig.sharps + (sig.sharps === 1 ? ' sharp' : ' sharps');
    } else if (sig.flats > 0) {
      sigStr = sig.flats + (sig.flats === 1 ? ' flat' : ' flats');
    } else {
      sigStr = 'no sharps or flats';
    }
    var enharmonic = COF_ENHARMONICS[keyName];
    var enhStr = enharmonic ? ' (enharmonic: ' + enharmonic + ')' : '';
    keySigEl.innerHTML = '<strong>' + keyName + ' Major / ' + minorName + '</strong> — ' + sigStr + enhStr;
  }

  function _handleCofClick(x, y) {
    var cx = COF_CANVAS_SIZE / 2;
    var cy = COF_CANVAS_SIZE / 2;
    var dx = x - cx;
    var dy = y - cy;
    var dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

    if (dist > COF_OUTER_RADIUS || dist < 48) {
      return;
    }

    var angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx) + Math.PI / 2;
    if (angle < 0) {
      angle += 2 * Math.PI;
    }
    var segIdx = Math.floor((angle / (2 * Math.PI)) * 12);
    if (segIdx >= 12) {
      segIdx = 0;
    }

    // Highlight selected segment
    _selectedCofKey = segIdx;
    _drawCircleOfFifths();
    _updateCofKeySig(segIdx);

    // Play the major chord for that key
    var keyName = COF_KEYS[segIdx];
    var rootIdx = NOTE_NAMES.indexOf(keyName);
    if (rootIdx < 0) {
      var flatMap = { 'Db': 1, 'Eb': 3, 'Ab': 8, 'Bb': 10, 'F#': 6 };
      if (flatMap[keyName] !== undefined) {
        rootIdx = flatMap[keyName];
      }
    }
    if (rootIdx >= 0) {
      var isMinorClick = (dist < COF_INNER_RADIUS);
      var baseMidi = 60 + rootIdx;
      if (isMinorClick) {
        // Play minor chord of relative minor
        _playChord([baseMidi + 9, baseMidi + 12, baseMidi + 16], 0.8);
      } else {
        _playChord([baseMidi, baseMidi + 4, baseMidi + 7], 0.8);
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Ear Training
  // ============================================================

  function _generateEarInterval() {
    var pool = DIFFICULTY_LEVELS[_earDifficulty] || DIFFICULTY_LEVELS['easy'];
    // Filter out unison (0)
    var filtered = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) {
      if (pool[i] > 0) {
        filtered.push(pool[i]);
      }
    }
    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    var randIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * filtered.length);
    _earCurrentInterval = filtered[randIdx];
    _earBaseNote = _earRootMidi; // use selected root note

    // Clear feedback and button states
    var feedback = document.getElementById('learn-ear-feedback');
    if (feedback) {
      feedback.textContent = 'Listen and guess...';
      feedback.style.color = '#aaaacc';
    }
    var allGuess = document.querySelectorAll('[data-ear-guess]');
    for (var g = 0; g < allGuess.length; g++) {
      allGuess[g].classList.remove('correct');
      allGuess[g].classList.remove('wrong');
    }

    _playTwoNotes(_earBaseNote, _earBaseNote + _earCurrentInterval, 500);
  }

  function _checkEarGuess(guessedSemitones, btn) {
    if (_earCurrentInterval < 0) {
      return;
    }

    _earTotal++;
    var correct = (guessedSemitones === _earCurrentInterval);
    var feedback = document.getElementById('learn-ear-feedback');

    if (correct) {
      _earCorrect++;
      btn.classList.add('correct');
      if (feedback) {
        feedback.textContent = 'Correct!';
        feedback.style.color = '#66ff66';
      }
    } else {
      btn.classList.add('wrong');
      // Highlight the correct answer
      var correctBtn = document.querySelector('[data-ear-guess="' + _earCurrentInterval + '"]');
      if (correctBtn) {
        correctBtn.classList.add('correct');
      }
      // Find the name of the correct interval
      var correctName = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < INTERVALS.length; i++) {
        if (INTERVALS[i].semitones === _earCurrentInterval) {
          correctName = INTERVALS[i].fullName;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (feedback) {
        feedback.textContent = 'Wrong - it was ' + correctName;
        feedback.style.color = '#ff6666';
      }
    }

    // Update score
    var correctEl = document.getElementById('learn-ear-correct');
    if (correctEl) {
      correctEl.textContent = _earCorrect;
    }
    var totalEl = document.getElementById('learn-ear-total');
    if (totalEl) {
      totalEl.textContent = _earTotal;
    }
    var accEl = document.getElementById('learn-ear-accuracy');
    if (accEl) {
      if (_earTotal > 0) {
        accEl.textContent = Math.round((_earCorrect / _earTotal) * 100) + '%';
      } else {
        accEl.textContent = '-';
      }
    }

    _earCurrentInterval = -1;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Scales
  // ============================================================

  function _getScaleNotes() {
    var intervals = SCALE_TYPES[_scaleType];
    if (!intervals) {
      return [];
    }
    var notes = [];
    for (var oct = 0; oct < _scaleOctaves; oct++) {
      for (var i = 0; i < intervals.length; i++) {
        var noteNum = (_scaleRoot + intervals[i] + oct * 12) % 12;
        notes.push(noteNum);
      }
    }
    // Add the top note
    notes.push(_scaleRoot);
    // Deduplicate
    var unique = [];
    for (var u = 0; u < notes.length; u++) {
      if (unique.indexOf(notes[u]) < 0) {
        unique.push(notes[u]);
      }
    }
    return unique;
  }

  function _updateScaleNotes() {
    var notesEl = document.getElementById('learn-scale-notes');
    if (!notesEl) {
      return;
    }
    var intervals = SCALE_TYPES[_scaleType];
    if (!intervals) {
      notesEl.textContent = '';
      return;
    }
    var names = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < intervals.length; i++) {
      names.push(NOTE_NAMES[(_scaleRoot + intervals[i]) % 12]);
    }
    // Add octave note
    names.push(NOTE_NAMES[_scaleRoot]);
    notesEl.textContent = NOTE_NAMES[_scaleRoot] + ' ' + _scaleType + ': ' + names.join(' - ');
  }

  function _drawScaleKeyboard() {
    // Build standard piano keyboard (same as notation/sight-reading)
    var scaleEndMidi = KEYBOARD_START_MIDI + _scaleOctaves * 12;
    _buildLearnPianoKeyboard('learn-scale-keyboard', 'data-scale-midi', KEYBOARD_START_MIDI, scaleEndMidi);

    // Highlight scale notes with pitch-class colors
    var scaleNotes = _getScaleNotes();
    var kbEl = document.getElementById('learn-scale-keyboard');
    if (!kbEl) {
      return;
    }
    var allKeys = kbEl.querySelectorAll('[data-scale-midi]');
    for (var k = 0; k < allKeys.length; k++) {
      var midi = parseInt(allKeys[k].getAttribute('data-scale-midi'), 10);
      var pc = midi % 12;
      var isInScale = false;
      for (var s = 0; s < scaleNotes.length; s++) {
        if (scaleNotes[s] === pc) {
          isInScale = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      // Add pitch-class color and scale highlight
      allKeys[k].classList.add('pc-' + pc);
      if (isInScale) {
        allKeys[k].classList.add('scale-highlight');
      }
    }

    // Wire click to play note
    kbEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var target = e.target;
      if (target.hasAttribute('data-scale-midi')) {
        var midi = parseInt(target.getAttribute('data-scale-midi'), 10);
        _playNote(midi, 0.4);
      }
    });
  }

  // Track scheduled playback timeouts so they can be stopped
  var _scaleTimers = [];
  var _isPlayingScale = false;

  function _highlightScaleKey(midi) {
    var kbEl = document.getElementById('learn-scale-keyboard');
    if (!kbEl) {
      return;
    }
    // Clear previous active highlight
    var prev = kbEl.querySelectorAll('.scale-playing');
    for (var p = 0; p < prev.length; p++) {
      prev[p].classList.remove('scale-playing');
    }
    // Highlight the current key
    var allKeys = kbEl.querySelectorAll('[data-scale-midi]');
    for (var k = 0; k < allKeys.length; k++) {
      if (parseInt(allKeys[k].getAttribute('data-scale-midi'), 10) === midi) {
        allKeys[k].classList.add('scale-playing');
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  function _clearScaleKeyHighlight() {
    var kbEl = document.getElementById('learn-scale-keyboard');
    if (!kbEl) {
      return;
    }
    var prev = kbEl.querySelectorAll('.scale-playing');
    for (var p = 0; p < prev.length; p++) {
      prev[p].classList.remove('scale-playing');
    }
  }

  function _playScale(descending) {
    // Stop any currently playing scale first
    _stopScale();

    var intervals = SCALE_TYPES[_scaleType];
    if (!intervals) {
      return;
    }
    var midiNotes = [];
    for (var oct = 0; oct < _scaleOctaves; oct++) {
      for (var i = 0; i < intervals.length; i++) {
        midiNotes.push(KEYBOARD_START_MIDI + _scaleRoot + intervals[i] + oct * 12);
      }
    }
    midiNotes.push(KEYBOARD_START_MIDI + _scaleRoot + _scaleOctaves * 12);

    if (descending) {
      midiNotes.reverse();
    }

    _isPlayingScale = true;
    _updateStopBtnVisibility();
    var delay = 250;
    for (var n = 0; n < midiNotes.length; n++) {
      (function(midi, d, isLast) {
        var timerId = setTimeout(function() {
          _highlightScaleKey(midi);
          _playNote(midi, 0.3);
          if (isLast) {
            // Clear highlight after note duration
            var clearId = setTimeout(function() {
              _clearScaleKeyHighlight();
            }, 300);
            _scaleTimers.push(clearId);
            _isPlayingScale = false;
            _updateStopBtnVisibility();
          }
        }, d);
        _scaleTimers.push(timerId);
      })(midiNotes[n], n * delay, n === midiNotes.length - 1);
    }
  }

  function _stopScale() {
    for (var i = 0; i < _scaleTimers.length; i++) {
      clearTimeout(_scaleTimers[i]);
    }
    _scaleTimers = [];
    _isPlayingScale = false;
    _clearScaleKeyHighlight();
    _updateStopBtnVisibility();
  }

  function _updateStopBtnVisibility() {
    var stopBtn = document.getElementById('learn-stop-scale');
    if (stopBtn) {
      if (_isPlayingScale) {
        stopBtn.style.display = '';
      } else {
        stopBtn.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Intervals
  // ============================================================

  function _updateIntervalDisplay() {
    var nameEl = document.getElementById('learn-int-name');
    if (!nameEl) {
      return;
    }
    var semi = Math.abs(_intervalNote2 - _intervalNote1);
    var found = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < INTERVALS.length; i++) {
      if (INTERVALS[i].semitones === semi) {
        found = INTERVALS[i].fullName + ' (' + semi + ' semitones)';
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!found) {
      found = semi + ' semitones';
    }
    nameEl.textContent = found;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init / Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _init() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }
    _initialized = true;
    _buildScreen();
    _setupEventListeners();
    _buildNotationMiniKeyboard();
    _buildSrKeyboard();
  }

  function activate(tabId) {
    _init();
    _active = true;

    // Handle tab routing from sidebar
    var TAB_ALIAS_MAP = {
      'theory': 'theory',
      'ear': 'ear',
      'notation': 'notation',
      'sight': 'sightread',
      'physics': 'physics',
      'scales': 'scales',
      'history': 'history'
    };
    if (tabId && TAB_ALIAS_MAP[tabId]) {
      _switchTab(TAB_ALIAS_MAP[tabId]);
    }

    // Draw canvases for current tab
    if (_currentTab === 'theory') {
      _drawCircleOfFifths();
    } else if (_currentTab === 'scales') {
      _drawScaleKeyboard();
      _updateScaleNotes();
    } else if (_currentTab === 'notation') {
      _drawNotationStaff();
    } else if (_currentTab === 'sightread') {
      _drawSightReadStaff();
    } else if (_currentTab === 'physics') {
      _drawPhysicsWaveInterference();
      _drawStandingWave();
      _drawFourierDecomposition();
      _drawWaveformShapes();
      _drawBeatsCanvas();
      _drawResonanceCanvas();
      _drawLoudnessCanvas();
      _drawHarmonicsCanvas();
      _drawHarmonicsSpectrum();
    }
    _updateIntervalDisplay();
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _stopAllAudio();
    // Release any sustained notes and worklet voices
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.stopAllSustained) {
      SL.audio.stopAllSustained();
    }
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.workletAllNotesOff) {
      SL.audio.workletAllNotesOff();
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Public API
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenLearn = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };

})();

(function() {

  function _ensureInstrumentType() {
