      SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi);
    }
  }

  function _startHoldNote() {
    _ensureInstrumentType();
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.playNote) {
      SL.audio.playNote(HOLD_NOTE_MIDI, HOLD_NOTE_DURATION);
    }
  }

  function _stopHoldNote() {
    var instId = _getCurrentInstId();
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.workletNoteOff) {
      SL.audio.workletNoteOff(HOLD_NOTE_MIDI, instId);
    }
  }

  function _toggleHoldNote() {
    _holdNoteActive = !_holdNoteActive;
    var btn = document.getElementById('voice-hold-btn');
    if (btn) {
      if (_holdNoteActive) {
        btn.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        btn.classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
    if (_holdNoteActive) {
      _startHoldNote();
    } else {
      _stopHoldNote();
    }
  }

  function _buildKeyboard() {
    var html = '';
    var totalWhite = WHITE_KEYS_PER_OCTAVE * KEYBOARD_OCTAVES;

    for (var w = 0; w < totalWhite; w++) {
      var octave = Math.floor(w / WHITE_KEYS_PER_OCTAVE);
      var whiteIdx = w % WHITE_KEYS_PER_OCTAVE;
      var noteInOctave = WHITE_NOTE_INDICES[whiteIdx];
      var midi = KEYBOARD_START_MIDI + octave * 12 + noteInOctave;
      var label = NOTE_NAMES[noteInOctave];

      html += '<div class="voice-key voice-key-white" data-voice-midi="' + midi + '">';
      html += '<span class="voice-key-label">' + label + '</span>';
      html += '</div>';

      // Black key after this white key?
      var blackNote = BLACK_NOTE_OFFSETS[whiteIdx];
      if (blackNote >= 0) {
        var blackMidi = KEYBOARD_START_MIDI + octave * 12 + blackNote;
        html += '<div class="voice-key voice-key-black" data-voice-midi="' + blackMidi + '"></div>';
      }
    }

    return html;
  }

  // Event Listeners

  function _setupEventListeners() {
    // Instrument type selector
    var instSel = document.getElementById('voice-inst-type');
    if (instSel) {
      instSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
        _instType = instSel.value;
        var ind = document.getElementById('voice-type-ind');
        if (ind) {
          ind.textContent = _instType.toUpperCase();
        }
        _ensureInstrumentType();
        _applySettings();
      });
    }

    // Hold Note toggle button
    var holdBtn = document.getElementById('voice-hold-btn');
    if (holdBtn) {
      holdBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        _toggleHoldNote();
      });
    }

    // Vowel buttons
    var vowelBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-voice-vowel]');
    for (var vb = 0; vb < vowelBtns.length; vb++) {
      (function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          _customF1 = null;
          _customF2 = null;
          _currentVowel = btn.getAttribute('data-voice-vowel');
          _updateVowelButtonHighlight(_currentVowel);
          _applySettings();
          _drawFormantChart();
        });
      })(vowelBtns[vb]);
    }

    // Formant chart canvas — interactive click
    var chartCanvas = document.getElementById('voice-formant-canvas');
    if (chartCanvas) {
      chartCanvas.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      chartCanvas.addEventListener('click', _handleChartClick);
    }

    // Sliders
    _setupSlider('voice-morph', function(val) { _morphValue = val; _applySettings(); }, 'voice-morph-val');
    _setupSlider('voice-shift', function(val) { _formantShift = val; _applySettings(); }, 'voice-shift-val');
    _setupSlider('voice-breath', function(val) { _breathiness = val; _applySettings(); }, 'voice-breath-val');
    _setupSlider('voice-pulse', function(val) { _pulseWidth = val; _applySettings(); }, 'voice-pulse-val');
    _setupSlider('voice-vib-rate', function(val) {
      _vibratoRate = val;
      var instId = _getCurrentInstId();
      var engine = _getFormantEngine();
      if (engine && engine.setVibratoRate) {
        engine.setVibratoRate(instId, val);
      } else if (engine && engine.setSettings) {
        engine.setSettings(instId, { vibratoRate: val });
      }
    }, 'voice-vib-rate-val');
    _setupSlider('voice-vib-depth', function(val) {
      _vibratoDepth = val;
      var instId = _getCurrentInstId();
      var engine = _getFormantEngine();
      if (engine && engine.setVibratoDepth) {
        engine.setVibratoDepth(instId, val);
      } else if (engine && engine.setSettings) {
        engine.setSettings(instId, { vibratoDepth: val });
      }
    }, 'voice-vib-depth-val');

    // Keyboard
    var keys = document.querySelectorAll('[data-voice-midi]');
    for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
      (function(key) {
        key.addEventListener('mousedown', function() {
          var midi = parseInt(key.getAttribute('data-voice-midi'), 10);
          _playVoicedNote(midi);
          key.classList.add('active');
          _activeKeys[midi] = true;
        });
        key.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
          key.classList.remove('active');
          var midi = parseInt(key.getAttribute('data-voice-midi'), 10);
          if (_activeKeys[midi]) {
            _stopVoicedNote(midi);
            delete _activeKeys[midi];
          }
        });
        key.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
          var midi = parseInt(key.getAttribute('data-voice-midi'), 10);
          if (_activeKeys[midi]) {
            key.classList.remove('active');
            _stopVoicedNote(midi);
            delete _activeKeys[midi];
          }
        });
      })(keys[k]);
    }
  }

  function _setupSlider(id, callback, valId) {
    var slider = document.getElementById(id);
    if (slider) {
      slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
        var val = parseInt(slider.value, 10);
        callback(val);
        var valEl = document.getElementById(valId);
        if (valEl) {
          valEl.textContent = val;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Formant Chart — coordinate helpers
  // ============================================================

  /** Convert F1/F2 frequencies to canvas pixel coordinates. */
  function _f1f2ToXY(f1, f2) {
    var x = ((f2 - CHART_F2_MIN) / (CHART_F2_MAX - CHART_F2_MIN)) * (CHART_WIDTH - 20) + 10;
    var y = ((f1 - CHART_F1_MIN) / (CHART_F1_MAX - CHART_F1_MIN)) * (CHART_HEIGHT - 20) + 10;
    return { x: x, y: y };
  }

  /** Convert canvas pixel coordinates back to F1/F2 frequencies. */
  function _xyToF1F2(x, y) {
    var f2 = ((x - 10) / (CHART_WIDTH - 20)) * (CHART_F2_MAX - CHART_F2_MIN) + CHART_F2_MIN;
    var f1 = ((y - 10) / (CHART_HEIGHT - 20)) * (CHART_F1_MAX - CHART_F1_MIN) + CHART_F1_MIN;
    return { f1: f1, f2: f2 };
  }

  /**
   * Compute a weighted blend of the nearest vowels' formant engine data
   * based on distance from the given F1/F2 position.
   * Returns a formant data object { freqs:[], amps:[], bws:[] } suitable
   * for setCustomVowelData.
   */
  function _blendFormantsAtPosition(clickF1, clickF2) {
    // Compute distances to all vowels (in normalized F1/F2 space)
    var f1Range = CHART_F1_MAX - CHART_F1_MIN;
    var f2Range = CHART_F2_MAX - CHART_F2_MIN;
    var distances = [];
    for (var vi = 0; vi < VOWELS.length; vi++) {
      var vName = VOWELS[vi];
      var vData = VOWEL_F1F2[vName];
      if (vData) {
        var df1 = (clickF1 - vData.f1) / f1Range;
        var df2 = (clickF2 - vData.f2) / f2Range;
        var dist = Math.sqrt(df1 * df1 + df2 * df2);
        distances.push({ name: vName, dist: dist });
      }
    }

    // Sort by distance ascending
    distances.sort(function(a, b) { return a.dist - b.dist; });

    // If we clicked very close to a vowel (within threshold), just use it
    var SNAP_THRESHOLD = 0.05;
    if (distances.length > 0 && distances[0].dist < SNAP_THRESHOLD) {
      return { snappedVowel: distances[0].name, blendData: null };
    }

    // Take nearest BLEND_NEIGHBOR_COUNT vowels and compute inverse-distance weights
    var neighbors = distances.slice(0, BLEND_NEIGHBOR_COUNT);
    var totalWeight = 0;
    var weights = [];
    for (var ni = 0; ni < neighbors.length; ni++) {
      var w = 1.0 / (neighbors[ni].dist + 0.001);
      weights.push(w);
      totalWeight += w;
    }

    // Normalize weights
    for (var wi = 0; wi < weights.length; wi++) {
      weights[wi] = weights[wi] / totalWeight;
    }

    // Blend formant data from the engine's VOWEL_DATA
    var engine = _getFormantEngine();
    var engineVowelData = (engine && engine.VOWEL_DATA) ? engine.VOWEL_DATA : null;
    if (!engineVowelData) {
      return { snappedVowel: neighbors[0].name, blendData: null };
    }

    var numFormants = 5;
    var blendedFreqs = [];
    var blendedAmps = [];
    var blendedBws = [];
    for (var fi = 0; fi < numFormants; fi++) {
      blendedFreqs.push(0);
      blendedAmps.push(0);
      blendedBws.push(0);
    }

    for (var bi = 0; bi < neighbors.length; bi++) {
      var vowelEngData = engineVowelData[neighbors[bi].name];
      if (vowelEngData) {
        for (var fj = 0; fj < numFormants; fj++) {
          blendedFreqs[fj] += vowelEngData.freqs[fj] * weights[bi];
          blendedAmps[fj] += vowelEngData.amps[fj] * weights[bi];
          blendedBws[fj] += vowelEngData.bws[fj] * weights[bi];
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      snappedVowel: null,
      blendData: { freqs: blendedFreqs, amps: blendedAmps, bws: blendedBws }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Handle a click on the formant chart canvas.
   * If the click is on a vowel dot, select that vowel.
   * Otherwise, compute a blended position and set custom formants.
   */
  function _handleChartClick(event) {
    if (!_chartCanvas) {
      return;
    }

    var rect = _chartCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scaleX = CHART_WIDTH / rect.width;
    var scaleY = CHART_HEIGHT / rect.height;
    var canvasX = (event.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
    var canvasY = (event.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;

    // Check if click is on a vowel dot
    for (var vi = 0; vi < VOWELS.length; vi++) {
      var vName = VOWELS[vi];
      var vData = VOWEL_F1F2[vName];
      if (vData) {
        var pos = _f1f2ToXY(vData.f1, vData.f2);
        var dx = canvasX - pos.x;
        var dy = canvasY - pos.y;
        var hitRadius = CHART_ACTIVE_RADIUS + 4;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= hitRadius * hitRadius) {
          // Clicked on a vowel dot — select it as if the button was clicked
          _customF1 = null;
          _customF2 = null;
          _currentVowel = vName;
          _updateVowelButtonHighlight(vName);
          _applySettings();
          _drawFormantChart();
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    // Clicked in open space — compute blended position
    var f1f2 = _xyToF1F2(canvasX, canvasY);
    var clampedF1 = Math.max(CHART_F1_MIN, Math.min(CHART_F1_MAX, f1f2.f1));
    var clampedF2 = Math.max(CHART_F2_MIN, Math.min(CHART_F2_MAX, f1f2.f2));

    var blend = _blendFormantsAtPosition(clampedF1, clampedF2);

    if (blend.snappedVowel) {
      // Close enough to a vowel — snap to it
      _customF1 = null;
      _customF2 = null;
      _currentVowel = blend.snappedVowel;
      _updateVowelButtonHighlight(blend.snappedVowel);
      _applySettings();
    } else if (blend.blendData) {
      // Set custom blended formants on the engine
      _customF1 = clampedF1;
      _customF2 = clampedF2;
      _currentVowel = '_CUSTOM';
      _updateVowelButtonHighlight(null); // deselect all vowel buttons

      var engine = _getFormantEngine();
      if (engine && engine.setCustomVowelData) {
        engine.setCustomVowelData(blend.blendData);
      }
      _applySettings();
    }

    _drawFormantChart();
  }

  /** Update the active class on vowel buttons. Pass null to deselect all. */
  function _updateVowelButtonHighlight(vowelName) {
    var allV = document.querySelectorAll('[data-voice-vowel]');
    for (var a = 0; a < allV.length; a++) {
      if (vowelName && allV[a].getAttribute('data-voice-vowel') === vowelName) {
        allV[a].classList.add('active');
      } else {
        allV[a].classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Formant Chart — drawing
  // ============================================================

  function _drawFormantChart() {
    _chartCanvas = document.getElementById('voice-formant-canvas');
    if (!_chartCanvas) {
      return;
    }
    _chartCtx = _chartCanvas.getContext('2d');
    _chartCtx.clearRect(0, 0, CHART_WIDTH, CHART_HEIGHT);

    // Background
    _chartCtx.fillStyle = '#111122';
    _chartCtx.fillRect(0, 0, CHART_WIDTH, CHART_HEIGHT);

    // Grid lines
    _chartCtx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    _chartCtx.lineWidth = 1;
    var gridSteps = 5;
    for (var gx = 1; gx < gridSteps; gx++) {
      var gxPos = (gx / gridSteps) * CHART_WIDTH;
      _chartCtx.beginPath();
      _chartCtx.moveTo(gxPos, 0);
      _chartCtx.lineTo(gxPos, CHART_HEIGHT);
      _chartCtx.stroke();
    }
    for (var gy = 1; gy < gridSteps; gy++) {
      var gyPos = (gy / gridSteps) * CHART_HEIGHT;
      _chartCtx.beginPath();
      _chartCtx.moveTo(0, gyPos);
      _chartCtx.lineTo(CHART_WIDTH, gyPos);
      _chartCtx.stroke();
    }

    // Axis labels
    _chartCtx.fillStyle = '#6666aa';
    _chartCtx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    _chartCtx.textAlign = 'center';
    // F2 axis (x) - note: traditionally F2 decreases left to right, but we go increasing
    _chartCtx.fillText(CHART_F2_MIN + '', 10, CHART_HEIGHT - 4);
    _chartCtx.fillText(CHART_F2_MAX + '', CHART_WIDTH - 20, CHART_HEIGHT - 4);
    // F1 axis (y) - F1 increases downward
    _chartCtx.textAlign = 'left';
    _chartCtx.fillText(CHART_F1_MIN + '', 2, 12);
    _chartCtx.fillText(CHART_F1_MAX + '', 2, CHART_HEIGHT - 14);

    // Plot vowels
    for (var vi = 0; vi < VOWELS.length; vi++) {
      var v = VOWELS[vi];
      var data = VOWEL_F1F2[v];
      if (!data) {
        continue;
      }

      var pos = _f1f2ToXY(data.f1, data.f2);
      var x = pos.x;
      var y = pos.y;

      var isActive = (v === _currentVowel);
      var radius = isActive ? CHART_ACTIVE_RADIUS : CHART_DOT_RADIUS;

      // Dot
      _chartCtx.beginPath();
      _chartCtx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      if (isActive) {
        _chartCtx.fillStyle = '#6a6aff';
        _chartCtx.shadowColor = '#6a6aff';
        _chartCtx.shadowBlur = 12;
      } else {
        _chartCtx.fillStyle = '#4a4a8a';
        _chartCtx.shadowBlur = 0;
      }
      _chartCtx.fill();
      _chartCtx.shadowBlur = 0;

      // Label — use smaller font for multi-char vowels
      _chartCtx.fillStyle = '#e0e0ff';
      _chartCtx.font = (v.length > 1) ? 'bold 10px sans-serif' : 'bold 14px sans-serif';
      _chartCtx.textAlign = 'center';
      _chartCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      _chartCtx.fillText(v, x, y);
    }

    // Draw custom click crosshair if a blended position is active
    if (_customF1 !== null && _customF2 !== null) {
      var cp = _f1f2ToXY(_customF1, _customF2);
      var cx = cp.x;
      var cy = cp.y;
      var crossSize = 10;

      // Crosshair lines
      _chartCtx.strokeStyle = '#ff8844';
      _chartCtx.lineWidth = 2;
      _chartCtx.beginPath();
      _chartCtx.moveTo(cx - crossSize, cy);
      _chartCtx.lineTo(cx + crossSize, cy);
      _chartCtx.stroke();
      _chartCtx.beginPath();
      _chartCtx.moveTo(cx, cy - crossSize);
      _chartCtx.lineTo(cx, cy + crossSize);
      _chartCtx.stroke();

      // Highlighted circle
      _chartCtx.beginPath();
      _chartCtx.arc(cx, cy, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      _chartCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 136, 68, 0.5)';
      _chartCtx.fill();
      _chartCtx.strokeStyle = '#ff8844';
      _chartCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      _chartCtx.stroke();

      // Label showing blended F1/F2
      _chartCtx.fillStyle = '#ff8844';
      _chartCtx.font = '9px sans-serif';
      _chartCtx.textAlign = 'left';
      _chartCtx.textBaseline = 'top';
      _chartCtx.fillText(Math.round(_customF1) + ',' + Math.round(_customF2), cx + 8, cy + 2);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init / Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

// SuperSynthLab - MIDI Screen Module (v13.1.181)
// MIDI configuration, monitoring, and channel routing.
// Top bar: device selectors, panic button
// Left: 16-channel x 5 instrument routing matrix
// Center: live scrolling MIDI monitor
// Right: per-channel activity LEDs
// Bottom: import/export, transpose
// ES5 compatible (var, no arrow functions, no template literals)
(function() {
  'use strict';

  var SL = window.SynthLab;

  // ============================================================
  // Constants
  // ============================================================

  var CHANNEL_COUNT = 16;
  var INSTRUMENT_COUNT = 5;
  var MAX_MONITOR_MESSAGES = 200;
  var LED_FLASH_DURATION_MS = 120;
  var NOTE_NAMES = ['C', 'C#', 'D', 'D#', 'E', 'F', 'F#', 'G', 'G#', 'A', 'A#', 'B'];

  // ============================================================
  // State
  // ============================================================

  var _initialized = false;
  var _active = false;

  // 16 channels x 5 instruments routing (boolean matrix)
  var _routing = [];
  var _messages = [];
  var _transpose = 0;
  var _ledTimers = [];
  var _ledElements = [];
  var _monitorListEl = null;
  var _transposeValEl = null;
  var _startTime = 0;

  // Original onmidimessage handler so we can intercept
  var _origMidiHandler = null;

  // ============================================================
  // Helpers
  // ============================================================

  function _pad2(n) {
    return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n;
  }

  function _hex(b) {
    var h = b.toString(16).toUpperCase();
    return h.length < 2 ? '0' + h : h;
  }

  function _midiNoteName(midi) {
    var octave = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
    return NOTE_NAMES[midi % 12] + octave;
  }

  function _formatTime(ms) {
    var s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
    var m = Math.floor(s / 60);
    s = s % 60;
    var frac = Math.floor((ms % 1000) / 10);
    return _pad2(m) + ':' + _pad2(s) + '.' + _pad2(frac);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Build Screen DOM
  // ============================================================

  function _buildScreen() {
    var container = document.getElementById('screen-midi');
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = '';

    // -- Top bar --
    var topBar = document.createElement('div');
    topBar.className = 'midi-scr-top-bar';

    var inLabel = document.createElement('label');
    inLabel.textContent = 'Input:';
    var inSelect = document.createElement('select');
    inSelect.id = 'midi-scr-input-sel';
    inSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (SL.midi && SL.midi.selectInput) {
        SL.midi.selectInput(inSelect.value || null);
      }
    });

    var outLabel = document.createElement('label');
    outLabel.textContent = 'Output:';
    var outSelect = document.createElement('select');
    outSelect.id = 'midi-scr-output-sel';
    outSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (SL.midi && SL.midi.selectOutput) {
        SL.midi.selectOutput(outSelect.value || null);
      }
    });

    var rescanBtn = document.createElement('button');
    rescanBtn.className = 'midi-scr-rescan-btn';
    rescanBtn.textContent = 'Rescan';
    rescanBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (SL.midi && SL.midi.rescan) {
        SL.midi.rescan();
        setTimeout(_refreshDeviceSelectors, 500);
      }
    });

    var panicBtn = document.createElement('button');
    panicBtn.className = 'midi-scr-panic-btn';
    panicBtn.textContent = 'PANIC';
    panicBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (SL.midi && SL.midi.panic) {
        SL.midi.panic();
      }
      _addMonitorMessage(0, 'PANIC', '--', 'All notes off', '');
    });

    topBar.appendChild(inLabel);
    topBar.appendChild(inSelect);
    topBar.appendChild(outLabel);
    topBar.appendChild(outSelect);
    topBar.appendChild(rescanBtn);
    topBar.appendChild(panicBtn);
    container.appendChild(topBar);

    // -- Main area --
    var main = document.createElement('div');
    main.className = 'midi-scr-main';

    // Left: routing matrix
    var leftPanel = document.createElement('div');
    leftPanel.className = 'midi-scr-routing';
    var leftTitle = document.createElement('h3');
    leftTitle.textContent = 'Channel Routing';
    leftPanel.appendChild(leftTitle);
    leftPanel.appendChild(_buildRoutingTable());

    // Center: monitor
    var centerPanel = document.createElement('div');
    centerPanel.className = 'midi-scr-monitor';
    var centerTitle = document.createElement('h3');
    centerTitle.textContent = 'MIDI Monitor';
    centerPanel.appendChild(centerTitle);

    var monitorList = document.createElement('div');
    monitorList.className = 'midi-scr-monitor-list';
    _monitorListEl = monitorList;
    centerPanel.appendChild(monitorList);

    // Right: activity LEDs
    var rightPanel = document.createElement('div');
    rightPanel.className = 'midi-scr-activity';
    var rightTitle = document.createElement('h3');
    rightTitle.textContent = 'Activity';
    rightPanel.appendChild(rightTitle);
    rightPanel.appendChild(_buildLEDs());

    main.appendChild(leftPanel);
    main.appendChild(centerPanel);
    main.appendChild(rightPanel);
    container.appendChild(main);

    // -- Bottom bar --
    var bottomBar = document.createElement('div');
    bottomBar.className = 'midi-scr-bottom-bar';

    var importBtn = document.createElement('button');
    importBtn.textContent = 'Import MIDI';
    importBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (SL.midiImport && SL.midiImport.openImportDialog) {
        SL.midiImport.openImportDialog();
      }
    });

    var exportBtn = document.createElement('button');
    exportBtn.textContent = 'Export MIDI';
    exportBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (SL.midiFile && SL.midiFile.exportMidi) {
        SL.midiFile.exportMidi();
      }
    });

    var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
    clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear Log';
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      _messages = [];
      if (_monitorListEl) {
        _monitorListEl.innerHTML = '';
      }
    });

    var transposeGroup = document.createElement('div');
    transposeGroup.className = 'midi-scr-transpose-group';
    var transposeLabel = document.createElement('label');
    transposeLabel.textContent = 'Transpose:';
    var transposeSlider = document.createElement('input');
    transposeSlider.type = 'range';
    transposeSlider.min = '-24';
    transposeSlider.max = '24';
    transposeSlider.value = '0';
    var transposeVal = document.createElement('span');
    transposeVal.className = 'transpose-val';
    transposeVal.textContent = '0';
    _transposeValEl = transposeVal;
    transposeSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      _transpose = parseInt(transposeSlider.value, 10);
      transposeVal.textContent = (_transpose >= 0 ? '+' : '') + _transpose;
      // Apply transpose to MIDI system
      if (SL.midi && SL.midi.setTranspose) {
        SL.midi.setTranspose(_transpose);
      }
    });

    transposeGroup.appendChild(transposeLabel);
    transposeGroup.appendChild(transposeSlider);
    transposeGroup.appendChild(transposeVal);

    bottomBar.appendChild(importBtn);
    bottomBar.appendChild(exportBtn);
    bottomBar.appendChild(clearBtn);
    bottomBar.appendChild(transposeGroup);
    container.appendChild(bottomBar);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Routing Matrix Table
  // ============================================================

  function _buildRoutingTable() {
    var table = document.createElement('table');
    table.className = 'midi-scr-matrix-table';

    // Header row
    var thead = document.createElement('thead');
    var headerRow = document.createElement('tr');
    var emptyTh = document.createElement('th');
    emptyTh.textContent = 'Ch';
    headerRow.appendChild(emptyTh);
    for (var inst = 0; inst < INSTRUMENT_COUNT; inst++) {
      var th = document.createElement('th');
      th.textContent = 'Inst ' + (inst + 1);
      headerRow.appendChild(th);
    }
    thead.appendChild(headerRow);
    table.appendChild(thead);

    // Body
    var tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
    for (var ch = 0; ch < CHANNEL_COUNT; ch++) {
      var row = document.createElement('tr');
      var chCell = document.createElement('td');
      chCell.className = 'midi-scr-ch-label';
      chCell.textContent = 'Ch ' + (ch + 1);
      row.appendChild(chCell);

      for (var inst2 = 0; inst2 < INSTRUMENT_COUNT; inst2++) {
        var td = document.createElement('td');
        var cb = document.createElement('input');
        cb.type = 'checkbox';
        // Default: channel N routes to instrument N (for first 5 channels)
        if (ch < INSTRUMENT_COUNT && ch === inst2) {
          cb.checked = true;
          _routing[ch][inst2] = true;
        }
        (function(c, i, checkbox) {
          checkbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
            _routing[c][i] = checkbox.checked;
            _applyRoutingToMidi();
          });
        })(ch, inst2, cb);
        td.appendChild(cb);
        row.appendChild(td);
      }
      tbody.appendChild(row);
    }
    table.appendChild(tbody);
    return table;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Activity LEDs
  // ============================================================

  function _buildLEDs() {
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'midi-scr-ch-leds';
    for (var ch = 0; ch < CHANNEL_COUNT; ch++) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'midi-scr-ch-led-row';

      var numSpan = document.createElement('span');
      numSpan.className = 'ch-num';
      numSpan.textContent = 'Ch ' + (ch + 1);

      var led = document.createElement('div');
      led.className = 'midi-scr-led';

      _ledElements[ch] = led;
      row.appendChild(numSpan);
      row.appendChild(led);
      wrap.appendChild(row);
    }
    return wrap;
  }

  function _flashLED(channel) {
    if (channel < 0 || channel >= CHANNEL_COUNT) {
      return;
    }
    var led = _ledElements[channel];
    if (!led) {
      return;
    }
    led.classList.add('active');
    if (_ledTimers[channel]) {
      clearTimeout(_ledTimers[channel]);
    }
    _ledTimers[channel] = setTimeout(function() {
      led.classList.remove('active');
      _ledTimers[channel] = null;
    }, LED_FLASH_DURATION_MS);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Monitor
  // ============================================================

  function _addMonitorMessage(channel, type, data1, data2, hexStr) {
    if (!_active) {
      return;
    }
    var now = performance.now() - _startTime;
    var msg = {
      time: _formatTime(now),
      type: type,
      channel: channel,
      data1: data1,
      data2: data2,
      hex: hexStr
    };
    _messages.push(msg);
    if (_messages.length > MAX_MONITOR_MESSAGES) {
      _messages.shift();
      if (_monitorListEl && _monitorListEl.firstChild) {
        _monitorListEl.removeChild(_monitorListEl.firstChild);
      }
    }
    _renderMonitorRow(msg);
  }

  function _renderMonitorRow(msg) {
    if (!_monitorListEl) {
      return;
    }
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'midi-scr-msg-row';

    var timeSpan = document.createElement('span');
    timeSpan.className = 'msg-time';
    timeSpan.textContent = msg.time;

    var typeSpan = document.createElement('span');
    typeSpan.className = 'msg-type';
    if (msg.type === 'Note On') {
      typeSpan.classList.add('note-on');
    } else if (msg.type === 'Note Off') {
      typeSpan.classList.add('note-off');
    } else if (msg.type === 'CC') {
      typeSpan.classList.add('cc');
    } else if (msg.type === 'PBend') {
      typeSpan.classList.add('pitch-bend');
    }
    typeSpan.textContent = msg.type;

    var chSpan = document.createElement('span');
    chSpan.className = 'msg-ch';
    chSpan.textContent = msg.channel !== '--' ? 'Ch' + (msg.channel + 1) : '--';

    var dataSpan = document.createElement('span');
    dataSpan.className = 'msg-data';
    dataSpan.textContent = msg.data1 + (msg.data2 !== '' ? ' ' + msg.data2 : '');

    var hexSpan = document.createElement('span');
    hexSpan.className = 'msg-hex';
    hexSpan.textContent = msg.hex;

    row.appendChild(timeSpan);
    row.appendChild(typeSpan);
    row.appendChild(chSpan);
    row.appendChild(dataSpan);
    row.appendChild(hexSpan);

    _monitorListEl.appendChild(row);
    _monitorListEl.scrollTop = _monitorListEl.scrollHeight;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MIDI Interception (tap into raw messages for monitor/LEDs)
  // ============================================================

  function _onRawMidiMessage(event) {
    var data = event.data;
    if (!data || data.length < 1) {
      return;
    }

    var status = data[0] & 0xF0;
    var channel = data[0] & 0x0F;
    var byte1 = data.length > 1 ? data[1] : 0;
    var byte2 = data.length > 2 ? data[2] : 0;

    // Build hex string
    var hexParts = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      hexParts.push(_hex(data[i]));
    }
    var hexStr = hexParts.join(' ');

    // Flash LED
    _flashLED(channel);

    // Decode for monitor
    if (status === 0x90 && byte2 > 0) {
      _addMonitorMessage(channel, 'Note On', _midiNoteName(byte1) + ' (' + byte1 + ')', 'vel=' + byte2, hexStr);
    } else if (status === 0x80 || (status === 0x90 && byte2 === 0)) {
      _addMonitorMessage(channel, 'Note Off', _midiNoteName(byte1) + ' (' + byte1 + ')', '', hexStr);
    } else if (status === 0xB0) {
      _addMonitorMessage(channel, 'CC', 'CC' + byte1, 'val=' + byte2, hexStr);
    } else if (status === 0xE0) {
      var bendVal = (byte2 << 7) | byte1;
      _addMonitorMessage(channel, 'PBend', '' + (bendVal - 8192), '', hexStr);
    } else if (status === 0xC0) {
      _addMonitorMessage(channel, 'PgmChg', 'Pgm ' + byte1, '', hexStr);
    } else if (status === 0xD0) {
      _addMonitorMessage(channel, 'ChPres', 'val=' + byte1, '', hexStr);
    } else if (status === 0xA0) {
      _addMonitorMessage(channel, 'PolyAT', _midiNoteName(byte1), 'val=' + byte2, hexStr);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Apply Routing Matrix to SL.midi config
  // ============================================================

  function _applyRoutingToMidi() {
    if (!SL.midi || !SL.midi.setMidiConfig) {
      return;
    }
    // For each instrument, find which channels route to it
    // The SL.midi config is per-instrument with a single channel,
    // so we map the first enabled channel per instrument
    for (var inst = 0; inst < Math.min(INSTRUMENT_COUNT, 4); inst++) {
      var foundChannel = -1;
      for (var ch = 0; ch < CHANNEL_COUNT; ch++) {
        if (_routing[ch][inst]) {
          foundChannel = ch;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (foundChannel >= 0) {
        SL.midi.setMidiConfig(inst, { midiIn: true, channel: foundChannel });
      } else {
        SL.midi.setMidiConfig(inst, { midiIn: false });
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Device Selector Refresh
  // ============================================================

  function _refreshDeviceSelectors() {
    if (!SL.midi) {
      return;
    }
    var inSelect = document.getElementById('midi-scr-input-sel');
    var outSelect = document.getElementById('midi-scr-output-sel');
    if (!inSelect || !outSelect) {
      return;
    }

    var inputs = SL.midi.getInputDevices ? SL.midi.getInputDevices() : [];
    var outputs = SL.midi.getOutputDevices ? SL.midi.getOutputDevices() : [];

    inSelect.innerHTML = '';
    var noneOpt = document.createElement('option');
    noneOpt.value = '';
    noneOpt.textContent = '-- None --';
    inSelect.appendChild(noneOpt);
    for (var i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = inputs[i].id;
      opt.textContent = inputs[i].name;
      inSelect.appendChild(opt);
    }

    outSelect.innerHTML = '';
    var noneOpt2 = document.createElement('option');
    noneOpt2.value = '';
    noneOpt2.textContent = '-- None --';
    outSelect.appendChild(noneOpt2);
    for (var j = 0; j < outputs.length; j++) {
      var opt2 = document.createElement('option');
      opt2.value = outputs[j].id;
      opt2.textContent = outputs[j].name;
      outSelect.appendChild(opt2);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init / Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _init() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }
    _initialized = true;

    // Initialize routing matrix
    for (var ch = 0; ch < CHANNEL_COUNT; ch++) {
      _routing[ch] = [];
      _ledTimers[ch] = null;
      for (var inst = 0; inst < INSTRUMENT_COUNT; inst++) {
        _routing[ch][inst] = (ch < INSTRUMENT_COUNT && ch === inst);
      }
    }

    _startTime = performance.now();
    _buildScreen();
    _refreshDeviceSelectors();
  }

  function _syncFromModel() {
    // MIDI screen reads device state from WebMIDI API
    // Re-sync device selectors to reflect any new connections
  }

  function activate() {
    _init();
    _active = true;
    _syncFromModel();
    _startTime = performance.now();
    _refreshDeviceSelectors();
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Public API
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenMidi = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate,
    onRawMidiMessage: _onRawMidiMessage
  };

})();

  function _playPianoNote(index) {

    var freq = 440 * Math.pow(2, (midi - 69) / 12);
    var now = ctx.currentTime;

    // Warm piano-like tone: fundamental + soft harmonics
    var master = ctx.createGain();
    master.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
    master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.25, now + 0.02);
    master.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.08, now + 0.3);
    master.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 1.2);
    master.connect(ctx.destination);

    var osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
    osc1.type = 'sine';
    osc1.frequency.value = freq;
    var g1 = ctx.createGain();
    g1.gain.value = 0.6;
    osc1.connect(g1);
    g1.connect(master);
    osc1.start(now);
    osc1.stop(now + 1.3);

    var osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
    osc2.type = 'triangle';
    osc2.frequency.value = freq * 2;
    var g2 = ctx.createGain();
    g2.gain.value = 0.15;
    osc2.connect(g2);
    g2.connect(master);
    osc2.start(now);
    osc2.stop(now + 1.3);

    var osc3 = ctx.createOscillator();
    osc3.type = 'sine';
    osc3.frequency.value = freq * 3;
    var g3 = ctx.createGain();
    g3.gain.value = 0.05;
    osc3.connect(g3);
    g3.connect(master);
    osc3.start(now);
    osc3.stop(now + 1.3);
  }

  function _setupCanvasEvents() {
    if (!_radarCanvas) {
      return;
    }

    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(evt) {
      evt.preventDefault();
      var pos = _getCanvasPos(evt);
      var hitIdx = _hitTestSource(pos.x, pos.y);
      if (hitIdx >= 0) {
        _draggingSource = _radarSources[hitIdx];
        _dragOffsetX = _draggingSource.x - pos.x;
        _dragOffsetY = _draggingSource.y - pos.y;
      }
    });

    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(evt) {
      if (!_draggingSource) {
        // Update cursor
        var pos = _getCanvasPos(evt);
        var hitIdx = _hitTestSource(pos.x, pos.y);
        _radarCanvas.style.cursor = hitIdx >= 0 ? 'grab' : 'default';
        return;
      }
      evt.preventDefault();
      var pos2 = _getCanvasPos(evt);
      var clamped = _clampToRadar(pos2.x + _dragOffsetX, pos2.y + _dragOffsetY);
      _draggingSource.x = clamped.x;
      _draggingSource.y = clamped.y;
      _updateSourceAudio(_draggingSource);
      _radarCanvas.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    });

    var mouseUpHandler = function() {
      if (_draggingSource) {
        _draggingSource = null;
        if (_radarCanvas) {
          _radarCanvas.style.cursor = 'default';
        }
      }
    };
    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('mouseup', mouseUpHandler);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', mouseUpHandler);

    // Double-click to remove
    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('dblclick', function(evt) {
      evt.preventDefault();
      var pos = _getCanvasPos(evt);
      var hitIdx = _hitTestSource(pos.x, pos.y);
      if (hitIdx >= 0) {
        _removeSourceFromRadar(hitIdx);
      }
    });

    // Right-click to remove
    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(evt) {
      evt.preventDefault();
      var pos = _getCanvasPos(evt);
      var hitIdx = _hitTestSource(pos.x, pos.y);
      if (hitIdx >= 0) {
        _removeSourceFromRadar(hitIdx);
      }
    });

    // Touch support
    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(evt) {
      if (evt.touches.length !== 1) {
        return;
      }
      evt.preventDefault();
      var touch = evt.touches[0];
      var pos = _getCanvasPos(touch);
      var hitIdx = _hitTestSource(pos.x, pos.y);
      if (hitIdx >= 0) {
        _draggingSource = _radarSources[hitIdx];
        _dragOffsetX = _draggingSource.x - pos.x;
        _dragOffsetY = _draggingSource.y - pos.y;
      }
    }, { passive: false });

    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function(evt) {
      if (!_draggingSource || evt.touches.length !== 1) {
        return;
      }
      evt.preventDefault();
      var touch = evt.touches[0];
      var pos = _getCanvasPos(touch);
      var clamped = _clampToRadar(pos.x + _dragOffsetX, pos.y + _dragOffsetY);
      _draggingSource.x = clamped.x;
      _draggingSource.y = clamped.y;
      _updateSourceAudio(_draggingSource);
    }, { passive: false });

    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
      _draggingSource = null;
    });

    // Drag-from-palette drop support
    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('dragover', function(evt) {
      evt.preventDefault();
      evt.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy';
    });

    _radarCanvas.addEventListener('drop', function(evt) {
      evt.preventDefault();
      var envIdxStr = evt.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
      var envIdx = parseInt(envIdxStr, 10);
      if (!isNaN(envIdx) && envIdx >= 0 && envIdx < ENVIRONMENTS.length) {
        var pos = _getCanvasPos(evt);
        _addSourceToRadar(envIdx, pos.x, pos.y);
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Radar Rendering
  // ============================================================

  function _startRenderLoop() {
    if (_radarAnimId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(_radarAnimId);
    }
    (function loop() {
      _radarAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      _drawRadar();
    })();
  }

  function _stopRenderLoop() {
    if (_radarAnimId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(_radarAnimId);
      _radarAnimId = null;
    }
  }

  function _drawRadar() {
    var ctx = _radarCtx;
    if (!ctx) {
      return;
    }

    var cx = RADAR_CENTER_X;
    var cy = RADAR_CENTER_Y;
    var r = RADAR_RADIUS;

    // Clear
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, RADAR_SIZE, RADAR_SIZE);

    // Background circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r + 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a14';
    ctx.fill();

    // Distance rings at 25%, 50%, 75%
    var ringAlphas = [0.12, 0.10, 0.08];
    var ringPcts = [0.25, 0.50, 0.75];
    for (var ri = 0; ri < ringPcts.length; ri++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * ringPcts[ri], 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(26, 26, 46, ' + ringAlphas[ri] + ')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Outer boundary ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40, 40, 70, 0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Crosshair lines
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - r, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + r, cy);
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - r);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + r);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30, 30, 55, 0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Center listener icon
    ctx.font = '42px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
    ctx.fillText('\uD83D\uDC42', cx, cy); // ear emoji

    // Draw connecting lines from sources to center
    for (var li = 0; li < _radarSources.length; li++) {
      var ls = _radarSources[li];
      var env = ENVIRONMENTS[ls.envIdx];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(ls.x, ls.y);
      ctx.strokeStyle = env.color.replace(')', ', 0.15)').replace('rgb', 'rgba');
      // Simple hex-to-rgba for our hex colors
      ctx.strokeStyle = _hexToRgba(env.color, 0.15);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Draw each source
    for (var si = 0; si < _radarSources.length; si++) {
      var src = _radarSources[si];
      var srcEnv = ENVIRONMENTS[src.envIdx];
      var isDragging = (src === _draggingSource);

      // Glow effect when dragging
      if (isDragging) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(src.x, src.y, SOURCE_HIT_RADIUS + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        var glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(src.x, src.y, 0, src.x, src.y, SOURCE_HIT_RADIUS + 6);
        glow.addColorStop(0, _hexToRgba(srcEnv.color, 0.3));
        glow.addColorStop(1, _hexToRgba(srcEnv.color, 0));
        ctx.fillStyle = glow;
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // Source background circle
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(src.x, src.y, SOURCE_HIT_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = _hexToRgba(srcEnv.color, isDragging ? 0.25 : 0.12);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = _hexToRgba(srcEnv.color, isDragging ? 0.6 : 0.35);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();

      // Source emoji
      ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillText(srcEnv.icon, src.x, src.y);

      // Volume indicator: small arc showing gain level
      var dx = src.x - cx;
      var dy = src.y - cy;
      var dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) / RADAR_RADIUS;
      dist = Math.min(dist, 1.0);
      var vol = 1.0 / (1.0 + dist * 3.0);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(src.x, src.y, SOURCE_HIT_RADIUS + 3, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * vol);
      ctx.strokeStyle = _hexToRgba(srcEnv.color, 0.5);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Source count indicator
    if (_radarSources.length > 0) {
      ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(102, 119, 136, 0.5)';
      ctx.fillText(_radarSources.length + '/' + MAX_SOURCES, RADAR_SIZE - 12, RADAR_SIZE - 8);
    }
  }

  function _hexToRgba(hex, alpha) {
    var r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16);
    var g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16);
    var b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
    return 'rgba(' + r + ',' + g + ',' + b + ',' + alpha + ')';
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Source Management
  // ============================================================

  function _addSourceToRadar(envIdx, dropX, dropY) {
    var ctx = _ensureAudio();
    if (!ctx) {
      return;
    }
    if (_radarSources.length >= MAX_SOURCES) {
      return;
    }
    if (_isEnvActive(envIdx)) {
      return;
    }

    var x, y;
    if (typeof dropX === 'number' && typeof dropY === 'number') {
      // Use provided coordinates (from drag-drop)
      var clamped = _clampToRadar(dropX, dropY);
      x = clamped.x;
      y = clamped.y;
    } else {
      // Random position near center (within 40% radius)
      var angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      var dist = Math.random() * RADAR_RADIUS * 0.4;
      x = RADAR_CENTER_X + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
      y = RADAR_CENTER_Y + Math.sin(angle) * dist;
    }

    // Create per-source gain and pan nodes
    var gainNode = ctx.createGain();
    var panNode = null;
    var hasPanner = typeof ctx.createStereoPanner === 'function';
    if (hasPanner) {
      panNode = ctx.createStereoPanner();
      gainNode.connect(panNode);
      panNode.connect(_masterGain);
    } else {
      // Fallback: just connect gain to master
      gainNode.connect(_masterGain);
    }

    // Build audio chain for this environment
    var nodes = _buildSourceAudio(ctx, envIdx, gainNode);

    var src = {
      envIdx: envIdx,
      x: x,
      y: y,
      nodes: nodes,
      gainNode: gainNode,
      panNode: panNode
    };

    // Set initial gain/pan from position
    _updateSourceAudio(src);

    _radarSources.push(src);
    _updatePaletteState();

    // Show breathing guide when first source is added
    if (_radarSources.length === 1) {
      if (_breatheGuide) {
        _breatheGuide.classList.add('visible');
      }
      if (_breatheCircle) {
        _breatheCircle.classList.add('animating');
      }
    }

    // Start timer if one is set and we just added first source
    if (_radarSources.length === 1 && _timerMinutes > 0) {
      _startTimer();
    }
  }

  function _removeSourceFromRadar(srcIdx) {
    if (srcIdx < 0 || srcIdx >= _radarSources.length) {
      return;
    }
    var src = _radarSources[srcIdx];

    // Stop and disconnect all audio nodes
    for (var i = 0; i < src.nodes.length; i++) {
      try {
        if (src.nodes[i].stop) {
          src.nodes[i].stop();
        }
        if (src.nodes[i].disconnect) {
          src.nodes[i].disconnect();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // already stopped
      }
    }
    try {
      src.gainNode.disconnect();
    } catch (e) { /* */ }
    if (src.panNode) {
      try {
        src.panNode.disconnect();
      } catch (e) { /* */ }
    }

    // If we were dragging this source, stop dragging
    if (_draggingSource === src) {
      _draggingSource = null;
    }

    _radarSources.splice(srcIdx, 1);
    _updatePaletteState();

    // Hide breathing guide when all sources removed
    if (_radarSources.length === 0) {
      if (_breatheGuide) {
        _breatheGuide.classList.remove('visible');
      }
      if (_breatheCircle) {
        _breatheCircle.classList.remove('animating');
      }
      _clearTimer();
      if (_timerDisplayEl) {
        _timerDisplayEl.textContent = '';
      }
    }
  }

  function _removeAllSources() {
    while (_radarSources.length > 0) {
      _removeSourceFromRadar(_radarSources.length - 1);
    }
  }

  function _updatePaletteState() {
    for (var i = 0; i < _paletteBtns.length; i++) {
      var entry = _paletteBtns[i];
      var btnEl = entry.btn;
      var idx = entry.envIdx;
      if (_isEnvActive(idx)) {
        btnEl.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        btnEl.classList.remove('active');
      }
      if (_radarSources.length >= MAX_SOURCES && !_isEnvActive(idx)) {
        btnEl.classList.add('disabled');
      } else {
        btnEl.classList.remove('disabled');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Per-Source Audio Update (gain + pan from position)
  // ============================================================

  function _updateSourceAudio(src) {
    var dx = src.x - RADAR_CENTER_X;
    var dy = src.y - RADAR_CENTER_Y;
    var dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) / RADAR_RADIUS;
    dist = Math.min(dist, 1.0);

    // Volume: closer = louder (inverse distance)
    var vol = 1.0 / (1.0 + dist * 3.0);
    src.gainNode.gain.value = vol;

    // Pan: left/right based on x position
    if (src.panNode) {
      var pan = dx / RADAR_RADIUS;
      pan = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, pan));
      src.panNode.pan.value = pan;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Audio Builders (one per environment)
  // Each returns array of nodes, connects to provided destination
  // ============================================================

  function _buildSourceAudio(ctx, envIdx, destination) {
    var env = ENVIRONMENTS[envIdx];
    var builders = {
      'ocean':        _buildOceanAudio,
      'rain':         _buildRainAudio,
      'forest':       _buildForestAudio,
      'campfire':     _buildCampfireAudio,
      'birdsong':     _buildBirdsongAudio,
      'space':        _buildSpaceAudio,
      'crickets':     _buildCricketsAudio,
      'heartbeat':    _buildHeartbeatAudio,
      'temple':       _buildTempleAudio,
      'snowfall':     _buildSnowfallAudio,
      'underwater':   _buildUnderwaterAudio,
      'cave':         _buildCaveAudio,
      'garden':       _buildGardenAudio,
      'rainforest':   _buildRainforestAudio,
      'creek':        _buildCreekAudio,
      'waterfall':    _buildWaterfallAudio,
      'lake':         _buildLakeAudio,
      'meadow':       _buildMeadowAudio,
      'thunderstorm': _buildThunderstormAudio,
      'desert':       _buildDesertAudio,
      'whale':        _buildWhaleAudio,
      'frogs':        _buildFrogsAudio,
      'cicadas':      _buildCicadasAudio,
      'purr':         _buildPurrAudio,
      'wolf':         _buildWolfAudio,
      'cafe':         _buildCafeAudio,
      'train':        _buildTrainAudio,
      'fan':          _buildFanAudio,
      'vinyl':        _buildVinylAudio,
      'typing':       _buildTypingAudio,
      'clock':        _buildClockAudio,
      'fireplace':    _buildFireplaceAudio,
      'aurora':       _buildAuroraAudio,
      'deepearth':    _buildDeepEarthAudio,
      'fog':          _buildFogAudio,
      'alien':        _buildAlienAudio,
      'bowl':         _buildBowlAudio,
      'chimes':       _buildChimesAudio,
      'om':           _buildOmAudio,
      'tibetan':      _buildTibetanAudio,
      'crystal':      _buildCrystalAudio
    };
    var builderFn = builders[env.id];
    if (builderFn) {
      return builderFn(ctx, destination);
    }
    return _buildForestAudio(ctx, destination);
  }

  // -- Noise buffer helpers --
  function _makeBrownNoise(ctx, seconds) {
    var bufLen = ctx.sampleRate * seconds;
    var buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufLen, ctx.sampleRate);
    var ch = buf.getChannelData(0);
    var lastVal = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < bufLen; i++) {
      var white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      lastVal = (lastVal + (0.02 * white)) / 1.02;
      ch[i] = lastVal * 3.5;
    }
    return buf;
  }

  function _makeWhiteNoise(ctx, seconds) {
    var bufLen = ctx.sampleRate * seconds;
    var buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufLen, ctx.sampleRate);
    var ch = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for (var i = 0; i < bufLen; i++) {
      ch[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    }
    return buf;
  }

  function _makePinkNoise(ctx, seconds) {
    var bufLen = ctx.sampleRate * seconds;
    var buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufLen, ctx.sampleRate);
    var ch = buf.getChannelData(0);
    var b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0, b3 = 0, b4 = 0, b5 = 0, b6 = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < bufLen; i++) {
      var white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      b0 = 0.99886 * b0 + white * 0.0555179;
      b1 = 0.99332 * b1 + white * 0.0750759;
      b2 = 0.96900 * b2 + white * 0.1538520;
      b3 = 0.86650 * b3 + white * 0.3104856;
      b4 = 0.55000 * b4 + white * 0.5329522;
      b5 = -0.7616 * b5 - white * 0.0168980;
      ch[i] = (b0 + b1 + b2 + b3 + b4 + b5 + b6 + white * 0.5362) * 0.11;
      b6 = white * 0.115926;
    }
    return buf;
  }

  // -- Ocean: brown noise + lowpass + LFO swell --
  function _buildOceanAudio(ctx, dest) {
    var nodes = [];
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = _makeWhiteNoise(ctx, 6);
    src.loop = true;
    var lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    lp.type = 'lowpass';
    lp.frequency.value = 600;
    var lfo = ctx.createOscillator();
    lfo.type = 'sine';
    lfo.frequency.value = 0.08;
    var lfoG = ctx.createGain();
    lfoG.gain.value = 200;
    lfo.connect(lfoG);
    lfoG.connect(lp.frequency);
    lfo.start();
    var g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.value = 0.35;
    src.connect(lp);
    lp.connect(g);
    g.connect(dest);
    src.start();
    nodes.push(src, lp, lfo, lfoG, g);
    return nodes;
  }

  // -- Rain: white noise + bandpass + low rumble --
  function _buildRainAudio(ctx, dest) {
    var nodes = [];
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = _makeWhiteNoise(ctx, 4);
    src.loop = true;
    var hp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    hp.type = 'highpass';
    hp.frequency.value = 1000;
    var lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    lp.type = 'lowpass';
    lp.frequency.value = 8000;
    var g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.value = 0.2;
    src.connect(hp);
    hp.connect(lp);
    lp.connect(g);
    g.connect(dest);
    src.start();
    nodes.push(src, hp, lp, g);

    // Low rumble layer
    var rumSrc = ctx.createBufferSource();
    rumSrc.buffer = _makeBrownNoise(ctx, 4);
    rumSrc.loop = true;
    var rumLp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    rumLp.type = 'lowpass';
    rumLp.frequency.value = 200;
    var rumG = ctx.createGain();
    rumG.gain.value = 0.15;
    rumSrc.connect(rumLp);
    rumLp.connect(rumG);
    rumG.connect(dest);
    rumSrc.start();
    nodes.push(rumSrc, rumLp, rumG);
    return nodes;
  }

  // -- Forest: brown noise + bird chirps --
  function _buildForestAudio(ctx, dest) {
    var nodes = [];
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = _makeBrownNoise(ctx, 4);
    src.loop = true;
    var lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    lp.type = 'lowpass';
    lp.frequency.value = 400;
    var g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.value = 0.4;
    src.connect(lp);
    lp.connect(g);
    g.connect(dest);
    src.start();
    nodes.push(src, lp, g);

    // Bird chirp texture
    var birdBufLen = ctx.sampleRate * 2;
    var birdBuf = ctx.createBuffer(1, birdBufLen, ctx.sampleRate);
    var birdCh = birdBuf.getChannelData(0);
    for (var bi = 0; bi < birdBufLen; bi++) {
      birdCh[bi] = Math.sin(bi * 0.15) * Math.sin(bi * 0.003) * 0.3;
    }
    var birdSrc = ctx.createBufferSource();
    birdSrc.buffer = birdBuf;
    birdSrc.loop = true;
    var birdG = ctx.createGain();
    birdG.gain.value = 0.08;
    var birdBp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    birdBp.type = 'bandpass';
    birdBp.frequency.value = 3000;
    birdBp.Q.value = 2;
    birdSrc.connect(birdBp);
    birdBp.connect(birdG);
    birdG.connect(dest);
    birdSrc.start();
    nodes.push(birdSrc, birdBp, birdG);
    return nodes;
  }

  // -- Campfire: brown noise rumble + crackle --
  function _buildCampfireAudio(ctx, dest) {
    var nodes = [];
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = _makeBrownNoise(ctx, 4);
    src.loop = true;
    var lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    lp.type = 'lowpass';
    lp.frequency.value = 250;
    var g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.value = 0.3;
    src.connect(lp);
    lp.connect(g);
    g.connect(dest);
    src.start();
    nodes.push(src, lp, g);

    // Crackle
    var crSrc = ctx.createBufferSource();
    crSrc.buffer = _makeWhiteNoise(ctx, 2);
    crSrc.loop = true;
    var crBp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    crBp.type = 'bandpass';
    crBp.frequency.value = 2000;
    crBp.Q.value = 3;
    var crG = ctx.createGain();
    crG.gain.value = 0.06;
    var crLfo = ctx.createOscillator();
    crLfo.type = 'sine';
    crLfo.frequency.value = 0.5;
    var crLfoG = ctx.createGain();
    crLfoG.gain.value = 0.04;
    crLfo.connect(crLfoG);
    crLfoG.connect(crG.gain);
    crSrc.connect(crBp);
    crBp.connect(crG);
    crG.connect(dest);
    crSrc.start();
    crLfo.start();
    nodes.push(crSrc, crBp, crG, crLfo, crLfoG);
    return nodes;
  }

  // -- Birdsong: oscillator chirps with frequency modulation --
  function _buildBirdsongAudio(ctx, dest) {
    var nodes = [];
    // Soft breeze background
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = _makeWhiteNoise(ctx, 4);
    src.loop = true;
    var bp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    bp.type = 'bandpass';
    bp.frequency.value = 1500;
    bp.Q.value = 0.3;
    var g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.value = 0.04;
    src.connect(bp);
    bp.connect(g);
    g.connect(dest);
    src.start();
    nodes.push(src, bp, g);

    var birdFreqs = [2200, 3200, 4400];
    for (var bi = 0; bi < birdFreqs.length; bi++) {
      var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = birdFreqs[bi];
      var bLfo = ctx.createOscillator();
      bLfo.type = 'sine';

  // ============================================================
  // Timer
  // ============================================================

  function _setTimer(mins) {
    _timerMinutes = mins;
    for (var i = 0; i < _timerBtns.length; i++) {
      if (i === 0 && mins === 0) {
        _timerBtns[i].classList.add('active');
      } else if (i > 0 && TIMER_OPTIONS[i - 1] === mins) {
        _timerBtns[i].classList.add('active');
      } else {
        _timerBtns[i].classList.remove('active');
      }
    }

    if (_radarSources.length > 0 && mins > 0) {
      _startTimer();
    } else if (mins === 0) {
      _clearTimer();
      if (_timerDisplayEl) {
        _timerDisplayEl.textContent = '';
      }
    }
  }

  function _startTimer() {
    _clearTimer();
    _timerStartTime = Date.now();
    _timerIntervalId = setInterval(function() {
      _updateTimer();
    }, 1000);
  }

  function _clearTimer() {
    if (_timerIntervalId) {
      clearInterval(_timerIntervalId);
      _timerIntervalId = null;
    }
  }

  function _updateTimer() {
    if (_timerMinutes <= 0) {
      return;
    }
    var elapsed = (Date.now() - _timerStartTime) / 1000;
    var total = _timerMinutes * 60;
    var remaining = total - elapsed;

    if (remaining <= 0) {
      _clearTimer();
      _removeAllSources();
      if (_timerDisplayEl) {
        _timerDisplayEl.textContent = '00:00';
      }
    } else {
      if (_timerDisplayEl) {
        _timerDisplayEl.textContent = _formatTimer(remaining);
      }
      // Fade out in the last FADE_OUT_DURATION_SEC seconds
      if (remaining <= FADE_OUT_DURATION_SEC && _masterGain) {
        var fadeFraction = remaining / FADE_OUT_DURATION_SEC;
        _masterGain.gain.value = _volume * fadeFraction;
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Init / Activate / Deactivate
  // ============================================================

  function _init() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }
    _initialized = true;
    _buildScreen();
  }

  function activate(tabId) {
    _init();
    _active = true;

    if (tabId === 'wellness') {
      var container = document.getElementById('screen-calm');
      if (container) {
        var existing = document.getElementById('calm-wellness-banner');
        if (!existing) {
          var banner = document.createElement('div');
          banner.id = 'calm-wellness-banner';
          banner.style.cssText = 'text-align:center;padding:8px;color:#88ccaa;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1px;';
          banner.textContent = 'Wellness Mode \u2014 Breathe and relax';
          container.insertBefore(banner, container.firstChild);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function deactivate() {
    _active = false;
    _removeAllSources();
    _stopRenderLoop();
    if (_masterGain) {
      try { _masterGain.disconnect(); } catch (e) { /* */ }
      _masterGain = null;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Public API
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenCalm = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };

  // Delay (ms) before resizing canvas after screen becomes visible
  var RESIZE_DELAY_MS = 50;

  var _initialized = false;
  var _canvas = null;
  var _canvasCtx = null;
  var _dpr = 1;

  // ============================================================
  // Initialization (runs once on first activate)
  // ============================================================

  function _initOnce() {
    if (_initialized) {
      return;
    }
    _initialized = true;

    _canvas = document.getElementById('spCanvas');
    if (_canvas) {
      _canvasCtx = _canvas.getContext('2d');
    }

    _wireToolbar();
    _wirePalette();
    _wireRecipeSelect();
    _wireImport();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Canvas sizing
  // ============================================================

  function _resizeCanvas() {
    if (!_canvas) {
      return;
    }

    // Switch the patchEditor to render on the sidebar canvas
    // and use the sidebar param panel for node editing
    if (SL.patchEditor && SL.patchEditor.setCanvas) {
      SL.patchEditor.setCanvas('spCanvas', 'spParamPanel');
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Toolbar wiring
  // ============================================================

  function _wireToolbar() {
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('spPlayBtn');
    var stopBtn = document.getElementById('spStopBtn');
    var clearBtn = document.getElementById('spClearBtn');

    if (playBtn) {
      playBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.patchEngine) {
          SL.patchEngine.start();
        }
      });
    }

    if (stopBtn) {
      stopBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.patchEngine) {
          SL.patchEngine.stop();
        }
      });
    }

    if (clearBtn) {
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.patchEngine) {
          SL.patchEngine.stop();
        }
        // Re-init editor with empty state
        if (SL.patchEditor && SL.patchEditor.renderPatch) {
          SL.patchEditor.renderPatch(null);
        }
      });
    }

    // Record to Sample button
    var recBtn = document.getElementById('spRecordBtn');
    var REC_SVG = '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;"><circle cx="8" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M4,6 L4,8 Q4,12 8,13 Q12,12 12,8 L12,6"/><line x1="8" y1="13" x2="8" y2="15"/><line x1="5" y1="15" x2="11" y2="15"/></svg>';
    if (recBtn) {
      recBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (SL.recordSample && SL.recordSample.isRecording()) {
          // Stop recording
          SL.recordSample.stopRecording();
          recBtn.innerHTML = REC_SVG + ' Record to Sample';
          recBtn.style.color = '#ff6666';
          recBtn.classList.remove('recording');
        } else {
          // Ensure patch is playing
          if (SL.patchEngine && !SL.patchEngine.isPlaying()) {
            SL.patchEngine.start();
            if (playBtn) {
              playBtn.classList.add('active');
            }
          }
          // Start recording
          if (SL.recordSample) {
            SL.recordSample.startRecording(function(buffer, length) {
              recBtn.innerHTML = REC_SVG + ' Record to Sample';
              recBtn.style.color = '#ff6666';
              recBtn.classList.remove('recording');
              // Auto-load into sampler on current instrument
              var instIdx = SL.audio ? SL.audio.getCurrentInstrument() : 0;
              if (SL.recordSample.loadIntoSampler) {
                SL.recordSample.loadIntoSampler(instIdx);
              }
              alert('Recorded ' + (length / 48000).toFixed(1) + 's into sampler (Instrument ' + (instIdx + 1) + ')');
            });
            recBtn.innerHTML = REC_SVG + ' Stop Recording';
            recBtn.style.color = '#ff4444';
            recBtn.classList.add('recording');
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Palette wiring
  // ============================================================

  function _wirePalette() {
    var toggle = document.getElementById('spPaletteToggle');
    var palette = document.getElementById('spPalette');

    var PALETTE_SVG = '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6"/><line x1="8" y1="5" x2="8" y2="11"/><line x1="5" y1="8" x2="11" y2="8"/></svg>';
    if (toggle && palette) {
      toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (palette.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
          palette.classList.remove('collapsed');
          toggle.innerHTML = PALETTE_SVG + ' - Add Node';
        } else {
          palette.classList.add('collapsed');
          toggle.innerHTML = PALETTE_SVG + ' + Add Node';
        }
        // Resize canvas after palette toggle
        setTimeout(function() {
          _resizeCanvas();
        }, 250);
      });
    }

    // Palette item clicks — use sp-palette-item class to avoid
    // conflicting with classic view .palette-item handlers.
    // Walk up from event target to find the data-type attribute,
    // since clicks may land on child SVG elements.
    var items = document.querySelectorAll('.sp-palette-item');
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      items[i].addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var el = e.target;
        while (el && !el.getAttribute('data-type')) {
          el = el.parentElement;
        }
        var nodeType = el ? el.getAttribute('data-type') : null;
        if (nodeType && SL.patchEditor && SL.patchEditor.addNodeFromPalette) {
          SL.patchEditor.addNodeFromPalette(nodeType);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Recipe dropdown
  // ============================================================

  function _loadRecipe(name) {
    if (!name || !SL.patchRecipes) {
      return;
    }
    var recipe = SL.patchRecipes.getByName(name);
    if (recipe) {
      var patchJson = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(recipe));
      if (SL.patchEngine) {
        SL.patchEngine.stop();
        SL.patchEngine.loadPatch(patchJson);
      }
      if (SL.patchEditor) {
        SL.patchEditor.renderPatch(patchJson);
      }
      // Update active card
      _setActiveRecipeCard(name);
    }
  }

  function _setActiveRecipeCard(name) {
    var browser = document.querySelector('.sp-recipe-browser');
    if (!browser) {
      return;
    }
    var cards = browser.querySelectorAll('.sp-recipe-card');
    for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      if (cards[i].getAttribute('data-recipe') === name) {
        cards[i].classList.add('active');
      } else {
        cards[i].classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
  }

  function _wireRecipeSelect() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('spRecipeSelect');
    if (!sel || !SL.patchRecipes) {
      return;
    }

    // Find parent container and hide the old select
    var parentLabel = sel.parentElement;
    if (parentLabel) {
      sel.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // Check if patchIcons is available
    var hasIcons = !!(SL.patchIcons && SL.patchIcons.getCategorySvg && SL.patchIcons.getRecipeSvg);

    // Build the card grid browser
    var browser = document.createElement('div');
    browser.className = 'sp-recipe-browser';

    var categories = SL.patchRecipes.getCategories();
    for (var c = 0; c < categories.length; c++) {
      var cat = categories[c];
      var catDiv = document.createElement('div');
      catDiv.className = 'sp-recipe-category';

      // Category header
      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sp-recipe-cat-header';

      if (hasIcons) {
        var catIconSpan = document.createElement('span');
        catIconSpan.className = 'sp-recipe-cat-icon';
        catIconSpan.innerHTML = SL.patchIcons.getCategorySvg(cat);
        header.appendChild(catIconSpan);
      }

      var catNameSpan = document.createElement('span');
      catNameSpan.className = 'sp-recipe-cat-name';
      catNameSpan.textContent = cat;
      header.appendChild(catNameSpan);

      catDiv.appendChild(header);

      // Recipe card grid
      var grid = document.createElement('div');
      grid.className = 'sp-recipe-cat-grid';

      var recipes = SL.patchRecipes.getByCategory(cat);
      for (var r = 0; r < recipes.length; r++) {
        var card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'sp-recipe-card';
        card.setAttribute('data-recipe', recipes[r].name);
        card.setAttribute('title', recipes[r].description || recipes[r].name);

        if (hasIcons) {
          var iconDiv = document.createElement('div');
          iconDiv.className = 'sp-recipe-card-icon';
          iconDiv.innerHTML = SL.patchIcons.getRecipeSvg(recipes[r].name);
          card.appendChild(iconDiv);
        }

        var nameDiv = document.createElement('div');
        nameDiv.className = 'sp-recipe-card-name';
        nameDiv.textContent = recipes[r].name;
        card.appendChild(nameDiv);

        card.addEventListener('click', (function(recipeName) {
          return function() {
            _loadRecipe(recipeName);
            // Close the popover after selecting a recipe
            var br = document.querySelector('.sp-recipe-browser');
            if (br) { br.classList.remove('open'); }
          };
        })(recipes[r].name));

        grid.appendChild(card);
      }

      catDiv.appendChild(grid);
      browser.appendChild(catDiv);
    }

    // Insert the browser into the toolbar (positioned absolutely via CSS)
    if (parentLabel && parentLabel.parentElement) {
      parentLabel.parentElement.appendChild(browser);
    }

    // Toggle recipe browser open/closed when clicking the label
    if (parentLabel) {
      parentLabel.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      parentLabel.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        browser.classList.toggle('open');
      });
    }

    // Close browser when clicking outside
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (browser.classList.contains('open') && !browser.contains(e.target) && e.target !== parentLabel && !parentLabel.contains(e.target)) {
        browser.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // PD Import
  // ============================================================

  function _wireImport() {
    var importBtn = document.getElementById('spImportPdBtn');
    var fileInput = document.getElementById('spPdFileInput');

    if (importBtn && fileInput) {
      importBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        fileInput.click();
      });

      fileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
        var file = e.target.files[0];
        if (file) {
          var reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = function(evt) {
            var pdText = evt.target.result;
            if (SL.pdImport) {
              var patchJson = SL.pdImport.parse(pdText);
              if (SL.patchEngine) {
                SL.patchEngine.stop();
                SL.patchEngine.loadPatch(patchJson);
              }
              if (SL.patchEditor) {
                SL.patchEditor.renderPatch(patchJson);
              }
            }
          };
          reader.readAsText(file);
          fileInput.value = '';
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Screen lifecycle
  // ============================================================

  function activate() {
    var firstTime = !_initialized;
    _initOnce();

    // Re-init patchEditor on the sidebar canvas and resize
    setTimeout(function() {
      _resizeCanvas();
      // Auto-load a default recipe on first visit so the canvas is not empty
      if (firstTime && SL.patchRecipes && SL.patchEngine) {
        var defaultRecipe = SL.patchRecipes.getByName('Fire Crackle');
        if (!defaultRecipe) {
          defaultRecipe = SL.patchRecipes.getByName('Wind');
        }
        if (defaultRecipe) {
          var patchJson = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultRecipe));
          SL.patchEngine.loadPatch(patchJson);
          if (SL.patchEditor && SL.patchEditor.refresh) {
            SL.patchEditor.refresh();
          }
        }
      }
    }, RESIZE_DELAY_MS);
  }

  function deactivate() {
    // Stop playback when leaving the patch screen
    if (SL.patchEngine && SL.patchEngine.stop) {
      SL.patchEngine.stop();
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Public API
  // ============================================================

  SL.screenPatch = {
    activate: activate,
    deactivate: deactivate
  };

})();

</script>
